Title: Senior Assortment Analyst
Description:
Overview

REI Co-op works together to find better ways to work. The goal is to help people enjoy the outdoors. Working for the co-op means doing your best work. Support is given to help you live your best life. You also help shape the future of the outdoors for people and the planet.

This job contributes to REI’s success by developing location attribution, clustering and space planning solutions that support locally relevant, productive assortments across the existing retail fleet. The role uses sales, productivity, space, customer, product and location insights to inform assortment size recommendations, seasonal audits and location-based assortment strategies. Models and acts in accordance with REI’s guiding values and mission.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities and Qualifications


Develops processes, tools and location attribution inputs that support clustering, space planning and assortment decisions across the existing retail fleet, using attributes such as store location, activity, climate, customer profile, demographics, skill level and value tier.
Builds location assortment solutions that improve local relevance and productivity; incorporates customer, product, sales, space and location insights while gaining alignment with key business partners.
Defines and applies productivity measures that inform assortment size, space allocation and location-based recommendations across stores.
Translates productivity trends, category performance, regional affinity, customer insights and location attributes into recommendations that influence assortment breadth, depth and space decisions.
Supports seasonal Category Management audits by evaluating assortment size, space and location attribute opportunities and helping prioritize recommended actions.
Measures the effectiveness of location-based assortment and attribution initiatives; communicates results, insights and recommendations to improve future planning decisions.
Builds effective partnerships with cross-divisional stakeholders, including Merchandising product and planning teams, Physical Place/Visual Merchandising, Analytics, Retail and Strategy.



Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Business, Merchandising or relevant field of study
3 to 5 years of merchandising, planning, analytics, or related experience involving customer and product trend analysis.
Elevated proficiency in MS Office suite including Outlook, Word, PowerPoint and Excel
Advanced proficiency in SQL, Snowflake, Excel and analytical modeling preferred; experience with clustering, location attribution, customer segmentation or space productivity analysis a plus.
Demonstrated ability to balance quantitative data and qualitative business input to make sound and effective decisions
Recognition of patterns, trends and relationships between customer needs, products and locations



Closing

At REI, we believe the outdoors is for all. We are committed to becoming a fully inclusive, anti-racist, multicultural organization. We know that there's strength in our diversity – that each employee brings unique skills, experiences, and perspectives. Every day you are driving change, fostering a culture of respect, and knowing you're backed by benefits that support your whole life. To work towards this commitment and fulfill our brand promise of inspiring and enabling a life outside for everyone, we seek employees who demonstrate different ways of working, create a sense of belonging, and actively listen and learn.

Pay Transparency

We are committed to practices that promote pay equity and transparency. As required by applicable Pay Transparency laws, REI provides a range of compensation for roles that may be hired in locations under these requirements. Factors that may be used to determine your actual salary may include a wide array of factors, including: your specific skills and experience, geographic location or other relevant factors.

REI offers all regular employees a generous employee discount, access to health benefits, a retirement savings plan and accrued time off. Click here for a detailed overview of benefits plans by employee profile.

Pay Range

$85,400.00 - $136,700.00 per year

About us




Network Rail Consulting (NRC) is the international consultancy arm of Network Rail – the owner and operator of Britain’s mainline rail system. We have been active in the North American, Australian and the Middle East markets since 2013 and have successfully delivered more than 150 consultancy contracts for government, public and privately owned organizations.




Through our consulting services in the United States (US), we are assisting both public agencies and private clients in the transportation sector to accelerate transformation efforts, make step-changes in major program delivery, and achieve leaps forward in areas such as asset management & maintenance, major projects, railway operations, strategic planning and advisory.




Our work is driven forward by our values: agile, always safe, care about people, collaborative, impartial and passionate.




About the Role




NRC supports multiple US clients from our strategic locations in Washington DC, New York City, and Boston, as well as West Coast clients from our offices in California and Seattle.




We are seeking a Data Analyst for our Seattle location.




You will provide support to our internal project teams and our clients to extract, compile, analyze and visualize data to help us make informed decisions that drive improvement in the way that transit assets are managed. Creating impactful PowerPoint presentations is a significant part of the role.




The initial client work will be with Sound Transit and King County Metro staff, focusing on data related to work orders, inventory, training data, and project dashboards.




What will you be doing?




Compile data from client systems including Trapeze EAM, Maximo EAM, and various LMS / EAM / ERP systems for training and inventory data.
Perform data mapping to support data migration and data conformance evaluation.
Develop data definition/dictionaries with SMEs.
Evaluate data quality against agency data quality metrics.
Develop data standards through partnering with data governance program.
Communicate to business on the remediation plan needed and develop plans to support next steps work on data remediation.
Develop reference data and taxonomies.
Provide feedback on data remediation recommendations.
Extract and organize data for analysis and trending and compares ERP/EAM Program needs and requirements.
Ensure data quality and compliance with applicable state and federal laws and regulations.
Design and build dashboards in Excel and Power BI for internal and external use.
Prepare PowerPoint presentations for internal and external use.
Assist the Client, Project Manager or project team as required.




About You




Applicants should be a recent graduate with a bachelor’s or master’s Degree or equivalent in a relevant field.




You are passionate about data and ways that data can tell a story. You have strong analytical and critical thinking skills; strong formal report, presentation and note writing skills, proficiency in spreadsheet manipulation; great attention to detail and communication skills.




Highly skilled in Power BI, Excel, and PowerPoint
Excellent communicator and writer
Experience in MS Co-Pilot
A highly capable visual storyteller that can make data easy to understand
An excellent listener that can work independently with clients
Experience with EAM / CMMS applications is strongly preferred.
Previous experience with ERP / LMS / GIS applications is desirable but not essential.




For the right person, this role presents a fantastic opportunity to develop their career, joining an established and passionate team, with ambitious plans to grow.




We offer benefits such as:




Competitive compensation packages
Healthcare insurance premiums (100% paid for by us)
Generous vacation leave entitlement
401K with employer matching contributions
Access to Employee Discount Program via LifeMart




NRC supports flexible working practices, and we understand that life balance is an important part of our employees' lives. We offer a wide range of flexible work/life balance options such as hybrid (home/office) working, flexible working hours where appropriate.




Candidate must be eligible to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsored work authorization now or in the future

Title: Senior Data Solutions Analyst: Operational Data & Reporting team
Description:
Description

Ensuring that data is a competitive differentiator for our enterprise, the USRM Data Office sets strategic data product visions, governs data for quality and compliance, develops best in class data and reporting solutions, and continuously seeks to optimize the value that data creates for our customers and company. Our team includes data analysts, data stewards, data strategists, and data product owners — performance-driven individuals who make sure that data is appropriately leveraged across every layer of our business.

The Operational Data & Reporting team within USRM Data Office is seeking a Senior Data Solutions Analyst focusing on scalable data & reporting solutions and insights for a range of stakeholders within our Direct Distribution and Partnerships reporting team.

This position may have in-office requirements dependent upon candidate location

Candidates who live within 50 miles of Boston, MA; Portsmouth, NH; Seattle, WA; Columbus, OH; or Plano, TX will follow a hybrid schedule, coming into the office two days per week. Otherwise, this role is remote.

Responsibilities


Design and develop scalable data solutions with a focus on reusability that enable effective self-service data consumption and can describe their value to the customer.
Independently works on prototyping/developing data solutions that meet the needs of the organization and business customers. Coding scalable proof-of-concepts and solutions.
Stay up to date with advancements in data engineering, evaluate new tools and recommend adoption where appropriate.
Identify opportunities to apply Gen AI for data discovery, lineage summarization, automated documentation, query generation and developer productivity (prompt engineering and code generation)
Designs proof-of-concept solutions utilizing and advanced understanding of multiple coding languages to meet technical and business requirements with an ability to perform iterative solution testing to ensure specifications are met.
Strive to become a technical leader and mentor for the team, providing assistance & guidance to junior team members
Optimize and tune data infrastructure for performance, scalability, reliability and cost-efficiency
Prioritizes efforts based on customer value and can set expectations for deliverables of high complexity.
Ensure data solutions include activities and deliverables required to achieve high data quality and displays a strong understanding of complex, multi-tier, multi-platform systems, applying principles of metadata, lineage, business definitions, compliance and data security to project work.


The Ideal Candidate Will


Have strong technical aptitude with data manipulation, data wrangling and Reporting tools (SQL, Power Bi, SAS, Python cloud computing: AWS and Snowflake).
Demonstrate 3+ years of experience building production data pipelines, data solutions and Power Bi Dashboards.
Possess hands-on experience with data quality testing frameworks and practices,and experience implementing automated data tests and validation.
Have excellent communication skills and the ability to work with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
3-5+ years’ experience in coding for data management, data warehousing, or other data environments, including, but not limited to, ETL & scripting languages (Python)
3-5+ years’ experience with top quadrant Business Intelligence tools. Demonstrated technical knowledge and skills in coding languages and business intelligence tools (e.g., SQL, Power BI SAS, Python) and interest in expanding knowledge in this space.
Must possess strong analytical, strategic, project management, decision-making and problem-solving skills.
Direct Distribution domain knowledge preferred but not required.
Demonstrates a comprehensive understanding of new technologies as needed to progress initiative and ability to adapt
Able to describe value and support the prioritization of data solutions.
Able to organize and address customer pain points.


Qualifications


Strong written and oral communication skills required
Bachelor`s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related discipline preferred
Master`s in same or related disciplines strongly preferred
3-5 years experience in coding for data management, data warehousing, or other data environments, including, but not limited to, working in NoSQL implementation, ETL, Java, scripting languages (Python, Perl, Shell), and the Hadoop stack

Title: Strategy Systems Analyst (Strategic Planning Analyst II)
Description:
Are you a tech-savvy data professional who thrives on translating complex operational data into actionable insights? The Mobility Infrastructure Services (MIS) section within the Parks and Roads Services branch is seeking a collaborative Strategic Systems Analyst to join our Business Performance and Analytics (BPA) Team.

Reporting to the Supervisor, Business Performance and Analytics, the Strategic Systems Analyst serves as an embedded technical and analytical partner supporting the Mobility Infrastructure Operations (MIO) unit—including Snow and Ice Control, Spring Sweep, and Reactive Sanitation programs—with additional support across Mobility Infrastructure Services (MIS) priorities as directed.

In this dynamic role, you will bridge the gap between complex field operations and enterprise IT systems. You will design, build, and maintain automated ETL data pipelines, custom mobile field applications, and interactive visual dashboards in Tableau. By working directly alongside frontline crews and section leadership, you will translate raw operational data into clear, actionable "Data Stories" and robust KPI frameworks that drive data-informed decision-making across the City.

If you are passionate about business intelligence, data governance, data visualization, continuous improvement, and helping the team thrive, we encourage you to apply!

What will you do?


Design, deploy, and maintain interactive, responsive dashboards using Tableau, Power BI, and Google Looker Studio aligned with the MIS Reporting Framework
Support the implementation of the MIS Performance Management Framework and build Enterprise Performance Measures aligned with corporate, branch, and section goals
Maintain KPI registries for the assigned MIO portfolio, analyze system data, and define operational baselines against unit KPIs and service levels
Design integrations for data pipelines, ensuring that the data sourced from an array of databases or systems is efficiently gathered and stored within the City of Edmonton's agreed database
Develop and configure custom operational tools, web interfaces, and mobile data collection apps using AppSheet, Google Apps Script, ESRI Field Maps, and ArcGIS QuickCapture
Use existing, corporate-approved software to address operational demands and may need to work collaboratively with the Service Innovation and Performance (SIP) team or the Department Strategy Section (DSS) to build solutions that assist in the collection, storage, evaluation, and reporting of information
Respond to routine and ad hoc requests for information from a variety of stakeholders
Turn operational data into clear insights and establish reliable, automated reporting processes
Act as a technical support, addressing and rectifying issues related to the analytical and operational software/programming tools designed by the Business Performance and Analytics team and used by the Mobility Infrastructure Operations unit



Qualifications:


University degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Statistics, or a related Engineering/Computer Science field
Minimum of five (5) years of experience in business software development, business intelligence analysis, statistics, or software project management



Assets:


Supporting education or professional training in software development, IT systems, process improvement, or business analytics
Project Management Professional (PMP) designation and/or Change Management certification



Skills required for success:


Scripting & Database Engineering: Strong proficiency in AppsScript, Python, JavaScript, C++, SQL, FME, GCP (BigQuery), and ERP integration concepts (e.g., SAP / SAP S/4 HANA)
BI & Dashboard Development: Expert-level mastery of Tableau, Power BI, Google Looker Studio, Google AppSheet, and Google Sheets
Analytics & Data Storytelling: Advanced ability in complex data modeling, data cleansing, statistical analysis, and translating data into audience-tailored narratives
Business Analysis & IT Governance: Solid expertise in business process modeling, IT architectural standards, data governance, and emerging technology evaluation
Interpersonal & Communication Skills: Exceptional ability to build relationships, engage diverse stakeholders (from frontline staff to executive leaders), and balance competing priorities in a public sector environment
Troubleshooting: Ability to troubleshoot systems, conduct solution maintenance, and ensure compliance with IT architectural and security standards
Geospatial & Field Mobility Systems: Working knowledge of ArcGIS Online/Pro, ESRI Field Maps, ArcGIS QuickCapture, and JSON integrations with geodatabases
Alignment to our Cultural Commitments and Leadership Competencies ( https://bit.ly/4brRrXm )
Embracing a culture of equity, diversity, reconciliation and inclusion



Work Environment:


Occasional visits to field locations, yards, or operational locations across the city to connect directly with operational teams and field staff

Title: Data Analyst II, Fraud
Description:
Job Description:

At Remitly, we believe everyone deserves the freedom to access, move, and manage their money wherever life takes them. Since 2011, we've tirelessly delivered on our promise to customers sending money globally, providing secure, simple, and reliable ways to manage their money, ensuring true peace of mind.

Whether it's supporting loved ones back home, growing a business across continents, or pursuing new opportunities abroad, we're not just here to move money— we're here to move our global customers forward.

We're looking for builders, reimaginers, and global thinkers who want to work at the intersection of technology, trust, and transformation. If that's you and you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career—we invite you to join over 2,800 passionate Remitlians worldwide who are united by our vision to transform lives with trusted financial services that transcend borders

About the Role:

As a Data Analyst, Fraud, you will be part of Remitly's Identity & Trust Analytics Team. Your mission is to leverage analytical methods to identify, prevent, and mitigate fraud impacting our customers globally. You will develop a deep understanding of Remitly's fraud detection systems, regional risk profiles, and operational processes to improve fraud defenses while maintaining a seamless experience for legitimate customers. You'll partner with Product, Engineering, Business Management, and Compliance to customize and optimize fraud models and workflows, integrating data from legacy and new platforms. This hybrid role requires 2–3 days per week in the Vancouver office.

You Will:


Become an expert on Remitly's fraud data (e.g. chargebacks, promo abuse, scams, onboarding risk).
Build data-driven models and dashboards to analyze and monitor fraud exposure, balancing customer experience with operational efficiency.
Collect, normalize, and analyze data from legacy prebriefs, transaction logs, and onboarding systems to identify fraud trends and behavior anomalies.
Partner with Business Management and Product to continuously improve customer verification, KYC, KYB and compliance workflows.
Design and evaluate experiments and A/B tests to measure fraud control effectiveness and minimize false positives.
Develop and track risk metrics that quantify fraud exposure, policy compliance, and system performance.
Provide actionable insights and influence the development of fraud detection strategies, tools, and automation.


You Have:


3+ years in an analytics or fraud/risk analysis role within fintech, e-commerce, or digital payments.
Experience with fraud or trust analytics.
Bachelor's degree in mathematics, engineering, economics, or another quantitative discipline (or equivalent experience).
Proficiency with SQL and hands-on experience analyzing large datasets (Python, R, or statistical modeling experience preferred).
Strong understanding of fraud taxonomies (chargebacks, identity theft, scams, onboarding risk, and promo abuse).
Demonstrated ability to distill business problems, develop hypotheses, perform analysis, and communicate clear recommendations.
Excellent data storytelling and communication skills; ability to translate complex findings into business decisions.


Compensation Details. The starting base salary range for this position is $100,000 - $125000. In Canada, Remitly employees are shareholders in our Company and equity is part of our total compensation plan. Your recruiter can share more information about medical benefits offered, as well as other financial benefits and total compensation components offered with this role.

Our Benefits


Four weeks vacation
Health Benefits
Mental Health & Family Forming Benefits
RRSP plan with company match
Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
Life Insurance & Disability
Continuing education and travel benefits


Our Connected Work Culture: Driving Innovation, Together

At Remitly, we believe that true innovation sparks when we come together. Our Connected Work Culture fosters dynamic in-person collaboration, where ideas ignite and challenging problems find solutions faster. For corporate team members, we have an in-office expectation of at least 50% of the time monthly, typically achieved by coming in three days a week. This creates a consistent, meaningful overlap that supports team norms and business needs. Managers also have the flexibility to set higher expectations based on their team's specific needs. These intentional in-office moments are vital for deepening relationships, fueling creativity, and ensuring your impact is felt where it matters most.

Remitly is an E-Verify Employer

At Remitly, we are dedicated to ensuring that our workplace offers equal employment opportunities to all employees and candidates, in full compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

Remitly is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Job Overview




We are seeking a Pricing Analyst to join our team and help drive strategic, data-informed pricing decisions across our fastener and industrial component product lines. In this role, you will analyze cost structures, margins, market trends, and competitive pricing to develop pricing strategies that balance profitability with market competitiveness.




Working closely with the Sales, Purchasing, and Finance teams, you will ensure pricing decisions align with both customer expectations and business objectives. You will also leverage advanced Excel and data analysis tools to support pricing initiatives, improve reporting processes, and provide actionable insights. This position reports directly to the Manager, Pricing.


This is a mid-level role best suited for a candidate with hands-on experience in pricing analysis, cost analysis, or revenue management, ideally within an industrial distribution, manufacturing, wholesale, or other B2B environment. The successful candidate will be highly analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with large data sets to support business decision-making in a fast-paced environment.










Responsibilities





Monitor vendor cost changes, commodity trends (steel, raw materials), and freight/tariff impacts, and adjust pricing models accordingly.


Conduct competitive pricing analysis within the fastener and industrial distribution market to identify opportunities and risks.


Build and maintain pricing models, price books, and matrices used by the sales team for quoting.


Partner with sales on customer-specific and contract pricing within our pricing framework.


Track pricing performance and margin trends, flagging anomalies or erosion for leadership review.


Support price list updates, including communication of changes to internal teams and customers.


Collaborate with purchasing/procurement to align pricing strategy with cost changes and inventory positioning.


Prepare regular reporting and dashboards on pricing, margin, and profitability metrics for leadership.


Assist in developing pricing policies and approval workflows aligned with our pricing model.


Build and maintain Python scripts/tools to automate pricing calculations, data cleanup, and recurring reporting.





Qualifications





2-5 years of experience in pricing analysis, cost analysis, or a related financial/analytical role — experience in fastener, industrial distribution, or manufacturing industries strongly preferred.


Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.


Advanced Excel proficiency is required, including expertise with complex formulas, pivot tables, lookups, data analysis, and large/complex workbooks. This is a core requirement for the role.


Working knowledge of Python is required for automating pricing calculations, data cleansing, reporting, and workflow optimization.


Strong understanding of pricing methodologies, including margin analysis, cost-plus pricing, list-less pricing, and competitive pricing strategies.


Experience working with ERP systems such as NetSuite, Epicor, SAP, Infor, or similar platforms is considered an asset.


Proven ability to analyze large data sets and translate findings into clear, actionable business recommendations.


Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across sales, purchasing, finance, and other cross-functional teams.


Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, with a strong understanding of the business impact of pricing decisions and errors.

How does this role contribute to our collective success?

We are seeking a skilled Data Engineer to join our dynamic Data & Analytics team, within the Platforms & Transformation group. This is an excellent opportunity to work within great teams across the business on complex, challenging and rewarding projects and initiatives to build towards the success of AXIS.

What will you do in this role?

Data Analysis & Modelling:


Work with the business teams, including senior leaders, to define the data products and use cases along with their data lineage, critical data elements, data glossaries and data quality rules.
Work with the Data Architecture team to enable the design of best-in-class current state and future state data flow diagrams
Partner with the Data Insights and AI & Innovation teams to design the outputs and workflows for Use Cases and Data Products.
Use your industry experience to define the metrics required for projects and solutions.
Lead the QA testing of data products and supporting the business teams during UAT.
Support the future phases of data products you have delivered in projects once live where you are considered a subject matter expert and have a relationship with the business teams.



Data Engineering:


Run simple and complex queries to understand existing data structures and relationships, data quality gaps and metric formulas to enable accurate documentation of the current state solutions.
Use your advanced Excel skills to reverse engineer complex workbooks with macros and layered formulas to enable modular redesign in our modern data architecture.
Build and execute test models against both on-premises SQL Server and Azure Databricks databases.
Work closely with the development teams to ensure your data product templates are clearly defined to the specifications required by the application delivery leads.
You may also be required to take on additional duties, responsibilities and activities appropriate to the nature of this role.

We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table, so while there are some qualifications and experiences, we need you to have, we are open to discussing how your individual knowledge might lend itself to fulfilling this role and help us achieve our goals.

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related technical field (or equivalent work experience).
4+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar data-focused role.
Very strong SQL and Excel experience
Design experience with star schemas and delta concepts
Experience in data modelling in Excel having worked within Data Governance and Data Quality frameworks
Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to understanding data quality issues and challenges
Experience with large complex projects delivering data products and use cases
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.
Ability to time manage and work across different priorities.



What we prefer you to have:


Insurance industry experience.
Microsoft SQL Server and Azure Databricks experience
Ability to read programming languages
Knowledge of Insurance KPIs and metrics and processing within Underwriting, Claims and Pricing
Experience taking a key role on Data & Analytics projects



Role Factors:

In this role, you will typically be required to:

This position is a hybrid role and will require mandatory in office presence 3 days per week.

For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $75,000 - $120,000 CAD (Nova Scotia). Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location. 

You will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid annual leave, and much more.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Location: Vancouver / Toronto / Remote in Canada | Employment Type: Full-time |

Reports to: Senior Data Analyst, Team Lead

Reporting to Senior Data Analyst, Team Lead, we're looking for a curious and collaborative Data Analyst (Survey Tabulations) to join Reach3 Insights. In this role, you'll help turn survey data into accurate, decision-ready cross-tabulations, working with smart, kind people who love turning human insights into clear stories, stronger decisions, and better customer experiences.

This role is open to candidates based in Canada, with a remote working model designed to support connection, focused work, and real life outside of work.

About Reach3 Insights

Reach3 Insights is a full-service research consultancy that helps modern brands move faster and get closer to their customers through mobile-first, conversational research. We design immersive, in-the-moment research programs, pair them with smart data science and dynamic storytelling, and turn insight into action.

As part of Rival Group — alongside Rival Technologies and Angus Reid — we're helping transform the insights industry through AI-accelerated, messaging-based conversational insights. Our work reaches consumers and business audiences in ways that feel fresh, human, and genuinely useful.

We work with ambitious teams and global brands, and we take the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. You'll find a team that values trust, curiosity, ownership, creativity, and having a good time while doing meaningful work.

What you'll own


Produce accurate, well-formatted cross-tabulations from survey data using WinCross, SPSS, Microsoft Excel, and other relevant tools; review questionnaires and tabulation plans, clarify requirements, and deliver accurate outputs.
Complete rigorous quality checks on survey data and tables, investigate discrepancies, collaborate to resolve issues, and advise researchers on how to structure and interpret analysis outputs across different survey methods and designs.
Plan and prioritize work in ClickUp, track output, and improve turnaround time, accuracy, and productivity by testing AI and emerging tools, recommending process improvements, supporting new tool rollouts, and maintaining training and process documentation.


What you bring


At least 2 years of professional experience preparing, transforming, and tabulating market research survey data, plus a university or college degree or graduate certificate in market research, analytics, statistics, economics, social sciences, or another field involving research methods and data analysis.
Hands-on proficiency with SPSS and WinCross, strong Microsoft Excel skills, and experience working with survey datasets and producing cross-tabulations.
Clear, concise written and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative approach when working with local and remote teammates and research stakeholders.
A proactive, curious approach to change and ambiguity, with the judgment to test new ideas responsibly, evaluate their impact, and continuously improve data analysis workflows.
The ability to prioritize high-impact work, manage competing deadlines, stay organized, and consistently deliver accurate, high-quality outputs in a fast-moving environment.
Accountability for goals and deliverables, with the ability to work independently, collaborate effectively as part of a team, and bring a positive, solutions-oriented mindset as priorities evolve.


Nice to have


Familiarity with questionnaires, table specifications, banners, filters, and weighting is an asset.
Experience working in market research or public opinion research is preferred.


Why Reach3 for your next career adventure?

At Reach3, how we work matters just as much as what we deliver. We're building a place where people can do meaningful work, grow their careers, partner with great clients, and enjoy the humans they work with along the way.

Fair compensation: We're committed to pay equity and fair pay practices. The salary range for this role is $65,000 to $85,000, with final compensation based on skills, experience, and internal equity.


Home office, internet, and cellphone stipends
Retirement savings with employer matching
Parental leave top-up


Flexibility and time off: Flexible ways of working, home office support, and comprehensive paid time off so you can recharge and do your best work.


Hybrid or remote working model, depending on role and location
Comprehensive paid time off
Volunteer and professional development days


Health and wellness: Benefits that support the whole human, not just the employee.


Competitive health, vision, and dental benefits
Health spending account
Generous sick, personal, and mental health days
Additional health benefits with Canada Life


Our values

Our values guide how we work together, make decisions, and show up for customers and each other:


Courage
Results
Energy
Kinship


The not-so-fine print

You must be eligible to work in Canada to be considered for this role. At Reach3, we value the unique qualities and experiences each candidate brings. We personally review every application and do not use AI or automated systems to screen or filter resumes.

If you don't see yourself fully reflected in every requirement above, we still encourage you to apply. Research shows that people from underrepresented groups often apply only when they feel 100% qualified. We're proud to be an equal opportunity workplace committed to building a team culture that celebrates diversity, inclusion, and belonging.

Reach3 provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We're also committed to an accessible work environment and inclusive employment practices. If you require accommodation at any point in the selection process, please email peopleteam@rivalgroup.io.

Please note that, given our security and compliance certifications, final applicants may be required to undergo a background check. No recruiters and no phone calls, please.

Title: Data Analyst, Investment Data Management
Description:
Interested in joining one of Canada’s top performing asset managers? We are looking for a Data Analyst for an existing vacancy on our Investment Data Management (IDM) team. The IDM Team resides within the middle office and is responsible for managing data centric processes and data quality that supports the investment management business. Connor, Clark & Lunn Financial Group Ltd. (CCLFG) manages a wide range of global assets and heavily relies on the output of the Data Management Team for a variety of functions from the front office to the back. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a dynamic strategic team whose scope and importance continues to grow enterprise wide. We place a high value on maintaining an entrepreneurial spirit and creating a culture where each of us has opportunities to succeed. We are a solution orientated and collaborative team seeking like-minded individuals who thrive in a challenging and dynamic environment. Our offices currently operate on a hybrid model with a combination of in-office and remote working days throughout the week.

What You Will Do


Maintain and validate accuracy of equity/fixed income/derivative data across multiple systems/databases to enable Investment Manager modeling, trading, and risk monitoring.
Manage and enable a myriad of scheduled processes for vendor systems, internal and market data transfers, valuation, and benchmarking data inputs to the investment process.
Deliver timely data signoffs to investment teams; develop and analyze data-quality exceptions and ensure timely resolution.
Provide analysis on operational needs, ad-hoc data/data-history requests for multiple business partners to support pre- and post-trade portfolio management functions.
Identify process/workflow improvements to increase operational efficiency, mitigate risk, improve data-quality, and increase service levels provided to stakeholders.
Supporter of other operational or engineering staff, senior or managers on a variety of ad-hoc tasks and projects.


What You Bring


You have a degree in Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, Business Operations, or a related field. Relevant designation, such as the MBA, CFA, or FRM is an asset.
2-6 years of relevant experience in the investment management industry with exposure to securities data, data quality and process management. Hands-on experience working with Bloomberg, FTSE, ICE Bond Edge, Charles River and related financial tools, platforms is an asset
You possess an analytical mindset and able to break down complex processes into components to logically deduce the root cause of issues in data and technology.
You have a collaborative spirit that helps you to work well with others and you communicate effectively to team/cross-team members, and upward to key stakeholders.
You have a passion for advancing the quality, scale, and efficiency of data processes and can take ownership of multiple processes with keen attention to detail.
You constantly take a critical eye to processes with the goal of finding improvement opportunities and bring an ability to manage multiple projects.


The salary range for this position is $60,000-$90,000. The salary range provided reflects the base salary range for this position as required by legislation. In addition, there is an annual performance bonus which contributes to the total compensation for this position. Further questions may be directed to the HR team during the interview process.

  

For a closer look at how you can build your career with us, we invite you to explore cclgroup.com. 

CC&L Financial Group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation or expression, disability, or age. 

Your application will be reviewed by a member of the hiring team - AI is not used in the screening, assessment or selection of applications at this time.

Title: Business Analyst
Description:
Requisition ID: 46819

Organization

Vancouver is consistently ranked as one of the world’s most liveable and environmentally sustainable cities. Recognized among BC’s Top Employers and Canada’s Greenest Employers, the City of Vancouver is seeking colleagues who can help advance our core commitments to exceptional public service, sustainability, equity, and an outstanding quality of life for all residents.

With a strong commitment to being a City of Reconciliation, we invite you to join our dedicated team and become part of an innovative, inclusive, and engaging workplace. A career with the City of Vancouver and within the broader public service, offers meaningful work where you play a key role in ensuring equitable access to services, upholding ethical governance, and supporting the needs of citizens with integrity and dedication.

Main Purpose and Function

The Business Analyst – Park Operations Information and Data Management is responsible for leading and/or supporting a wide range of projects that provide business analysis and data support to inform strategic, operational and financial decision-making to improve performance and deliver value to the City. Park Operations supports a wide range of service areas including destination and neighbourhood parks, urban forestry, horticulture, park ranger services, mobile janitorial operations, and trade-based maintenance functions.

This role supports the development of business-focused reporting, dashboards, and workflow solutions using Microsoft 365 tools to enhance operational efficiency, data accessibility, and decision-making This position supports the ongoing management and development of operational information and management systems and processes, which includes SAP, Hansen, VanTree, GIS, Microsoft 365 applications, records-management systems and other building-information tools and resources.

The Business Analyst works with a variety of people to understand business needs and has the interested and expertise in data and analytics to translate those needs into clear business and date requirements. The role understands and evaluates how operational work is planned and delivered in the field, working closely with frontline management and groups across the organization. The analyst synthesizes and identifies relationships and correlations across datasets and has experience processing large volumes of data; analyzing and visualizing the data using business-intelligence tools. The position identifies and interprets data trends and issues, makes recommendations to improve business, operational and system processes, and transforms information into insights that support better business processes, service delivery and informed decision-making.

Work includes leading and/or supporting a range of projects involving objective and comprehensive business analytics, data analysis, system-design research, business-process reviews/re-engineering and management reporting, and providing recommendations based on this work. The role facilitates decision-making and presents recommendations to the Park Operations Director, division and branch heads, senior management and business-unit managers.

Specific Duties And Responsibilities


Leads or supports the full lifecycle of business-process reviews, from current-state to future-state process mapping and implementation, using a variety of tools such as workflow and data/metrics analysis, fit/gap analysis to develop recommendations for improvement and identify associated implications.
Leverages asset and operational management principles to inform specific projects, system improvements and service-delivery enhancements.
Analyzes complex operational issues and develops practical recommendations supported by evidence and sound professional judgement.
Support the Park Operations Director and work-group team on several projects concurrently, with a wide range of contributions. Produces reasoned and systematic analysis to provide input for key decisions concerning the needs and priorities for operations management.
Support staff and management in Park Operations and other areas of Parks to structure, develop, understand and utilize asset and operational data to provide metrics and financial, lifecycle, and operational performance data, with quantitative and/or qualitative information, to understand issues and opportunities and to support informed tactical and strategic decision-making.
Undertake various tasks supporting project components such as stakeholder consultation, developing reports or presentations to the Park Board, and/or managing external consultants.
Synthesizes and consolidates complex information into succinct and meaningful written and verbal management reporting, leveraging productivity tools such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint and SharePoint, Power BI and Power Automate.
Translates complex data into clear, actionable reports, presentations and recommendations for management to track the progress of business-process changes against stated objectives over time.
Uses metrics, financial information and quantitative and qualitative data to identify issues and opportunities.
Supports the development and improvement of departmental park hard and soft asset-data systems, work management processes and data-integration strategies, including related business processes.
Uses enterprise data systems, databases, SQL, Power BI, Power Query, Excel and other appropriate tools to extract, transform, analyze and visualize data.
Develops test plans, test cases and acceptance criteria; coordinates user acceptance testing and confirms that solutions meet business requirements.
Supports implementation planning, data migration, documentation, training, user readiness, adoption and post-implementation evaluation.
Listens and communicates effectively with managers, staff and stakeholders within the team and across the wider organization to understand issues, needs, concerns, ideas, challenges, limitations, constraints, impacts and opportunities for a program, project or process being undertaken.
Conducts research related to operational service delivery, benchmarking, peer surveys, best practices, recommended standards and key performance indicators relevant to municipal park and field-based operations.
Coordinates project activities with internal teams, external vendors, consultants and service providers
Performs other duties and responsibilities as assigned.


Qualifications

Education and Experience:


Completion of a university bachelor’s degree in Business Management, Commerce, Public Policy, Economics or a related technical area such as Finance, Computer Science or Engineering, with demonstrated business-analyst-related experience and a minimum of five years’ experience in a position with primary responsibility for undertaking business analytics, data analysis, research, business-process reviews/re-engineering and management reporting to support complex and multi-faceted business, operational and/or service-delivery projects, including experience working directly with and/or reporting to senior management in a large organization. or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience working in a management-consulting, business-advisory firm, or service-delivery environment, and/or a large, complex, multi-stakeholder organization is considered an asset.
Experience working in municipal government, a provincial or federal government organization or a public utility is considered an asset.


Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Thorough knowledge of business and business-systems planning principles, methods and standards.
Thorough knowledge of problem definition and analysis related to business processes and systems
Ability to analyze complex datasets and developing dashboards, reports or business intelligence solutions.
Ability to elicit and document business, functional, data and reporting requirements and supporting the assessment, design, testing, implementation and adoption of business or technology solutions.
Ability to think analytically, systematically frame and analyze an issue, opportunity or policy problem, and think innovatively to arrive at a solution supported by a balance of facts and good judgment.
Excellent organizational skills and the ability to concurrently manage multiple tasks and competing priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
An aptitude for and interest in learning about a wide variety of topics
Ability to approach problem-solving objectively with professional judgment.
Ability to focus on details without losing sight of the big picture.
Ability to distill research results into meaningful and useful data and/or information.
Ability to understand and leverage structured data systems and records, and to structure and connect information from various sources.
Skill in developing and maintaining strong working relationships with technical, professional and operational staff, as well as with senior management.
Superior written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to present analyses and solutions in clear and compelling terms.
Experience in process improvement, project management, risk management, performance measurement, financial analysis and/or data management is considered an asset.
Experience with scripting or programming languages used for analysis and automation, such as Python, R, JavaScript or equivalent, is considered an asset.
Experience in data management, business intelligence and data mining, report and dashboard design, business-process review, and supporting change initiatives and strategic decisions for a large organization is considered an asset.
Experience designing and implementing workflow and low-code solutions using Power Automate, Power Apps and SharePoint are considered an asset.
Working knowledge of computerized maintenance and work management systems, database systems, content-management systems such as SharePoint, data-integration tools such as Microsoft Power BI and Power Query, SAP, BIM, GIS, SQL and other operational data systems or tools is considered an asset.
Knowledge of analytics, quality-improvement tools, techniques and methodologies, with certifications such as International Institute of Business Analysis or Lean Six Sigma, is considered an asset.

  • Performs other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Experience working in municipal government, a provincial or federal government organization or a public utility is considered an asset.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

  • Thorough knowledge of problem definition and analysis related to business processes and systems
  • Ability to analyze complex datasets and developing dashboards, reports or business intelligence solutions.
  • Ability to elicit and document business, functional, data and reporting requirements and supporting the assessment, design, testing, implementation and adoption of business or technology solutions.
  • Ability to think analytically, systematically frame and analyze an issue, opportunity or policy problem, and think innovatively to arrive at a solution supported by a balance of facts and good judgment.

  • An aptitude for and interest in learning about a wide variety of topics
  • Ability to approach problem-solving objectively with professional judgment.

Title: Data Business Analyst
Description:
Location: This is a hybrid role that requires 2-3 days on-site at our Burnaby, BC office.

Welcome to Specsavers – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. Ranked the 5th Best Workplace™ in Canada and 12th globally by Great Place to Work®, we’re proud of our optometrist-owned model that makes high-quality, eyecare and eyewear accessible to all Canadians.

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

As a Data Business Analyst, you'll be responsible for eliciting requirements and shaping solutions to business problems across the full reporting lifecycle — from requirements gathering through to delivery of reports and dashboards. You'll work within an Agile framework, acting as the conduit between the business, and our Data Engineers and Visualization Analysts.

Key Responsibilities


Gather and define detailed project requirements from across the Canadian business for data reporting products
Own the end-to-end reporting lifecycle, from requirements gathering, to solution design, build support, user acceptance testing, and deployment
Run workshops, interviews, and prototyping sessions to capture and refine requirements — including situations where requirements are unclear or priorities are shifting
Define and document data mappings, and end-to-end data flows
Support data governance, data quality, and master data management initiatives
Produce Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Specification Documents (FSDs), user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria
Partner with Data Visualization Analysts to support the delivery of Power BI and self-service analytics solutions, ensuring outputs are intuitive, well-documented and accessible to business users
Ensure requirements are complete, consistent, concise, and verifiable — and traceable back to a genuine business need.
Provide input into new products and feature designs so that reporting and analytics needs are considered from the outset, not bolted on afterward
Manage scope changes and requirements during implementation
Partner with the Product Owner to refine and size the backlog
Maintain oversight of delivery, including scope, timelines, dependencies and expected outcomes
Proactively identify risks, blockers and potential delays, driving mitigation and escalation where required
Define acceptance criteria (Definition of Ready / Definition of Done) and support test planning and UAT


What We’re Looking For


3-5 years' experience as a Business Analyst, ideally on data or reporting products.
Demonstrated experience across the full reporting lifecycle (requirements through deployment)
Experience writing technical user stories and documentation
Ability to understand database schemas, including the relationships between objects and key terminology
Experience gathering requirements from diverse, sometimes non-technical stakeholders, including in situations with unclear requirements or changing priorities
Data profiling experience, including querying and profiling data using SQL
Exposure to a cloud data platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Experience working within an Agile delivery methodology
Excellent communication skills — confident liaising with stakeholders at all levels, able to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences
Sound analytical thinking, problem-solving, and negotiation skills
Self-motivated and comfortable working autonomously, while collaborating closely with the other Data Business Analysts

Nice-to-have


Experience in a retail environment.
Technical data skills: Power BI or other visualization tools
Experience in data visualisation techniques and principles
Awareness of the use of AI to support in the Data BA space


Compensation: $95,000 - $115,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.
Quarterly bonuses, based on your performance.
Annual Profit Share program to recognize your part in Specsavers’ success.
Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.


Behaviours We Value


Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose
Curious: We question, explore, and seek out diverse perspectives to develop our knowledge and understanding
Courageous: We challenge the status quo, we experiment with good ideas, and we are brave, bold, and fast in our decision making
Compassionate: We care, support, and help each other
Commercial: We treat money wisely and make decisions that are good for our customers, our partners, our people and for the long term


We hope that in applying with us, you value these things as well!

Our Hybrid Work Model

Experience the best of both worlds. At Specsavers, we embrace a hybrid approach that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. We come together in office two to three days a week to connect, innovate, and keep our culture thriving.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Specsavers, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a diverse team enriches our work environment and enables us to achieve our goals. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you believe you can contribute to our mission and vision, we welcome your application, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We value the unique skills and perspectives each individual brings to our team.

Accessibility and Accommodations

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know by contacting us at careers.ca@specsavers.com . We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At CI, we see a great place to work as one that is a safe place for everyone to have a voice, where people are empowered to take ownership over meaningful work, where there is an opportunity to grow through stretching themselves, where they can work on innovative products and projects, and where employees are supported and engaged in doing so.

We are seeking experienced Data Analysts to support a large-scale data migration and integration initiative. You will be responsible for investigating existing data structures, analyzing business logic hidden in queries and reports, mapping source data to target systems, and collaborating with business stakeholders to ensure accuracy and completeness.

This role is highly investigative and requires a blend of technical analysis and business communication skills. You should be comfortable navigating undocumented environments, reverse-engineering logic, and documenting findings clearly for both technical and business audiences.

Key Responsibilities


Source System Analysis
Investigate source systems and databases to understand data structures, relationships, and logic.
Analyze existing SQL queries, reports, and stored procedures to reverse engineer business rules.
Data Mapping & Transformation
Map source fields to target model requirements.
Identify gaps, data quality issues, and transformation needs.
Work closely with data engineers to validate ETL/transformation rules.
Stakeholder Collaboration
Partner with business SMEs and stakeholders to clarify definitions, logic, and requirements.
Translate technical findings into clear documentation for non-technical stakeholders.
Documentation & Knowledge Transfer
Produce detailed data dictionaries, mapping documents, and gap analysis reports.
Capture undocumented business logic and processes uncovered during investigation.
Validation & Testing Support
Support data validation and reconciliation efforts during development and UAT.
Assist in resolving discrepancies between source and target systems.

Required Skills & Experience


Strong SQL skills, with ability to read, analyze, and write complex queries.
Proven experience in data migration, data warehousing, or system integration projects.
Background in analyzing large datasets.
Strong data profiling, mapping, and reconciliation skills.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities in ambiguous environments.
Strong communication skills to work with both technical teams and business stakeholders.
Experience creating data dictionaries, mapping documents, and gap analysis reports.
Experience with dashboard tools such as Sigma or equivalent
Experience with code repository systems – Bitbucket or Git


Nice to Have


Experience with Snowflake or other modern cloud data platforms.
Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and tools.
Exposure to financial services or other regulated industries

Title: Data Prioritization Analyst

Job Description

What is the Opportunity?

In the increasingly complex world of financial services, accurate and complete data is critical for Risk management, financial reporting and regulatory compliance. Ensuring data governance begins with an understanding of financial services data, identifying the critical elements (CDEs), data quality controls and resolving data issues.

As a Data Prioritization Analyst with the data prioritization team, you will be accountable for working with various Data domains to prioritize critical data associated with business processes. Reporting to the Associate Director, you will work in collaboration with other teams providing data services such as the DMO’s, Data Lineage, Data Quality, Metadata management, and Data Completeness Teams.

What will you do?

Data Prioritization


Create and support repeatable, robust process to identify Data Elements that are most critical and has the highest impact on RBC’s key processes. Seek out industry trends and organizational knowledge to understand alternative approaches / solutions to propose viable options
Engage Data Domain stewards and Business Unit leadership to identify and define key business processes and prioritization and identification of critical reports
Engage Report Owners and their delegates to prioritize data utilizing the enterprise approved Critical Data Element (CDE) identification methodology.
Support other Data Management activities.
Identify, capture and curate metadata associated with CDEs (such as Business Term, Data Classification, Owning Data Domain, vintage tags among other things) for U.S. key regulatory reports.
Accountable for IHC Regulatory Reporting Data Domain metadata associated with Data Prioritization / CDEs to be present in Collibra, Enterprise Data Governance Platform.


Communication and Documentation


Document the critical data, its usage in business process and reports and rationale for critical data in firm standard CDE memo document template
Engage with key stakeholders from Risk Management, Finance, Liquidity, AML and other business Units
Manage and report on work status, including escalating execution risks in a timely manner


Training and Continuous Improvement


Gain and apply an in-depth understanding of data management, data governance, and metadata tools and systems to support the definition and documentation of effective data elements.
Work with the Chief Data Office and other Data Management Offices to support standards and best practices to improve data quality, participating in initiatives to raise awareness and drive improved data quality across the organization (e.g., Data Working Groups, Data Literacy projects).


What do you need to succeed?

Must-have


2-3+ years of experience in Data Management, Accounting, risk management, and/or Data Analysis
Undergraduate degree in a numerical discipline, business administration, finance or a combination
Good communications skills - verbal and written
Some experience with business and/or technical documentation


Nice-to-have


Self-starter, highly motivated, having a strong drive to achieve tangible results; ability to manage multiple competing priorities in times of stress
Ability to analyze and comprehend complex financial products, reporting and data related issues.
Familiarity with financial service regulatory requirements and guidelines (e.g. US regulatory reporting, BCBS 239)
A background in delivering data initiatives in Agile tooling (Jira)

We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities

Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team
A world-class training program in financial services
Flexible work/life balance options
Opportunities to do challenging work
Opportunities to take on progressively greater accountabilities
Opportunities to building close relationships with clients

Title: Fleet & Equipment Data Analyst & Coordinator
Description:
Overview:

The Fleet & Equipment Data Analyst & Coordinator supports the effective financial capture and operational management of the company’s equipment and vehicle fleet. This position is responsible for collecting, validating, and analyzing fleet data to improve equipment costing, project allocation, utilization, maintenance planning, replacement forecasting, and full life-cycle management.

Working closely with Fleet, Operations, Finance, Maintenance, Procurement, and Project Management, the incumbent will maintain accurate cost profiles for each asset and provide validated information regarding equipment deployment, retention, replacement, rental, purchase, and disposal.




Duties and Responsibilities:




Fleet Costing and Data Analysis

Manage, maintain and monitor complete cost profiles for designated assets.
Manage ownership and operating costs, including including replacement cost, interest, lifecycle, fuel, labour, repairs, maintenance, licensing, insurance, telematics, transportation, and salvage.
Calculate hourly, daily, monthly, and per-kilometre equipment costs.
Update appropriate internal charge-out and project allocation rates.
Compare actual equipment costs against budgets, forecasts, and established benchmarks.
Investigate cost variances and identify opportunities to reduce total cost of ownership.
Support capital budgeting and business cases for equipment purchases and replacements.
Identify and analyze operator factors both positive and negative which affect life cycles and cost of operation







Equipment Allocation and Utilization

Coordinate and perform the allocation of asset costs to divisions, yards, and operating locations.
Ensure equipment usage is assigned to the correct cost code, department, or business unit.
Report on utilization, availability, downtime, idle time, and production hours.
Identify underutilized, overallocated, or inactive assets to the responsible parties.
Analyze company-owned equipment costs against rental, lease, subcontract, and purchase options.




Equipment Life-Cycle Management

Maintain life-cycle records for each asset from acquisition through disposal.
Track equipment age, hours, kilometers, condition, maintenance history, reliability, utilization, replacement value, and market value.
Assist in maintaining replacement criteria based on age, operating hours, repair trends, downtime, safety, productivity, and residual value.
Prepare repair-versus-replace and retain-versus-dispose analyses.
Support the development of annual and multi-year capital replacement plans.
Document asset specifications, participate in research of emerging technologies, fuel alternatives, and industry trends.
Assist with disposal planning, trade-in evaluations, auction reviews, and resale-value analysis.
Conduct post-purchase and post-disposal reviews to compare actual results with projections.




Data Management and Reporting

Maintain accurate fleet master data of assets across maintenance, accounting, telematics, fuel, procurement, and project-management systems.
Audit data for missing entries, duplication, incorrect allocations, and inconsistent asset information.
Monitor and provide info and recurring reports
Total cost of ownership
Providing data to Supervisors regarding operator performance
Convert operational data into clear findings for management.
Support the development of standardized fleet policies, processes, cost codes, and performance measures.




Coordination and Continuous Improvement

Coordinate information between Fleet, Maintenance, Finance, Operations, Procurement, Dispatch, and Project Management.
Follow up on missing meter readings, work orders, invoices, fuel transactions, equipment transfers, and allocation records.
Participate in fleet-planning, capital-budget, maintenance, and operational review meetings.
Document workflows and recommend improvements to data capture and reporting processes.
Support implementation and improvement of fleet-management, ERP, telematics, maintenance, and business-intelligence systems.
Assist with special studies related to fleet standardization, productivity, emissions, electrification, and operating efficiency.




Requirements:

Two to five years of experience in fleet analysis, equipment coordination, construction operations, maintenance administration, cost accounting, or asset management.
Experience with construction equipment, commercial vehicles, or industrial fleets is strongly preferred.
Understanding of equipment costing, depreciation, utilization, preventive maintenance, and capital replacement planning.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, lookups, formulas, data validation, and financial modelling.
Experience with fleet-management, ERP, telematics, maintenance, or business-intelligence systems is an asset.
A valid driver’s license may be required.




Knowledge and Skills

Strong analytical and research capabilities
High level of accuracy and attention to detail
Ability to connect financial data with field-operating conditions
Strong organizational and coordination skills
Ability to manage multiple priorities and follow up on incomplete information
Clear written and verbal communication
Sound judgment and practical problem-solving
Ability to explain complex cost information to operational and non-financial stakeholders
Understanding of heavy equipment terminology and construction operations
Commitment to confidentiality, data integrity, safety, and continuous improvement




Cavanagh Employee Benefits:

Family oriented work environment
Attractive, competitive compensation for qualified candidates
Internal growth opportunities
Training and development opportunities
Benefit, Wellness and Pension Plans




Wage Range:

The salary range for this position in Ontario at the start of employment is expected to be between $70,000 per year and $80,000 per year. However, the range offered is based on local job market factors and may vary further depending on factors specific to the selected job candidate, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations.

Title: Jr. Analytics Developer
Description:
Job Description

Jr. Analytics Developer - Go Auto Corporate (Mayfield)

The Opportunity

We strive to stay at the forefront of data-driven decision-making and are seeking a curious and enthusiastic Jr. Analytics Developer to help turn business questions into trusted, useful data products. This is a junior role with meaningful responsibility and growth opportunities. You’ll work across the analytics lifecycle, across tools and products, and get exposure to many business areas.

This role is a strong fit for someone who cares about doing thoughtful, high-quality work. You don’t need to know every tool in our technology stack. We’re looking for solid foundations, attention to detail, a willingness to learn, and the drive to follow a problem through to a useful result. If you are passionate about data and curious about the business decisions behind it, we want to hear from you!

Primary Duties


Work with team members and stakeholders to understand business objectives, processes, and analytical needs.
Help turn business questions into clear requirements, metric definitions, and practical analytics solutions.
Build and maintain data models, tables, and transformation logic using established development patterns.
Create reports, dashboards, and tools that are clear, reliable, and designed to support decisions.
Complete ad hoc analysis and communicate your findings, assumptions, and limitations.
Test and reconcile data against source systems so stakeholders can trust the results.
Help maintain and improve current infrastructure, including user support.
Develop your skills across technologies such as Fabric, Azure, AWS, SQL, Spark, Python, Excel, and DAX.


Requirements


Foundational experience with SQL and working with structured data.
Foundational understanding of programming concepts.
Foundational understanding of business.
Exposure to data visualization or business intelligence tools, such as Power BI or a comparable platform.
Understanding of databases, relational data modelling, transformation, and validation concepts.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Careful attention to accuracy, clarity, and maintainability.
The ability to explain technical information in clear, practical language.
A willingness to ask for help, receive feedback, and keep developing your skills.
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business, Computer Science, Statistics or related.


Nice to Have


Professional analytics / data science / development experience.
Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Azure, Google or AWS environments.
Technical Proficiency: SQL, python, spark, DAX, VBA, AI.
Familiarity with the automotive industry, including dealership operations and performance metrics.
Examples of high-quality analytical or technical work from employment, education, personal projects, or another setting.


Perks


Learn and Grow - We're committed to your growth and development. We will ensure you receive all of the training you need as well as access to our library of courses in the Go Auto U.
Employee Investment Program - Money back? Yes, please! Brace yourself for this irresistible offer. Our program guarantees a 10% return every year, up to a whopping 16%, based on Go Auto's profits.
Vacation Vibes - We understand the importance of work-life balance. Picture yourself sipping margaritas on a sandy beach. After your first year, enjoy THREE WEEKS OF VACATION! Reach five years, and you'll have four weeks. Hit ten years, and you'll be soaking up FIVE weeks of vacation time!
Health and Dental - Your well-being matters to us. Experience comprehensive benefits, including healthcare, dental coverage, and a health spending account. We want to see your biggest, brightest smile!
Climb the Ladder - With our promote-from-within culture, you'll have ample opportunities to grow along your chosen career path?
Positive Team Environment - Join a vibrant team of like-minded individuals who share your passion and drive. We foster a positive and collaborative work environment where everyone supports and uplifts each other. Together, we celebrate victories, overcome challenges, and create lasting friendships.
Giving Back Feels Great - We're all about making a positive impact. Every year, we donate to worthy causes like the Kids with Cancer Society and Go Auto Fuels the Schools.
Find Your Life-Changing Career - We don't just offer jobs; we build lifelong careers. During your interview, ask us about our inspiring success stories of career growth within Go Auto.
