Description:
This is Adyen

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Optimization Data Analyst to join our team in San Francisco to play a critical role in driving scalable optimizations and advanced analytics across Adyen’s global Performance Optimization team. As an Optimization Data Analyst, you will independently lead complex analyses, support automation and experimentation projects, and collaborate with commercial and product stakeholders to deliver actionable insights that maximize merchant growth.

This role is ideal for an experienced analyst looking to deepen technical impact while influencing product and business outcomes at scale.

What You'll Do


Data-Driven Optimization- Analyze large-scale payment datasets to identify performance trends, uncover optimization opportunities, and deliver high-impact recommendations to our biggest customers, while identifying and driving scalable opportunities that benefit the broader merchant base.
Scalable Tooling & Automation- Design and build scalable analytics solutions, automation pipelines, and self-service tools that empower internal teams and stakeholders.
Cross-Functional Collaboration- Partner with Product, Data, and Commercial teams to translate business challenges into analytical solutions, driving continuous platform improvements.
Advanced Problem-Solving & Experimentation- Lead complex A/B testing and data investigations, shaping data-driven strategies and validating hypotheses with analytical rigor.
Strategic Data Storytelling- Drive strategic discussions by synthesizing complex data into compelling narratives, tailoring insights for technical and non-technical audiences, and positioning the Performance Optimization team as a key business enabler.
Mentorship & Best Practices- Support knowledge-sharing within the Performance Optimization team, contributing to the elevation of analytical standards and technical excellence.


Who You Are


3–5 years of relevant experience in a data analytics, data science, or similar role, ideally in fintech, payments, or a high-growth tech environment.
Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, and PySpark, with hands-on experience in large-scale data processing.
Ability to design and develop efficient and scalable ETL and data pipelines for datasets, including the use of data validations to ensure reliability.
Familiarity with big data tools (Spark, Airflow) and version control using Git.
Solid experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau) and dashboard development.
Deep understanding of statistics, hypothesis testing, and data mining.
Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence product and business outcomes.
Proactive, self-directed, and able to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, global environment.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, translating data insights into business value.


Compensation

The annual base salary range for this role is $132,000 - $178,000, plus RSUs; to learn more about our compensation philosophy, please click here.

Location

This role is based out of our San Francisco office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.

Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!

What’s next?

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

Title: Data Analytics Engineering
Description:
About Sage Care

Sage Care is a fast-growing, early-stage healthcare startup founded by exceptional leaders from Apple, Uber, Carbon Health and backed by top-tier venture capital (General Catalyst, Chelsea Clinton). With a strong customer pipeline, Sage Care is transforming healthcare by simplifying care navigation.

Our platform makes it easier for patients to find the right doctor and helps providers focus on those who need them most through harnessing the latest AI innovations.

Building on our successful collaborations with health systems across the U.S., we have expanded internationally to the MENA region. We are now partnering with health systems there to deploy our AI-powered care navigation platform.

About The Role

Every day, our services match real patient queries, symptoms, and pathologies to providers, sites of care, and urgency. These mappings are highly complex and non-linear, ranging from queries like “back pain” to “doctor for head trauma”. We log and can query for historical requests but want to build tools to help us analyze this data in aggregate and build deeper insights into what we’re seeing day to day.

We are looking for someone to help us build out the analytics infrastructure and tooling for the matching pipeline. This will provide us with learnings from real patient data and provide key insights into how to iterate and improve our current offerings.

We’re looking for someone who can help build out the core analytics infrastructure and pipelines for our matching products. You’ll work closely with engineers who work on the matching software, as well as our business team to help understand, surface, and design the metrics we need to better the impact of our product and how to improve it.

What You'll Do

Build and design analytics tooling and pipelines


Build dashboards that we can show to partners, the business team, and internally that surface metrics and insights into our data
Build the pipelines that connect metrics from our services to our dashboards
Build offline analysis tooling to help us understand aggregate and larger scale impacts of our services.


Build New Insights


Help design and implement new metrics that assess how we’re performing and how we can improve our services
Establish metrics of quality that we can hill climb on to improve our algorithms


What We're Looking For

Required


2+ years of data analytics and engineering experience
Experience building out dashboards and UI’s that monitor live data using tools like Grafana.
Data engineering experience piping metric data from live services
Strong experience in an object-oriented language (e.g. Python, Java, JavaScript)
Strong backend engineering skills and systems thinking


Nice to Have


Experience working with Open Telemetry and related products (e.g. Honeycomb, Jaeger UI).
Experience in healthcare technology


Example Things you’ve Done


Built out dashboards that monitor real-world metrics and usages
Implemented and design novel metrics to capture useful insights
Worked on tracing software and piping data through multiple software systems

Title: Business Operations Analyst - Trust and Safety
Description:
Responsibilities
The Reports & Insights Team empowers data-driven decision-making within our organization. We are committed to delivering meaningful insights that drive continuous improvement and optimize performance across all operational areas. The Reports & Insights team owns and manages operational metrics and develops robust reporting systems and analytical insights to ensure accuracy, actionability, and timeliness of information. Our focus is on fostering collaboration, innovation, and efficiency for Trust & Safety (T&S) global functioning.

Responsibilities:
- Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to gather, prioritize, and translate business requirements into scalable analytics and automation solutions.
- Develop and maintain scalable data workflows (e.g. Scheduled SQL queries, Python scripts or RPA bots).
- Collaborate with operations, engineering, and platform teams to improve systems integration and data flow between platforms (e.g. workflow tools and databases).
- Build, design, and monitor reporting tools that surface key metrics and operational insights. These may include data related to efficiency and quality performance in moderation teams.
- Develop and maintain technical documentation, data definitions, and user documentation to support scalable analytics solutions.
- Evaluate emerging analytics, automation, and AI technologies to improve operational efficiency, scalability, and data accessibility.
- Ensure data quality, validation, and governance standards across automated reporting and AI-assisted workflows to support accurate, reliable decision-making.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualification(s):
- 5+ years of hands-on experience in data automation, analytics, or a related analyst role.
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate business needs into scalable data solutions and technical concepts into actionable business insights.
- Proficient in Excel automation, data pipeline development, and scripting for automation tasks. Including proficiency in Python and SQL for data analysis, automation, and scalable data workflows.
- Experience applying data quality, validation, and governance best practices to ensure accurate, reliable, and trustworthy analytics.
- Understanding of relational databases and/or data warehousing for concepts (e.g. BigQuery, Snowflake).
- Proven analytical problem-solving skills with a keen eye for detail and process optimization.
- Familiarity with data visualization tools, e.g., Tableau, Power BI, etc.

Preferred Qualification(s):
- A Bachelor's degree or higher in Management Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Statistics or related subjects is preferred.
- Comfortable with ambiguity; able to thrive with minimal oversight and process, while keeping leadership informed on progress against deadlines.
- Experience working in Trust and Safety scaled operations, with an understanding of content moderation workflows or workflow management systems.
- Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
- Experience identifying opportunities to leverage AI-assisted tools and automation to improve reporting, operational workflows, and productivity.

Trust & Safety
Content that this role interacts with includes images, video, and text related to every-day life, but it can also include (but is not limited to) bullying; hate speech; child safety; depictions of harm to self and others, and harm to animals. Hence, it is possible that this role will be exposed to harmful content on a daily basis. ​
​
TikTok recognises that keeping our platform safe for the TikTok communities is no ordinary job which can be both rewarding and psychologically demanding and emotionally taxing for some. This is why we are sharing the potential hazards, risks and implications in this unique line of work from the start, so our candidates are well informed before joining. ​
​
We are committed to the wellbeing of all our employees and promise to provide comprehensive and evidence-based programs, to promote and support physical and mental wellbeing throughout each employee's journey with us. We believe that wellbeing is a relationship and that everyone has a part to play, so we work in collaboration and consultation with our employees and across our functions in order to ensure a truly person-centred, innovative and integrated approach.​


About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​


TikTok Accommodation
TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request​

The base salary range for this position in the selected city is $108000 - $151200 annually.​
Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units.​
Benefits may vary depending on the nature of employment and the country work location. Employees have day one access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) savings plan with company match, paid parental leave, short-term and long-term disability coverage, life insurance, wellbeing benefits, among others. Employees also receive 10 paid holidays per year, 10 paid sick days per year and 17 days of Paid Personal Time (prorated upon hire with increasing accruals by tenure).​
The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice.​

3. Exercising sound judgment.​

Create and refine complex calculated fields to extend Workday's reporting capabilities, enabling deeper analysis and more precise data extraction. Data analysis and Interpretation;
Working with business stakeholders (HR, Finance, etc.);
Translate high-level business questions into technical specifications for multiple reports;
Troubleshoot report issues, resolve data discrepancies, and develop creative solutions to meet client needs; and
Train end-users on how to run, interpret, and leverage multiple reports.

Title: P2P Data & Automation Analyst
Description:
GAQ327R181

While candidates in the listed location(s) are encouraged for this role, candidates in other locations will be considered.

Databricks is executing a multi-year Procure-to-Pay transformation spanning an expense management platform migration, the BrickBuy enterprise procurement portal, a managed services onboarding, and policy and process redesign initiatives. This role sits embedded within Procurement — not in a central IT or analytics function — and operates in accordance with the Finance Data Strategy governance framework to drive rapid P2P process transformation by designing, deploying, and scaling automation and data solutions directly within business workflows.

This is a builder role for someone who wants to own outcomes, not tickets: the person will sit inside the processes they are automating, ship working solutions in weeks rather than quarters, and carry them through adoption — pairing hands-on technical delivery with the change management discipline needed to make new ways of working stick.

The Impact You Will Have


Business process ownership. Own designated P2P sub-processes end to end — intake-to-PO, invoice exception handling, supplier onboarding, expense workflows — including process mapping, baseline metrics (cycle time, touch rates, exception volumes), and redesign. Act as the recognized process owner who is accountable for how the process performs, not just how it is documented.
Requirements & solution design. Translate pain points raised by requesters, approvers, buyers, and AP into structured requirements and solution designs. Work within the Finance Data Strategy governance framework for data definitions, source-of-truth alignment, access controls, and quality standards — solutions must tie to certified Finance data, not shadow datasets.
Embedded automation. Design, deploy, and scale automations directly within business workflows and the systems where work actually happens (ZIP, SAP, NetSuite, expense platform, BrickBuy) — including AI/LLM-assisted triage, auto-routing, data enrichment, exception auto-resolution, and notification/nudge logic. Build in production-adjacent environments with appropriate guardrails rather than standalone tools users must remember to visit.
Rapid iteration. Operate on a ship-measure-iterate cadence: release minimum viable automations in weeks, instrument them from day one, and refine based on usage data and user feedback. Maintain sandbox-to-production discipline consistent with Finance Data Strategy and SOX/control requirements.
Data & measurement. Build and maintain the P2P datasets, dashboards, and metrics that the transformation runs on — cycle time, Fast Pass performance, first-pass yield, policy compliance, automation coverage, and adoption rates — and report against them in existing operating rhythms (e.g., quarterly business reviews), with numbers that tie across reports and to source data.
User adoption & change management. Own the adoption of what you build. Design role-based training and enablement for affected requesters, approvers, and P2P operations staff; produce launch communications, FAQ/help content, and go-live announcements in a style consistent with executive reporting norms (concise, structured, blockers called out explicitly); run feedback loops with change champions across subsidiaries; and actively identify and mitigate resistance rather than assuming usage will follow deployment.
Day-to-day prioritization. Run the intake and backlog for automation and data requests across Procurement: triage incoming asks, prioritize by value, effort, and risk, publish a visible roadmap, and make defensible trade-off calls daily — protecting capacity for transformation priorities while handling operational requests.
Stakeholder engagement. Partner closely with Procurement operations, the Finance Data team, the CIO org, and managed services partners; represent Procurement in Finance Data Strategy governance forums; and ensure automation work lands coherently alongside parallel workstreams (expense platform migration, BrickBuy rollout, Global Procurement Policy adoption, managed services transition).


What We Look For


4–8 years in data analytics, process automation, or operations roles within P2P, procurement, or finance — with demonstrable examples of automations or data products you built, shipped, and scaled yourself.
Hands-on technical skills: SQL and Python (or equivalent), workflow and integration tooling (iPaaS, RPA, or native platform automation), and dashboarding/BI. Experience building on the Databricks platform and applying LLM/AI tooling to business workflows is a strong plus.
Working knowledge of P2P systems and data — ERP (SAP or NetSuite), procurement intake/orchestration platforms (ZIP or similar), and expense management tools — including how transactions, approvals, and master data flow between them.
Experience operating within a data governance framework: certified data sources, data quality standards, access controls, and audit/SOX considerations — comfortable moving fast without going around governance.
Change management fluency: track record of driving adoption of new tools or processes through training, communications, champion networks, and adoption metrics — not just deploying and moving on.
Strong prioritization judgment and stakeholder management: able to run a busy intake, say no with a rationale, and communicate crisply to audiences from frontline requesters to executives.
Experience in a high-growth, multi-entity organization (multiple subsidiaries/geographies) is a plus; formal change management certification (Prosci, ADKAR, or equivalent) or process improvement certification (Lean/Six Sigma) preferred but not required.

Title: Product Analyst
Description:
About Finch

We are on a mission to revolutionize employment by building the infrastructure that powers every facet of work . To do this, we're looking for individuals who think about problems holistically and in-depth, who are relentlessly curious, self-starters, and determined to drive ideas from inception through to completion.

Finch is a Series B company backed by a fantastic set of firms, angels, and our developers including General Catalyst, Menlo Ventures, Homebrew, BoxGroup, YCombinator, Charley (1st business hire at Plaid), Sima (ex-Head of Biz Dev at Plaid), Henrique + Pedro (co-CEOs at Brex), Jeff + Wayne (co-CEOs at Digits), Immad (CEO at Mercury), Sam (CEO at Vouch Insurance), Karim (CTO at Ramp), and more.

About Our Team

We're a team of problem solvers who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions. We value velocity, curiosity, empathy, and diverse perspectives. Everyone on the team is excited about the scope of the problems we address and the potential impact our work can have on the global workforce. We realize that the value we provide comes with great responsibilities, and therefore make security and privacy our highest priorities.

We come from a diverse set of backgrounds and each member brings different skills to the group. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and potential will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns.

About The Role

We're looking for a data-driven Product Analyst to support SLA monitoring and tracking, provider expansion, and automation initiatives. This role owns operational workflows end-to-end with a strong emphasis on metrics, tracking, and identifying where processes are off track. This individual will partner closely with product, integrations, and engineering to move work from manual support toward scalable automation.

What You'll Do

Operational Analytics & Reporting


Monitor SLAs and operational performance across multiple product workflows, flagging misses or anomalies as they emerge
Investigate root causes behind performance issues and process breakdowns
Build and maintain actionable reporting and dashboards that surface where processes are on or off track
Own operational workflows end-to-end, with clear visibility into status, bottlenecks, and outcomes


Provider & Connection Lifecycle Management


Help drive the full lifecycle of new provider/connection work, including intake, data mapping, cross-team coordination, parallel run support, and handoff toward automation
Act as a key point of coordination across the stages of provider expansion, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner closely with product, integrations, engineering, and operations teams to identify opportunities to move workflows from manual support to scalable automation
Communicate progress, blockers, and risks clearly to stakeholders across functions


Independent Execution


Independently run with ambiguous or evolving problems, owning ongoing processes without heavy oversight
Set a high bar for execution, both in terms of quality and speed
Drive follow-through on initiatives from identification through resolution


What You'll Bring


Data-driven, analytical, and operationally minded, with a track record of using metrics to identify and resolve process issues
Comfortable working in ambiguous, evolving processes where the path isn't always fully defined
Strong reporting and analytics skills, with experience building and interpreting operational metrics
Proven experience handling structured data (Excel, CSV, JSON, etc.)
Comfortable working in process-heavy, operational environments with multiple moving parts
Able to independently manage and set clear deadlines across multiple simultaneous projects
Strong written communication skills and ability to clearly document processes so they can be optimized over time
Comfortable coordinating with multiple parties and building relationships both internally and externally
Comfortable working with SQL to locate the right data sources, join tables, and build dashboards you can verify and trust — 1+ years of experience working across multiple datasets preferred.
Working knowledge of Python for data analysis, scripting, or automation
2–4 years of experience in business operations, product operations, business/data analysis, or a related analytical role at a financial, tech, or fintech company.


Success Looks Like


Familiarity working with payroll/HR systems or retirement
Experience in a technical support, product operations, or business analyst role — preferably with an API-based or hyper-process-oriented product
Experience building dashboards and tracking metrics in tools like Sigma
Familiarity with Snowflake or other cloud data warehouses
Comfortable digging through logs (e.g., Datadog) to help investigate operational or technical issues.


What We Offer


Competitive equity with a 10-year exercise window
Full medical, dental, and vision coverage (100% for employees, 85% for dependents)
Unlimited PTO (with a 3-week minimum)
401(k) plan
Regular team offsites and meetups
Hybrid work: 2+ days/week in our SF Office


$80,000 - $86,000 a year

Finch’s compensation package includes a competitive base salary benchmarked against real-time market data, as well as equity for all full-time roles. We want all full-time employees to be invested in Finch and to be able to take advantage of that investment, so our equity grants include a 10-year exercise window.

We also offer exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. Our minimum salary range for this role is: $80,000 - $86,000.

Final offers may vary from the amount listed based on geography, candidate experience and expertise, and other factors.

Finch is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Operational Analytics & Reporting

Provider & Connection Lifecycle Management

Description:
We are looking for a creative, data-driven Compensation Analyst to join our team. If you are a problem solver with strong analytical prowess, excellent communication skills, and a genuine passion for data analytics, this role is for you.

As a Compensation Analyst, you won’t just crunch numbers—you will contribute to the strategic development and implementation of our compensation programs. You will collaborate with team members to develop modern analytic tools, automate legacy processes, and help compose the future of our compensation strategy. The ideal candidate is enthusiastic, hardworking, and thrives on building elegant analytical models.

What You’ll Be Doing


Evolve Compensation Strategy: Help us redefine and evolve how we believe about base, variable, and equity compensation structures.
Advanced Analytics: Apply quantitative and qualitative analysis to identify problems, develop hypotheses, and recommend data-backed solutions for compensation programs and processes.
Data Visualization & Modeling: Build and develop dynamic dashboards and analytic models to provide actionable business insights and interpret market or internal trends.
Workday Optimization: Partner with the HRIS/Systems team to implement, test, and define requirements for Workday performance and compensation modules, ensuring seamless updates to structures and job profiles.
Drive Automation: Streamline and automate monthly, quarterly, and annual compensation reporting and analysis using modern data tools and AI workflows.
Market Benchmarking: Conduct global market benchmarking, assess peer groups, and ensure consistent market pricing practices while maintaining internal equity.
Storytelling with Data: Provide sophisticated compensation analytics, clearly conveying complex findings and recommendations to collaborators.


What We Need To See


BA/BS degree, preferably in a quantitative-focused major (e.g., Finance, Data Analytics, Statistics, Economics) or equivalent experience.
5+ years of dedicated, progressive experience in Compensation.
Core Tech Stack: Advanced proficiency in Excel (complex formulas, VBA, Power Query) and a strong working knowledge of HRIS systems (preferably Workday).
Communication: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable narratives.
Soft Skills: High learning agility, flexibility, and unmatched quantitative problem-solving skills.


Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd


AI & Automation Savvy: Experience bringing to bear AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT Advanced Data Analysis, Microsoft Copilot) to accelerate data cleaning, script writing, and compensation reporting.
BI & Visualization: Proven experience building interactive dashboards using Tableau, Power BI, or other advanced analytic platforms.
Coding & Automation: Familiarity with Python, R, or SQL for data manipulation and automating repetitive workflows.
Project Mastery: Strong planning, organizational, and project management skills with a track record of driving initiatives from concept to completion.
Scalable Processes: Demonstrated experience developing and implementing scalable, repeatable processes backed by detailed ongoing documentation.

Title: Strategic Operations Analyst
Description:
About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

About The Role

The Strategic Operations team serves as the internal operating system for Zipline's global operations organization. We partner across Maintenance, Fulfillment, Flight Test, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Commercial Operations to solve complex operational problems, build scalable systems, and enable data-driven decision making.

As a Strategic Operations Analyst, you'll work on some of the highest-priority operational challenges at Zipline. One week you may be building executive metrics that shape fleet strategy; the next you could be standing in a maintenance hub conducting time studies, designing a new operational process, or building an internal software tool that saves hundreds of hours across the organization.

This is not a traditional analytics role. Success requires curiosity, technical depth, and the ability to move seamlessly between data analysis, software development, process design, and operational execution.

You'll own ambiguous problems from end to end—understanding how work happens today, identifying opportunities for improvement, building solutions, and measuring their impact.

What You’ll Do


Partner directly with leaders across Strategic Operations, Maintenance, Fulfillment, Flight Test, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Commercial Operations to solve high-impact operational challenges.
Build analytical models and metrics that provide visibility into fleet health, operational performance, cost, quality, and reliability.
Design scalable operating mechanisms including processes, workflows, documentation, and decision frameworks.
Develop internal software tools, dashboards, and automations that eliminate manual work and improve operational efficiency.
Design new methods for collecting operational data where none exists, including field observations, time studies, surveys, and instrumentation.
Investigate complex operational problems by combining quantitative analysis with direct observation in production and commercial environments.
Lead cross-functional projects from problem definition through implementation and measurement.
Communicate findings and recommendations to executive leadership through clear visualizations, written narratives, and presentations.
Travel up to 20% to commercial sites, manufacturing facilities, and flight test locations to understand operations firsthand and validate solutions.



Required

What You’ll Bring


Strong analytical skills with experience using SQL to analyze large datasets.
Experience using Python, R, or similar languages to automate analyses, build tools, or solve operational problems.
Experience designing metrics, dashboards, and reporting systems that influence business decisions.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and independently drive them to completion.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical findings into clear business recommendations.
Demonstrated ability to work effectively across technical and operational teams.
High ownership, strong organizational skills, and a bias toward action.
Willingness to travel approximately 20%.



Preferred


Experience building internal software applications, workflow automation tools, or operational systems.
Experience with business intelligence platforms such as Mode, ThoughtSpot, Looker, or Power BI.
Experience in logistics, manufacturing, aviation, robotics, supply chain, or another operationally intensive environment.
Experience with experimentation, statistical analysis, forecasting, or optimization.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Operations Research, Economics, or a related quantitative field.



What Else You Need To Know

The starting cash range for this role is $130,000-$170,000. Please note that this is a target, starting cash range for a candidate who meets the minimum qualifications for this role. The final cash pay for this role will depend on a variety of factors, including a specific candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, working location, and projected impact. The total compensation package for this role may also include: equity compensation; overtime pay; discretionary annual or performance bonuses; sales incentives; benefits such as medical, dental and vision insurance; paid time off; and more.

Zipline is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, mental or physical disability, medical condition, genetic information, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, military or veteran status, citizenship, or other characteristics protected by state, federal or local law or our other policies.

Please Note

We have received reports stating that certain individuals are reaching out to people under false pretenses, claiming to be Zipline employees, affiliates, agents, or representatives. They may seek to gain access to your personal information or to acquire money from you by offering fictitious employment opportunities or by claiming that they are contacting you on Zipline’s behalf.

Genuine Zipline employees or representatives will never ask you for money or payment in exchange for employment opportunities or other related services. Any such offer of employment or any other service in exchange for fees that claims to be from us is deceitful and part of a fraud.

Voluntary Self-Identification

For government reporting purposes, we ask candidates to respond to the below self-identification survey. Completion of the form is entirely voluntary. Whatever your decision, it will not be considered in the hiring process or thereafter. Any information that you do provide will be recorded and maintained in a confidential file.

Title: Research Data Analyst 2
Description:
Job Description

The Division of Computational Medicine in the Stanford Department of Medicine is advancing the future of health through data science, biomedical informatics, and interdisciplinary research. Our faculty are national leaders driving innovation that transforms complex data into meaningful clinical impact.

We are seeking a collaborative data science and machine learning professional to help build and evaluate real-world clinical AI, from extracting and curating EHR data (clinical notes, lab results, and other sources) to producing analysis-ready datasets and publication-quality reports and visualizations (for example ROC and precision recall analyses). Working side by side with physicians, fellows, and data warehouse and IT partners, you will define evolving data needs, troubleshoot data quality issues, and ensure responsible, compliant data use. You will also train and assess machine learning and large language model approaches to identify clinical infections and predict laboratory outcomes, and contribute to prototyping and testing software and data pipelines, including Python-based serverless functions that retrieve near real-time patient data via FHIR APIs, supported by clear audit-ready documentation.

The job duties listed are typical examples of work performed by positions in this job classification and are not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, tasks, and responsibilities. Specific duties and responsibilities may vary depending on department or program needs without changing the general nature and scope of the job or level of responsibility. Employees may also perform other duties as assigned.

Responsibilities

Core Duties:


Prioritize and extract data from a variety of sources such as notes, survey results, medical reports, and laboratory data, and maintain its accuracy and completeness.
Determine additional data collection and reporting requirements.
Design and customize reports based upon data in the database. Oversee and monitor regulatory compliance for utilization of the data.
Use system reports and analyses to identify potentially problematic data, make corrections, and eliminate root cause for data problems or justify solutions to be implemented by others.
Create complex charts and databases, perform statistical analyses, and develop graphs and tables for publication and presentation.
Serve as a resource for non-routine inquiries such as requests for statistics or surveys.
Test prototype software and participate in approval and release process for new software.
Provide documentation based on audit and reporting criteria to investigators and research staff.


Minimum Education

Bachelor's degree and three years of relevant experience or combination of education and relevant experience.

Minimum Experience

Experience in a quantitative discipline such as economics, finance, statistics or engineering.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Substantial experience with MS Office and analytical programs.
Excellent writing and analytical skills.
Ability to prioritize workload.

Title: Staff Data Analyst
Description:
Who We Are

At 2K, we create some of the most iconic and culture-shaping video games in entertainment, including NBA® 2K, one of the top-selling franchises in the world, and legendary titles like BioShock®, Borderlands®, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization®, and XCOM®, as well as fan favorites WWE® 2K, TopSpin®, and PGA TOUR® 2K. We build unforgettable experiences by pushing the boundaries of creativity, authenticity and innovation across every genre.

Our portfolio is brought to life by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Visual Concepts, Firaxis Games, Hangar 13, Cat Daddy Games, 31st Union, Cloud Chamber, Gearbox, HB Studios, and 2K SportsLab create world-class experiences across platforms.

But what truly powers 2K is our people.

We believe the best ideas come from teams that feel empowered, supported, and inspired. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive workplace where people are encouraged to come as they are and do their best work.

What We Need

We’re looking for a passionate Staff Data Analyst to support the Sports* Game Science & Insights team, to explore, analyze, report, and action on data from our portfolio of titles (WWE 2K, PGA TOUR 2K). We’re looking for someone who can translate product & business knowledge into deep analysis and, in turn, translate to actionable insights for cross functional business stakeholders. As you deliver valuable insights to stakeholders, you will aim to build strong relationships, become a trusted partner among business functions, and scale out team efforts from one team to the next. Our mission is to enable our partners to be more proactive, productive & successful by providing best in class, end-to-end and scalable data solutions.

What You Will Do


Leverage a deep understanding of how our titles’ game features & mechanics work and our business priorities to deliver actionable, business-impacting insights
Support business narratives and develop business cases with effective data storytelling. Focus on using data and hypothesis-driven decision-making to drive future growth and customer lifetime value
Learn different business teams’ and stakeholders’ ways of working and preferences for understanding data, and be a bridge between the data team and business teams (Product, Marketing, Commercial) to translate complex business needs into data-related projects
Tailor the output to match stakeholder needs, including reports, visualizations, charts, and tables
Gain an understanding of internal titles outside of our portfolio (NBA 2K, Borderlands, other 2K titles) to provide strong benchmarking and comparison points for business performance
Lead the exploration of creative new ways of measurement to identify patterns and causal relationships
Empower teams to track and analyze activity/productivity and support their research projects, leading the efforts towards building scalable self-service tools
Act as a subject matter expert to support analysts and other data-users to improve their capabilities. Grow and develop best practices that contribute to both the team and wider business understanding of our players
Data doesn't just appear overnight, we work with our stakeholders to understand what data matters most to their business and strategy. In addition to delivering insights on what is available to us, this role will be responsible for liaising with stakeholders to proactively identify what data we need to begin to record for future initiatives that drive value


What Will Make You A Great Fit

The ideal candidate for this role has the ability to see the underlying story in the data, know how to ask the right questions and relate output back to measurable player or business outcomes. A solution-oriented and creative problem solver. A self-starter with the passion and enthusiasm to join a growing insights team to get results for meaningful change.


Track record of successfully leading the delivery of insights and analysis across business functions (Product, Commercial, Marketing)
Proven ability to produce impactful insights that resulted in tangible enhancements to product or business outcomes
Profound knowledge in SQL
Great communication skills and a clear understanding of how to make insights understandable and actionable for the business

Job Summary

Location - US/Canada 



We are seeking a skilled and analytical Power BI Developer to design, develop, and maintain business intelligence solutions that enable data-driven decision-making across the organization. Design, develop, and deploy interactive Power BI dashboards and reports.

Title: Data Analyst II
Description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Data at Brex

The Data organization develops insights, models, and data infrastructure for teams across Brex, including Sales, Marketing, Product, Engineering, and Operations. Our Data Scientists, Analysts, and Engineers work together to make data—and insights derived from data—a core asset across the company.

What You’ll Do

As a Data Analyst II (DA), you will play a central role in enhancing the operational tracking and reporting capabilities of different business teams across Brex. You will work closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and partner teams to drive meaningful insights for the business through visualizations, self-service tools, and ad-hoc analyses. This is a high-impact role in a fast-paced fintech environment where your work will directly influence strategic decisions.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities


Apply data visualization and storytelling skills in creating business intelligence solutions (such as Looker and/or Hex dashboards) that enable actionable insights.
Perform ad-hoc analyses and deep dives to investigate business questions, surface trends, and provide data-driven recommendations.
Develop self-service data tools and processes that empower business stakeholders to independently monitor the performance and health of their respective areas.
Collaborate closely with Data Scientists and Data Engineers to identify data sources, enable data pipelines, and support the development of analytical data models that operationalize reports and dashboards.
Implement and maintain rigorous data quality checks to ensure the integrity and robustness of datasets used across dashboards, reports, and analyses.
Partner with various departments—including Sales, Operations, Product, and Finance—to understand their data needs and deliver tailored analyses and reporting that support strategic planning.
Contribute to the automation of recurring analyses and reporting workflows using Python.


Requirements


3+ years of experience in data analytics or a related role in a professional setting.
2+ years of experience working directly with Sales, Operations, Product, or equivalent business teams.
Fluency in SQL to manipulate data and perform complex analyses (CTEs, window functions, joins across large datasets).
Experience with Python for data analysis, automation, or scripting.
Experience with business intelligence and data visualization tools (Looker, Hex, Tableau, or similar).
Strong quantitative and analytical skills with a demonstrated ability to translate data into business insights.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with stakeholders across different functions and levels of technical fluency.
Experience with generative AI and LLM-based tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to perform and accelerate analyses, automated reporting, and build self-service data tools.


Bonus points


Familiarity with cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks).
Familiarity with dbt for data modeling and transformation.
Exposure to data pipeline orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow).
Experience in fintech, financial services, or payments.
Comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with evolving priorities.


Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $93,600 - $117,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

Title: Sales Operations Analyst
Description:
About Clipboard

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

About The Role

Clipboard is looking for a Sales Operations Analyst to help build and run the systems behind our sales organization.

You'll work across Salesforce, data, automation, and internal tools to help our sales team operate more effectively. That might mean building an automation that eliminates a recurring workflow, investigating a messy data problem, redesigning part of our Salesforce setup, or building a new system from the ground up.

We are a small team with an unusual operating model. Much of our execution runs through AI agents that we direct and quality-check, allowing each analyst to operate with the leverage of a much larger team.

This is equal parts builder and operator. You'll own systems end to end, work through ambiguous requests from reps and leadership, and be accountable for making sure the things you build actually work.

What You'll Do


Own live systems. Take ownership of production systems such as account distribution, deal intelligence, competitor tracking, and data sync pipelines. You'll be accountable for their accuracy and reliability.
Solve ambiguous problems. Work through requests from sales reps, managers, and leadership, figure out what is actually needed, and execute quickly.
Direct AI agents. Write specs and prompts, supervise AI agents, and rigorously QA their output before it touches production data.
Build automations and tools. Create scripts, scheduled jobs, Slack bots, and lightweight web apps that turn recurring manual work into scalable systems.
Analyze and report. Use SQL and other tools to answer important revenue questions and build reporting the organization can trust.
Guard data quality. Handle merges, deduplication, account mapping, enrichment, and other work required to keep our systems accurate at scale.


What We're Looking For


Evidence of building. You've built scripts, automations, tools, systems, or other solutions to real problems.
AI-native working style. You already use AI to multiply your output and understand where it can fail and how to verify its work.
High judgment under ambiguity. You can take a loosely defined problem, figure out what matters, and know when to act versus when to ask.
Strong attention to detail. You're comfortable being the last line of defense before changes affect production systems and large datasets.
Bias to ownership. When something you own breaks, you don't just fix the immediate issue. You look for the underlying problem and improve the system.


SQL and Python experience are strong pluses, but we're more interested in your curiosity, judgment, and ability to ship than checking every technical box.

Nice to Have


Salesforce administration or development experience, including flows, SOQL, or data model design.
Experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Operations, analytics, or a similar environment.
Experience building automations with tools, scripts, APIs, or AI agents.


Interview Process


Application Review – We'll review your experience and evidence of things you've built, automated, or owned.
Take-Home Assessment – A practical, ~2-hour assessment using a fictional company, mock website, and CRM. You'll have 48 hours to complete it, and AI tools are encouraged.
Technical Walkthrough – A 45-minute session where you'll demo what you built, explain your decisions, and make a small live change to your system.
Manager Interview – A 30-minute conversation focused on communication, ownership, judgment, and how you operate under ambiguity.
Final Steps / Offer! – Some candidates may have an executive conversation, followed by references and an offer.


What We Offer


Competitive base salary
Insurance benefits + 401k options
Unlimited PTO and flexible holidays
Remote-first working environment


To get a better understanding of the general type of people we want to hire, you can check out our blog here.

Quick Note On Scammers

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here.

Compensation Range: $75K - $110K

Title: Demand Planner
Description:
About the role:

The Demand Planner plays a key role in ensuring Backroads offers the right trips, at the right times, with the right level of capacity to meet guest demand. As a member of the Demand Planning team and the greater Yield Organization, this role analyzes booking trends, performance data, and market insights to make recommendations that optimize trip offerings and support future growth.

This person will identify opportunities and risks, recommend schedule and capacity adjustments, and help shape future trip assortments. They will also partner closely with teams across Trip Development, Marketing, Hotel Operations, Business Analytics, Sales, and Yield to support strategic planning initiatives and ensure business decisions are backed by data.

What you’ll be doing:


Analyze booking trends, trip performance, and demand patterns to identify opportunities and risks across Backroads' trip assortment and support data-driven decision making.
Conduct ongoing reviews of trip performance and departure schedules, making recommendations to add capacity, release inventory, modify departures, or cancel trips based on demand and business objectives.
Play a key role in biannual planning meetings by identifying challenges, opportunities, and strategic initiatives, developing proposals and recommendations, and driving alignment among stakeholders and leadership.
Serve as a primary Demand Planning resource through the team's service desk, providing timely guidance and recommendations to Trip Development and other cross-functional partners on trip performance, scheduling, inventory, and capacity-related requests.
Play a central role in the annual assortment planning process, evaluating current and future offerings and helping define what the Backroads portfolio should look like over the next two to three years.
Partner closely with Trip Development to align trip offerings with guest demand, identify capacity constraints, and develop solutions that support business growth.
Collaborate with Marketing to prioritize trips, destinations, and product segments for promotion based on demand trends, booking performance, and business priorities.
Monitor industry trends, competitor activity, and market demand to identify opportunities that can enhance Backroads' trip offerings and future planning strategies.
Prepare ad hoc analyses, presentations, and recommendations for leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, as well as support ad hoc business inquiries and projects.


Exact duties and responsibilities may shift based on business needs.

What you’ll need to be successful:


3+ years of experience in planning, forecasting, business analytics, consulting, inventory management, or a related field.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
Advanced Excel skills and experience working with large datasets to identify trends and support decision-making.
Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations.
Ability to communicate complex information clearly through presentations, reports, and discussions with cross-functional partners and C-Suite executives.
Highly organized with strong project management and prioritization skills in a deadline-driven environment.
Comfortable working across multiple systems and managing detailed information with a high level of accuracy.
Ability to build strong working relationships and collaborate effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
Self-motivated and able to balance independent work with cross-functional collaboration.
Curiosity and a proactive mindset, with a willingness to learn new concepts and explore data to solve business challenges.


Work environment:


On-Site, Berkeley, CA
4 days in-office, 1 day work from home (Wednesdays)


About the department:

The Demand Planning team is a highly analytical group responsible for helping Backroads align trip offerings and capacity with guest demand. By combining booking data, market insights, and long-term planning, the team helps ensure Backroads delivers the right mix of trips and experiences to support both guest satisfaction and business growth.

The team works closely with Trip Development, Hotel Operations, Rooming Operations, Business Analytics, Sales, Marketing, and Yield teams to evaluate trip performance, optimize capacity, and support strategic planning decisions. Through data-driven recommendations, the Demand Planning team plays a significant role in shaping the future of the Backroads trip assortment.

About Backroads:

Founded in 1979, Backroads is the world’s leading guest-focused travel company, offering luxury Biking, Hiking & Walking, and Multi-Adventure Trips for active people of all ages and experience levels. But we’re more than a travel company —we’re pioneers in crafting extraordinary experiences that bring people closer to the world and each other. We blend innovation, precision, and an unrelenting drive for excellence, drawing strength from our roots as a long-standing, family-run, global company.  We are dynamic, resilient and invest deeply in our people and our guests. We set the benchmark in active travel and raise it every year. 

Why Backroads:

Backroads is built on sustainable growth, a transparent culture and a high-caliber team. We empower employees to deliver exceptional experiences and share our story with pride. You’ll work alongside dedicated, competent and active colleagues in an environment that values collaboration, balance and continual improvement. We move fast, act with integrity and strive for high-quality results.

Backroads is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Salary Ranges:

$100,000.00 - $125,000.00

At Backroads, we uphold a commitment to transparency and fairness within our hiring process, particularly regarding compensation. The salary range posted for each role applies to both employment offers and employees actively working in the role.

New hires are typically offered a starting salary between the minimum and midpoint of the range to ensure there is continued opportunity for salary progression during your employment at Backroads, reflecting our commitment to rewarding ongoing dedication, high performance, and significant contributions to our team. This approach not only supports our budgeting strategy but also our intention to foster an environment that encourages long-term growth and strong relationships between Backroads and our valued employees.

Our office roles are onsite in our Berkeley headquarters, unless specifically noted as 'available for remote'. We do allow one work-from-home day a week, as well as one work-from-anywhere week per year. This pay range is intended for in-person work in our Berkeley, CA headquarters. Pay ranges for remote-eligible roles will be subject to adjustment based on the geolocation of the employee.

Title: Analyst, Sales Planning
Description:
As Torani continues to grow toward our vision of reaching $1B by 2030, the importance of clear insights, reliable reporting, and strong business planning continues to grow alongside it. To support these efforts, we’re looking for a Sales Planning Analyst who can help turn data into actionable insights that improve decision-making and support sales execution across the organization.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with data, identifying trends, and helping teams better understand business performance. The Sales Planning Analyst will support sales reporting, retail analytics, customer insights, and planning processes that help sales leadership make informed decisions and prioritize opportunities effectively.

The most successful person in this role combines analytical thinking with strong business curiosity. They proactively identify trends, improve reporting processes, and help translate complex data into clear and actionable recommendations for the business. This role will work closely with Sales, Sales Operations, Demand Planning, and Marketing to improve visibility into performance and support strategic growth initiatives.

Why You’ll Love Working Here: At Torani, we flavor more than just drinks – we flavor lives. We’re a Certified B Corporation committed to shared success, and that means everyone here plays a meaningful role. You’ll be empowered to grow, try new things, and help others thrive.

SUCCESS FACTORS (FIRST 12–18 MONTHS)


Business Insights Contributor: You’ve become a trusted source of business insights by delivering clear, accurate, and actionable reporting that helps sales leadership understand performance, identify opportunities, and make informed decisions. Your ability to connect data to business context improves visibility across customers, channels, and categories.
Reporting & Dashboard Owner: You’ve streamlined and improved recurring reports and dashboards to make information easier to access and understand. By making reporting more consistent, accurate, and easier to maintain, you’ve reduced manual work and helped teams feel more confident using the data.
Retail & Customer Analytics Partner: You’ve improved how the organization evaluates retail performance by building and maintaining reporting that highlights sales trends, distribution gains, promotional effectiveness, assortment opportunities, and customer performance. Your analysis helps sales teams prioritize actions and focus on the highest impact opportunities.
Data Quality & Process Improver: You proactively identify data gaps, inconsistencies, and reporting challenges and help improve how information is maintained across systems. Through strong attention to detail and process improvement, you help create more reliable and scalable ways of working.
You Bring Fun!: You remind us that success isn’t just about what we achieve – it’s how we feel doing it, and you make sure it’s fun along the way.


What You’ll Bring:


2–5 years of experience in Sales Analytics, Sales Planning, Business Analytics, or related commercial roles
Experience in CPG, foodservice, beverage or related industries preferred
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to translate data into business insights
Advanced Excel skills required; experience with Power BI, Tableau, Salesforce, or other reporting tools preferred
Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities
Based in the Flavor Factory in San Leandro, CA


Why People Love Working Here

Why Torani


Become an owner: Every regular team member participates in Torani's Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), giving you the opportunity to share in the long-term success you're helping create: Profit Sharing, an annual bonus, and a 401(k) company match are just a few of the additional ways we celebrate and reward that success together.
Growing with purpose: For more than 35 years, Torani has grown year after year. That growth creates opportunities to build new skills, work with new technologies, and take on new challenges to keep building our business.
Better together: We work across teams, solve problems together, and support one another through both successes and setbacks.


More to Love


Healthcare that's fully covered: We pay 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for our team members.
Celebrate together: From Company Day and cultural heritage celebrations to team lunches and milestone celebrations, we make time to connect and celebrate.
The perks are pretty delicious: Enjoy unlimited Italian sodas, flavored lattes, and plenty of opportunities to taste the products we're creating together.
And, of course, the essentials: Competitive pay, paid time off, and a comprehensive benefits package to support you.


Work Location: San Leandro, Hybrid, 2 days on site, 3 days work from home

Salary Range: $90,220 - $100,244

Description:
Level Up Your Career with Zynga!

At Zynga, we bring people together through the power of play. As a global leader in interactive entertainment and a proud label of Take-Two Interactive, our games have been downloaded over 6 billion times—connecting players in 175+ countries through fun, strategy, and a little friendly competition.

From thrilling casino spins to epic strategy battles, mind-bending puzzles, and social word challenges, our diverse game portfolio has something for everyone. Fan-favorites and latest hits include FarmVille™, Words With Friends™, Zynga Poker™, Game of Thrones Slots Casino™, Wizard of Oz Slots™, Hit it Rich! Slots™, Wonka Slots™, Top Eleven™, Toon Blast™, Empires & Puzzles™, Merge Dragons!™, CSR Racing™, Harry Potter: Puzzles & Spells™, Match Factory™, and Color Block Jam™—plus many more!

Founded in 2007 and headquartered in California, our teams span North America, Europe, and Asia, working together to craft unforgettable gaming experiences. Whether you're spinning, strategizing, matching, or competing, Zynga is where fun meets innovation—and where you can take your career to the next level.

Join us and be part of the play!

Position Overview

Zynga is looking for an ambitious analyst to join our world-class advertising team. The mission of this role will be to maximize the value of our advertising inventory through operational excellence and creative analytics. This role’s responsibilities will be to model the short and long term economic value of our ad products, identify new supply opportunities for our users, and scale our findings into actionable reports. This is a collaborative, highly visible position that will directly impact the daily revenues of the business. The ideal candidate will enjoy working with numbers and identifying patterns and trends, and will be eager to develop skills in econometrics, user segmentation, process management, and product & business intelligence.

What You'll Do


Maximize the value of advertising inventory through manual and automated processes.
Design, execute, and analyze innovative pre/post and A/B tests to identify new opportunities.
Synthesize data into dashboards and reports using Excel, SQL, and Tableau.
Refine data processes, set up tools, and create automation to improve operational efficiency.
Execute ad hoc analysis to identify revenue optimization opportunities and improve business performance.
Assist with daily operations and analytics as needed.
Role may also require researching recent trends in the mobile advertising, mobile gaming, and advertising technology industries.


What You Bring


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field
At least 2 years of experience in a data-intensive role
Prior experience in mobile gaming or advertising is a big plus
Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel including pivot tables, lookups, conditional functions, charting, and keyboard shortcuts
Advanced skills in SQL including joins, creating tables, case statements, and subqueries
Prior experience using dashboarding software (especially Tableau) or Python/R is a big plus
Strong problem-solving skills, teamwork, and creativity
Strong work ethic to consistently meet deadlines in a fast-paced business
Intellectual curiosity to dig through large volumes of data in order to uncover the insights within it
Exceptional accuracy and attention to detail, time management skills, and openness toward growth
Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills
Enthusiasm about mobile gaming is a plus


What We Offer You

The pay range for this position in California at the start of employment is expected to be between $78,900 and $116,760 per year. However, base pay offered is based on market location, and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations.

Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or equity awards and eligibility to participate in our 401(K) plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program.

Regular, full-time employees are also eligible for a range of benefits at the Company, including: medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance coverage; 14 paid holidays per calendar year; paid vacation time per calendar year (ranging from 15 to 25 days) or eligibility to participate in the Company’s discretionary time off program; up to 10 paid sick days per calendar year; paid parental and compassionate leave; wellbeing programs for mental health and other wellness support; family planning support through Maven; commuter benefits; and reimbursements for fitness-related expenses.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, which means we are committed to creating and celebrating diverse thoughts, cultures, and backgrounds throughout our organization. Employment with us is based on substantive ability, objective qualifications, and work ethic – not an individual’s race, creed, color, religion, sex or gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin or ancestry, alienage or citizenship status, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, status as a victim of domestic violence or sex offenses, reproductive health decision, or any other characteristics protected by applicable law.

As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing the necessary support and accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities, health conditions, or impairments (subject to any local qualifying requirements) to ensure their full participation in the job application or interview process. Please contact us at accommodationrequest@zynga.com to request any accommodations or for support related to your application for an open position.

Please be aware that Zynga does not conduct job interviews or make job offers over third-party messaging apps such as Telegram, WhatsApp, or others. Zynga also does not engage in any financial exchanges during the recruitment or onboarding process, and will never ask a candidate for their personal or financial information over an app or other unofficial chat channel. Any attempt to do so may be the result of a scamp or phishing attack, and you should not engage. Zynga’s in-house recruitment team will only contact individuals through their official Company email addresses (i.e., via a zynga.com, take2games.com, naturalmotion.com, smallgiantgames.com, themavens.com, gram.gs email domain).
