Title: Data Scientist (Growth)
Description:
About Us

At Rox, we believe in empowering people to do their best work.

Our platform supercharges sellers with autonomous revenue agents to do the manual work so they can focus on what they do best: selling. Just as coding agents 10x’d engineering, revenue agents 10x customer work.

We are reimagining the revenue stack by building the world’s first revenue operating system, from the application layer to the system of context. With Rox, humans are evolving to orchestrators while agents manage the end-to-end customer lifecycle.

Rox powers Global 2000 leaders in banking, hardware, construction, and sovereign AI, while serving dominant AI winners like Ramp and Cognition.

Underlying all of this success is a unwavering, shared belief in the mission, with an unreasonable commitment of doing whatever it takes to make it a reality.

The Team

Nothing is possible without the world-class team, assembled to redefine how businesses operate.

Members On Our Team Have


Founded and exited successful companies
Held the highest positions at Google, AWS, Confluent, and New Relic
Won IMO and IOI gold medals
Published field-defining papers


We’re backed by the best, having raised $50M from Sequoia (Alfred Lin), General Catalyst (Hemant Taneja), Google Ventures, Elad Gil, and Chris Ré.

Core Principles

Taste: Craft beautiful experiences.

No matter how small, we strive to make sure every detail is right. We care deeply about every interaction, both in terms of whether it helps the seller get the job done, but also how the product makes them feel. We get a visceral feeling when something is off and stop at nothing to make sure we make it right. We never settle, continuously exploring ways to delight sellers.

Obsession: Commit unreasonably.

In all aspects of our craft, we commit. We not only are immediately reactive to customers’ requests but are proactive about driving value even before they ask. We are also obsessive about always learning and honing our craft, improving ourselves and product every single day.

Action: Get it done.

Talking is easy but the difference comes from the execution. We lean heavily towards making thoughtful yet fast decisions and delivering immediately. We play in a field where trust is paramount. We earn the trust and right to empower the best sellers by forging a history of over-delivering on the promise at record speed.

Role

As a Data Scientist at Rox, you will power the intelligence layer behind the world’s first revenue operating system. You’ll be responsible for the metrics, insights, and analytical frameworks that shape how we build product, operate as a business, and help our customers transform their revenue organizations.

This is a high-ownership, high-leverage role for someone who thrives at the intersection of data, GTM, product strategy, and operational excellence. You will work directly with leadership, engineering, and GTM pods to create clarity, drive decisions, and build the analytical foundations that scale with the company.

If you love turning ambiguity into structured insight, building clean data models, and influencing business strategy with evidence, this is the role for you.

You'll be one of Rox's first dedicated data hires. It's an opportunity to help build an agile data function from the ground up at an early-stage, fast-growing company.

Responsibilities


Build and maintain dashboards, KPIs, and the company-wide single source of truth for revenue, usage, and customer telemetry.
Partner with GTM leaders to drive segmentation, funnel insights, measurement of workflow adoption and ROI.
Build and maintain COGS and unit-economics models with Finance, giving the business a clear view of cost-per-action and margin by customer and product.
Own and improve our dbt/Paradime models and Snowflake pipelines, keeping data quality, reliability, and consistency high as the foundation everything else runs on.
Ship self-serve tooling (internal data apps, dbt models, and Sigma dashboards) that GTM and Finance rely on without hand-holding.
Run deep product and usage analytics, including cohort and uplift analysis, to measure adoption, support enterprise rollouts, and inform product decisions.
Deliver clear, defensible analyses to support leadership and new revenue motions, framing the metric, the method, and the "so what."
Create scalable documentation, metric dictionaries, automations, and enablement materials while onboarding teams into Rox’s data ecosystem.


Qualifications

Required


Degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics)
2–5+ years experience in fast-paced, high-growth companies supporting Sales, Finance, or Product
Strong SQL and Python skills, able to work efficiently with large, messy datasets
Experience working with dbt ecosystems (e.g, paradime, dbt)
Experience building dashboards in tools like Sigma, Looker, Tableau, Mode, or equivalent
Exceptional analytical rigor and structured problem-solving skills
Strong communication skills, able to translate complex data into simple narratives for both technical and non-technical stakeholders
High energy, “no job is too small” mentality, and ability to operate with extreme ownership
Ability to context-switch rapidly and thrive in an environment of speed, ambiguity, and high expectations
Located in or willing to relocate to San Francisco


Preferred


Experience at a consumption or usage-based business (e.g., Datadog, New Relic, Snowflake), with fluency in usage metering and unit economics
Or a Finance / FP&A background with experience building and owning COGS, margin, or cost models
Experience working directly with GTM organizations and leadership teams
Knowledge of revenue methodologies, KPIs, and operational models
Familiarity with data warehousing technologies
Experience designing semantic layers and metric governance processes
Ability to build minimal data apps, Python scripts, or automations to scale workflows
Experience supporting enterprise customers or working with B2B SaaS telemetry datasets
Strong intuition for business levers, product adoption mechanics, and cohort analysis
Comfort with AI-native development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code to move quickly


Benefits


Competitive pay with considerable equity upside
Health Insurance


Apply

Title: Data Analyst I, Tech
Description:
About The Role And Team

Working at Uber means solving hard problems in a high-stakes, fast-moving environment. As a Data Analyst, you will help drive the analysis behind critical decisions related to operations, process, and optimizations. You will turn unstructured problems with lots of ambiguity into focused plans of execution, creating analytical frameworks to support new initiatives and products.

This role requires you to be a big-picture thinker and strategic partner who can move with urgency and care. You'll need to take ownership of your work, stay adaptable through constant change, and demonstrate resilience when navigating the messy reality of doing big things at scale. If you are energized by challenge and motivated by real-world impact, this is where you will grow.

Rate of Pay: $113,000 to $138,000 per Year

You will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered other types of comp. You will also be eligible for various benefits. More details can be found at the following link https://www.uber.com/careers/benefits.

What You'll Do


Partner with Customer Support, Engineering, and Product teams to gather and clarify business needs for analytics and reporting related to autonomous vehicle (AV) customer support.
Lead discovery and gap analysis to assess existing analytics coverage, data availability, and reporting workflows, and identify opportunities for improvement.
Document detailed business requirements, data requirements, metric definitions, and reporting specifications for new dashboards, reports, and analytics tools.
Translate business and analytics requirements into data solution requirements, defining data structures, context, and usage to support customer support quality measurement.
Perform source-to-target data mapping to support the design and implementation of new data models and data pipelines.
Support the design and development of scalable analytics solutions by ensuring alignment between business intent and technical implementation.
Participate in user acceptance testing (UAT) and data validation activities to ensure new data products meet functional requirements and established data quality standards.
Maintain and update documentation for data sources, metric definitions, reporting logic, and data lineage to support long-term scalability and maintainability.
Serve as a liaison between technical and non-technical stakeholders to align on goals, priorities, dependencies, and delivery timelines.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of data analytics infrastructure, data processes, and reporting workflows supporting autonomous vehicle customer support.
May telecommute.


Basic Qualifications


Employer will accept a Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Engineering, Analytics, or related field, and two years of experience in the job offered or in a related occupation.
Position requires two years in:
Translating complex customer support and product workflows in autonomous vehicle, ride-sharing, and delivery ecosystems into precise data, analytics, and reporting requirements to support operational and customer experience decisions;
Conducting end-to-end discovery, process mapping, and source-to-target data mapping across multiple systems to design scalable, auditable data models and analytics pipelines;
Using SQL to query, reconcile, and validate large-scale structured and semi-structured datasets, including identifying and resolving data quality issues in production analytics environments;
Performing scalable, repeatable data analysis using Python or R, to build reusable analytical frameworks;
Designing, executing, and interpreting A/B tests, simulations, or causal analyses to evaluate the impact of operational, tooling, or process changes in customer support environments;
Knowledge of autonomous vehicle technology and real-world customer support operations in transportation, ride-sharing, or food and grocery delivery environments, including service quality and operational efficiency;
Building and maintaining self-service dashboards and analytics using tools such as Tableau or Looker;
Validating, monitoring, and debugging analytics outputs in production by tracing issues across upstream data sources, transformation logic, and reporting layers.

Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

Title: Associate, Revenue Analytics Finance & Strategy - AI Automation
Description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Netflix’s analytical rigor is a meaningful competitive advantage. Revenue Analytics, within Business Finance & Strategy, plays a central role in shaping and communicating the company’s membership and revenue outlook. Our forecasts are critical inputs to corporate planning, resource allocation, and storytelling for internal leaders and external stakeholders, while our insights help inform growth and monetization strategy.

The team is also applying AI towards innovative solutions, using advanced AI development and productivity tools to build automated dashboards, forecast pipelines, reusable capabilities, and intelligence tools. As these solutions evolve from experimentation into core operating infrastructure, we are seeking an Associate, AI Automation to provide dedicated ownership and scale their impact.

This role is based in our Los Gatos, California office and follows a hybrid schedule, with in-office attendance Tuesday through Thursday.

Responsibilities


Build and maintain reusable, scalable workflows across revenue forecasting, subscriber analytics, membership reporting, and title performance.
Own dashboards, core tables, data pipelines, and ETL processes end to end, ensuring accuracy, reliability, usability, and observability.
Automate recurring reporting and deploy AI-powered self-service tools, agents, and reusable skills with appropriate human oversight.
Implement monitoring, anomaly detection, reconciliation, alerting, access controls, and versioned change management to keep critical data reliable and traceable.
Organize business knowledge, metric definitions, and analytical methodologies into structured repositories, tools, and playbooks that enable reliable AI outputs and responsible adoption across teams.


Qualifications


2-4 years of work experience in finance, analytics, consulting, or a related quantitative field.
Experience conducting quantitative analysis, including modeling, and using data to drive insights, recommendations, and results.
Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets and strong SQL skills; familiarity with Python is a plus.
Genuine interest in AI and automation, with a desire to experiment hands-on with Claude Code, Claude Cowork, or similar tools.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain analytical and technical concepts clearly to non-technical partners and senior leaders.
Strong initiative and ability to work independently, with the flexibility to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
Highly intellectually curious, willing to challenge the status quo, and committed to the highest personal and professional standards of integrity and ethics.
Degree in economics, business, mathematics, engineering, computer science, or other relevant field, or equivalent work experience.


Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $180,000.00 - $275,000.00.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here.

Title: Data and Analytics Engineer
Description:
Who we are…

We are Payactiv, a FinTech company in the heart of Silicon Valley, devoted to giving workers access to their earned wages when they need them. Payactiv is the pioneer and industry leader in Earned Wage Access. We are the only Certified B Corporation and Public Benefit Corporation in our industry. Our app provides millions with financial services that help them avoid debt, manage their finances, and regain flexibility to pay for things on their own schedule.

What you will do…

Payactiv is seeking a hands-on Data and Analytics Engineer to own and support our business reporting, analytics, dashboarding, and marketing/operational data request workflows. This is a highly technical role responsible for managing analytics dashboards and BI reporting, supporting our Snowflake data warehouse environment, fulfilling data requests for user lifecycle messaging, and ensuring the accuracy, quality, and reliability of business-critical reporting.

The ideal candidate has strong SQL skills, experience working with cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, and the ability to partner directly with business teams including User Lifecycle & Growth, Customer Success, Customer Support, Marketing, Legal, Compliance, and executive stakeholders. This person should be comfortable translating business questions into accurate data outputs, maintaining trusted dashboards, and supporting recurring and ad hoc reporting needs.

Title: Business Systems Analyst
Description:
The Opportunity

Do you like solving messy problems, organizing chaos, and turning data into decisions? Are you curious about how cloud technology, finance, and strategy intersect—? If so, this role was built for you.

This is a high-impact opportunity to join Adobe’s Cloud FinOps program, where we help teams understand, optimize, and make smarter decisions about cloud usage and investment. Work closely with finance, engineering, product, and leadership to drive meaningful cost efficiency—while building systems, dashboards, and processes that scale. We’re looking for someone motivated, thoughtful, and organized. Deep cloud expertise is helpful—but curiosity, grit, and the ability to break problems down and build solutions matter more. If you’ve ever enjoyed consulting-style problem solving, building your own frameworks, or automating something just because it annoyed you that it was manual—this role will feel like home.

The Challenge

As a FinOps Cloud Analyst, you’ll play a central role in how cloud efficiency data is created, shared, and acted on across Adobe—directly contributing to savings initiatives with millions of dollars in impact.

You will:


Design and run processes that collect, analyze, and distribute cloud cost, usage and efficiency metrics across every product team in Adobe
Create dashboards, tools, and automation that reduce manual work and scale insights (Tableau, SQL, Python, Cursor, or similar tools welcomed)
Help shape operating strategies for cloud optimization—identifying data, opportunities, and risks and turning insights into executable programs with achievements based roadmaps
Support internal “customers” by answering inquiries, surfacing trends, and proactively delivering the information teams need
Model financial impacts of cloud infrastructure and operating decisions and present insights to key decision makers


Key Skills and Experience Needed:


General: Are a full stack finance athlete with added capabilities across customer insights development, strategy creation, multi-functional leadership and program execution
Program Management: Ability to simultaneously oversee and lead multiple cloud business initiatives with high organizational skills. Ease in collaborating with finance, engineering and product managers to define project scope, objectives, timelines, and deliverables. Comfort in proposing / correcting pathways not just documenting what others say.
Technical Capability: An ability to automate the manual and engage with the ever changing business analytics and AI landscape
Finance & Analytics: Solid grasp of financial modeling and budgeting. You love numbers and Excel. Comfort working with ambiguity and can synthesize information into numbers with ease.
Customer Engagement: Skilled at building trust, influencing without authority, and soliciting feedback to incorporate into programs and communications. Not afraid to ask questions to get clarity.
Executive Communication: An uncanny ability to synthesize information from a variety of sources to present succinct, thoughtful decisions and opportunities. Capacity to seek executive guidance and support to overcome roadblocks. Competence in Power Point presentation and story telling.
Grit: Demonstrated perseverance through complex challenges and the ability to turn incomplete information into actionable decisions.


Why This Role Is Exciting


You’ll sit at the intersection of finance, technology, and strategy
Build—not just maintain—dashboards, processes, and automations
Gain exposure to executives and teams across all products and roles
Develop highly transferable skills in cloud economics, analytics, and AI-enabled work
Own your outcome - You’ll be trusted to figure things out and shape how FinOps operates


If you’re eager, analytical, and ready to grow fast—this role offers both responsibility and runway.

Qualifications:


BA/BS or equivalent experience in Business Administration, Communications, or a related field. MBA is preferred.
5+ years of experience in finance, analytics, consulting, or program management (flexible for exceptional candidates)
Project/Program management experience (PMP certification not required)
Consulting experience preferred
High proficiency in Power Point, Excel and Jira – Tableau, SQL a plus
History of working with large data sets and managing multiple concurrent work streams

Title: Reporting Analyst
Description:
If you are a data-driven individual with a passion for uncovering insights and driving business success, we would love to hear from you! As a Reporting Analyst, you will play a key role in gathering and analyzing data to help inform business decisions. You will work with various departments to understand their data needs, perform data analysis, and provide access to data using tools like Power BI.

Position Responsibilities


Collect, clean, and analyze data from multiple sources to support business goals.
Develop and maintain dashboards and reports using Power BI to track key performance indicators (KPIs).
Identify trends, patterns, and insights in data sets.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand their data requirements and provide actionable insights.
Create data visualizations using Power BI to effectively communicate findings to stakeholders.
Collaborate with the automation specialist to find ways to automate the delivery of reports, improve efficiency and ensure timely access to data.
Assist in the implementation of data-driven strategies
Ensure data accuracy and integrity by performing regular data quality checks.
Stay current with industry trends and best practices in data analysis.


Required Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field.
Proven experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar role.
Proficiency in data analysis tools (e.g., SQL, Excel).
Experience with data visualization tools, particularly Power BI.


Preferred Qualifications


Bilingualism (English and French) is an asset. If the successful candidate is in Québec, proficiency in both languages will be required to support clients from various provinces outside of Quebec.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy.


When You Join Our Team


We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.
We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words.
As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.

Title: Underwriting Analyst
Description:
We are seeking an Underwriting Analyst to join our team in Toronto, Montreal, Winnipeg, or Burnaby. The Underwriting Analyst supports and enhances underwriting tools, reporting, pricing, and quoting systems while developing technical solutions for ad hoc underwriting requests.

This can be a hybrid or remote role.

The Underwriting Analyst Will


Analyze and interpret large and complex datasets to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable insights for clients and internal stakeholders.
Develop, maintain, and enhance reporting tools, dashboards, and data models using Excel, Power Query, and other analytical tools.
Assist with the development and continuous improvement of underwriting tools, processes, reporting automation, and data management practices.
Gain familiarity with pricing analysis and evaluating new business opportunities through TPA channels in order to be able to maintain and improve existing quote tools.
Analyze claims experience, demographic data, financial results, and carrier proposals to develop recommendations and support strategic decision-making.
Collaborate with carriers, consultants, Account Managers, brokers, and internal teams to gather data and ensure accurate underwriting outcomes.
Identify plan performance, claims trends, and reporting issues, and recommend solutions to internal stakeholders.
Prepare renewal analysis and reporting packages, including support for insurer negotiations.
Support new sales initiatives and revenue growth objectives through data-driven analysis and underwriting expertise.
Provide underwriting and analytical consulting services to various stakeholders.
Maintain effective working relationships with insurers, Plan Sponsors, Plan Administrators, consultants, and internal partners.


To be successful as an Underwriting Analyst with People Corporation, you will need:


Post-secondary education in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Actuarial Science, Business Analytics, or a related discipline; equivalent experience will also be considered.
3–5 years of experience in underwriting, insurance, group benefits, financial analysis, or a similar analytical role.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, advanced formulas, data analysis, and data clean up techniques.
Experience using Power Query to transform, validate, and automate data processes.
Experience with VBA or other automation tools is considered a strong asset.
Demonstrated experience working with large datasets and producing insightful reports, analyses, and recommendations.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
Ability to interpret complex data and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
Effective verbal and written communication skills.
Strong collaboration and teamwork skills, including the ability to work across departments and with external partners.
Knowledge of group benefits, underwriting principles, and/or the insurance industry is an asset.
GBA designation or progress toward a professional industry designation is an asset.


What's In It For You


Learn by working alongside our experts
Extended health care and dental benefits

A suite of Health & Wellness offerings
Mental Health programs and support for you and your family
Competitive compensation

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Job Overview




We are seeking a Pricing Analyst to join our team and help drive strategic, data-informed pricing decisions across our fastener and industrial component product lines. In this role, you will analyze cost structures, margins, market trends, and competitive pricing to develop pricing strategies that balance profitability with market competitiveness.




Working closely with the Sales, Purchasing, and Finance teams, you will ensure pricing decisions align with both customer expectations and business objectives. You will also leverage advanced Excel and data analysis tools to support pricing initiatives, improve reporting processes, and provide actionable insights. This position reports directly to the Manager, Pricing.


This is a mid-level role best suited for a candidate with hands-on experience in pricing analysis, cost analysis, or revenue management, ideally within an industrial distribution, manufacturing, wholesale, or other B2B environment. The successful candidate will be highly analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with large data sets to support business decision-making in a fast-paced environment.










Responsibilities





Monitor vendor cost changes, commodity trends (steel, raw materials), and freight/tariff impacts, and adjust pricing models accordingly.


Conduct competitive pricing analysis within the fastener and industrial distribution market to identify opportunities and risks.


Build and maintain pricing models, price books, and matrices used by the sales team for quoting.


Partner with sales on customer-specific and contract pricing within our pricing framework.


Track pricing performance and margin trends, flagging anomalies or erosion for leadership review.


Support price list updates, including communication of changes to internal teams and customers.


Collaborate with purchasing/procurement to align pricing strategy with cost changes and inventory positioning.


Prepare regular reporting and dashboards on pricing, margin, and profitability metrics for leadership.


Assist in developing pricing policies and approval workflows aligned with our pricing model.


Build and maintain Python scripts/tools to automate pricing calculations, data cleanup, and recurring reporting.





Qualifications





2-5 years of experience in pricing analysis, cost analysis, or a related financial/analytical role — experience in fastener, industrial distribution, or manufacturing industries strongly preferred.


Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.


Advanced Excel proficiency is required, including expertise with complex formulas, pivot tables, lookups, data analysis, and large/complex workbooks. This is a core requirement for the role.


Working knowledge of Python is required for automating pricing calculations, data cleansing, reporting, and workflow optimization.


Strong understanding of pricing methodologies, including margin analysis, cost-plus pricing, list-less pricing, and competitive pricing strategies.


Experience working with ERP systems such as NetSuite, Epicor, SAP, Infor, or similar platforms is considered an asset.


Proven ability to analyze large data sets and translate findings into clear, actionable business recommendations.


Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across sales, purchasing, finance, and other cross-functional teams.


Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, with a strong understanding of the business impact of pricing decisions and errors.


Highly organized self-starter with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and thrive in a fast-paced distribution environment.





Nice to Have





Familiarity with fastener product categories, including bolts, nuts, screws, washers, specialty fasteners, or similar industrial/MRO products.


Experience with SQL, Power BI, or other data analysis and visualization tools.


Experience applying Python to data analysis, reporting automation, and process improvement initiatives.


Previous experience supporting pricing, sales, purchasing, or supply chain functions within a distribution or manufacturing environment.





 Company Overview




The Fastener Group Ltd. (TFG) is a leading supplier of fasteners and tools with 21 locations in Canada, dedicated to providing high-quality products and exceptional service to our customers. TFG is committed to growth and innovation in the fasteners and tools industry, offering a wide range of products for various industries, including manufacturing, construction, and industrial.

We are seeking a skilled Data Engineer to join our dynamic Data & Analytics team, within the Platforms & Transformation group. This is an excellent opportunity to work within great teams across the business on complex, challenging and rewarding projects and initiatives to build towards the success of AXIS.

Data Analysis & Modelling:


Work with the business teams, including senior leaders, to define the data products and use cases along with their data lineage, critical data elements, data glossaries and data quality rules.
Work with the Data Architecture team to enable the design of best-in-class current state and future state data flow diagrams
Partner with the Data Insights and AI & Innovation teams to design the outputs and workflows for Use Cases and Data Products.
Use your industry experience to define the metrics required for projects and solutions.
Lead the QA testing of data products and supporting the business teams during UAT.
Support the future phases of data products you have delivered in projects once live where you are considered a subject matter expert and have a relationship with the business teams.



Data Engineering:


Run simple and complex queries to understand existing data structures and relationships, data quality gaps and metric formulas to enable accurate documentation of the current state solutions.
Use your advanced Excel skills to reverse engineer complex workbooks with macros and layered formulas to enable modular redesign in our modern data architecture.
Build and execute test models against both on-premises SQL Server and Azure Databricks databases.
Work closely with the development teams to ensure your data product templates are clearly defined to the specifications required by the application delivery leads.
You may also be required to take on additional duties, responsibilities and activities appropriate to the nature of this role.



About You:

We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table, so while there are some qualifications and experiences, we need you to have, we are open to discussing how your individual knowledge might lend itself to fulfilling this role and help us achieve our goals.

What you need to have:


Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related technical field (or equivalent work experience).

Experience in data modelling in Excel having worked within Data Governance and Data Quality frameworks

Experience with large complex projects delivering data products and use cases
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.
Ability to time manage and work across different priorities.

Insurance industry experience.
Microsoft SQL Server and Azure Databricks experience
Ability to read programming languages
Knowledge of Insurance KPIs and metrics and processing within Underwriting, Claims and Pricing
Experience taking a key role on Data & Analytics projects

A Little Bit About Us

Founded in Vancouver in 2016, FORM is the sports technology company behind the award-winning FORM Smart Swim Goggles. Position Overview

We're seeking an experienced Analytics Developer to strengthen FORM's analytics data foundation and business intelligence capabilities. Working primarily in SQL, dbt, Amazon Redshift and Tableau, you will transform raw product, subscription, ecommerce and financial data into trusted, reusable models and translate those models into clear, decision-ready dashboards and visualizations. Primary Responsibilities


Build and maintain scalable SQL and dbt models in Amazon Redshift
Transform raw product, subscription, ecommerce, marketing and financial data into clean, reusable analytics datasets
Define and maintain consistent business metrics, including revenue, MRR, churn, retention, trial conversion, customer lifetime value and sales performance
Implement automated data-quality tests, documentation and lineage so stakeholders can trust and understand the data
Monitor scheduled analytics workflows, investigate failures and improve pipeline reliability
Develop and maintain Tableau data sources and dashboards using curated warehouse models
Build Python-based data integrations and automation where SQL and dbt are not the right tools
Improve Git-based development, code review, deployment and CI/CD practices for analytics
Partner with Analytics, Data Engineering and business stakeholders to translate requirements into durable data products


Requirements

Required Skills and Qualifications


3 - 5 years of experience in analytics development, data engineering or a highly technical analytics role
Advanced SQL skills and strong knowledge of dimensional data modelling
Hands-on experience building, testing and documenting production data models with dbt
Experience working with a cloud data warehouse; Amazon Redshift and AWS experience are preferred
Experience using Git, code review and software development practices in an analytics environment
Working proficiency in Python for data pipelines, integrations or automation
Experience with Tableau or another modern business intelligence platform
Ability to troubleshoot data issues across source systems, transformation pipelines and downstream reporting
Strong communication skills and the ability to turn ambiguous business questions into clear, maintainable data solutions


Nice to Haves


Experience with Dagster, Airflow or another workflow orchestration platform
Experience with Fivetran or other managed data ingestion tools
Experience with subscription, ecommerce, product telemetry or financial data
Experience working in a fast-paced startup or consumer technology environment

Group Life - AD&D - Critical Illness Insurance
Paid Time Off Benefits
Employee Discounts

Reporting to Senior Data Analyst, Team Lead, we're looking for a curious and collaborative Data Analyst (Survey Tabulations) to join Reach3 Insights. In this role, you'll help turn survey data into accurate, decision-ready cross-tabulations, working with smart, kind people who love turning human insights into clear stories, stronger decisions, and better customer experiences.

This role is open to candidates based in Canada, with a remote working model designed to support connection, focused work, and real life outside of work.

About Reach3 Insights

Reach3 Insights is a full-service research consultancy that helps modern brands move faster and get closer to their customers through mobile-first, conversational research. We design immersive, in-the-moment research programs, pair them with smart data science and dynamic storytelling, and turn insight into action.

As part of Rival Group — alongside Rival Technologies and Angus Reid — we're helping transform the insights industry through AI-accelerated, messaging-based conversational insights. Our work reaches consumers and business audiences in ways that feel fresh, human, and genuinely useful.

We work with ambitious teams and global brands, and we take the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. You'll find a team that values trust, curiosity, ownership, creativity, and having a good time while doing meaningful work.

What you'll own


Produce accurate, well-formatted cross-tabulations from survey data using WinCross, SPSS, Microsoft Excel, and other relevant tools; review questionnaires and tabulation plans, clarify requirements, and deliver accurate outputs.
Complete rigorous quality checks on survey data and tables, investigate discrepancies, collaborate to resolve issues, and advise researchers on how to structure and interpret analysis outputs across different survey methods and designs.
Plan and prioritize work in ClickUp, track output, and improve turnaround time, accuracy, and productivity by testing AI and emerging tools, recommending process improvements, supporting new tool rollouts, and maintaining training and process documentation.


What you bring


At least 2 years of professional experience preparing, transforming, and tabulating market research survey data, plus a university or college degree or graduate certificate in market research, analytics, statistics, economics, social sciences, or another field involving research methods and data analysis.
Hands-on proficiency with SPSS and WinCross, strong Microsoft Excel skills, and experience working with survey datasets and producing cross-tabulations.
Clear, concise written and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative approach when working with local and remote teammates and research stakeholders.
A proactive, curious approach to change and ambiguity, with the judgment to test new ideas responsibly, evaluate their impact, and continuously improve data analysis workflows.
The ability to prioritize high-impact work, manage competing deadlines, stay organized, and consistently deliver accurate, high-quality outputs in a fast-moving environment.
Accountability for goals and deliverables, with the ability to work independently, collaborate effectively as part of a team, and bring a positive, solutions-oriented mindset as priorities evolve.

Familiarity with questionnaires, table specifications, banners, filters, and weighting is an asset.
Experience working in market research or public opinion research is preferred.

Title: Business Analyst
Description:
Business Analyst

Eastlink




Work Location: 33 Alderney Drive, Dartmouth, NS (On-site, 5 days per week)

Department: Customer Care

Reports To: Director, Customer Service & Accounts Receivable

Employment Status: Full time, 40 hours per week




At Eastlink, our Business Analysts are driven by curiosity, problem-solving, and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact. By transforming data into actionable insights, they help us improve performance and enhance the customer experience to move the business forward.

In this role, you'll support our Customer Care and Accounts Receivable teams by providing analysis that helps leaders understand performance and anticipate future business needs. You'll work across teams to evaluate trends, support planning activities, and recommend improvements that contribute to operational effectiveness and business success.




What You’ll Be Doing

As a Business Analyst, you'll help the business better understand performance, identify opportunities, and make informed decisions. You will:

Monitor and analyze key operational, customer service, and Accounts Receivable metrics.
Create and maintain reports, dashboards, and performance scorecards.
Present findings in a clear way to help teams prioritize actions and achieve results.
Support forecasting, workforce planning, and sales performance tracking.
Partner with leaders to evaluate challenges, answer business questions, and recommend solutions.
Contribute to improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency and support business goals.




What We’re Looking For

We're looking for someone who enjoys working with information, asking thoughtful questions, and finding practical solutions. You’ll succeed in this role if you:

Are naturally curious and enjoy understanding the story behind the numbers.
Take ownership of your work and can confidently manage priorities independently.
Approach challenges with strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.
Can identify trends, evaluate impacts, and make well-supported recommendations.
Are comfortable working with both detailed information and the bigger business picture.
Build strong working relationships and collaborate effectively with different teams.
Communicate clearly and can adjust information to different audiences.
Have a strong commitment to accuracy, quality, and continuous learning.




What You’ll Bring

Three or more years of experience in an analytical, financial, operational, or business support role.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including experience working with large and complex datasets.
Demonstrated experience gathering, analyzing, and interpreting business data.







Strong reporting and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate findings effectively.
Experience working with performance metrics, forecasting, and operational reporting.
Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and time management abilities.

Title: Vineyard Business Analyst
Description:
Winemaking in some major regions of the world can be an ‘industrial’ undertaking, but for us here at Iconic Wineries of British Columbia, every decision in the vineyard has a direct impact on the quality of what ultimately ends up in the bottle.

Exceptional vineyards require more than great farming practices. They require clear insights, strong operational discipline, and the ability to understand the story behind the data.

Our vineyards generate vast amounts of information every season, from labour and productivity metrics to purchasing activity, operational costs, vineyard performance trends, and planning data. The opportunity is no longer collecting data. It is transforming that information into meaningful insights that help our teams make better decisions.

The Role

As our Vineyard Business Analyst, you will play a critical role in helping us better understand, measure, and optimize the performance of our vineyard operations. Sitting at the intersection of data, operations, finance, and viticulture, you will transform complex operational information into actionable insights that improve productivity, strengthen cost visibility, and support decision-making across our vineyards. This is a highly collaborative role that combines business analysis, operational reporting, procurement support, and data visualization. You will work closely with Vineyard Managers, operational leaders, and finance partners to uncover trends, identify opportunities, and build reporting tools that provide clarity across vineyard operations. More than a reporting role, this is an opportunity to bring a fresh perspective, challenge assumptions with data, and help shape how vineyard performance is measured and managed for years to come.

Productivity & Performance Analytics


Measure and monitor vineyard productivity, labour efficiency, and operational performance across activities, blocks, sites, and seasons.
Analyze key operational metrics including hours per acre, cost per activity, labour utilization, and year-over-year performance trends.
Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce waste, and support continuous improvement initiatives.
Translate complex operational data into practical recommendations that vineyard leadership can act on.
Support annual planning processes through productivity benchmarking, workforce analysis, and operational forecasting.
Develop meaningful performance indicators that help leaders understand operational effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.


Data Visualization & Reporting


Design and maintain dashboards and reporting tools that provide visibility into vineyard performance and operational health.
Transform data from multiple operational systems into meaningful business insights.
Develop reporting frameworks that allow teams to proactively identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
Present data in a clear and compelling way, helping stakeholders understand the story behind the numbers.
Ensure data integrity, consistency, and accessibility across vineyard reporting processes.
Create visualizations that simplify complex datasets and support informed decision-making at all levels of the organization.


Financial Analysis, Procurement & Cost Visibility


Support procurement and purchasing activities by validating invoices and ensuring alignment to approved budgets and plans.
Monitor vineyard operating costs and spending trends to improve financial visibility across the organization.
Partner with Finance and operational teams to improve cost reporting and forecasting accuracy.
Identify potential productivity or cost-related risks before they become larger operational challenges.
Maintain disciplined documentation and reporting standards that support planning, budgeting, and operational decision-making.
Help establish stronger cost controls and spending transparency across vineyard operations.


Collaboration & Continuous Improvement


Partner closely with Vineyard Managers, operational leaders, finance teams, vendors, and stakeholders across the business.
Build trusted relationships while introducing new ways of measuring and evaluating operational performance.
Support the development of data-driven processes that improve consistency and operational discipline across vineyard operations.
Bring curiosity, fresh thinking, and a continuous improvement mindset to help evolve how work gets done.
Contribute to a culture where decisions are informed by data, insight, and transparency.
Act as a bridge between operational teams and data, ensuring insights translate into meaningful action.


Who You Are


Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, Supply Chain, Agriculture, or a related discipline.
2+ years of experience in business analysis, operational analytics, financial analysis, supply chain, procurement, or a similar analytical role.
Advanced Excel skills with strong capabilities in data manipulation, reporting, and analysis.
Experience with data visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting tools.
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to transform data into actionable recommendations.
Comfortable working with both operational and financial datasets in a fast-paced environment.
Strong communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders through data and insights.
Experience in agriculture, wine, food manufacturing, supply chain, logistics, or operational environments is considered an asset, but not required.
Naturally curious, detail-oriented, and motivated by solving problems and improving processes.
Able to translate complex information into simple, practical business recommendations.


What's In It For You


A rare opportunity to help build and shape how vineyard performance is measured across one of Canada's most respected premium wine organizations.
Visible impact across vineyard operations, influencing planning, budgeting, productivity improvement, and operational decision-making.
Exposure to vineyard operations, finance, procurement, business analytics, and strategic planning in one highly collaborative role.
The opportunity to create reporting tools and processes that become foundational to how our teams operate.
A role where your insights directly influence business decisions rather than sit in a report.
Partnership with experienced vineyard, finance, and operational leaders who value curiosity, fresh thinking, and continuous improvement.
The ability to bring a fresh lens, challenge legacy processes, and make a measurable impact on how the business operates.
Opportunity to grow your scope and influence as our vineyard analytics and reporting capabilities continue to evolve.


Why Join Us?

Iconic Wineries of British Columbia is committed to hiring, engaging, and growing qualified, talented, and motivated team members at every level of our organization. We offer competitive compensation that recognizes individual and company performance. The typical hiring range for this position is $65,000 - $80,000 annually, complemented by a bonus plan. Access to company-matched RRSP contributions

We stay curious, dreaming big and navigating the unknown with an enduring belief in better.

Made With Humility

We disrupt the status quo, moving fast to seize opportunities and acting scrappy to stay ahead of industry giants.

Title: Analyst, Platform & Enablement
Description:
Role Summary

Job Description Summary

We are seeking a Data Analyst to join the Analytics Architecture team within McAfee’s Analytics Platform & Enablement organization. In this role you will build, validate, and maintain the analytical logic behind McAfee’s most critical consumer business metrics — retention rate, trial conversion, bookings, subscriber counts, and marketing effectiveness. You will work directly in Databricks writing SQL and Python to transform raw data into certified KPIs that drive decisions at the VP and C-level.

This is a hands-on, high-output role. You will own end-to-end analysis cycles: receiving business questions from leadership, translating them into data logic, validating results against source-of-truth systems, and delivering findings that directly influence how McAfee measures and optimizes its subscription business. You will partner closely with Data Engineering, Finance, Marketing, and Product teams on a daily basis.

This position reports to the Senior Manager of Analytics Architecture and works alongside 2–3 peer analysts who collectively own the analytical foundations for McAfee’s consumer business.

This is a Hybrid Position located in either Waterloo or Toronto, Canada. We are only considering candidates within a commutable distance to either location. You will be required to be onsite on an as-needed basis; when not working onsite, you will work from your home office.

Position Details

About The Role


Build and validate the data logic behind core business KPIs — translating business definitions into certified analytical models across multiple dimensions.
Perform end-to-end data reconciliation — validating analytical datasets against finance and operational source-of-truth systems, investigating discrepancies, and ensuring accuracy of reported metrics.
Conduct customer lifecycle analysis — defining and measuring customer populations, segmenting behavior across acquisition, engagement, and renewal stages, and identifying drivers of key business outcomes.
Build waterfall and funnel analyses — decomposing aggregate metric movements into contributing factors, quantifying the impact of each, and presenting findings to leadership in a clear and actionable format.
Build and maintain data models and transformation logic — working in Databricks to create, migrate, and backfill analytical tables, validate data transformations, and ensure consistency between raw and curated data layers.
Produce and maintain automated dashboards and reports — building executive-facing visualizations that track business performance across multiple data sources with automated refresh pipelines.
Conduct root cause analysis on metric anomalies — investigating unexpected movements in KPIs, tracing issues through multiple data layers, and producing actionable findings for business stakeholders.
Analyze digital customer journeys and web funnels across acquisition, engagement, trial, purchase, and renewal touchpoints, using web analytics data to identify conversion drivers, drop-offs, and opportunities to improve customer outcomes.
Deliver ad-hoc analysis for senior leadership — responding to executive requests with data-driven insights on topics such as customer sizing, audience segmentation, and business performance deep dives.
Document data lineage and business logic — mapping how metrics flow from source systems through transformation layers to final reporting, ensuring traceability and auditability of all certified KPIs.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Finance, and Data Stewards to certify data logic before it enters production reporting, and flag data quality issues proactively.


About You


You have 5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related quantitative field.
You have deep expertise in subscription or SaaS business metrics — including retention rate, churn, auto-renewal, trial conversion, LTV, and bookings — ideally in a consumer technology or eCommerce context.
Data and coding fluency — you are a self-starter comfortable using SQL, Python, and generative AI tools to access data and deliver analysis independently.
You have hands-on experience with Databricks (SQL,Python, PySpark, Delta Lake) and can write, review, and troubleshoot complex analytical queries and data pipelines.
You have hands-on experience with web analytics and tracking ecosystems such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Adobe Launch, Google Tag Manager, or similar tools, including familiarity with events, sessions, users, UTM parameters, attribution, funnels, and conversion measurement.
You have experience with BI and reporting platforms — particularly Power BI.
You have experience with data validation and reconciliation — comparing data across source systems, identifying discrepancies, and documenting business rules that govern metric calculations.
You are comfortable performing root cause analysis — diagnosing why a metric moved, tracing issues through multiple data layers, and presenting findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You can translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches — scoping the data needed, defining assumptions, and delivering concise answers under time pressure.
You have experience working in agile environments — managing your own backlog across 2-week sprints, balancing recurring reporting with project work, and communicating progress and blockers proactively.


Company Overview

McAfee is a leader in personal security for consumers. Focused on protecting people, not just devices, McAfee consumer solutions adapt to users’ needs in an always online world, empowering them to live securely through integrated, intuitive solutions that protects their families and communities with the right security at the right moment.

Company Benefits And Perks

We work hard to embrace diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone at McAfee to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We’re proud to be Great Place to Work® Certified in 10 countries, a reflection of the supportive, empowering environment we’ve built where people feel seen, valued, and energized to reach their full potential and thrive.

We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family-friendly benefits to all of our employees.


Bonus Program
Pension and Retirement Plans
Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
Paid Time Off
Paid Parental Leave
Support for Community Involvement


We're serious about our commitment to diversity which is why McAfee prohibits discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status.

Pay Range

The anticipated compensation for this position is CAD $122,010.00/Yr. - CAD $165,070.00/Yr. depending on experience and qualifications.

Position Overview:

Finning Canada is looking to hire a permanent, full-time Procurement Data Specialist in Edmonton or Calgary who will report to the Procurement Performance Manager.

Major Job Responsibilities:


Manage and optimize procurement data and systems by maintaining the integrity of supplier, item, and related master data within the enterprise resource planning (ERP) system, while supporting overall system functionality and data architecture.
Partner with internal and external stakeholders to gather business requirements, support data analysis, and translate operational needs into system and process improvements that enhance procurement performance.
Support ERP systems and continuous improvement initiatives by contributing to system enhancements, configuration changes, and integration activities in collaboration with IT and cross-functional teams to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
Develop and maintain data governance standards by establishing data policies, controls, and best practices to ensure consistency, accuracy, compliance, and system integrity across procurement processes.
Design and deliver reporting and insights by developing and maintaining reports, dashboards, and analytical outputs to support decision-making, performance tracking, and operational visibility.
Provide mentorship and guidance to Procurement Data Coordinators and support cross-functional teams in data processes, reporting tools, and system usage.
Lead and contribute to continuous improvement efforts by identifying opportunities to optimize procurement systems, workflows, and data processes, and ensuring initiatives are tracked through to completion.


Education and Experience:


Post-secondary degree in Business or Supply Chain, related to Data Management, Operations Management or related field
2+ years experience in a Data Management or Supply Chain role
Strong computer skills and proficient in MS Office Suite – specifically Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
Experience with MS Power Automate or similar workflow automation tools
Experience with analytics and the development of reports, metrics and dashboards using tools such as PowerBI
SQL and Excel (VBA) knowledge is an asset
Previous experience with SAP Ariba would be an asset
Knowledge and understanding of end-to-end supply chain management
Working knowledge of ERP and data base systems


Soft Skills:


Highly developed analytical and problem solving skills
Quality and timeliness - demonstrates a high level of organization, accuracy, and thoroughness, monitors own work to ensure quality, and able to prioritize key tasks versus required timelines.
Takes initiative and displays creativity and innovation in achieving results
Clear concise written, verbal, communication, presentation skills that are professional, timely and accurate
Strong customer focus
Ability to influence and collaborate
Ability to adapt to changing requirements and provide necessary support
Passion for driving continuous improvements

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

The Game Intelligence team within the Enterprise Intelligence organization is involved in every aspect of data at EA, using it to deliver valuable insights and solutions for game teams and players. We drive strategy, build data and AI tools, and support personalization, experimentation, and analytics. Join GI to work with experts dedicated to improving understanding, workflows, and player experiences.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Analyst, Insights to join our analytics team supporting a high-definition title in development. In this hybrid role based in Vancouver, you’ll collaborate with product managers, engineers, game designers, and quality teams to enhance player experiences and drive business outcomes through data. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Analytics, you’ll use your expertise to inform strategic decisions across product optimization, gameplay features, technology, testing, and overall quality.

What You'll Do


Analyse player and product data to uncover patterns and recommend opportunities to improve performance, stability, automation and test coverage and bug metrics
Build dashboards, reports, and visualisations that help stakeholders make better, faster decisions
Contribute to the development of predictive models and other applications of machine learning that personalise player experiences or support product decisions
Explore and apply generative AI tools to increase the efficiency of your own work and support scalable insights
Work with partners to define the right questions to ask and the right data to use, helping embed data in daily decision-making
Present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences


What You'll Bring


3+ years of experience in data analysis or applied analytics, in gaming, software, mobile apps, or similar
Proficiency in SQL for querying large datasets; experience with analysis and modelling in Python or R
Experience with visualisation tools such as Looker, PowerBI
Ability to translate business needs into technical data requirements
Experience with or interest in using machine learning and generative AI tools to support analytics or player insights
You will use storytelling to convert business objectives into analytical questions, and communicate results with practical recommendations and actionable steps.
Excellent problem-solving and communication skills
Ability to independently manage assigned tasks including work planning for assigned deliverables


Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES


British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$92,900 - $129,200 CAD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

Title: Data Prioritization Analyst

Job Description

What is the Opportunity?

In the increasingly complex world of financial services, accurate and complete data is critical for Risk management, financial reporting and regulatory compliance. Ensuring data governance begins with an understanding of financial services data, identifying the critical elements (CDEs), data quality controls and resolving data issues.

As a Data Prioritization Analyst with the data prioritization team, you will be accountable for working with various Data domains to prioritize critical data associated with business processes. Reporting to the Associate Director, you will work in collaboration with other teams providing data services such as the DMO’s, Data Lineage, Data Quality, Metadata management, and Data Completeness Teams.

What will you do?

Data Prioritization


Create and support repeatable, robust process to identify Data Elements that are most critical and has the highest impact on RBC’s key processes. Seek out industry trends and organizational knowledge to understand alternative approaches / solutions to propose viable options
Engage Data Domain stewards and Business Unit leadership to identify and define key business processes and prioritization and identification of critical reports
Engage Report Owners and their delegates to prioritize data utilizing the enterprise approved Critical Data Element (CDE) identification methodology.
Support other Data Management activities.
Identify, capture and curate metadata associated with CDEs (such as Business Term, Data Classification, Owning Data Domain, vintage tags among other things) for U.S. key regulatory reports.
Accountable for IHC Regulatory Reporting Data Domain metadata associated with Data Prioritization / CDEs to be present in Collibra, Enterprise Data Governance Platform.


Communication and Documentation


Document the critical data, its usage in business process and reports and rationale for critical data in firm standard CDE memo document template
Engage with key stakeholders from Risk Management, Finance, Liquidity, AML and other business Units
Manage and report on work status, including escalating execution risks in a timely manner


Training and Continuous Improvement


Gain and apply an in-depth understanding of data management, data governance, and metadata tools and systems to support the definition and documentation of effective data elements.
Work with the Chief Data Office and other Data Management Offices to support standards and best practices to improve data quality, participating in initiatives to raise awareness and drive improved data quality across the organization (e.g., Data Working Groups, Data Literacy projects).


What do you need to succeed?

Must-have


2-3+ years of experience in Data Management, Accounting, risk management, and/or Data Analysis
Undergraduate degree in a numerical discipline, business administration, finance or a combination
Good communications skills - verbal and written
Some experience with business and/or technical documentation


Nice-to-have


Self-starter, highly motivated, having a strong drive to achieve tangible results; ability to manage multiple competing priorities in times of stress
Ability to analyze and comprehend complex financial products, reporting and data related issues.
Familiarity with financial service regulatory requirements and guidelines (e.g. US regulatory reporting, BCBS 239)
A background in delivering data initiatives in Agile tooling (Jira)

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.


A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock where applicable
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
Ability to make a difference and lasting impact
Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team
A world-class training program in financial services
Flexible work/life balance options
Opportunities to do challenging work
Opportunities to take on progressively greater accountabilities
Opportunities to building close relationships with clients

Critical Thinking, Data Administration, Data Analysis, Database Structures, Data Governance, Data Management, Data Modeling, Data Movement, Data Research, Detail-Oriented, Group Problem Solving, Information Capture, Standard Operating Procedure (SOP), Teamwork

Title: Enterprise Data Analyst
Description:
Husch Blackwell LLP is a full-service litigation and business law firm with multiple locations across the United States, serving clients with domestic and international operations.

At Husch Blackwell we believe that diverse, equitable and inclusive teams lead to better outcomes. Husch Blackwell is committed to retaining, recruiting, developing, and promoting talented lawyers and business professionals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We foster an engaged, diverse, and inclusive team culture of accountability and purpose that makes our Firm and our communities better.

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight


Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency


Dashboarding & Reporting


Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics


Data Management & Quality


Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities


Continuous Improvement & Growth


Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence


Position Requirements


Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, information design, or a related quantitative communications field; commensurate professional and educational experience shall also qualify
3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role (the role may be filled at more than one level; strong candidates earlier in their careers will also be considered)
Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards
Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets
Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem
Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms
Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders
Experience with statistical modeling, regression analysis, and null hypothesis significance testing
Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects
Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them
Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics
Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations
