Job title:
Senior SQL Data Analyst

Salary:
$90,000 - $95,000 + Bonus + Benefits

Role status:
Current opening

Our client:
A well-established Canadian professional services organization with a national presence and a strong reputation within its industry.

This is a highly visible role offering exposure to senior leadership and key business stakeholders across the organization. Our client is looking for a strong Senior SQL Data Analyst who can work with large, complex datasets, identify trends and business drivers, and translate analysis into clear, actionable insights for the business. This opportunity is ideal for someone who combines advanced SQL and analytical capability with polished communication skills, strong business acumen, and the confidence to present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Principal tasks and responsibilities include:

Write complex SQL queries to extract, validate, analyze, and interpret large volumes of business and operational data.
Analyze revenue, pricing, productivity, profitability, utilization, and other key business performance metrics to support decision-making and performance improvement.
Identify trends, anomalies, risks, and opportunities in the data, and provide actionable recommendations to business leaders.
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc reporting packages, dashboards, scorecards, and presentations for senior leadership.
Translate raw data into meaningful business insights that can be clearly understood by both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
Partner closely with leadership, finance, operations, and other business groups to understand reporting needs and answer key business questions through data.
Support strategic analysis, business planning, and performance reviews by delivering data-driven insight and thoughtful commentary.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




The Data & Analytics team within the IT Solutions line of business has an ambitious mandate, where we are accountable for leveraging Data & Analytics to deliver business value both internally as well as to external clients through the following:




Enhance existing or create new products and services with proprietary data assets and partnering with external data providers, through the application of data science
Design and deliver cutting-edge reporting solutions to bring data to life
Conduct advanced data analysis to generate business insights that drive strategic decision-making
Demonstrate thought leadership in the ecosystem in which we operate
Provide actionable recommendations to improve overall organizational efficiencies




In addition, this team will play an important role in evangelizing and educating the value of Data & Analytics to the rest of the organization, in support of cultivating a data-driven culture.

You will support these ambitious goals primarily through ensuring seamless data integration, maintaining high quality data standards, collaborating with cross functional teams, and delivering comprehensive analyses and innovative visualization using business intelligence tools.




What You’ll Be Doing







The Senior Data Analyst plays a pivotal role in driving data-informed decisions across our organization. Operating at the intersection of business strategy and data expertise, this hands-on role brings clarity to complex problems and empowers teams with actionable insights:




Business Data Consultation (35%)

Collaborate across marketing, product, finance, partner solutions, data engineering and other teams to deeply understand business objectives
Translate business questions into technical data needs, ensuring alignment with project goals
Research, identify and then collect / extract the external data sets required for the use case. Creativity, thinking outside of the box, and resourcefulness is required to find new and relevant data sources to meet business requirements
Exhibit strong attention to detail while working with large datasets to ensure accuracy, completeness and high-quality standards
Translate technical findings into clear recommendations for non-technical stakeholders, ensuring alignment with business use cases




Data Processing and Engineering Support (30%)

Partner closely with data engineers and data scientists to ensure data pipelines and models align with organizational goal
Diagnose and enhance data quality across diverse sources
Recommend ways to integrate disparate data sources into a usable data model to meet business requirements
Present business insights in a meaningful and intuitive manner, in accordance with the target audience, using Tableau, Excel, and other BI tools




Data Analytics and Visualization (35%)

Implement segmentation and categorization techniques to build dynamic solutions tailored to use case
Demonstrate curiosity by exploring datasets, conducting exploratory data analysis to uncover hidden trends, outliers, anomalies, and identify insights that might not be obvious
Provide detailed analysis of customer behavior, market trends, and competitive landscape to support product, sales and marketing strategies
Build advanced dashboards and visualizations that turn data into compelling narratives







About You




What will you need to be successful?




You are someone who:




Is keen to understand the business – data analytics cannot be done in a vacuum – we need to be close to the business so that we understand what we are trying to solve for and what the data means.
Tells stories from data – data analytics is not data dump – it needs to be meaningful and intuitive to the end user to realize the inherent business value.
Challenges the status quo – the state of business and the field of data analytics are constantly evolving, and we need to as well.Assumptions and old ways of doing things are open season, as long as you bring along workable and relevant solutions articulated in a professional manner. Proactively pursue and learn about new data sets, analytical tools, and methodologies to solve problems in new and innovative ways.
Is good at problem solving – someone who can “connect the dots”, and have a logical and methodical way to tackle new and complex problems.
Takes pride in your work – your work is diligent and thorough and you are proud of your reputation for high-quality and reliable work.
Is a quick study – the successful candidate must be curious, resourceful, and dig into the weeds to ask the right questions and figure things out independently.
Is a good communicator – someone who is polished and can communicate effectively with internal and external parties to ensure alignment on data analysis and reporting needs.




Technical qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative field: Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering
Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience as a Data Analyst or Senior Data Analyst
Proficiency in SQL, Python and Excel
Advanced expertise in Tableau, or other BI tools
Knowledge of Big Data Technologies (HDFS, Spark, etc.) and Cloud platforms (AWS and/or Azure)
Understanding of spatial data concepts, including geospatial data formats (e.g., GeoJSON, Shapefiles), spatial analysis, and tools like ArcGIS




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $110,000 - $132,000 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!




Our Human Approach to Hiring




At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.




Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.










At Teranet, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we live and serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.




Come As You Are. We Like You That Way!

Title: Sr Data Analyst
Description:
Summary

Reporting directly to the leadership, the Senior Data Analyst ( Data Analytics) specializes in harnessing

analytics solutions to empower informed decision-making across the organization. Key responsibilities

include spearheading the delivery of impactful business intelligence solutions to end users. This role

involves leveraging advanced development tools to craft dynamic reports, insightful dashboards, and robust

analytical solutions tailored to business specifications.

This position serves as the primary support liaison for the team, offering expertise in complex assignments

while championing both independent and collaborative work approaches. A core focus involves conducting

comprehensive analyses of workflows, data collection processes, and software performance, ensuring

alignment with MyMichigan Health's operational guidelines. Additionally, the Senior Data Analyst serves as

a subject matter authority for three or more application data models, fostering a deep understanding of

critical data domains.

Responsibilities

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

(45%)*Data Analysis and Reporting:


Lead and execute complex data analysis projects across various clinical and administrative domains


within the healthcare system.


Design and develop data queries and reports using EPIC, Tableau, and other reporting and statistical


software to extract actionable insights from healthcare data.


Analyze trends, identify patterns, and develop data-driven recommendations to improve clinical outcomes,


operational efficiency, and patient satisfaction.


Create and maintain data dashboards and visualizations to effectively communicate data insights to


stakeholders at all levels.


Develop and implement data quality initiatives to ensure accuracy and consistency of healthcare data.


(25%)*Data Management and Integration:


Collaborate with IT and other departments to ensure seamless integration of data from various sources,


including EPIC, administrative systems, and external data sources.


Develop and maintain data models and schemas to facilitate efficient data analysis and reporting.
Implement and manage data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes to ensure timely and accurate data availability.
Monitor data quality and integrity and identify and resolve data discrepancies.
Participate in testing reports and extracts during system or business changes, participates in product


upgrades and implementations.

(15%)*Communication and Collaboration:


Present data insights and recommendations to leadership, clinical teams, and other stakeholders in a


clear and concise manner.


Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and address data-driven opportunities for improvement.
Educate and train staff on data analysis concepts and tools.
Stay up-to-date on the latest trends and technologies in healthcare data analytics and apply them to


improve data-driven decision making within the organization.

(15%)*Additional Responsibilities:


Contribute to the development and implementation of data governance policies and procedures.
Participate in continuous improvement initiatives aimed at optimizing data analysis processes and tools.
Stay informed on relevant healthcare regulations and compliance requirements.


Other Duties And Responsibilities

Provide excellent customer service to all customers while performing duties.

Lead meetings, prioritize, resolve conflicts, maintain issues lists, and manage a project plan.

Demonstrate strong project management and organizational skills.

Communicate effectively with project leadership and subject matter experts.

Continue to learn the software and increase their knowledge over time.

MyMichigan Health is a technology driven organization and employees need to demonstrate competency in Microsoft® Windows.

Employees are required to take a Computer Skills Assessment via the learning management system upon hire.

Based on the results of the assessment, an employee may be required to participate in further learning opportunities offered by MyMichigan Health.

Certifications and Licensures

N/A

Required Education

Bachelor’s Degree in IT, business, or healthcare field required.

Master's degree in data science, analytics, or a related field preferred.

Other Information

Experience, Training And Skills

Five or more years of experience in data analysis roles preferably within a healthcare setting.

Two or more years of experience in a data analyst position or leading complex data analysis projects.

Relevant professional certifications (e.g., Tableau Certified Professional, Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert (MCSE) for Data Analytics). stored procedures, and functions.

Proficiency in SQL: Writing complex queries, designing database schemas, creating T-SQL/PL/SQL scripts,

stored procedures, and functions.

Expertise in data analysis tools: Python, R, Power BI, Tableau, Excel (advanced with formulas and

macros), QlikView, SAS, or other statistical software.

Exceptional communication and presentation skills: Effectively communicate data insights to both technical

and non-technical audiences.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills: Identify key business questions, design and execute data

analysis plans, extract actionable insights from data.

Experience and competency with EPIC and Cogito applications including (Clarity, Caboodle, Chronicles,

Radar, Reporting Workbench. Slicer Dicer, Analytics Catalog).

Physical/Mental Requirements And Typical Working Conditions

Exposure to stressful situations, including those involving public contact, as well as, trauma, grief and death.

Able to wear personal protective equipment that includes latex materials or appropriate substitute if required for

your position.

Is able to move freely about facility with or without an assisted device and must be able to perform the functions

Of The Job As Outlined In The Job Description.

Overall vision and hearing is necessary with or without assisted device(s).

Frequently required to sit/stand/walk for long periods of time. May require frequent postural changes such as

stooping, kneeling or crouching.

Some exposure to blood borne pathogens and other potentially infectious material. Must follow MyMichigan

Health bloodborne pathogen and TB testing as required.

Ability to handle multiple tasks, get along with others, work independently, regular and predictable attendance

and ability to stay awake.

Overall dexterity is required including handling, reaching, grasping, fingering and feeling. May require repetition

of these movements on a regular to frequent basis.

Physical Demand Level: Sedentary. Must be able to occasionally (0-33% of the workday) lift or carry 0-10 lbs.

Current initiatives include modernizing enterprise reporting, supporting finance and board-level reporting, enhancing data marts, and improving data alignment across systems to ensure consistent decision-making throughout the university.

Partner with stakeholders, faculty staff, leaders, and cross-functional teams to understand business needs and translate them into analytics solutions and technical requirements.
Analyze complex data across multiple domains to answer critical business questions, evaluate hypotheses, support research initiatives, and develop forecasts.
Design, build, and maintain reporting, dashboards, data visualizations, and analytical products that drive informed decision-making.
Collaborate with Data Engineering teams to develop and enhance ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, and scalable data structures.
Identify and resolve complex data quality issues while contributing to standards and best practices that improve enterprise data integrity.
Lead and manage analytics projects from discovery through implementation, communicating progress, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to stakeholders.
Present insights through compelling data storytelling that enables leaders to take deliberate, informed action.


What You'll Bring


Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline.
5 years of related experience in Data Analysis, Business Intelligence, Data Science, Statistics, Decision Intelligence, Research, Learning Science, or Behavioral/Cognitive Psychology.
Advanced SQL proficiency, including queries and subqueries, data modification (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE), views, joins, filtering, sorting, aggregations, window functions, common table expressions (CTEs), and performance tuning.
Strong experience creating dashboards and visualizations using Tableau, Power BI, or similar business intelligence tools.
Experience translating technical concepts and analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for business audiences and senior leaders.
Experience leading projects or workstreams from planning through delivery while managing multiple priorities and stakeholder expectations.
Ability to work independently with a high degree of ownership, curiosity, problem-solving ability, and a bias for action.
Knowledge of data modeling concepts, including conceptual and logical data models, dimensional modeling, star schema, and snowflake schema.
Experience with descriptive statistics, causal analysis, and inference.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including advanced Excel skills.
Familiarity with project management methodologies such as Agile, Waterfall, and SDLC.
Experience using flowcharting and diagramming tools such as Miro, Visio, Lucidchart, or similar software.


Bonus Points


Experience working in Databricks environments.
Experience with Genie AI or similar AI-enabled analytics tools.
Experience developing or working with large language model (LLM) solutions or AI-powered data products.


Experience in Lieu of Education

An equivalent combination of training, experience, credentials, or accomplishments demonstrating the ability to perform the essential functions of this job may substitute for education degree requirements.

We thoughtfully review every application and invite forward the candidates whose experience and potential best align with the role and our mission.

This is a full-time, in-office position requiring five days per week in our Salt Lake City, Utah office, designed to foster the collaboration and connection that fuel our best work.

Visa Sponsorship

While we welcome applicants from all backgrounds, WGU is not able to provide visa sponsorship for this role.

This position requires occasional travel of up to 20%, including required attendance at designated company summits (typically one to two per year). Title: Data Analyst - Revenue Management
Description:
Since opening our first self-storage facility in 1972, Public Storage has grown to become the largest owner and operator of self-storage facilities in the world. With thousands of locations across the U.S. and Europe, and more than 170 million net rentable square feet of real estate, we're also one of the largest landlords.



We've been recognized as A Great Place to Work by the Great Place to Work Institute. And, our employees have also voted us as having Best Career Growth, ranked us in the Top 5% for Work Culture, and in the Top 10% for Diversity and Inclusion.



We're a member of the S&P 500 and FT Global 500. Our common and preferred stocks trade on the New York Stock Exchange.



Public Storage is the nation’s leading self-storage provider, recognized for its iconic orange doors and commitment to delivering simple, reliable solutions to millions of customers across the country. We are expanding our creative team to enhance our consistent and engaging visual brand presence.





Job Description



Position Summary



The Data Analyst will be a key member of the Revenue Management team, responsible for transforming raw data into actionable insights that support strategic pricing decisions. The Analyst will use their analytical skills to gather, validate, and implement pricing strategies based on performance data. In addition will provide managerial reporting and trends for revenue performance. The position works closely with our team of internal analysts, external business partners, and our information technology group. The primary goal is to help us improve the revenue generating effectiveness of our consumer by translating complex and massive data sets into actionable insights and recommendations for senior management.



Key Responsibilities



Conduct in-depth analysis of large datasets to uncover patterns, trends, and variances
Apply data mining techniques to extract meaningful insights
Build and maintain data models that reflect complex business processes and relationships
Create clear, comprehensive reports and presentations for stakeholders
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business needs and deliver customized insights
Ensure data quality, integrity, and security by following governance standards and best practices
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong communication and presentation abilities.
Ability to work cross-functionally and manage multiple priorities.
Ability to work efficiently under pressure, accurately meet deadlines, present a professional demeanor and work well independently is essential


Qualifications







Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Business Analytics, or a related field
2+ years of experience in a data analyst or similar role or graduate in above fields from top universities.
Proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and analysis
Highly proficient in Excel and comfortable with using formulas, vlookups and pivot table and graph
Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI is helpful but not required
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
Strong communication and interpersonal abilities
Ability to work independently and collaboratively

Preferred Skills:



Master’s degree in a relevant field


Additional Information



Compensation



Base Pay Range: $95,000 - $110,000



Workplace



One of our values pillars is to work as One Team and we believe that there is no replacement for in-person collaboration but understand the value of some flexibility. Public Storage teammates are expected to work in the office five days each week with the option to take up to three flexible remote days per month.

Public Storage is an equal opportunity employer and embraces diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status. All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.



**Sponsorship for Work Authorization is not available for this posting. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without restrictions or requiring sponsorship now or in the future. We do not provide training plans or support for F-1 OPT, STEM OPT extensions, or future visa sponsorship.**

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Corporate Intelligence Platform
Description:
Overview

Company Description

As a Senior Data Analyst on the Corporate Intelligence Platform team, you will be the analytic engine and data steward ensuring CIP’s outputs are accurate, reliable, and meaningful. This role is all about making our data sing – you will dive deep into enterprise source systems (HR, Finance, project tracking, etc.) to understand and document data, then shape it into trusted analytical datasets and dashboards that drive executive decisions. By painstakingly validating data quality, defining core metrics, and building intuitive dashboard views, you’ll transform raw data into insights that Epsilon’s leaders rely on. Your work will bridge the gap between data engineering and business teams, ensuring that CIP not only centralizes data but also delivers answers to key business questions with confidence and clarity.

Responsibilities


Source Data Mastery: Become the subject-matter expert on CIP’s source data. Work with IT and system owners to map out all relevant fields and data flows from our internal systems (e.g., HRIS, financial databases, project management tools) into the CIP environment. Document data definitions, schemas, and business logic, making sure the team and end-users understand the context and limitations of each data source. Identify any data gaps or integrity issues early and recommend solutions or workarounds.
Refined Data Products & Metrics: Collaborate with data engineers and the product manager to transform raw data into business-ready “Silver” and “Gold” layer datasets. Validate that data cleansing and transformation rules produce accurate results. Help design dimensional data models and aggregated views that support common analytics needs (for example, workforce cost by product/initiative, project delivery timelines, or revenue by product). Ensure each curated dataset has clear business context, defined metrics, and documentation so that it’s immediately useful and trustworthy for analysis.
Metrics Definition & Consistency: Define and maintain the catalog of key business metrics and KPIs within CIP. Work with partners in Finance, Product, and Operations to agree on a single definition for critical measures (e.g., “fully-loaded cost”, “utilization rate”, “bookings vs revenue”) and implement these calculations in CIP’s data models. Create and manage a semantic layer or metrics repository that ensures all reports and dashboards use consistent formulas. By driving this consistency and clarity, you’ll prevent divergent numbers and solidify CIP’s reputation as the single source of truth for internal analytics.
Data Quality & Validation: Establish rigorous data quality checks to catch issues like missing data, inconsistencies, or anomalies. Regularly reconcile CIP’s aggregated results with source system records (e.g., compare CIP’s finance totals with official finance system outputs) to ensure everything lines up. Investigate discrepancies to find root causes – whether a pipeline issue, data entry error, or definition mismatch – and work with data engineers to implement fixes. You will also monitor data freshness and reliability, giving partners confidence that CIP’s insights are accurate and up-to-date.
Analytics & Dashboard Development: Design and deliver insightful analytics and dashboards on top of CIP’s datasets. Use your data exploration skills (e.g., advanced SQL in Databricks SQL/GenAI tools) to answer ad-hoc executive questions and to shape the content of dashboards. For example, you might build a dashboard that highlights key product investment metrics or perform analyses to support long-term planning discussions.


Qualifications


Analytical Expert: You have 5+ years of experience as a data analyst, business intelligence analyst, or similar role, working with large-scale data sets and complex business metrics. You have a strong track record of turning data into insights used by business teams, and you’re excited by the challenge of making sense of diverse internal data.
SQL & Data Proficiency: You are a SQL expert – comfortable writing advanced queries to join, aggregate, and analyze data. You have hands-on experience with modern data platforms (Databricks or similar required) and a solid understanding of data warehouse/lake concepts (familiarity with Lakehouse/Delta Lake, medallion architectures). You may have some experience with Python or data visualization tools, and you’re always eager to learn new technologies (including using AI tools to accelerate data analysis).
Detail-Oriented & Quality-Focused: You are obsessed with data accuracy and consistency. You have experience setting up data quality checks, verifying results against source systems, and ensuring that dashboards are error-free. You understand the importance of data governance, and you naturally document your work so others can trust and build upon it.
Metrics & Business Savvy: You understand business metrics and can engage with business partners to refine them. You excel at asking the right questions to ensure a metric truly reflects business reality. Your analytical skills help you connect the dots between data points and business outcomes, so you can support collaborators in interpreting results and finding opportunities or issues.
Collaborative & Communicative: You work best in a team environment, closely partnering with data engineers, product managers, and other analysts. You can communicate complex data findings in simple terms, helping non-technical colleagues understand what the numbers mean and why they matter.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Finance, etc.) or equivalent experience. Professional certifications or training in data analysis/BI (e.g., data analytics certifications) are a plus.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Commercial
Description:
At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Analyst at Capital One you will leverage analytic and technical skills to innovate, build, and maintain well-managed data solutions and capabilities to tackle business problems.

On any given day you will be challenged by three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:

Innovation


Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms
Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers
Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives


Business Intelligence


Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization
Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies


Data Management


Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality


Our ideal candidate will have:


Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
Scripting experience in (Python, R, Spark, and SQL)
Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)
Experience utilizing and developing within Snowflake services


Basic Qualifications:


Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 2 years of experience performing data analytics, or currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Master’s Degree with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.
At least 1 year of experience working with at least one scripting language
At least 1 year of experience utilizing business intelligence visualization tool
At least 1 year of experience querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms


Preferred Qualifications:


Master’s Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
At least 2 years of experience coding in Python, R, Spark, or SQL
At least 2 years of experience working within process management and improvement methodologies – Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, etc.
At least 1 year of experience utilizing and developing within AWS services
At least 1 year of experience working with and demonstrating knowledge of data governance, data quality management concepts and data quality tools (i.e. Informatica DQ)

Brief Job Description

The Texas Health and Specialty Care System (HSCS) is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Data Analyst to join the Office of Forensic Services and Coordination (OFSC). In this essential role, the Data Analyst will support and enhance data reporting, analytics, and operational processes across the forensic service continuum. The position is responsible for maintaining and improving existing reporting products, identifying opportunities to automate workflows, optimizing data extraction and reporting processes, and supporting data-informed decision-making through analysis and visualization of complex datasets.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong foundation in data analytics, reporting, and statistical analysis, with experience working with large datasets and developing solutions that improve efficiency, accuracy, and accessibility of information. This position will work closely with program staff, leadership, and data partners to support ongoing reporting needs, improve data quality, and identify innovative approaches to strengthen business processes and reporting capabilities. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, effective collaboration, and a commitment to continuous learning and professional development in emerging data tools and technologies.

The Data Analyst works under the direction of OFSC’s data analyst on the policy, planning, research and coordination team within the OFSC with moderate latitude for the use of initiative and independent judgement to ensure the statutorily mandated duties of the Forensic Director (SB 1507, 84th Legislature, Regular Session, 2015) are met. These duties include statewide coordination and oversight of forensic services; coordination of forensic programs operated by HHSC; and addressing issues with the delivery of forensic services in Texas including significant increases in populations with serious mental illness and criminal justice system involvement. The Data Analyst will be expected to be a motivated self-starter.

The salary will be offered in accordance with the salary range posted for this position. Salary requests outside of the range in the posting will not be considered and is non-negotiable. For internal applicants, salary negotiations must align with the HHS Human Resources Manual and align with the salary range for this posting. For internal applicants, salary requests beyond the salary range in this posting or that require higher level approvals will not be considered.

Essential Job Functions (EJFs)

Data Analysis Reporting and Dashboard Support: Maintains, enhances, and supports reporting products, dashboards, and analytical tools used across the forensic service continuum. Performs analysis of complex datasets to identify operational trends, performance measures, and outcomes. Creates reports, visualizations, and data summaries that support business operations and data-informed decision-making. Assists in translating technical findings into understandable information for leadership and program staff.

(25%)

Data Automation and Process Improvement: Identifies opportunities to automate recurring reports, data collection activities, and business processes to increase efficiency and reduce manual effort. Develops and improves automated workflows, data refresh processes, validation routines, and reporting solutions. Collaborates with team members to streamline existing processes and implement sustainable, scalable data solutions. (20%)

Query Development and Data Management: Develops, maintains, and optimizes SQL queries, datasets, and reporting logic supporting forensic programs. Reviews and improves existing queries and processes to enhance performance, accuracy, and reliability. Assists with documenting data definitions, business rules, and reporting methodologies to ensure consistency and sustainability of reporting products. (15%)

Fielding Data Requests: Supports internal and external data requests by gathering requirements, conducting analyses, and delivering accurate and timely information. Works closely with HSCS leadership and staff to understand business needs and develop appropriate reporting solutions. Ensures all activities comply with applicable confidentiality, privacy, and data security requirements. (15%)

Collaboration and Data Quality Improvement: Collaborates with data partners across HSCS, Behavioral Health Services, state hospitals, state supported living centers, and other stakeholders to improve data quality, consistency, and reporting capabilities. Assists in identifying data discrepancies, conducting validation activities, and developing recommendations for process improvements that strengthen data integrity and program outcomes. (10%)

Policy Research and Evaluation: Support the development of studies, policy research, and evaluations. Partner with agency leadership and staff, universities, and stakeholders to support research and evaluation projects. (5%)

Training, Documentation, and Knowledge Sharing: Develops and maintains documentation related to reports, datasets, processes, and reporting tools. Assists in training staff on reporting products and data resources. Shares knowledge and best practices to promote effective use of data across the organization. (5%)

Continuous Professional Development: Stay current with advancements in data analytics, forensic policy, and relevant legislation. Participate in professional development opportunities, conferences, and training sessions to enhance skills and knowledge. Share insights and best practices with colleagues to foster a culture of continuous improvement within the OFSC. (5%)

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities (KSAs)

Knowledge of data analytics principles, statistical concepts, and techniques used to analyze, interpret, and communicate findings from complex datasets.

Knowledge of relational databases, data models, database design concepts, and data governance practices.

Experience using SQL, Tableau, Excel, or similar business intelligence and reporting tools to develop reports, dashboards, and data visualizations.

Experience working with healthcare, behavioral health, forensic mental health services, electronic health records, or other large operational data systems.

Skill in developing, maintaining, and optimizing SQL queries, data extracts, and reporting processes.

Skill in analyzing problems, identifying opportunities for process improvement, and developing effective data-driven solutions.

Ability to compile, review, validate, and analyze data while maintaining a high level of accuracy, attention to detail, and data integrity.

Ability to prepare reports, dashboards, presentations, and data visualizations and communicate technical findings effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Ability and willingness to learn emerging technologies, automation tools, and advanced analytics techniques to enhance reporting capabilities, improve operational efficiency, and support continuous improvement initiatives.

High degree of integrity, ability to build trust and communicate effectively.

Ability to work the hours of 8 a.m.-5 p.m., Monday through Friday with flexibility to be available after hours as needed such as during Legislative Sessions.

Registrations, Licensure Requirements Or Certifications

N/A

A bachelors, masters degree or doctoral degree from an accredited university in one of the following disciplines: data science, computer science, business administration, business analytics, public administration, information technology or mathematics. Other disciplines will be considered based on relevant coursework and experience.

Demonstrated experience in data analytics and research, with expertise in statistical modeling to identify patterns and trends in existing datasets.

Experience in managing complex datasets.

Verisign helps enable the security, stability, and resiliency of the internet. We are a trusted provider of internet infrastructure services for the networked world and deliver unmatched performance in domain name system (DNS) services.

We are a mission focused, values driven company where each individual can contribute to building a stronger, more secure internet. We offer a dynamic and flexible work environment with competitive benefits and the ability to grow your career.




The Data Analyst II, as a member of the Business Intelligence and Data Analytics team, analyzes and helps solve complex business problems using data and available resources to provide insight to decision-makers. In this role, you will analyze trends in domain name usage, digital service activation and channel distribution dynamics.




The role requires consistent communication across teams -- including marketing, account management, product management, finance, and platform engineering -- to translate between technical and behavior trends and end-user demand characteristics. Your work on the team will involve studying data trends and patterns to derive insights that support data-driven presentations with creative visualizations highlighting key trends.




An ideal candidate cares deeply about data quality, visualization, business impact, and understanding global DNS or the broader web hosting ecosystem.

Evaluate extensive datasets leveraging large-scale data analysis platforms to explain how end users are utilizing domain names
Create specifications for data acquisition to support exploration of emerging technologies impacting the global DNS.
Develop and maintain manual and automated processes to ensure data quality and integrity.
Research trends to support briefings, presentations, and reporting on business performance and progress relative to plans.
Support the formation of recommendations and strategic/tactical plans based on capturing relevant business metrics.




Qualifications:

4 years of progressively responsible, related business and/or data analysis experience
Bachelor’s degree in either Computer Science, Data Analytics or Business, or equivalent work experience, is required
Strong Excel and SQL skills required, with hands-on experience with data visualization tooling (such as Tableau or related tools)
Strong analytic skills and the ability to share insights with peers
Demonstrable planning and organization skills
Experience performing data ETL, including designing data collection methods, data models, and transformation processes for relational databases (Oracle/SQL) and distributed data systems (such as Snowflake, Hadoop, Spark with scripting languages like Python)




This position is based in our Reston, VA office and offers a hybrid work schedule.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Confido is the AI infrastructure powering modern CPG — the platform that 200+ brands like OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Dr. Squatch, and Tropicana use to run everything from deductions to production planning. Finance, accounting, sales, and operations, unified in one system for the first time.

We're growing 5x year over year with a small team in New York City; the people who join now will shape the product, the culture, and the company itself.

If you want your work on shelves everywhere — and outsized ownership while you build — we'd love to meet you.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will build the analytics layer that helps both Confido and our customers understand their financial and operational data. You’ll design dashboards, develop core metrics, and surface insights that drive decision-making across the platform.

This is a foundational role where you’ll help shape Confido’s data culture and establish how analytics are delivered internally and to customers.

Location: New York, NY (Relocation supported)

What You'll Do


Partner with product, engineering, and customers to understand analytics needs
Design and build dashboards, reports, and analytical tools for internal and external users
Write complex SQL queries to analyze large-scale financial and operational datasets
Define and maintain key business metrics and KPIs
Identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities within retailer and financial data
Drive analytical projects from exploration through delivery
Collaborate with engineers to improve data models and underlying datasets


Example Problems

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Commercial
Description:
At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Analyst at Capital One you will leverage analytic and technical skills to innovate, build, and maintain well-managed data solutions and capabilities to tackle business problems.

On any given day you will be challenged by three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:

Innovation


Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms
Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers
Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives


Business Intelligence


Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization
Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies


Data Management


Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality


Our ideal candidate will have:


Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
Scripting experience in (Python, R, Spark, and SQL)
Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)
Experience utilizing and developing within Snowflake services


Basic Qualifications:


Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 2 years of experience performing data analytics, or currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Master’s Degree with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.
At least 1 year of experience working with at least one scripting language
At least 1 year of experience utilizing business intelligence visualization tool
At least 1 year of experience querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms


Preferred Qualifications:


Master’s Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
At least 2 years of experience coding in Python, R, Spark, or SQL
At least 2 years of experience working within process management and improvement methodologies – Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, etc.
At least 1 year of experience utilizing and developing within AWS services
At least 1 year of experience working with and demonstrating knowledge of data governance, data quality management concepts and data quality tools (i.e. Informatica DQ)

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
At OSL Retail Services, we believe people are the heart of everything we do, and it is an exciting time to be part of something special! Our momentum is growing, and is fueled by innovation, collaboration, and a shared entrepreneurial spirit that drives real results. Founded in 2012 in Mississauga, Ontario, OSL delivers customized sales solutions in retail, direct sales, and customer acquisition, all built on a foundation of integrity, respect, and passion. Our culture thrives on connection, purpose, and growth. If you’re looking for a place where your talents are valued, your ideas matter, and your career can grow, we’d love to meet you!




The Role:




We are currently seeking a Senior Data Analyst to monitor, assess, and translate key business data into meaningful insights. This role will focus on Omnichannel core KPIs, sales and profit performance, marketing effectiveness, and site performance to help optimize results and support informed business decisions.

The incumbent will also lead eCommerce market intelligence activities, including online market sizing, brand-level market share analysis, competitive insights, global best-price benchmarking, and market price monitoring.




What you’re responsible for:




KPI Management (50%)

Track and manage sales and profit performance against targets and historical results.
Design, develop, and maintain KPIs for eCommerce and store performance.
Develop tracking tools for site operations and Omnichannel KPIs, including visits, conversion, bounce rate, average order value, attach rate, reserve and pick-up, and cart abandonment rate; analyze results and provide actionable insights.
Develop tracking tools for partner-related KPIs, including transaction processing, shipping lead time, fraud rejections, and return lead time; analyze results and identify opportunities for improvement.
Partner with the Marketing Manager to assess digital marketing campaign effectiveness and provide timely recommendations for updates or changes.
Manage and maintain the BI reporting tool developed in Tableau.
Use Omniture and Google Analytics to extract and analyze performance-related data.
Support the development of weekly, monthly, and annual revenue targets by SKU, aligned with the mid- to long-term eCommerce strategy.




Market Intelligence (30%)

Partner with the Market Intelligence team to gather total market and eCommerce data and develop accurate online market size estimates.
Collaborate with external vendors to monitor industry trends and market share.
Maintain tracking tools for market-related data and reporting.
Monitor competitor activity and provide clear, actionable competitive analysis.
Work with HQ and review external sources to identify and share eCommerce store best practices.
Monitor product pricing across retail channels and assess alignment to ensure pricing is managed appropriately.




Strategy, Planning and Reporting (20%)

Support the development of weekly, monthly, and annual sales targets by SKU for eCommerce and stores.
Support the development of mid- to long-term strategies for eCommerce and store growth.
Develop regular KPI reports for internal stakeholders, highlighting key trends, results, and insights.
Prepare ad hoc reports and analysis as required to support business needs.




To Join Our Team:

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, or a related field, with relevant professional experience.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships and engage effectively with stakeholders at all levels, from senior executives to support teams, both within and outside the organization.
Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision while consistently meeting deadlines.
Strong analytical, organizational, and planning skills.
Ability to translate data and insights into clear, compelling storylines for reports and presentations.




Technical Skills

Required: High proficiency in SQL for querying complex relational databases.
Required: Expertise in data visualization and building automated dashboards using BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
Required: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, complex formulas, modeling).
Strongly Preferred: Experience with a statistical programming language (Python or R) for data manipulation and analysis.
Required: Hands-on experience with web analytics platforms, particularly Google Analytics







Let's Talk Perks

While the salary for this role is $75K to $89K, with a yearly eligible 10% bonus, your final compensation will reflect your years of experience and beyond the numbers, we’re proud to offer a holistic package that includes:




Generous time off: 3 weeks of vacation.
Comprehensive benefits package: Includes medical, dental, vision and a health spending account.
Retirement support: Company-sponsored RRSP matching program to help build your financial future.
Award-winning culture: Proud to be one of Canada’s Best Managed Companies for 8 years running — now a Platinum Club member.
Invested in you: Structured employee development programs designed to help you thrive.




We’re committed to supporting your success every step of the way. What are the next steps?




The Interview Process

Step 1: If your profile is a match, we will invite you for a first conversation with the recruiter.

Step 2: The next step is a virtual or in person interview with the hiring manager.

Step 3: The final step is an in-person interview with the hiring manager and extended team members.




Ready to bring your talent to a team where your impact matters? Apply today — we can’t wait to meet you!




We thank all interested applicants; however, only qualified candidates will be contacted. This position requires successful completion of a criminal background check. Build and maintain reports and dashboards that monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) across Operations

Assist in the development and enhancement of existing reporting tools and systems

You hold a Bachelor’s degree in business Economics, Finance, Math, Engineering. In lieu of a degree, we will accept a combination years of hands-on experience in business or operations-focused data

You have a solid understanding of SQL (T-SQL or PL-SQL preferred) and experience working with relational databases
You are proficient in Power BI, including creating dashboards, using DAX, and working with Power Query
You have experience using Microsoft Excel for analysis and reporting, with a preference for Power Query and Pivot Tables

You are able to manage multiple tasks, work independently, and collaborate effectively with others
You have a strong interest in learning and growing within the energy industry and data analytics space

This role is eligible for our hybrid work policy; working 3 days in the office

Title: Federal Lead Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description

Federal Lead Data Analyst

This role is based in our Arlington, VA office

We’re on a journey to advance how health happens with technologies that support clinicians, inspire innovation, empower patients, and save lives. Our mission? To create a human-centric healthcare experience powered by unified global data.

It’s a big challenge, but big challenges are what we do best. We’re already transforming some of the world’s largest health systems—helping them turn data into lifesaving decisions and better patient care.

We want people just as dedicated as we are making history with the advancement of Federal Healthcare systems. If you’re excited about making healthcare more human, you’ve come to the right place.

Oracle Health Government Services is seeking a skilled Federal Lead Data Analyst to support mission-driven healthcare programs. In this role, you will analyze program, operational, financial, and performance data to help teams make informed decisions, identify risks and trends, and improve delivery outcomes. You will work closely with program leaders, functional teams, and technical teams, to build reports, dashboards, models, and insights that support Federal Healthcare initiatives.

The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a regulated federal environment. This person should be able to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Key Responsibilities:


Analyze program data to identify trends, risks, issues, performance gaps, and improvement opportunities.
Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations to support program leadership and client decision-making.

Ability to manage multiple priorities independently while demonstrating sound judgment, accountability, and a bias for action.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including advanced Excel capabilities.


Bonus Points


Experience presenting analyses and recommendations to executive leaders.
Project management experience, including exposure to Agile, Waterfall, SDLC, or related methodologies.

Job Status: X2 Permanent Vacancies

Team: Analytics

Reports to: Manager, Analytics

Job Level: 6

I. Job Purpose

Creates reports, dashboards and performs ad-hoc analysis to support the College’s strategic commitment to leveraging data and analytics to support evidence-based decision-making.

Ii. Key Responsibilities

  • Develops reports, standardized queries, dashboards and performs ad-hoc analysis to support College projects, initiatives, and processes.
  • Coordinates/fulfills data requests and supports relationships with system partners.
  • Supports the work of data scientists in reporting, analyzing and interpreting data; and in the development of data science products.
  • Collaborates with teams at the College to define and/or refine their ad-hoc analysis needs.

Iii. Required Qualifications

Education and Experience

  • Completion of a Bachelor’s Degree in a highly quantitative field (Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering) or related analytical fields.
  • Minimum 1 year work experience performing data analysis using statistical software (e.g. R, Python, SPSS, SAS) and creating reports and dashboards using data visualization tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau).

Organizational Competencies

Consistently Demonstrate CNO’s Organizational Competencies

  • Innovation – Curiously cultivate new ideas with a desire to learn and a collective focus on the best outcome.
  • Integrity – Conduct every interaction with fairness, honesty, and mutual respect.
  • Collaboration – Work with the right people at the right time to make the best-informed decision.
  • Well-being – Care for the physical, mental, spiritual, and emotional needs of ourselves and others.

Job Competencies, Knowledge, Skills

  • Analytical & Critical Thinking – Supports reporting, analyzing and interpreting large amounts of information from diverse sources; identifies frameworks for which data can be organized, classified and analyzed; leverages analysis and knowledge of previous similar situations when interpreting data.
  • Attention to Detail – Creates processes and tools to ensure work is of high-quality, accurate, and thorough while managing priorities effectively in a dynamic environment.
  • Communication – Clarifies data requests to confirm understanding of ad-hoc analytical needs when working with teams and system partners, and supporting the work of data scientists; adjusts communication delivery and approach when difficulties with understanding arise; responds to requests and shares information to appropriate system partners ensuring adherence to the CNO’s policies for accessing information and compliance with Privacy legislation.
  • Data Analysis – Collaborates with teams to obtain a deep understanding of data analysis needs; conducts advanced statistical techniques to analyze data and interpret results.
  • Data Visualization & Reporting – Creates clear and compelling visualizations and comprehensive reports using a variety of advanced data tools; uses a variety of advanced data tools that highlight key points, show trends and patterns; reports findings that are relevant and meaningful.

Title: Analyst, Data & Analytics
Description:
Permanent Full Time

Canada Life is seeking a highly skilled Data Analyst to join the Insurance Solutions team. As a part of the Performance Management area, this role will be responsible for supporting the data management, analysis, and reporting needs of the department. The Data Analyst supports decision-making, monitors business performance, and provides actionable insights using analytics and visualizations tailored to different audiences.

The role will benefit from collaboration with subject matter experts and data scientists. If you are looking to become a subject matter expert in connected data and help guide the team in improving processes through data mining and analysis, this is the role for you.

Given the size and scope of our organization, we have the flexibility for this position to be located in the following head office locations: Toronto and London.

What You Will Do


Build, implement, and maintain data models, custom reports, and dashboards, keeping in mind the needs of varied audiences
Create visually compelling presentations and use strong communication skills to present them to stakeholders (ability to build a narrative that outlines the background and highlights the impact of initiatives)
Identify opportunities to ingest data, prioritize data needs, and build data marts to drive efficiencies in reporting functions
Leverage data expertise to support new initiatives through analysis and ongoing reporting across the entire analytics lifecycle
Communicate requirements to the Technology team for development and ensure smooth deployment of data projects after performing data quality testing
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and deliver data solutions that meet business needs
Support existing data owners in their data management practices, ensuring a single source of truth
Work with large datasets that may be inconsistent, unclean, or not fully modeled
Ensure best practices are followed with respect to data governance and structure
Communicate effectively while demonstrating critical thinking and business acumen


What You Will Bring


University or College education in a related field of study, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Experience working with raw data and manipulating large datasets
Proficiency in Excel, Power BI, data modelling, and Databricks, with experience creating interactive dashboards
Ability to work with diverse data inputs and build data marts aligned with business requirements
Proven ability to learn quickly, work independently, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Ability to work with little to no documentation or instructions
Strong attention to detail, with the ability to produce high-quality outputs under tight timelines
Driven to continuously improve processes, performance, and efficiency
Knowledge of the organization, distribution channels, products, systems, and data is an asset
Ability to write complex SQL queries to extract and integrate data from multiple sources
Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python or R
Hands-on experience with Azure compute services and a good understanding of Azure Data Factory pipelines
Preferred: Microsoft Certified – Azure Data Analyst Associate (Power BI) certification


The base salary for this position is between $65,800 - $87,700 annually. This represents base salary only and does not represent other variable compensation components of our total compensation ( i.e. annual bonus, commission etc). If you are selected to move forward in our recruitment process, your recruiter will be able to discuss additional details of our total rewards program with you.

Career opportunities will be open a minimum of 5 business days from the date of posting, closing dates will vary depending on the search activity. All applications received will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

The Data & Insights (D&I) team is involved in every aspect of data at EA, using it to deliver valuable insights and solutions for game teams and players. We drive strategy, build data and AI tools, and support personalization, experimentation, and analytics. Join D&I to work with experts dedicated to improving understanding, workflows, and player experiences.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our analytics team supporting a high-definition title in development. In this hybrid role based in Vancouver, you’ll collaborate with product managers, engineers, and quality teams to enhance development quality, product stability and drive business outcomes through data. Reporting to the Manager of Analytics, you’ll use your expertise to inform strategic decisions across product optimization, technology, testing, and overall quality.

What You'll Do


Communicate with studio stakeholders to identify opportunities where data can better support decision making
Work with partners to define the right questions to ask and the right data to use, helping embed data in daily decision-making
Present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences
Build dashboards, reports, and visualisations that help stakeholders make better, faster decisions
Contribute to the development of predictive models and other applications of machine learning that personalise player experiences or support product decisions
Explore and apply generative AI tools to increase the efficiency of your own work and support scalable insights


What You'll Bring


4+ years of experience in data analysis or applied analytics, in gaming, mobile apps, or other digital products
Proficiency in SQL for querying large datasets; experience with analysis and modelling in Python or R
Experience with visualisation tools such as Looker, PowerBI
Ability to translate business needs into technical data requirements
Experience with or interest in using machine learning and generative AI tools to support analytics or player insights
You will use storytelling to convert business objectives into analytical questions, and communicate results with practical recommendations and actionable steps.


Pay Transparency - North America

British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$92,900 - $129,200 CAD

Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Job Type

Full-time

Description

At Specialty Dental Brands, we bring together a supportive community of leading pediatric dentistry, orthodontic, and oral surgery practices. Our team provides the behind-the-scenes support and business insights that help our partner practices grow while continuing to deliver exceptional patient care.

We are looking for a curious, collaborative, and solutions-focused Senior Data Analyst to join our team. This role will play a critical part in transforming complex data into clear, actionable insights that guide performance and strategic decision-making across our growing, multi-site organization.

The Senior Data Analyst will partner closely with operational, clinical, accounting, and financial leaders to identify trends, forecast outcomes, and develop data-driven solutions that improve patient care, practice performance, and overall business efficiency.

This is a hybrid position based at our Nashville Home Office, offering three days of in-office collaboration and two days remote each week.

What You'll Do


Pull and analyze data primarily from the enterprise data warehouse, using source systems—including EHR, practice management, finance, and HRIS platforms—as the underlying systems of record.
Clean, validate, and interpret complex datasets to generate meaningful and reliable business insights.
Design, build, and maintain advanced data models that support enterprise initiatives such as patient retention, provider productivity, operational efficiency, and accounting and finance functions.
Translate data findings into clear, actionable recommendations for clinical and business leaders.
Partner with IT and Business Intelligence teams to strengthen data infrastructure, improve reporting processes, and expand access to reliable information.
Use statistical and predictive modeling techniques to forecast trends and identify opportunities for improvement.
Collaborate across departments to define key performance indicators, reporting standards, and measurement frameworks.
Present analyses and insights through reports, presentations, and interactive dashboards, primarily using Power BI.
Support data integrity, governance, and compliance with healthcare privacy requirements, including HIPAA.


Requirements


Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Accounting, Finance, or a related field; a master’s degree is preferred.
Candidates with an Accounting or Finance background and strong technical, analytical, and data-reporting capabilities are encouraged to apply. A traditional computer science or highly technical degree is not required.

Summit School Services is seeking a Data Analyst to design, build, and deliver impactful Power BI

performance, enhance quality, and optimize operational processes.

Reporting & Analytics Development

• Partner with stakeholders to gather requirements for reports, metrics and dashboards

• Develop a deep understanding of business operations and data usage

• Provide guidance on data management standards and best practices

• Design, build, and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards tailored to multiple audiences

• Identify trends and perform root cause analysis

• Ensure reports are intuitive, visually clear, and actionable for non-technical users.

Data Analysis & Storytelling

• Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.

• Translate analysis into clear insights and narratives that drive understanding and action.

• Present findings to stakeholders with varying levels of technical and operational expertise.

Stakeholder Management

• Build collaborative relationships with business stakeholders.

• Define functional requirements and gather feedback to improve data products.

• Advance enterprise reporting through product-thinking, including roadmaps and backlog

management.

• Identify opportunities for improvement and cost savings.

Team Collaboration

• Serve as a subject matter expert for Data Engineers & reporting teams.

• Manage vendors and cross functional work to achieve outcomes

• Develop materials for leadership presentations

• Produce weekly and monthly KPI reports using Excel and Power BI.

• Develop SQL queries for recurring and ad-hoc reports.

• Identify trends, gaps and improvements in operational performance.

• Engage in new analytical projects and exploratory data capturing.

• Identify and resolve issues in established reports.

• Experience in Power BI reports and dashboards (DAX, Data modeling, performance

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and Microsoft Office Skills.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret and synthesize data.

• Experience working with operational or performance-based KPIs.

• Experience in transportation, logistics, operations, or field-based services.

• Experience in Microsoft Fabric

• Experience with predictive analytics, forecasting, or trend modeling.

Skills

• Predictive analytics, decision trees, optimization

• Database design and data visualization tools.
