Brief Job Description

The Texas Health and Specialty Care System (HSCS) is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Data Analyst to join the Office of Forensic Services and Coordination (OFSC). In this essential role, the Data Analyst will support and enhance data reporting, analytics, and operational processes across the forensic service continuum. The position is responsible for maintaining and improving existing reporting products, identifying opportunities to automate workflows, optimizing data extraction and reporting processes, and supporting data-informed decision-making through analysis and visualization of complex datasets.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong foundation in data analytics, reporting, and statistical analysis, with experience working with large datasets and developing solutions that improve efficiency, accuracy, and accessibility of information. This position will work closely with program staff, leadership, and data partners to support ongoing reporting needs, improve data quality, and identify innovative approaches to strengthen business processes and reporting capabilities. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, effective collaboration, and a commitment to continuous learning and professional development in emerging data tools and technologies.

The Data Analyst works under the direction of OFSC’s data analyst on the policy, planning, research and coordination team within the OFSC with moderate latitude for the use of initiative and independent judgement to ensure the statutorily mandated duties of the Forensic Director (SB 1507, 84th Legislature, Regular Session, 2015) are met. These duties include statewide coordination and oversight of forensic services; coordination of forensic programs operated by HHSC; and addressing issues with the delivery of forensic services in Texas including significant increases in populations with serious mental illness and criminal justice system involvement. The Data Analyst will be expected to be a motivated self-starter.

The salary will be offered in accordance with the salary range posted for this position. Salary requests outside of the range in the posting will not be considered and is non-negotiable. For internal applicants, salary negotiations must align with the HHS Human Resources Manual and align with the salary range for this posting. For internal applicants, salary requests beyond the salary range in this posting or that require higher level approvals will not be considered.

Essential Job Functions (EJFs)

Data Analysis Reporting and Dashboard Support: Maintains, enhances, and supports reporting products, dashboards, and analytical tools used across the forensic service continuum. Performs analysis of complex datasets to identify operational trends, performance measures, and outcomes. Creates reports, visualizations, and data summaries that support business operations and data-informed decision-making. Assists in translating technical findings into understandable information for leadership and program staff.

(25%)

Data Automation and Process Improvement: Identifies opportunities to automate recurring reports, data collection activities, and business processes to increase efficiency and reduce manual effort. Develops and improves automated workflows, data refresh processes, validation routines, and reporting solutions. Collaborates with team members to streamline existing processes and implement sustainable, scalable data solutions. (20%)

Query Development and Data Management: Develops, maintains, and optimizes SQL queries, datasets, and reporting logic supporting forensic programs. Reviews and improves existing queries and processes to enhance performance, accuracy, and reliability. Assists with documenting data definitions, business rules, and reporting methodologies to ensure consistency and sustainability of reporting products. (15%)

Fielding Data Requests: Supports internal and external data requests by gathering requirements, conducting analyses, and delivering accurate and timely information. Works closely with HSCS leadership and staff to understand business needs and develop appropriate reporting solutions. Ensures all activities comply with applicable confidentiality, privacy, and data security requirements. (15%)

Collaboration and Data Quality Improvement: Collaborates with data partners across HSCS, Behavioral Health Services, state hospitals, state supported living centers, and other stakeholders to improve data quality, consistency, and reporting capabilities. Assists in identifying data discrepancies, conducting validation activities, and developing recommendations for process improvements that strengthen data integrity and program outcomes. (10%)

Policy Research and Evaluation: Support the development of studies, policy research, and evaluations. Partner with agency leadership and staff, universities, and stakeholders to support research and evaluation projects. (5%)

Training, Documentation, and Knowledge Sharing: Develops and maintains documentation related to reports, datasets, processes, and reporting tools. Assists in training staff on reporting products and data resources. Shares knowledge and best practices to promote effective use of data across the organization. (5%)

Continuous Professional Development: Stay current with advancements in data analytics, forensic policy, and relevant legislation. Participate in professional development opportunities, conferences, and training sessions to enhance skills and knowledge. Share insights and best practices with colleagues to foster a culture of continuous improvement within the OFSC. (5%)

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities (KSAs)

Knowledge of data analytics principles, statistical concepts, and techniques used to analyze, interpret, and communicate findings from complex datasets.

Knowledge of relational databases, data models, database design concepts, and data governance practices.

Experience using SQL, Tableau, Excel, or similar business intelligence and reporting tools to develop reports, dashboards, and data visualizations.

Experience working with healthcare, behavioral health, forensic mental health services, electronic health records, or other large operational data systems.

Skill in developing, maintaining, and optimizing SQL queries, data extracts, and reporting processes.

Skill in analyzing problems, identifying opportunities for process improvement, and developing effective data-driven solutions.

Ability to compile, review, validate, and analyze data while maintaining a high level of accuracy, attention to detail, and data integrity.

Ability to prepare reports, dashboards, presentations, and data visualizations and communicate technical findings effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Ability and willingness to learn emerging technologies, automation tools, and advanced analytics techniques to enhance reporting capabilities, improve operational efficiency, and support continuous improvement initiatives.

High degree of integrity, ability to build trust and communicate effectively.

Ability to work the hours of 8 a.m.-5 p.m., Monday through Friday with flexibility to be available after hours as needed such as during Legislative Sessions.

Registrations, Licensure Requirements Or Certifications

N/A

Initial Screening Criteria

A bachelors, masters degree or doctoral degree from an accredited university in one of the following disciplines: data science, computer science, business administration, business analytics, public administration, information technology or mathematics. Other disciplines will be considered based on relevant coursework and experience.

Demonstrated experience in data analytics and research, with expertise in statistical modeling to identify patterns and trends in existing datasets.

Experience in managing complex datasets.

Ability to translate business needs into technical data requirements
Experience with or interest in using machine learning and generative AI tools to support analytics or player insights

Location: Huntsville, AL

Position Overview

We are seeking a Data Analyst Mid to support mission-focused programs in Huntsville. The ideal candidate will have strong experience performing data analysis, developing reporting solutions, and working directly with technical and functional teams to gather and define data requirements. The Data Analyst Mid will support data-driven decision making through analysis, visualization, documentation, and reporting activities in secure environments.

Responsibilities


Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations using PowerBI.
Extract, manipulate, and analyze data using SQL.
Work independently with cross-functional teams to gather, define, and document data analysis requirements.
Create and maintain data documentation, data dictionaries, and analytical procedures.
Utilize Python/R for Statistical scripting.
Support continuous improvement initiatives related to data processes and reporting capabilities.
Develop data analytics for desktop and web-developed visual analytic software.
Facilitate the bulk analysis of relational information utilizing advanced graphics, visualization, and high-performance computing.
Use the specified open source, COTS, and GOTS technologies when needed.
Establish an application that produces manageable, actionable intelligence from streams of a structured and semi-structured data.
Design strategies for enterprise database systems and set standards for operations, programming, and security.
Design and construct large relational databases.
Integrate new systems with existing warehouse structure and refine system performance and functionality.


Required Qualifications


Active Top Secret (TS) security clearance.
Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, or related field (or equivalent experience).
Five (5)+ years of relevant experience.
Experience with Python and SQL for data analysis and reporting.
Experience developing dashboards and reports using PowerBI.
Knowledge of Data Pipelines & Warehousing (ETL/ELT).
Knowledge of Statistical Scripting such as Python/R.
Knowledge of Advanced Data Querying such as SQL.


Desired Qualifications


Experience with Data pipelines and data transformation.
Experience with Cribl.


Culture Requirements


Engineers, Analysts, and Developers at Cintel, Inc. are highly motivated, technical, and self‐organized. We place a lot of trust in our team members to develop technical solutions for ill‐defined problems (i.e. thrive in an environment where the problem is vague, requirements are lacking, and a solution is not obvious). We need problem solvers.
We want our team members to be self‐motivated and eager to learn new skills. If you consider yourself a jack‐of‐all‐trades, and are eager to keep up with the latest trends in technology, you’ll fit right in.


About Cintel, Inc

Cintel Inc. is a Small Business providing strategies and services to support an array of Government clients in Software Development, Operational/Tactical and Installation/Facilities Energy, Cyber Security, Modeling and Simulation, Data Science, and Programmatic support.

We offer our clients nimble, unique, and value focused solutions with an emphasis on people, connectivity, communication, and teamwork. Our team believes that people drive solutions. By connecting people, information, teams, and experience we deliver solutions that respond to customer needs.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About the Company

South Coast Community Services is a behavioral health nonprofit with over 40 years of history serving individuals, families, and youth across Southern California. SCCS delivers mental health services through county contracts with San Bernardino County and Orange County, managed care agreements, commercial insurance, and school district partnerships (NPA-certified). Our team of 400 includes more than 160 clinicians operating across San Bernardino and Orange Counties and beyond. SCCS accepts Medi-Cal, managed care, and commercial insurance plans.




About the Role

The Senior Data Analyst is responsible for supporting organizational decision-making through the development of reliable reporting, data analysis, and documentation of systems and data structures. This role works across clinical, operational, and financial datasets to produce accurate, actionable insights and maintain a clear understanding of how data flows across systems.




The position requires strong technical skills in SQL and Tableau, along with the ability to work with complex relational data environments, including behavioral health EHR systems. A key focus of this role is ensuring data clarity and consistency by documenting existing data sources, reporting logic, and system relationships, enabling more effective and scalable analytics across the organization. This role partners with stakeholders across Marketing, Customer Care, Finance, Clinical Operations, and IT to deliver reporting and analysis that supports day-to-day operations and ongoing performance improvement.




Responsibilities

Data Analysis and Reporting

Develop, maintain, and enhance Tableau dashboards and reports supporting referral tracking, intake performance, clinician activity, and program metrics.
Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, join, and transform data from complex relational databases.
Produce recurring and ad hoc reports to support operational and strategic decision-making.
Ensure accuracy and consistency of reported data through validation and reconciliation processes.




Data Systems Documentation and Structure

Document current data systems, including data sources, table structures, field definitions, and relationships across systems.
Maintain clear documentation of reporting logic, metric definitions, and calculation methodologies.
Identify gaps or inconsistencies in data structures and escalate opportunities for improvement.
Support the development and maintenance of data dictionaries and internal documentation resources.




Data Quality and Integrity

Perform regular audits to identify data inconsistencies, missing values, or reporting discrepancies.
Partner with IT and operational teams to investigate and resolve data quality issues.
Ensure alignment between source system data (e.g., EHR, CRM, billing systems) and reporting outputs.




Cross-Functional Support

Collaborate with stakeholders to understand reporting needs and translate business questions into data queries and visualizations.
Support multiple departments including Marketing, Finance, Customer Care, and Clinical Operations with data requests and analysis.
Present findings in a clear, concise manner appropriate for both technical and non-technical audiences.




EHR and Data Environment Support
Work with behavioral health EHR data to support reporting and analysis needs.
Assist in extracting and validating data from EHR and connected systems.
Develop familiarity with system workflows and data capture processes to improve reporting accuracy.




Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields such as data analytics, statistics, mathematics, health informatics, or related discipline.
Minimum 3–5 years of experience in a data analyst or similar role.
Strong proficiency in SQL, including complex joins, aggregations, and data transformation.
Experience building dashboards and visualizations in Tableau or a similar BI tool.
Experience working with complex relational databases and multi-source data environments.
Demonstrated ability to document data systems, reporting logic, and workflows clearly and accurately.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and integrity.




Preferred Skills




Experience working in healthcare or behavioral health environments.
Familiarity with EHR systems and healthcare data structures.
Understanding of basic financial or operational metrics in a service-based organization.
Experience supporting cross-functional teams with reporting and analytics.




Pay range and compensation package

$100,000 - $125,000

Permanent Full Time

Canada Life is seeking a highly skilled Data Analyst to join the Insurance Solutions team. As a part of the Performance Management area, this role will be responsible for supporting the data management, analysis, and reporting needs of the department. The Data Analyst supports decision-making, monitors business performance, and provides actionable insights using analytics and visualizations tailored to different audiences.

The role will benefit from collaboration with subject matter experts and data scientists. If you are looking to become a subject matter expert in connected data and help guide the team in improving processes through data mining and analysis, this is the role for you.

Build, implement, and maintain data models, custom reports, and dashboards, keeping in mind the needs of varied audiences
Create visually compelling presentations and use strong communication skills to present them to stakeholders (ability to build a narrative that outlines the background and highlights the impact of initiatives)

Leverage data expertise to support new initiatives through analysis and ongoing reporting across the entire analytics lifecycle
Communicate requirements to the Technology team for development and ensure smooth deployment of data projects after performing data quality testing
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and deliver data solutions that meet business needs
Support existing data owners in their data management practices, ensuring a single source of truth
Work with large datasets that may be inconsistent, unclean, or not fully modeled
Ensure best practices are followed with respect to data governance and structure
Communicate effectively while demonstrating critical thinking and business acumen

University or College education in a related field of study, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Experience working with raw data and manipulating large datasets

Title: Data Analyst II
Description:
Verisign helps enable the security, stability, and resiliency of the internet. We are a trusted provider of internet infrastructure services for the networked world and deliver unmatched performance in domain name system (DNS) services.

We are a mission focused, values driven company where each individual can contribute to building a stronger, more secure internet. We offer a dynamic and flexible work environment with competitive benefits and the ability to grow your career.




The Data Analyst II, as a member of the Business Intelligence and Data Analytics team, analyzes and helps solve complex business problems using data and available resources to provide insight to decision-makers. In this role, you will analyze trends in domain name usage, digital service activation and channel distribution dynamics.




The role requires consistent communication across teams -- including marketing, account management, product management, finance, and platform engineering -- to translate between technical and behavior trends and end-user demand characteristics. Your work on the team will involve studying data trends and patterns to derive insights that support data-driven presentations with creative visualizations highlighting key trends.




An ideal candidate cares deeply about data quality, visualization, business impact, and understanding global DNS or the broader web hosting ecosystem.




Summary of key responsibilities:

Evaluate extensive datasets leveraging large-scale data analysis platforms to explain how end users are utilizing domain names
Create specifications for data acquisition to support exploration of emerging technologies impacting the global DNS.
Develop and maintain manual and automated processes to ensure data quality and integrity.
Research trends to support briefings, presentations, and reporting on business performance and progress relative to plans.
Support the formation of recommendations and strategic/tactical plans based on capturing relevant business metrics.




Qualifications:

4 years of progressively responsible, related business and/or data analysis experience
Bachelor’s degree in either Computer Science, Data Analytics or Business, or equivalent work experience, is required
Strong Excel and SQL skills required, with hands-on experience with data visualization tooling (such as Tableau or related tools)
Strong analytic skills and the ability to share insights with peers
Demonstrable planning and organization skills
Experience performing data ETL, including designing data collection methods, data models, and transformation processes for relational databases (Oracle/SQL) and distributed data systems (such as Snowflake, Hadoop, Spark with scripting languages like Python)




This position is based in our Reston, VA office and offers a hybrid work schedule.




The pay range is $89,900 - $121,700.




The anticipated annual base salary range for this position is noted above, however, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience. Verisign offers a discretionary bonus which is based on individual and company performance, and certain roles may be eligible for discretionary stock awards.

Title: Specialty Pharmacy Data Analyst
Description:
About The Job

Loopback Health is hiring an innovative and team-oriented Data Analyst within the Health System Solutions team to work on a blend of clinical, economic and operational datasets to answer questions across the healthcare delivery and life sciences value chain.

The Analyst’s role will be to inquire about the nature of the question being asked, distill the question into relevant data elements to represent, the visualization and delivery format, and presentation scheme to answer the client question at hand.

The ideal candidate will have experience interfacing with internal and external client teams, problem solving with peers, and possess a strong technical aptitude with good organizational skills and a desire to learn and work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate will also have excellent problem-solving skills and exhibit strong, fact-based communication skills. At Loopback you will enjoy success, develop your professional skills, and allow your career to thrive within a fast-growing business who is expanding their team.

Duties to Include


Distill complex business and technical requirements into viable analytical solutions
Partner with subject matter experts to understand root cause patterns within data
Data mapping, transformation and normalization
Data visualization and interface/ manipulation development
Analytics platform enhancements and toolset evaluations
Troubleshooting and audit trail development


Requirements

You will thrive if you:


Exhibit a “self-starter” mindset in taking ownership over delegated project responsibilities
Quickly spot non-standard patterns in data and can follow the trail back through complex data pipelines
Enjoy rapid mastery of process dimensions around problems solved with data analytics
Are a tenacious self-learner
Are detail and results oriented


You Bring a Toolkit Of Your Past Experiences Of


3-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst or with Data Analytics tooling (e.g. Python, SQL, PowerBI, Tableau, etc.) in a commercial capacity
Experience working with extremely large health care datasets
Demonstrated history of integrating multiple data sets to create unique insights
Implementing and designing data curation, and data analysis frameworks
Experience working across an array of stakeholders
Effective collaboration, experienced in creating technical partnerships across teams
Learning and understanding the various data domains across the enterprise and able to communicate complex relationships between clinical and business concepts across the enterprise and various stakeholders
Effectively delivering results in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities
Documenting and testing results of your analytics efforts, engaging with QA and Delivery teams to satisfy client needs


Travel


Expected to be minimal.


This employer will not sponsor applicants for employment visa status (e.g., H1-B) for this position. All applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

About Loopback

Loopback is a healthcare data company dedicated to improving access and outcomes for complex patients. We partner with health systems to grow and optimize specialty pharmacy performance, and we support life sciences organizations in accelerating evidence generation and expanding patient access through differentiated data and insights. Our work sits at the intersection of data, technology, and patient care, and we’re building a purpose-driven team that reflects that mission.

Founded in 2009, Loopback has been recognized by the Dallas Business Journal as one of the Best Places to Work, reflecting a culture grounded in collaboration, trust, and impact. Loopback has been recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies and consistently ranks among the fastest-growing companies in Dallas by the Dallas Business Journal.

Title: Sr. Data Analyst
Description:
The Sr. Data Analyst is responsible for acting as Single Family Operations’ primary data analyst and report developer for Single Family Operations. This role involves collaborating closely with Single Family Operations’ business units, utilizing advanced SQL and Excel skills to extract and manipulate data from multiple sources, and leveraging visualization tools to transform raw data into meaningful reports and dynamic dashboards that address specific business needs. The Sr. Data Analyst (SF Ops) is a key contributor to enhancing operational efficiency and strategic decision-making through accurate and timely reporting.




This role provides timely and thorough analysis, as well as sound and prudent feedback on major projects and business opportunities identified by Single Family Operations’ senior leadership team. It ensures all relevant business requirements are met, risks are mitigated, alternative options are explored, and costs are managed. This role works together with business units, and internal technology teams to document processes and solutions, present and explore new methods to enhance operations, test and validate results, implement appropriate process and technology solutions, and provide information and support to the training team.




Provide subject matter expertise and impact analysis on projects and business opportunities.

Develop, maintain and automate reporting to improve efficiency and data accessibility
Translate business needs into clear reporting and system requirements, ensuring proper documentation
Collaborate with business units and IT to develop solutions, resolve issues, and assess impacts
Extract, integrate, and analyze data from multiple sources using SQL while ensuring accuracy and data integrity
Develop automated reporting solutions (e.g., SSIS, SSRS) and support data optimization initiatives
Review and validate analysis outputs, providing feedback and supporting sign-off processes
Build and maintain effective cross-functional relationships across the organization while handling sensitive information with confidentiality
Document reporting procedures and contribute to data optimization and streamlining initiatives
Operates with high independence, proactively identifies opportunities, influences business strategy, and provides recommendations directly to leadership
Identify data gaps, risks, and cross-functional impacts, and support issue resolution with IT and stakeholders
Support business case development and communicate findings through reports and presentations
Apply extensive business background and working knowledge of systems to identify options, impacts and issues affecting other business units not initially included in the project scope




Collaborate with Stakeholders, the Leadership Team, and IT team to implement appropriate data and reporting solutions.

Document report specifications and changes for impacted business units
Assist in providing end user testing and signoff on test results
Anticipate and communicate risks as well as propose associated mitigation strategies
Identify opportunities for report automation and optimization to enhance the efficiency of report generation
Keep current on industry best practices and emerging tools for data analysis and reporting
Integrate data from various systems and databases to create comprehensive datasets for analysis
Perform data cleansing and transformation to ensure the quality and reliability of the data used in reports
Effectively communicate and provide progress updates
Escalate immediately relevant problems with recommended action plans
Recognize opportunities to increase efficiency by combining similar requests




What You Bring To The Team




Minimum 3 years’ experience in data role preferred
Extensive industry knowledge and understanding of Information Technology concepts
Experience in the Financial Services industry
Expert proficiency in SQL for data extraction, manipulation, and aggregation.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Power BI and visualization tools
Experience with Azure DevOps and working in an Agile environment
Experience in Cross Departmental Impact Analysis
Experience in Business Case Development
Experience with report automation through SSIS packages and SSRS
Extensive knowledge of core application system
Industry Knowledge
Subject matter expert in Core Application Systems
Extensive Knowledge of Test Case analysis, definition and
Development
University Degree/College Diploma or equivalent work experience
Certification(s) from IIBA, PMI etc. preferred

Minimum 1 year work experience performing data analysis using statistical software (e.g. R, Python, SPSS, SAS) and creating reports and dashboards using data visualization tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau).

Consistently Demonstrate CNO’s Organizational Competencies


Innovation – Curiously cultivate new ideas with a desire to learn and a collective focus on the best outcome.
Integrity – Conduct every interaction with fairness, honesty, and mutual respect.
Collaboration – Work with the right people at the right time to make the best-informed decision.
Well-being – Care for the physical, mental, spiritual, and emotional needs of ourselves and others.

Analytical & Critical Thinking – Supports reporting, analyzing and interpreting large amounts of information from diverse sources; identifies frameworks for which data can be organized, classified and analyzed; leverages analysis and knowledge of previous similar situations when interpreting data.
Attention to Detail – Creates processes and tools to ensure work is of high-quality, accurate, and thorough while managing priorities effectively in a dynamic environment.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
EvenUp is on a mission to close the justice gap using technology and AI. We empower personal injury lawyers and victims to get the justice they deserve. Our products enable law firms to secure faster settlements, higher payouts, and better outcomes for victims injured through no fault of their own in vehicle collisions, accidents, natural disasters, and more.

We are one of the fastest-growing vertical SaaS companies in history, and we are just getting started. EvenUp is backed by top VCs, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Bain Capital Ventures, SignalFire, and Lightspeed. We are looking to expand our team with talented, driven, and collaborative individuals who seek to have a lasting impact. Learn more at www.evenuplaw.com.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to work a hybrid schedule, with three days per week in our San Francisco or Toronto offices, and to translate complex healthcare and product data into clear, actionable insights that drive strategy and business impact. You are a fit if you thrive in ambiguous, cross-functional environments, own analytical deep work end to end, and enjoy influencing decisions through rigorous, well-communicated analysis.

What you’ll do:


Work cross-functionally with Revenue Operations, Finance, and Customer Success to scope and implement trusted business metrics, proactively identify data integrity issues, and optimize operational workflows.
Translate complex datasets into clear insights with strategic recommendations that drive measurable actions and outcomes to inform business priorities.
Communicate analysis results and outcomes clearly and tailor messaging based on the audience.
Help build and evolve our analytical foundation, including event instrumentation, metric frameworks, and scalable self-serve analytics tools.
Mentor other analysts and raise the bar for data storytelling, analytical rigor, and stakeholder influence across the organization.


What we look for:


Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field such as statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent years of practical work experience.
5+ years of experience using SQL or similar big data querying languages.
5+ years of experience with a programming language such as Python or R.
5+ years of experience with applied statistical techniques, such as inferential methods, causal methods, A/B testing, or statistical modeling techniques.
Strong experience working with Salesforce or other CRM platforms, including modeling and analyzing customer, pipeline, and revenue data.
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to distill complex findings from data and models into compelling insights for technical and non-technical audiences.


Bonus (Nice to have):


Advanced degree in applied mathematics, statistics, actuarial science, economics or a related field.
Experience working with sales organizations and familiarity with funnel and pipeline processes.
Strong mentorship and leadership skills, with a track record of elevating scientific standards and developing junior talent across teams.


Benefits & Perks:

As part of our total rewards package, we offer attractive benefits and perks to our employees, including:


Choice of medical, dental, and vision insurance plans for you and your family.
Additional insurance coverage options for life, accident, or critical illness.
Flexible paid time off, sick leave, short-term and long-term disability.
10 US observed holidays, and Canadian statutory holidays by province.
A home office stipend.
401(k) for US-based employees and RRSP for Canada-based employees.
Paid parental leave.
A local in-person meet-up program.
Hubs in San Francisco and Toronto.


(Please note the above benefits & perks are for full-time employees)

Notice to Candidates:

To ensure fairness and proper consideration, we do not accept resumes or expressions of interest via email or social media messages. If you’re interested in a role, please submit your application directly through our careers page.

Please note that EvenUp may use AI notetakers and other recording devices in the recruiting process. If you interview with us, with your consent, we may record your conversations and summarize them into notes for internal use. Recording is optional, and declining will not affect your candidacy.

EvenUp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to diversity and inclusion in our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Collect, clean, and manage data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy and consistency
Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
Develop and maintain reports and dashboards to monitor data performance
Use statistical methods to validate and interpret data for business decisions
Create clear data visualizations (charts, graphs, dashboards) to communicate insights
Partner with cross-functional teams to understand business needs and deliver data-driven solutions
Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders in a meaningful way
Document processes, data definitions, and reporting standards
Stay current on data tools, technologies, and industry best practices
Support special projects and continuous improvement initiatives

The College of Massage Therapists of Ontario (CMTO) is a progressive regulatory body dedicated to protecting the public interest by upholding the highest standards for Registered Massage Therapists (RMTs). At CMTO, we are dedicated to excellence in protecting the public interest, guiding registrants, and promoting the highest possible quality of the practice of Massage Therapy.




WORKING @ CMTO

This full-time, permanent position offers a competitive annual salary, a comprehensive benefits package, RRSP matching, and a professional development fund. At CMTO, we foster a collaborative team culture and a strong commitment to our mission. Our flexible, remote-first work environment allows staff to work remotely most of the time, while our office—located centrally, steps from TTC—is available when needed.

The BI Analyst reports to the Manager, Projects and Data Analytics, provides insights that support regulatory operations, organizational performance and strategic decision-making.




KEY DUTIES

Collect, extract, integrate and analyze data from multiple sources to identify emerging risks.
Translate complex analytical findings into meaningful insights and practical recommendations tailored to technical and non-technical audiences.
Design and create impactful visualizations, dashboards, and reports using Microsoft Power BI to clearly communicate key business insights to stakeholders.
Develop and maintain data governance standards, reports, business terminology and data dictionaries to promote consistency, accuracy and standardization.
Investigate data quality issues, identify root causes and work collaboratively with organization teams to implement corrective actions and improvements.
Partner with business leaders to define KPIs, metrics, reporting requirements and analytical priorities.
Develop and maintain datasets, semantic models, dashboards and reporting solutions leveraging CMTO's Microsoft Azure Data Lakehouse environment to support enterprise reporting, analytics and decision-making.
Perform data validation, reconciliation and quality assurance projects to ensure the integrity, usability and reliability of organizational data used for reporting and analysis.
Support adoption of Power BI and self-service through user training, documentation, coaching and reporting best practices.
Identify opportunities to automate data collection, reporting and analytical processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
Present analytical findings, trends and recommendations to senior leadership and organizational teams to support discussions and planning.




SKILLS

Advanced analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Skilled in developing dashboards, reports and data visualizations and data storytelling.
Ability to translate data into actionable business insights and present findings.
Excellent organizational and time management skills.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment;
Ability to work independently and contribute effectively within a team.
Adaptability and continuous improvement mindset.




QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, or equivalent business experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence or related field.
Minimum of 5 years of professional experience with at least 3 years of specialization in business intelligence or data analytics.
Expertise in designing, developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards, reports, semantic models and performance measurement frameworks.
Experience working with enterprise data platforms including Microsoft Azure Data Lakehouse, data pipelines, semantic models and Power BI reporting environments.
Experience with ETL processes, cloud-based storage solutions, and advanced Excel.
Knowledge of Microsoft Azure Data Lakehouse architecture, data engineering concepts, cloud-based analytics platforms, and emerging AI-enabled analytics capabilities.
Proficiency in SQL and data modeling, with experience using Python or other analytical programming languages.
Familiarity with data integration tools and AI-driven analytics is an asset.




LIFE at CMTO

Compensation and Time Off

Hiring salary: $90,000 - $100,000
15 vacation days plus 4 personal days
Office closure every year from December 25 to January 1




Benefits & Support

Group benefits starting on your first day
Health Care Spending Account
Annual professional development funding
Group Retirement Savings Plan
Maternity and parental leave top-up program




Work Environment

Remote-first workplace with in-office expectations 2 times per month on average
Collaborative, collegial team culture
Office located at 175 Bloor Street East, Toronto with easy transit and parking access

Partnership Net is revolutionizing the €90B sponsorship industry with its innovative AI-powered Agent-as-a-Service platform. Title: Senior Data Analyst
HTML:
A SIBS existe para tornar mais simples o que antes era complicado. Por isso, hoje, quando pensamos numa transação financeira, ponderamos sempre algo que pode ser feito com o simples premir de um botão ou com a passagem de um cartão.

Com mais de quatro décadas de existência e uma história de sucesso impulsionada pela inovação tecnológica e pela competitividade, somos uma referência internacional e um dos maiores processadores de pagamentos eletrónicos na Europa e em África. Entre as marcas mais conhecidas destacamos o MULTIBANCO, MB NET e MB WAY. E para continuar a inovar ano após ano, o Grupo SIBS estuda e desenvolve novas soluções que tornam a vida ainda mais simples para todos nós, particulares e empresas. Procuramos constantemente profissionais que assumam este compromisso e tenham capacidade para trabalhar em ambientes exigentes, desafiantes e tecnologicamente inovadores.

Com o objetivo de reforçar a atual Equipa da Núcleo de Business do Departamento Data and Advance Analytics, estamos a recrutar um Senior Data Analyst, com o seguinte Perfil:

  • Licenciatura em Informática, Matemática, Economia, Gestão de Informação ou similar;
  • Experiência profissional mínima de 5 anos na função de analista de dados;
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos na utilização do Power BI;
  • Elevada capacidade analítica e atenção ao detalhe;
  • Proatividade e autonomia no desempenho das funções;
  • Forte orientação para resultados e foco no cliente;
  • Proficiência em modelação de dados dimensional;
  • Experiência consolidada na utilização do Power BI;
  • Domínio da linguagem DAX;
  • Conhecimentos técnicos em Databricks;
  • Conhecimento do negócio na área financeira, nomeadamente, no processamento de pagamentos;
  • Experiência comprovada na otimização de modelos de dados com elevados volumes de informação, assegurando um desempenho eficiente.


Função:

  • Colaborar estreitamente com as equipas de negócio, com o objetivo de compreender as suas necessidades de dados e assegurar que as análises produzidas estejam alinhadas com os objetivos estratégicos definidos;
  • Desenvolver datasets, dashboards e relatórios de forma interativa, recorrendo ao Power BI, de modo a responder eficazmente às necessidades de gestão das diferentes áreas de negócio;
  • Assegurar a manutenção e atualização regular de relatórios periódicos, garantindo a integridade, rigor e atualidade dos dados apresentados;
  • Elaborar e manter documentação detalhada relativa aos processos de desenvolvimento de relatórios e dashboards.


Benefícios:

  • Oportunidade de desenvolver projetos inovadores e de impacto direto na sociedade, numa empresa em crescimento e que aposta na inovação tecnológica há mais de 40 anos;
  • Acesso a um conjunto de benefícios atrativos: Subsídio de Alimentação superior aos valores médios de mercado; Pacote de Seguros; Pacote de Comunicações Móveis; Acesso a protocolos com diversos parceiros, entre outros;
  • Perspectivas de desenvolvimento e crescimento profissional;
  • Excelente ambiente de trabalho.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description

Ciao, siamo Subito! 🚀

Hai presente quell'app che quasi ogni italiano ha installata sul telefono? Ecco, quella è casa nostra. Subito è il marketplace leader in Italia: un posto dove milioni di persone comprano, vendono e danno una seconda vita agli oggetti ogni giorno. Siamo un brand amato, con una valutazione di 4.8 stelle e una community vastissima, ma non ci sediamo sugli allori. Vogliamo trasformare ogni singolo dato in un'opportunità per rendere l'esperienza dei nostri utenti sempre più fluida, sicura e intelligente.


Il tuo posto nel team Data

Stiamo cercando un Senior Data Analyst che abbia la passione per i numeri e la capacità di trasformarli in narrazioni efficaci. Entrerai a far parte del team Data Analytics, il cui compito è estrarre valore dai dati per comprendere a fondo il mercato italiano. Studierai il comportamento degli utenti, valuterai le iniziative strategiche e sperimenterai nuove feature. Soprattutto, il tuo lavoro avrà un impatto diretto sulla crescita del nostro business.



Job Requirements

Cosa andrai a fare?

In Subito, i dati non sono solo numeri, ma la bussola che guida ogni nostra decisione:

Genererai Insight ad alto valore: Analizzerai i dati per supportare il business con insights rilevanti (funnel analysis, trend e pattern comportamentali) e presenterai i risultati agli stakeholder.

Democratizzerai il dato: Progetterai report e dashboard automatizzate e intuitive, permettendo a tutta l'azienda di accedere ai dati in modo semplice e immediato.

Modellerai il business: Imparerai a conoscere e aiuterai a progettare il nostro Data Lake per estrarre il massimo valore possibile dai dati e modellare al meglio le nostre logiche di business (data modeling).

Sperimenterai sul campo: Formulerai ipotesi e progetterai esperimenti per valutare l'impatto reale delle nuove feature sui nostri utenti.

Sarai un partner strategico: Collaborerai con gli stakeholder per raccogliere i requisiti e rispondere alle loro domande con l'approccio analitico più efficace.



Job Responsibilities

Come lavoriamo? (Spoiler: amiamo l'eccellenza tecnica)

Abbiamo costruito un ecosistema moderno dove il dato è al centro di tutto:

Tu intègres l'équipe en tant que Data Analyst pour l'un de nos grands comptes clients. Ton rôle sera d'accompagner les directions métiers dans la valorisation de leur patrimoine data. Tu interviendras sur l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur, de la phase d'exploration à l'exposition des résultats.



Tes missions :



Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des cas d'usage concrets par le croisement de sources de données complexes (ciblage marketing, analyses descriptives ou modèles prédictifs).

Tu justifies d'une expérience solide dans le domaine de la Data (manipulation de bases de données, SQL, outils d'analyse).



Tu as une appétence pour l'utilisation de Snowflake.



Pédagogue et rigoureux, tu traduis des concepts techniques en solutions concrètes pour des interlocuteurs non-experts.



Tu maitrises les statistiques et les visualisations de données.

Nous te proposons des avantages et des opportunités pour enrichir ton expérience professionnelle et personnelle tout au long de l'année :

🧑 💻 Pourquoi ce rôle est clé ?

En tant que Data Analyst Senior, vous occuperez un rôle stratégique au niveau de la data, de la business intelligence et de l'intelligence artificielle. Votre mission principale sera de transformer la donnée en leviers d'action concrets pour les équipes métiers, en consolidant le pilotage analytique et en intégrant des solutions d'IA pour affiner la prise de décision.




🎯 Vos missions au quotidien :

Pilotage de la performance :

Assurer un rôle de pilotage data et analytique complet, en définissant et en suivant les indicateurs de performance clés (KPI) pour le business.




Définition de stratégies :

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Till Trygg-Hansa Företagsmarknad söker vi nu en Senior Data Analyst som vill vara med och ta organisationens BI- och analysfunktion till nästa nivå.

Om jobbet | Ta data till insikter som gör skillnad för affären

Som Senior Data Analyst får du en nyckelroll i att driva utvecklingen av BI, analys och datadrivet beslutsfattande inom Företagsmarknad. Du utvecklar moderna rapporterings- och analyslösningar i Power BI och gör data tillgänglig på ett sätt som skapar verkligt affärsvärde. Du arbetar nära beslutsfattare och specialister i verksamheten och omvandlar komplexa affärsfrågeställningar till värdeskapande rapporter, dashboards och dataleveranser som används i det dagliga beslutsfattandet.

Du blir en del av ett erfaret team av analytiker och data scientists som delar kunskap, utmanar varandra konstruktivt och samarbetar tvärfunktionellt med många delar av organisationen. Teamet har ett övergripande ansvar för Företagsmarknads rapportering och analys. Vi utvecklar och förvaltar rapporter och dashboards end-to-end, exempelvis inom försäljning och portföljutveckling. Teamet supporterar också organisationen med data och analys.

Exempel På Ansvarsområden


Identifiera möjligheter att öka användningen av data och BI i verksamheten samt driva förbättringsinitiativ
Omsätta affärsbehov till skalbara analysprodukter, KPI:er och dashboards
Utveckla och vidareutveckla rapporterings- och analyslösningar i Power BI end-to-end
Bygga och förbättra dataflöden samt ETL-processer med moderna tekniker och verktyg
Säkerställa hög användarvänlighet och rätt design i våra rapporter och dashboards
Utveckla ett nära samarbete med stakeholders för att förstå organisationens behov
Ta ägarskap och aktivt bidra i planering av både kort- och långsiktig utveckling
Agera rådgivare till verksamheten i frågor kopplade till analys, rapportering och datadrivet beslutsfattande
Planera och genomföra demo av nya rapporter


Placeringsort är Stockholm och du rapporterar till Chef för Data, Analys & Rapportering.

Om dig | Senior analytiker som skapar insikter och förändring

Det här är en roll för dig som har gedigen praktisk erfarenhet av analys och BI, trivs med stort eget ansvar och vill utveckla lösningar som påverkar både affären, kundvärdet och hur organisationen arbetar med data.

För att kvalificera dig för rollen har du:


Relevant akademisk utbildning inom exempelvis Statistik, Matematik, Datavetenskap, Industriell ekonomi eller annat närliggande område
Minst fem års relevant erfarenhet inom dataanalys/BI i affärsnära roll
Mycket goda kunskaper i Power BI, från datamodellering till dashboard-design
Mycket goda kunskaper i statistisk analys och metoder
Mycket goda kunskaper i SQL.
Erfarenhet av Python, dbt, samt Azure, Databricks eller andra moderna data- och analysplattformar är meriterande
Erfarenhet av att omvandla affärsbehov till datadrivna lösningar som skapar konkret affärsnytta
Förmåga att uttrycka dig väl på svenska och engelska både i tal och skrift


Vi söker dig som har hög kapacitet, stark analytisk förmåga och vilja att bidra till ett team där ansvar, lärande och gemensam utveckling är viktiga delar av vardagen.

För att lyckas i rollen kombinerar du stark analytisk och teknisk kompetens med ett stort intresse för kund- och affärsnära frågor. Du uppskattar att själv arbeta hands-on med data, analys och visualisering samtidigt som du kan lyfta blicken, förstå verksamhetens behov och bidra till att sätta riktning och prioriteringar.

Om oss | Skapa värde med data i stark gemenskap

Trygg-Hansa är en av Sveriges mest välkända försäkringsaktörer och en del av Tryg-koncernen, en av Nordens största försäkringsgrupper. Hos oss får du arbeta i en verksamhet där data, analys och kundinsikter spelar en allt viktigare roll för hur vi utvecklar affären och skapar värde för våra kunder. Vår kultur bygger på tillit, ansvarstagande och att skapa utveckling tillsammans, och vi tror att de bästa resultaten skapas när olika kompetenser och perspektiv får bidra – vi vet att olika erfarenheter och arbetssätt stärker vår förmåga att fatta bättre beslut. Därför arbetar vi aktivt för en inkluderande kultur där fler kan komma till sin rätt och göra ett hållbart och meningsfullt arbete.

Här kan du läsa mer om hur det är att arbeta hos oss, möta några av dina framtida kollegor och ta del av mer information om våra medarbetarförmåner.

Ansökan | Vi ser fram emot att höra av dig

Välkommen med din ansökan via länken nedan. Då urvalet sker löpande ser vi gärna att du inkommer med din ansökan snarast möjligt, dock senast 2026-08-30.

Vid frågor om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Frank Svensson på via mail: frank.svensson@trygghansa.se.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Slutkandidaten kommer att genomgå en bakgrundskontroll.

Vi undanber oss kontakt från rekryteringsföretag angående våra annonserade roller.

Fackliga representanter

Akademikerföreningen: Cecilia Jarlstedt, cecilia.jarlstedt@trygghansa.se

Forena: Elias Bakk, elias.bakk@trygghansa.se

Sonreímos al cambio y afrontamos juntos cada nuevo reto, impulsando la excelencia de nuestros servicios y fomentando el crecimiento de nuestros equipos en un extraordinario ambiente de trabajo.

¿En qué consiste el puesto?




Buscamos un Data Analyst en Madrid, cuya misión será transformar los datos en conocimiento accionable para apoyar la toma de decisiones en la organización, analizando, interpretando y visualizando información procedente de múltiples fuentes para identificar tendencias, patrones y oportunidades de mejora.




Funciones a desarrollar:




Analizar y explorar datos, identificando tendencias, patrones y oportunidades que aporten valor al negocio.
Diseñar, desarrollar y optimizar cuadros de mando e informes, utilizando herramientas de visualización (principalmente Power BI) para facilitar la toma de decisiones.
Traducir necesidades de negocio en requerimientos analíticos, colaborando con las distintas áreas para definir métricas e indicadores clave (KPIs).
Garantizar la calidad y coherencia de los análisis, validando la integridad de los datos tanto en origen como en el Data Warehouse y asegurando la correcta interpretación de los resultados.
Colaborar con otros perfiles de datos, asegurando la disponibilidad, calidad y adecuación de los datos necesarios para el análisis.
Documentar métricas, indicadores y definiciones, manteniendo un catálogo claro y consistente que facilite el autoservicio analítico.
Impulsar la cultura del dato y el autoservicio, apoyando a los equipos de negocio en el uso autónomo de las herramientas analíticas.
Apoyar la toma de decisiones basada en datos, presentando conclusiones y recomendaciones de forma clara a perfiles técnicos y de negocio.
Aplicar estándares de gobierno, calidad y seguridad del dato, asegurando el cumplimiento de las políticas corporativas en el tratamiento de la información.
Analizar y comprender la información de negocio de forma integral, identificando oportunidades de mejora y proponiendo nuevos indicadores, análisis y cuadros de mando que aporten valor a la organización.
Participar en la definición e implantación de controles y mecanismos de calidad del dato, monitorizando la información y estableciendo procesos de alerta y comunicación con los Data Owners ante la detección de incidencias o anomalías.
Colaborar en el diseño y evolución de datasets analíticos y modelos de datos orientados al reporting y al autoservicio, participando en procesos de integración y transformación de datos.




¿Qué buscamos?




Grado en ingeniería informática, matemáticas, estadística, ADE o similar
Experiencia sólida en análisis de datos y dominio de SQL para la consulta, explotación y optimización de datos.
Dominio de herramientas de visualización (principalmente Power BI).
Conocimiento de arquitecturas de datos en plataformas cloud, especialmente Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Knowledge Catalog, etc.).
Conocimiento de Python para análisis, tratamiento y automatización de datos.
Inglés (Avanzado)
Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia en análisis de datos, Business Intelligence o analítica de datos en entornos corporativos con las tecnologías mencionadas.
Perfil con capacidad analítica, comunicación, orientación a resultados, mejora continua, atención al detalle, autonomía y proactividad, trabajo en equipo

Contrato indefinido: te ofrecemos un proyecto a largo plazo en una empresa líder en servicios de infraestructuras.




Flexibilidad para facilitar la conciliación. Serveo ha sido galardonada con el Certificado EFR de la Fundación Más Familia, por su implicación en la conciliación personal, familiar y laboral. En este puesto tendrás:
Flexibilidad horaria de entrada y salida
Jornada continua en verano y festividades
Política corporativa de teletrabajo




Paquete retributivo competitivo.
Retribución total altamente competitiva en el sector, compuesta por una retribución fija más una retribución variable
Acceso a una competitiva 'Bolsa Corporativa de Beneficios' anual que podrás destinar con toda flexibilidad a diferentes productos (tarjeta comida, seguro de salud, tarjeta transporte público, cheque guardería, formación o plan de ahorro) según tus intereses, lo que te permitirá optimizar la fiscalidad de tu retribución y disfrutar de importantes descuentos a los que tenemos acceso como gran empresa.




Desarrollo y proyección profesional: a través de la participación en proyectos transversales, formación y movilidad interna.




Excepcional ambiente de trabajo, en el que te sentirás como ‘en familia’ desde el primer día. En Serveo impulsamos una forma de trabajar que deja de lado las jerarquías y empodera a cada persona para ser líder en su día a día.

Title: Data analyst
Description:
STATERA est une société d'ingénierie et de conseil spécialisée dans l'accompagnement des projets IT, Data et Transformation Digitale.

Nous accompagnons de grands comptes dans la réussite de leurs projets en mobilisant des expertises à forte valeur ajoutée autour de la Data, du Cloud, de la Cybersécurité, de l'Agilité, du DevOps et des applications métiers. Notre approche repose sur la proximité, la flexibilité et la confiance, avec une ambition forte : construire des partenariats durables, aussi bien avec nos clients qu'avec nos consultants.




Lieu : Aix-en-Provence (13) – Présentiel

Démarrage : ASAP




Votre mission

Dans le cadre du renforcement de l'équipe Performance & Run de l'un de nos clients, nous recherchons deux Data Analysts disposant également de compétences en Data Science.

Vous intégrerez une équipe en charge de la valorisation des données et participerez au développement de nouveaux usages analytiques destinés à accompagner les métiers dans leurs prises de décision.

Votre rôle consistera à transformer les données en informations exploitables, concevoir des indicateurs pertinents et développer des solutions analytiques performantes en vous appuyant sur l'écosystème Google Cloud Platform. Vous contribuerez également à l'amélioration continue des outils décisionnels existants et à la mise en place de nouvelles solutions Data répondant aux enjeux de performance de l'organisation.




Vos principales responsabilités

Concevoir, développer et maintenir des tableaux de bord et rapports décisionnels sous Power BI.
Collecter, structurer et analyser les données afin de produire des indicateurs fiables et pertinents.
Exploiter les données hébergées sur Google Cloud Platform.
Développer et optimiser les traitements de données avec BigQuery et DBT.
Participer à la conception de pipelines de données via Cloud Composer.
Réaliser des analyses avancées et contribuer au développement de cas d'usage orientés Data Science.
Accompagner les équipes métiers dans l'identification de leurs besoins et la traduction de ceux-ci en solutions analytiques.
Être force de proposition dans l'amélioration continue des modèles de données, des processus et des outils BI.




Environnement technique

Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
BigQuery
DBT
Cloud Composer
Power BI




Profil recherché

Vous justifiez d'une expérience d'au moins 6 ans sur des projets Data et avez évolué dans des environnements exigeants où la qualité des données et la performance des solutions analytiques sont des enjeux majeurs.




Vous maîtrisez :

Power BI
Google Cloud Platform
BigQuery
DBT
Cloud Composer




Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre capacité d'analyse, votre autonomie et votre aptitude à travailler en interaction avec des interlocuteurs métiers comme techniques.

Une expérience sur des sujets de Data Science, de modélisation ou d'analyses avancées constituera un véritable atout.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Charging your car should feel as natural as charging your phone. That's the future we're building: a network of EV chargers where life happens. We don't just install chargers. We accelerate sustainable mobility. We obsess over partnerships. We grow relentlessly: our network, our partners, ourselves.

If you're here, you're probably not looking for "just a job." Neither are we. 😎 We're driven by impact, and always looking for people who thrive on turning bold ideas into reality. If that sounds like you, you'll feel at home here. We're looking for people who see challenges as puzzles, not problems, thrive in fast-growing, high-energy environments, and want to shape the future of mobility, not just watch it unfold. At Powerdot, you'll get freedom, ownership, and responsibility. The space to experiment. The chance to scale your ideas. And a team that's always pushing the edge of what's possible.

🚀 About This Role

As our Data Analyst, you'll be part of the Central Data team at Powerdot and will play a key role in the current phase of accelerated growth. Your mission is to transform raw data into clear, actionable insights that power smarter decisions across the business — ensuring every team has the visibility they need to move fast and move well. The ideal candidate has strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.

How You'll Shape Our Story:

Your day-to-day will include

Gathering and transforming data from a variety of sources — including internal databases, external APIs, and surveys, ensuring data is ready for analysis.
Analyzing data using statistical techniques — identifying trends, patterns, and insights that drive smarter business decisions.
Developing data visualizations — creating clear, compelling dashboards and reports that communicate findings to stakeholders in a concise and actionable way.
Partnering with stakeholders — understanding their needs and developing data-driven solutions that address real business questions.
Championing data quality — maintaining and supporting a culture of strong data quality across teams and workflows.
Staying ahead of analytics trends — keeping up-to-date on the latest tools, techniques, and best practices in data analytics.
Mentoring colleagues — coaching co-workers on analytics best practices and helping elevate the team's overall data capability.

This Is About You, Not Us 🫵🏼:

Up to 4 years of experience in data analytics or a related field.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills — you know how to break down complex questions and find the signal in the noise.
Technical proficiency — familiar with SQL, Python, and at least one data visualization tool such as Tableau, Metabase, or Power BI.
Eagerness to learn and develop — you thrive in a fast-moving environment and proactively grow your skills.
Great communication skills — you can translate technical findings into clear narratives for non-technical audiences.
Comfort with ambiguity and complexity — you navigate unstructured problems with ease and bring clarity to chaos.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team — you're self-driven but collaborative when it counts.

The Kind of Energy We're Looking For:

We're not into titles, egos, or corporate buzzwords. We're into people who make things happen.

You lead and listen. Whether you're steering the ship or rowing alongside the crew, you bring others with you and keep communication wide open.
You own your stuff. You don't wait for instructions: you see an opportunity, grab it, and make it better than anyone expected.
You've got a green heartbeat. Sustainability isn't just cool, it's core. You care about doing work that leaves the world a little better than you found it.
You balance hustle with humanity. You love the buzz of in-person teamwork, but you also know when to recharge (pun totally intended 🔋).
You grow on purpose. You're hungry to learn, to stretch, and to build something meaningful, not just rack up LinkedIn bullet points.

How you'll be Powered up?

🏥 Private health insurance coverage
💪🏼 Gym membership to help you stay active
⏰ Flexible working hours: you own your time
🌍 Annual offsite where we celebrate the year's achievements and spend quality time together (this year we went to Algarve, Portugal!)
🤝🏼 Regular team-building events with your local teammates
📚 English Training — as English is our language used to connect with all markets and teams
🍩 Free office snacks and unlimited coffee & Meal allowance for every worked day
⚡️ Special discounts for charging your electric vehicle

Our Promise To You

The best solutions come from different voices. We're building a culture where inclusion, respect, and equal opportunity aren't policies — they're lived every day. At Powerdot, everyone has the space to speak up, challenge the status quo, and make a difference. Your voice powers the future — literally.

Title: Analista de datos
Description:
Desde la división de Data & AI estamos buscando un/a Data Analyst para una importante multinacional (cliente final) con sede en Madrid.




¿Qué harás?




Traducir necesidades de negocio en análisis e insights de alto impacto para la toma de decisiones.
Realizar análisis exploratorios y ad-hoc sobre grandes volúmenes de datos.
Participar en el diseño y evolución de modelos de datos y Data Marts.
Desarrollar y mantener dashboards en herramientas de BI, principalmente Tableau.
Velar por la calidad del dato, detectando inconsistencias y proponiendo mejoras.
Trabajar en squads multidisciplinares colaborando con negocio y equipos técnicos.
Interactuar con soluciones de IA generativa, validando resultados y aportando criterio analítico.




¿Qué buscamos?




Entre 2 y 3 años de experiencia como Data Analyst o en posiciones similares.
Nivel avanzado de SQL y experiencia con Python para análisis de datos.
Experiencia con herramientas de BI (Tableau u otras).
Valorable experiencia con dbt, Spark/Databricks o modelado de datos.
Perfil analítico, orientado a negocio y con interés por la IA generativa.
Capacidad para desenvolverse en entornos dinámicos y con aprendizaje continuo.
Nivel fluido de español e inglés.
Residencia en España y permiso de trabajo en vigor.




¿Qué ofrecemos?




Contrato indefinido.
Salario + variable + bonus.
Modelo híbrido.
Seguro médico privado, Wellhub, retribución flexible, plan de pensiones y compra de acciones.
Proyecto con alto impacto en negocio, tecnología puntera y excelentes oportunidades de crecimiento.




Si estás interesado/a, aplica y contactaremos contigo.

Title: Data Analyst Power BI confirmé (H/F)
Description:
CDI


SIBYLONE, société de conseil spécialisée dans les systèmes d’information de synthèse et de pilotage, aide ses clients à tirer toute la valeur de leur patrimoine de données, levier stratégique majeur de développement et de rentabilité.

Notre ambition : rendre les différents acteurs de l’entreprise autonomes dans l’exploitation des données, libérer les usages Métier, pour qu’ils soient en mesure de relever les défis de performance, de couverture de risque, de financement, de conquête client, de RSE… qui s’imposent à eux.

Spécialistes reconnus, nos consultants s’appuient pour cela sur une connaissance approfondie de l’activité business de nos clients, en lien avec nos trois piliers que sont le Métier, la Data et le Projet.

SIBYLONE emploie environ 200 salariés et réalise un chiffre d’affaires de 30 millions d’euros en fournissant des services de haute qualité à de grandes entreprises.

SIBYLONE est une Filiale du Groupe Smart 4 Engineering : Créé en 2020, le groupe compte aujourd’hui 12 marques en France, en Italie, en Espagne et au Portugal dans le domaine de l’ingénierie et de l’IT. Avec près de 3 500 ingénieurs et consultants hautement qualifiés, nous offrons des services dans des domaines porteurs comme le Digital, la Data, l’Intelligence Artificielle, la Cybersécurité, le Cloud et le Software.

Avec nos 3,000 ingénieurs / consultants hautement qualifiés, le Groupe offre ses services dans les domaines très porteurs du Digital, de la Data, de l’Intelligence Artificielle, de la Cybersécurité, du Cloud et des Logiciels.

Contexte

Vous interviendrez en tant que Data Analyst Power BI dans le cadre d’un programme de transformation digitale de la Direction Financière. Notre client grand groupe du secteur bancaire souhaite renforcer son équipe Data pour optimiser le pilotage de la performance financière.

L’objectif est de moderniser les outils de reporting, fiabiliser les données et accompagner les métiers dans une meilleure exploitation des indicateurs clés (KPI). Vous interviendrez au sein d’une équipe dynamique, en lien direct avec les contrôleurs de gestion, les responsables financiers et les équipes IT/Data.

Vos missions

En tant que Data Analyst Power BI, vous interviendrez en proximité avec la Direction Financière pour :


Comprendre les enjeux métiers et l’environnement fonctionnel Finance
Prendre en main et faire évoluer les dashboards existants
Repenser le design et la visualisation des KPI financiers
Participer à la collecte, la transformation et la gouvernance des données
Animer des ateliers avec les sponsors pour recueillir les besoins
Automatiser les traitements et garantir la qualité des livrables
Former et accompagner les utilisateurs dans la prise en main des outils


Compétences techniques attendues


Power BI : expertise en visualisation, storytelling et modélisation
SQL : maîtrise des requêtes complexes
Azure : bonne connaissance de Synapse, SSAS
Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery) : un plus apprécié
Git : pour le versioning et le delivery
Bonne culture BI et sensibilité aux évolutions technologiques


Pourquoi pas vous ?

Profil recherché :


Diplômé d’un bac+5 (école d’ingénieur, Miage, …)
+9 ans d’expérience en tant que Data Analyst ou Consultant BI
Forte appétence pour les métiers de la Finance
Excellent relationnel, esprit d’analyse et sens du service
Autonomie, rigueur et capacité à vulgariser les sujets techniques


Les  Sibylone !

Ce Que Nous Offrons !


Une culture d’excellence : Nous exigeons le meilleur de nos collaborateurs tout en cultivant la cohésion et l’esprit d’équipe.
Moments de convivialité : Séminaires, afterworks, conférences, petits déjeuners…
Actions solidaires : Partenariat avec la start-up spécialisée en RSE Vendredi pour permettre à nos collaborateurs de réaliser des missions auprès d’associations.
Formation continue : Une offre de formation innovante adaptée à nos métiers et expertises (Data, Métier, Projet)
Télétravail : Accord de télétravail en vigueur pour une meilleure flexibilité.

Title: Data Analyst (m/w/d)
Description:
Unternehmensbeschreibung

BFS health finance nimmt Mediziner:innen alles ab, was Zeit frisst: Vom Zahlungsstrommanagement über die Sicherung von Honoraren bis hin zur Beratung im Praxismanagement. BFS vertrauen tausende Zahnärzt:innen, Ärzt:innen, Tierärzt:innen, Dentallabore, medizinische Versorgungszentren sowie Chefärzt:innen und Kliniken. Als Spezialist für Finanzdienstleistungen im Gesundheitswesen ist BFS health finance der Wegebereiter für das vernetze Gesundheitssystem der Zukunft in der Unternehmensgruppe Riverty. Riverty ist ein global tätiger Finanzdienstleister und zu Bertelsmann zugehörig.

Stellenbeschreibung

In unserer Rolle als dynamischer Finanzdienstleister im Gesundheitswesen streben wir danach, mit Hilfe von Datenanalysen neue Maßstäbe zu setzen. Bist du bereit, als Data Analyst (m/w/d) Teil eines Teams zu werden, das die Zukunft der Branche mitgestaltet? Dann suchen wir genau dich!

(Senior) Data Analyst (m/w/d)

an unserem Standort in Dortmund und bis zu 80 % mobiles Office

Was dich bei uns erwartet


Dashboards und Berichte in Power BI erstellen, pflegen und stetig verbessern
KPIs entwickeln und implementieren, die unternehmensweit als Entscheidungsgrundlage dienen
Reporting-Landschaft mitgestalten/weiterentwickeln und bestehende Strukturen eigenständig optimieren
Python für Datenanalysen nutzen, um komplexe Zusammenhänge sichtbar zu machen
Ansprechperson für Kundendashboards und interne Analysen sein
Datenanalysen durchführen, um strategische Entscheidungen zu unterstützen
Mit Fachabteilungen zusammenarbeiten, um Datenanforderungen gezielt zu ermitteln


Qualifikationen

Was du mitbringen solltest


Abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Statistik, BWL oder einem verwandten Bereich
Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Data Analyst, idealerweise in der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche
Fundierte Kenntnisse in Power BI, Python und SQL
Fähigkeit zur verständlichen Visualisierung komplexer Daten
Sicheres Auftreten in Kundengesprächen und Präsentationen
Hohe Eigeninitiative und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise
Fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift


Zusätzliche Informationen

Was wir mitbringen?


Wir sind voll motiviert: Bei uns findest du abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben und eine partnerschaftliche Arbeitsatmosphäre mit flachen Hierarchien & Duz-Kultur
Wir leben flexibles Arbeiten: Du kannst deinen Arbeitsort im Rahmen unserer 80% Mobile Office-Regelung innerhalb Deutschlands frei wählen sowie nach Antragsgenehmigung auch bis zu 30 Tage aus dem EU-Ausland arbeiten
Wir bieten vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten: Wir unterstützen dich dabei, bei uns deine individuellen Ziele zu verwirklichen
Wir fördern umweltfreundliches Verhalten: Bei uns gibt es ein Cash-Back-Programm für einen grünen Arbeitsweg. Passend hierzu befindet sich unser Bürogebäude in verkehrsgünstige Lage - von der Zug- & U-Bahn Haltestelle ist das Büro fußläufig in nur zwei Minuten zu erreichen
Uns liegt deine Gesundheit am Herzen: Unser ganzheitliches Gesundheitsmanagement bietet verschiedenste Angebote in den Bereichen Ernährung, Bewegung, Psyche, Vorsorge und Arbeitsumfeld
Außerdem gibt’s bei uns: eine strukturierte, vollumfängliche Einarbeitung, sechs Wochen Jahresurlaub, Rundumversorgung mit Getränken und Obst (im Büro), einen Zuschuss zu deinen Lebensmitteleinkäufen, zahlreiche Mitarbeiterrabatte und einen Massageservice


Das klingt nach Deinem Traumjob? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine aussagekräftige Online-Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf, Angaben zu Gehaltsvorstellung und frühestmöglichen Eintrittsdatum.

Informationspflichten Im Zusammenhang Mit Der Erhebung Deiner Personenbezogenen Daten

Verantwortlicher für den Datenschutz bei deiner Bewerbung ist die in der Stellenausschreibung angegebene Firma. Die Firma verarbeitet deine Daten zwecks Begründung eines Beschäftigungsverhältnisses auf Grundlage des Art. 6 (1) b DSGVO /


26 (1) 1 BDSG.


Die Speicherdauer deiner Daten richtet sich an den Fristen des jeweiligen Landes aus beginnend mit Abschluss des Einstellungsprozesses. Diese findest du hier.

Den Datenschutzbeauftragten der Firma kannst du unter der o.g. Postanschrift erreichen.

Weitere Informationen zum Datenschutz und zu deinen Rechten erhältst du hier.
