Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Potentiam is a fast-growing global offshore solutions provider connecting top talent with leading UK and European businesses. With offices across South Africa, Romania, India, and Brazil, we offer international exposure, real career progression, and the opportunity to work with high-performing global teams.

We combine global opportunity with local support - giving you the chance to grow, make an impact, and build a long-term career in a business that’s scaling fast.

Global clients. Clear progression. Real opportunity.




We are an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from people with disabilities and will provide reasonable accommodations during the hiring process.




About Our Client

Our client helps organisations unlock value from their customer base, improve efficiency through AI, and build strong data foundations that support scalable growth. Their teams combine industry expertise with advanced AI and data capabilities to deliver solutions that simplify complexity, accelerate outcomes, and strengthen internal capabilities. They focus on end-to-end transformation, enabling businesses to design, optimise, and scale personalised customer engagement strategies that drive meaningful value for both the business and its customers.




Purpose of Role

As a Data Analyst, you will provide analytical support aligned with business needs, transforming data into meaningful insights that drive decision-making. You will work across multiple business areas, helping stakeholders understand performance, identify opportunities and improve outcomes through data-driven analysis.




Roles & Responsibilities

Deliver end-to-end data analysis independently, from understanding the business question through to presenting insights and recommendations.
Translate business requirements into clear analytical questions, datasets, and actionable insights
Build, maintain, and enhance Power BI dashboards and reports for business and client stakeholders.
Develop clear data visualisations and communicate findings effectively to non-technical audiences.
Automate recurring reporting and analytical processes where appropriate.
Work with large and complex datasets and investigate data discrepancies or anomalies.
Collaborate with data engineers, consultants, product owners, business stakeholders, and clients to understand requirements and deliver analytical solutions.
Provide recommendations based on analysis and explain the potential business impact of findings.
Manage multiple analytical requests and prioritise deliverables according to business needs.
Follow GDPR and responsible data-handling principles when working with sensitive or business-critical information.
Contribute to improving reporting processes, data quality, and analytical methodologies.
Use Python for basic to intermediate data analysis or automation where required.




Skills, Qualfications & Abilities

3–5 years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or a related field.
SQL skills and experience working with relational databases.
Good practical experience with Power BI, including dashboards, reports, visualisations and basic data modelling concepts.
Strong data validation and reconciliation skills.
Ability to analyse datasets independently and identify meaningful trends, patterns and anomalies.
Ability to translate business questions into analytical approaches and actionable insights.
Experience with reporting and process automation.
Intermediate Python skills, particularly for data analysis or automation.
Understanding of ETL/data pipelines and how analytical data is produced, without necessarily requiring hands-on data engineering experience.
Basic understanding of data modelling concepts.
Good understanding of data quality, governance, GDPR and responsible data handling.
Degree in relevant discipline (Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, or similar) or equivalent practical experience.




Data Privacy Notice

The personal information you provide during the application and recruitment process will be used solely for recruitment purposes, in accordance with our data protection policies.

For any questions regarding data processing related to HR activities, please contact Chantal Endemann at careers@potentiam.co.uk.

All data shared with third parties complies with applicable confidentiality and retention requirements.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Company Overview

Holafly is a high-growth scale-up revolutionising how businesses and travellers connect to the internet abroad. Since 2018, we’ve empowered travellers in over 200 destinations worldwide with secure and reliable eSIM solutions. With a team of 500+ professionals across multiple countries, we are scaling globally to support travellers with seamless, unlimited data connectivity. We’re not just connecting people—we’re enabling freedom and peace of mind, ensuring our users stay connected from the second they land, wherever their journey takes them.

The Role

As our App-focused Data Analyst, you will support our mobile growth engine by building robust dashboards, preparing reliable metrics, and conducting deep-dive analyses. By translating raw app data into clear reporting, you will empower our UA, ASO, Product and CRM teams, and Leadership, with the insights they need to confidently execute their strategies and optimize their budgets and releases.

Key Responsibilities


Build and maintain scalable, self-serve dashboards that give App, UA, and ASO teams instant, reliable access to core performance metrics (ROAS, CAC, LTV) and daily tracking.
Fuel marketing investments’ optimizations by creating specialized reports analyzing ad creatives, Custom Product Pages (CPPs), Custom Store Listings (CSLs), and in-app events across channels.
Provide holistic visibility into app growth by unifying organic and paid data, allowing teams to evaluate deduplicated traffic and true channel incrementality.
Support product and marketing decisions by analyzing full-funnel behavior and interpreting A/B tests to identify actionable conversion and retention gaps.
Maintain a trustworthy data foundation by working closely with mobile attribution (MMP-level) data, flagging platform discrepancies, and documenting metrics definitions.
Partner directly with UA and ASO stakeholders to deliver exploratory analyses on channel efficiency and audience quality, making complex data accessible to non-technical teams.


Qualifications


5+ years of Data Analysis experience in a mobile-first, performance marketing, or growth-oriented environment.
Expert-level SQL and proficiency in Python or R for data manipulation and automating reporting processes.
Hands-on expertise with BI tools (Looker Studio, Tableau) and mobile attribution/MMP ecosystems (Adjust, AppsFlyer).
Deep knowledge of App Store analytics platforms (AppTweak, Apple Ads, App Store Connect) and evaluating paid UA data.
Strong statistical foundation, with proven experience translating A/B tests and cohort analyses into clear methodology docs and insights.
Hands-on experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Firebase for mobile apps, including custom event tracking, funnel analysis, and extracting raw data.


Nice to Have


Background in travel, e-commerce, or fast-paced subscription-based apps.
Familiarity with alternative market intelligence tools like SensorTower.
Knowledge of BigQuery, dbt, or similar modern data stack components.


Benefits & Perks


High-Impact Influence: Your metrics and reporting will directly shape UA investments and ASO strategies.
Work-Life Balance: A highly flexible, remote-friendly culture designed for modern professionals.
Global Impact: Join a fast-moving, international team operating across 200+ markets with zero bureaucracy.

Title: Experienced Data Analyst (Ad-network)
Description:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team

Voodoo Ad-Network is an autonomous product of around 30 people that carries the ambitious mission of providing ad network services. One goal is to leverage Voodoo’s first-party data to improve Voodoo’s monetisation. Moreover, the product is growing through new ventures like opening up to external inventory, reaching the external-advertisers market and social-network monetisation through BeReal’s recent acquisition. Thanks to promising results, our ambition is now to scale up the team to support growth.

The Ad Experience team owns the end-to-end quality of the ads delivered by our network, from ad rendering to data collection. It has a strong focus on viewability, tracker integrity and the diagnostic signals that feed our Machine Learning models. It’s composed of mostly senior Software Engineers, Mobile Developers, QA Engineers and Full Stack Engineers who iterate together to detect issues quickly, improve the user-side ad experience and protect the quality of the data flowing back into the product.

Role

We’re looking for an Experienced Data Analyst to join our Engineering & Data team. In this role, you will:


Work on end-to-end data projects with the Ad Experience squad to improve ad delivery quality, reduce ad-load and rendering failures, and maintain a high data quality.
Monitor SDK diagnostic events and build alerting, anomaly detection and root-cause analyses on top of the Ad Experience datasets.
Build data collection and transformation pipelines, and actionable dashboards.
Analyze large, complex data sets with billions of events representing the behaviour of mobile game players and of our ad network to investigate ad-quality regressions, attribution discrepancies and SDK rollouts.
Design solutions from scratch, iterate quickly, create POCs, and deploy to production rapidly.
Occasionally leverage Python skills and Statistics skills to support A/B tests on ad-experience changes


Profile


You possess substantial experience in analytical roles, ideally within a web or mobile company or the tech or ad tech industry.
You are highly skilled in SQL and have a proven track record of building production-ready pipelines that handle large and complex data sets.
You have solid experience in ETL development.
You have solid experience with DBT.
You have practical experience with Tableau or another standard dashboard platform, and can create dashboards that are shared company-wide, facilitating data-driven decision-making across departments.
Advanced knowledge of statistical tools and models will be considered a significant advantage.
Development skills, particularly in Python, will be considered a significant advantage
You enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and are able to balance the tradeoff between time-consuming development and rapid results.
You have a solid problem solving mindset as well as a great track record demonstrating ownership and ability to come up with innovative ideas.
A BA/B.Sc degree in Statistics, Math, Engineering, Economy, or other quantitative fields is mandatory for this role.


Our Stack


DBT; Tableau; SQL; Athena; Spark; Python


Benefits


Competitive salary based on experience
Swile Lunch voucher
Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)
Premium healthcare coverage with SideCare, 100% covered for you and your family
Wellness activities in our Paris office
Remote Fridays

Title: Data Analyst Data & AI Senior - F/H - CDI
Description:
Description de l'entreprise

Fondé en France, Talan est aujourd’hui un groupe international qui accompagne ses clients dans leur transformation Data & IA, de bout en bout, en combinant conseil en management et expertise technologique.

Avec plus de 6000 collaborateurs sur 5 continents, nous accélérons les transformations de nos clients à travers des partenariats de long terme, en créant un impact mesurable et durable.

Notre proposition de valeur repose sur un écosystème d’innovation structuré : 2 500 experts Data & IA, des solutions propriétaires construites sur des modèles avancés et un laboratoire de recherche appliquée, de développement expérimental et d’innovation.

Nous traduisons l’innovation technologique en avantage concurrentiel depuis plus de 20 ans dans des secteurs stratégiques : banques et services financiers, énergie, transport et mobilité, luxe et distribution, santé.

Porté par sa promesse de Positive Innovation, Talan s’impose comme un acteur de référence pour répondre à la complexité croissante des environnements économiques, technologiques et réglementaires.

Talan est une entreprise responsable, attachée à la diversité. Des aménagements de poste peuvent être organisés pour tenir compte des personnes en situation de handicap.

Retrouvez nos engagements RSE ici et nos actions en faveur de la diversité ici

Description du poste

Rejoignez notre communauté Data & Analytics chez Talan !

Nous recherchons un(e) Data Analyst Senior capable de dépasser les simples reportings pour déceler les signaux faibles, expliquer les performances et éclairer les décisions stratégiques de nos clients.

Votre valeur ne se mesure pas uniquement à la qualité de vos dashboards, mais à votre capacité à poser les bonnes questions, à challenger les hypothèses et à transformer des millions de lignes de données en recommandations concrètes et actionnables.

Au sein de notre équipe Data & AI Experience, vous accompagnerez de grands groupes dans leur transformation data en combinant expertise analytique, visualisation, compréhension métier et innovations autour de l'IA générative.

Votre rôle sur nos projets :

Au sein d’équipes projets, vous pourrez être en charge des missions suivantes :


Recueillir, comprendre et challenger les besoins métiers afin d'identifier les enjeux de pilotage, de performance et d'aide à la décision.
Explorer et analyser des données provenant de multiples sources pour identifier des tendances, corrélations, signaux et opportunités d'amélioration.
Définir et construire des indicateurs pertinents (KPIs) en lien avec les objectifs stratégiques et opérationnels de nos clients.
Traduire des données complexes en recommandations claires et actionnables à travers des approches de data storytelling adaptées aux différents publics.
Concevoir des tableaux de bord et rapports interactifs sous des outils de datavisualisation comme Power BI favorisant la compréhension, l'analyse et la prise de décision.
Garantir la qualité, la fiabilité et la cohérence des données utilisées dans les analyses et les restitutions.
Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Data Engineering pour formaliser les besoins en données, améliorer les modèles analytiques et fiabiliser les usages.
Rédiger les spécifications fonctionnelles et documenter les analyses, métriques et règles de gestion.
Exploiter les capacités de l'IA et de l'IA générative pour accélérer l'exploration des données, l'analyse, la génération d'insights et la production de restitutions à forte valeur ajoutée.
Utiliser les fonctionnalités avancées de Power BI (Copilot, Q&A en langage naturel, Smart Narratives, détection d'anomalies, analyses automatisées) pour enrichir l'expérience décisionnelle.
Accompagner les utilisateurs dans l'appropriation des outils, la compréhension des indicateurs et le développement d'une culture data au sein des organisations.


Votre rôle chez Talan


Benchmark de solutions et conseil auprès de nos clients sur les technologies data & analytics à adopter, en lien avec leurs besoins
Réalisation de POC (Proof Of Concept) sur les modern data platforms et les outils de data visualisation
Animer la communauté Data & AI : retours d’expérience, conférences internes, mentoring, formations, veille technologique et partage des bonnes pratiques.


#TalanFrance

Qualifications

En tant que Data Analyst Senior, vous justifiez d’une expérience réussie sur des projets data & analytics à fort enjeu, alliant transformation de données et restitution décisionnelle.

Formation & expérience


Titulaire d’un Bac +5 (école d’ingénieur, université) ou équivalent
Minimum 7 ans d’expérience en data analyse dont une expérience significative combinant data visualisation et proposition d’insights.


Data Visualisation & Analytics


Maîtrise avancée de Power BI : modélisation sémantique, DAX, Power Query, conception de tableaux de bord interactifs et optimisation des performances
Excellente capacité à explorer, analyser et interpréter les données afin d'identifier des tendances, opportunités, risques et leviers de performance
Forte culture de la restitution des analyses et du data storytelling et de l’UX appliqué à la data visualisation, avec la capacité à adapter les messages aux différentes populations (métiers, directions, COMEX)
Maîtrise des techniques d'analyse de données : segmentation, analyse comportementale, analyses de performance, corrélations, détection d'anomalies
Connaissance des fonctionnalités d'IA de Power BI (Copilot, Q&A en langage naturel, Smart Narratives, analyse automatisée) pour enrichir les analyses et accélérer la production d'insights
La connaissance d'autres outils de data visualisation (Tableau, Qlik Sense, Looker Studio) constitue un atout


Data Management & Exploitation de la donnée


Solide maîtrise du SQL pour l'exploration, l'analyse et la préparation des données
Usage des outils de data préparation (DBT, Dataiku, Alteryx)
Bonne compréhension des modèles de données et des architectures analytiques modernes
Sensibilité aux enjeux de qualité, de fiabilité et de gouvernance des données
Capacité à exploiter des sources de données variées et à croiser des informations multiples pour construire des analyses à forte valeur ajoutée


IA appliquée à l'analyse de données


Maîtrise des usages de l'IA et de l'IA générative pour accélérer l'exploration des données, la recherche d'insights et la production de livrables analytiques
Capacité à utiliser les assistants IA pour enrichir les analyses, automatiser certaines investigations et améliorer l'expérience décisionnelle
Sensibilité aux notions de traçabilité, qualité, sécurité et gouvernance de la donnée


Cloud & Environnements Data


Expérience des environnements analytiques modernes : Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, Microsoft Fabric ou plateformes équivalentes
Compréhension des principes de stockage, de transformation et d'exposition de la donnée dans les plateformes analytiques modernes
La connaissance du versioning (Git) et des pratiques collaboratives de développement constitue un plus


Méthode & outils


Expérience du travail en mode agile (Scrum, Kanban, SAFE)
Capacité à communiquer avec des interlocuteurs variés : métiers, équipes techniques et directions
Maîtrise des outils collaboratifs et de gestion de projet (Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Teams...)
Bon niveau d'anglais professionnel (oral et écrit) – B2 minium


Certifications (un plus)


Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst (PL-300)
Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer (DP-600)
Databricks Data Analyst Associate
Certifications IA appliquées à la data et à la Business Intelligence


Qualités personnelles attendues


Esprit analytique développé et forte capacité de résolution de problèmes
Curiosité intellectuelle et goût pour l'exploration des données
Capacité à formuler des recommandations concrètes à partir des analyses
Excellentes qualités de communication et sens de la pédagogie
Autonomie, esprit d'initiative et force de proposition
Orientation résultats et impact métier
Capacité à vulgariser des sujets complexes auprès d'interlocuteurs non techniques
Esprit d'équipe et sens du service client


Votre souhait d’évolution

Si vous avez les compétences requises et souhaitez faire partie d’une équipe à taille humaine en pleine expansion, alliant expertise technique et proximité, vous êtes certainement le/la Data Analyst que nous recherchons !

Quelques références


Client du secteur de l’industrie : Modernisation de la plateforme décisionnelle - cadrage des besoins métier, construction des flux de transformation dbt sur Snowflake, modélisation des data marts, développement et déploiement des tableaux de bord Power BI.
Client du secteur du luxe : Mise en place d’une architecture analytics - industrialisation des pipelines ELT (dbt) sur Databricks, définition des règles de gouvernance et de qualité des données, développement des rapports Power BI et déploiement continu intégré à Git.
Client du secteur du transport : Solution de data visualisation self-service - animation d’ateliers de recueil de besoin, modélisation des données sur BigQuery (GCP), création de flux dbt documentés et testés, maquettage et développement des rapports Power BI.


Informations supplémentaires

AVANTAGES :


Plan de formation pour accompagner votre carrière (formations éditeurs, certifications) grâce à nos partenariats nous accordant une position de partenaire privilégié, et management de proximité par des experts
Locaux modernes en centre-ville
Top 5 du Palmarès Great Place to Work
Télétravail jusqu’à 5 jours selon les missions, prime d’équipement de 100€
Mobilité en France et à l’étranger
Top 1% des entreprises évaluées par Ecovadis dans le domaine social, environnemental et éthique
Tickets restaurant, prime vacances, 50% transport (abonnement transport public), mutuelle
Permanence handicap (consultant dédié aux collaborateurs en situation de handicap et aux proches aidants)
Actionnariat salarié
Prime de cooptations
RTT


L’équipe recrutement s’engage à vous proposer un processus de recrutement rapide et fluide :


Un premier échange de 30 min en visio avec le recruteur pour vous présenter le poste et comprendre votre projet professionnel
2 entretiens métier, dont au moins 1 dans nos locaux, pour entrer dans les détails du poste et rencontrer votre futur manager

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Join our highly skilled team of engineers, designers and product managers — breaking new ground and shaping the future of retail.




We dare to dream big, we have the courage to keep raising the bar, and we’re committed to being a force for good in retail - helping both established and fast-growing brands meet the ever-changing expectations of their customers.




Sitoo is a fast-growing technology company exploring how far we can take innovation to deliver the world’s best Unified Commerce Platform and Point of Sale. Our technology is used in more than 20 countries - a number that keeps growing thanks to our incredible teams in Engineering & Product. And we have no intention of slowing down. Are you the Data Analyst we’re looking for?




*This is a position for candidates with a permanent residency in Sweden*




Your mission at Sitoo




As a Data Analyst at Sitoo, you will be a foundational member of the Data & Analytics team, responsible for turning data into trusted insights that guide product, commercial, and operational decisions across the company.




This is a hands-on, high-impact role where you will help shape how Sitoo defines success, measures performance, and uses data in everyday decision-making. You’ll work closely with Product, Commercial, Operations, and Engineering to make data clear, actionable, and decision-ready. If you enjoy ownership, close collaboration with stakeholders, and seeing your insights directly influence how a company builds, operates, and grows, this role is for you.




What you’ll bring to the table




You are a curious and hands-on Data Analyst who enjoys working close to the business and learning how data drives product and commercial decisions. You like taking ownership of analyses, working from a vaguely defined question to a well-communicated insight, and improving how data is used over time and impacting the business.




You’re comfortable collaborating with Product, Commercial, and Engineering teams and motivated by seeing your work used in real decisions. You value clarity over complexity and are developing your ability to explain insights, assumptions, and limitations to different audiences.




3+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Product Data Analyst, or similar role, supporting product, commercial, or operational decisions.
Experience working directly with stakeholders, translating business or product questions into clear analyses, defining metrics and KPIS, and communicating insights and recommendations clearly.
Experience building and maintaining dashboards and recurring reports in a BI or analytics tool like Metabase, Looker, Power BI, Tableau etc.
Solid working knowledge of SQL, with experience working in modern cloud data warehouses (e.g. BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, Databricks, or similar).
Familiarity with core analytics concepts such as funnels, cohorts, retention, and basic growth metrics.
Basic understanding of experimentation and A/B testing, including metric selection and interpretation of results.




What you'll do




Act as a trusted analytics partner to Product, Engineering and Commercial teams, turning business and product questions into clear analyses and decision-ready insights with measurable business impact. Collaborating closely with data engineer, PM’s and engineers.
Define, develop and standardize core KPIs and metric definitions, helping establish a shared language for growth, retention, engagement, and revenue.
Build and maintain dashboards and insights reports that the organisation and teams rely on to run the business and evaluate product performance.
Perform deep-dive analyses on user behavior, funnels, cohorts, retention, and feature performance to inform prioritization and strategy.
Support experimentation and A/B testing, from hypothesis and success metrics to analysis, learnings, and recommendations.
Work closely with Product and Engineering to improve tracking, event schemas, and data quality, contributing to a scalable analytics foundation.




Why Sitoo




We are forward thinkers. By turning curiosity into knowledge — and knowledge into continuous improvement — we break new ground and shape the future of retail.




We believe in an inclusive culture where everyone feels like they belong. We support each other, win together, celebrate success together, and overcome challenges together.




Today, we are close to 100 dedicated experts with a positive and solution-oriented mindset. Most importantly, we take care of each other, and we never forget to have fun.

Title: Data Analyst Senior F/H
Description:
Rattaché(e) à la direction Digital & Data d’Ulys, le/la Data Analyst Senior a pour mission de développer une connaissance approfondie des clients et prospects afin de produire des analyses directement actionnables.

Il/elle contribue activement à la création de valeur à partir de la donnée pour :


accélérer le développement du parc clients,
améliorer la performance commerciale,
éclairer les décisions sur les stratégies produit, relationnelle et marketing.



Avec une forte orientation business et client, le/la Data Analyst Senior joue un rôle clé dans la définition et la mise en œuvre des stratégies d’Ulys.

Appétence pour les outils d’IA (notamment IA générative) appliqués à l’analyse de données afin d’accélérer la production d’insights

Missions principales :

Au sein d’une équipe de 5 personnes, vous serez en charge de :

1. Analyse & business impact

Comprendre les enjeux des équipes métiers et traduire leurs besoins en analyses data

Produire des analyses à forte valeur ajoutée : segmentation clients, comportements, saisonnalité, performance campagnes

Identifier des leviers de fidélisation et de création de valeur

2. Performance commerciale

Accompagner l’optimisation des actions d’acquisition et de développement du parc

Mesurer l’efficacité des dispositifs commerciaux et recommander des axes d’amélioration

3. Contribution à la stratégie produit

Analyser les usages des solutions Ulys

Alimenter les décisions produit avec des insights data

4. Pilotage & datavisualisation

Concevoir et maintenir des dashboards de pilotage (Power BI)

Structurer des indicateurs de performance fiables et partagés

5. Vision client 360°

Contribuer à l’enrichissement de la connaissance client (nouvelles données, nouveaux indicateurs)

Participer à la formalisation des besoins data avec les équipes produit (spécifications, recette)


Structuration & partage



Documenter les analyses et méthodes

Contribuer à la montée en compétence des équipes.

Profil recherché :


Bac +5 en statistiques, économétrie ou data
Expérience ≥ 5 ans en data analyse dans un environnement marketing / client
Expérience en business par abonnement ou B2B appréciée



Compétences clés

Techniques


Maîtrise avancée de SQL
Bonne pratique de Python ou R
Expérience en outils BI (Power BI, Tableau…)



Data & analyse


Capacité à structurer et challenger les analyses
Rigueur et fiabilité dans la production de résultats



Business & communication


Capacité à traduire la data en recommandations actionnables
Aisance à communiquer avec des interlocuteurs non techniques



Soft skills


Esprit analytique et orienté résultats
Autonomie, proactivité
Bon relationnel et capacité à travailler en transverse
Orientation client forte
Vous occuperez un rôle stratégique au cœur des enjeux data et expérience client
Vous évoluerez au sein d'une équipe engagée et dynamique, dans un environnement favorisant l’autonomie et l’impact
Nous vous offrons des conditions de travail attractives (télétravail, localisation, avantages...).

Title: Data Analyst - Madrid
Description:
Sobre esta Vacante

Serveo

Ubicación: Madrid, Community of Madrid, España

Modalidad: On-site

Industria: Facilities Services

Descripción del Puesto

¿Quieres formar parte del equipo de Serveo?

Si quieres que cada día sea diferente, enfrentándote a nuevos desafíos y formando parte de un equipo que te permita desarrollar todas tus capacidades, ¡sigue leyendo!

En Serveo somos un equipo multidisciplinar, diverso e inclusivo, formado por más de 48.000 profesionales. Somos un referente en servicios deindustria, salud, corporate, government e infraestructuras ofreciendo soluciones integrales, innovadoras y sostenibles.

Sonreímos al cambio y afrontamos juntos cada nuevo reto, impulsando la excelencia de nuestros servicios y fomentando el crecimiento de nuestros equipos en un extraordinario ambiente de trabajo.

¡Estamos orgullosos/as de ser reconocidos como una de las 100 mejores empresas para trabajar en España por Actualidad Económica (El Mundo) y por Forbes y de estar en el Top 5 del Happy Trainees en 2025!

¿En qué consiste el puesto?

Buscamos un Data Analyst en Madrid, cuya misión será transformar los datos en conocimiento accionable para apoyar la toma de decisiones en la organización, analizando, interpretando y visualizando información procedente de múltiples fuentes para identificar tendencias, patrones y oportunidades de mejora.

Funciones a Desarrollar

Analizar y explorar datos, identificando tendencias, patrones y oportunidades que aporten valor al negocio.Diseñar, desarrollar y optimizar cuadros de mando e informes, utilizando herramientas de visualización (principalmente Power BI) para facilitar la toma de decisiones.Traducir necesidades de negocio en requerimientos analíticos, colaborando con las distintas áreas para definir métricas e indicadores clave (KPIs).Garantizar la calidad y coherencia de los análisis, validando la integridad de los datos tanto en origen como en el Data Warehouse y asegurando la correcta interpretación de los resultados.Colaborar con otros perfiles de datos, asegurando la disponibilidad, calidad y adecuación de los datos necesarios para el análisis.Documentar métricas, indicadores y definiciones, manteniendo un catálogo claro y consistente que facilite el autoservicio analítico.Impulsar la cultura del dato y el autoservicio, apoyando a los equipos de negocio en el uso autónomo de las herramientas analíticas.Apoyar la toma de decisiones basada en datos, presentando conclusiones y recomendaciones de forma clara a perfiles técnicos y de negocio.Aplicar estándares de gobierno, calidad y seguridad del dato, asegurando el cumplimiento de las políticas corporativas en el tratamiento de la información.Analizar y comprender la información de negocio de forma integral, identificando oportunidades de mejora y proponiendo nuevos indicadores, análisis y cuadros de mando que aporten valor a la organización.Participar en la definición e implantación de controles y mecanismos de calidad del dato, monitorizando la información y estableciendo procesos de alerta y comunicación con los Data Owners ante la detección de incidencias o anomalías.Colaborar en el diseño y evolución de datasets analíticos y modelos de datos orientados al reporting y al autoservicio, participando en procesos de integración y transformación de datos.

¿Qué buscamos?

Grado en ingeniería informática, matemáticas, estadística, ADE o similarExperiencia sólida en análisis de datos y dominio de SQL para la consulta, explotación y optimización de datos.Dominio de herramientas de visualización (principalmente Power BI).Conocimiento de arquitecturas de datos en plataformas cloud, especialmente Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Knowledge Catalog, etc.).Conocimiento de Python para análisis, tratamiento y automatización de datos.Inglés (Avanzado)Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia en análisis de datos, Business Intelligence o analítica de datos en entornos corporativos con las tecnologías mencionadas.Perfil con capacidad analítica, comunicación, orientación a resultados, mejora continua, atención al detalle, autonomía y proactividad, trabajo en equipo

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

Contrato indefinido: te ofrecemos un proyecto a largo plazo en una empresa líder en servicios de infraestructuras.

Flexibilidad para facilitar la conciliación. Serveo ha sido galardonada con el Certificado EFR de la Fundación Más Familia, por su implicación en la conciliación personal, familiar y laboral. En este puesto tendrás:Flexibilidad horaria de entrada y salidaJornada continua en verano y festividadesPolítica corporativa de teletrabajo

Paquete retributivo competitivo. Retribución total altamente competitiva en el sector, compuesta por una retribución fija más una retribución variableAcceso a una competitiva 'Bolsa Corporativa de Beneficios' anual que podrás destinar con toda flexibilidad a diferentes productos (tarjeta comida, seguro de salud, tarjeta transporte público, cheque guardería, formación o plan de ahorro) según tus intereses, lo que te permitirá optimizar la fiscalidad de tu retribución y disfrutar de importantes descuentos a los que tenemos acceso como gran empresa.

Desarrollo y proyección profesional: a través de la participación en proyectos transversales, formación y movilidad interna.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Gruppo Digital360 è il gruppo italiano che supporta imprese e Pubblica Amministrazione nella trasformazione digitale, nell’innovazione organizzativa e valorizzazione del brand e posizionamento.

Digital360 unisce rigore accademico e visione imprenditoriale, affiancando le organizzazioni e le imprese, pubbliche e private, con team multidisciplinari che integrano competenze di natura umanistica, economica, tecnologica, legale e organizzativa e riunisce manager, imprenditori e professionisti presenti sul mercato da oltre quarant’anni. All’interno delle sue tre Business Unit – Advisory, GOV e Connect- il Gruppo offre servizi che si sviluppano sui principali pillar della trasformazione digitale, diventando un vero abilitatore dell’evoluzione organizzativa e tecnologica delle aziende e delle organizzazioni.




Nato nel 2012 da un’iniziativa del Politecnico di Milano, il Gruppo Digital360 è oggi una Società Benefit, con headquarter in Italia, a Milano e a Roma, con oltre 1.300 persone e 140M € di ricavi nel 2025.




Attualmente siamo alla ricerca di un Data Analyst appassionato/a, capace di trasformare numeri complessi in storie chiare e strategie vincenti. Il/la candidato/a lavorerà nell’area di Business Information a diretto riporto della direzione IT e si occuperà di raccogliere requisiti e disegnare soluzioni a supporto del business, del board e dell’area finance.




Principali responsabilità:

Analisi e Reporting: estrarre, pulire e analizzare dati provenienti da diverse fonti per supportare il decision-making aziendale.
Data Visualization: progettare e mantenere report interattivi e dashboard d'impatto su Power BI.
Optimization: utilizzare Excel a livelli avanzati per analisi rapide, modelli finanziari o riconciliazioni dati.
Insight strategici: collaborare con i diversi team per identificare trend, anomalie e opportunità di crescita.
Data Quality: monitorare l'integrità dei dati e ottimizzare i processi di raccolta.




Competenze e capacità richieste:

Power BI: conoscenza di Power Query, modellazione dati e linguaggio DAX.
Excel: ottima padronanza (Pivot, Cerca.Vert/XLOOKUP, Formule nidificate, Power Pivot).
Data mindset: capacità di tradurre i requisiti di business in indicatori tecnici (KPI).
Curiosità intellettuale: non ti fermi al "cosa", vuoi capire il "perché".
Precisione: hai un occhio clinico per il dettaglio.
Comunicazione: sai spiegare dati complessi anche a chi non mastica i numeri.




Requisiti:

Esperienza: Almeno 2-3 anni in ruoli analoghi.
Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica, Informatica o percorsi affini, oppure diploma tecnico con competenze equivalenti.




Cosa offriamo:

Inserimento a tempo indeterminato con CCNL Commercio Terziario
RAL compresa tra 30.000€ e 35.000€, definita in funzione del profilo e dell’esperienza complessivamente maturata
Pacchetto welfare aziendale
Buoni pasto per ogni giorno lavorato.




Perché lavorare con noi:

Entrerai in un gruppo che integra consulenza, tecnologia e comunicazione, lavorando su progetti concreti per imprese e Pubblica Amministrazione.
Avrai l’opportunità di confrontarti con competenze diverse e contribuire a iniziative che uniscono strategia, execution e sviluppo del mercato.
Lavorerai in un contesto in evoluzione, dove sperimentazione e collaborazione sono parte integrante del modo di operare.
Utilizziamo l’AI e strumenti avanzati per supportare le attività quotidiane e migliorare l’efficacia del lavoro.
Offriamo modalità di lavoro flessibili e un ambiente che favorisce autonomia e responsabilità.
Investiamo nella crescita delle persone, attraverso formazione continua e opportunità di sviluppo professionale.




La ricerca rispetta il d.lgs. 198/2006 ed è aperta a persone con disabilità, di qualsiasi orientamento o espressione di genere, orientamento sessuale, età, etnia e credo religioso. Il presente annuncio è stato ideato nel rispetto della diversity e dell’inclusività.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Department

WDTech - R&D

We are Walker & Dunlop. We are one of the largest providers of capital to the commercial real estate industry, enabling real estate owners and operators to bring their visions of communities — where people live, work, shop, and play — to life. We are committed to creating meaningful social, environmental, and economic change in our communities.

Department Overview

WDTech is W&D’s in-house technology team – a group of collaborative and highly skilled technology professionals, all of whom are leading experts in real estate data, data science, and technology.

WDTech Engineering builds solutions that impact not only our products but also the people and processes across our organization. A commitment to innovation and a passion for disrupting the old-fashioned real estate industry are our highest priorities.

The Impact You Will Have

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will play a key role in delivering trusted data insights and analytics that support business and product decision-making across the organization. This role is responsible for analyzing complex datasets, developing reporting solutions and dashboards, and translating data into actionable insights that improve operational effectiveness and support strategic initiatives.

Working closely with Data Analysts, BI Analysts, Data Engineers, Data QA Engineers, Data Scientists, and Product Managers, you will help ensure data products are accurate, scalable, and aligned with evolving business needs as Walker & Dunlop continues to grow as a data-driven organization.

Primary Responsibilities


Analyze and curate data sources to support business and product stakeholders in making informed decisions.
Lead key components of the analytical lifecycle, including data exploration, analysis, reporting, and insight delivery.
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for technical and non-technical audiences.
Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions.
Perform data wrangling, transformation, and analysis using SQL and enterprise analytical databases.
Define and document datasets, business logic, and reporting definitions to support consistent data usage.
Partner with data and product teams to support data governance, data quality, and data management processes.
Analyze user engagement, operational, and product data to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
Mentor junior analysts and promote best practices in analytics, visualization, and stakeholder collaboration.
Perform other duties as assigned


Education And Experience


Bachelor’s degree preferred, preferably in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related field.
6+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or analytics roles with demonstrated ownership of end-to-end analytical projects.
Strong experience working with enterprise analytical databases such as Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, or similar technologies.
Experience developing dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualization tools.
Experience with SQL, data transformation, and analytical reporting workflows.
Experience with Python and geospatial analysis preferred.
Real estate, financial services, or related industry experience preferred.


Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Deep expertise in SQL and data analysis techniques.
Strong proficiency with data visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Understanding of data modeling, ETL processes, and analytical best practices.
Ability to communicate technical concepts and analytical findings clearly to business and technical audiences.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work collaboratively across technical and business teams in a fast-paced environment.
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools that support reporting, documentation, and analysis workflows preferred.
High level of accountability, attention to detail, and commitment to continuous improvement.
Ability to show ownership of your work, take on challenges and acknowledge growth opportunities, and demonstrate patience when learning new processes
Courtesy, respect, and thoughtfulness in teaming with colleagues and other stakeholders


What We Offer 


You will have the opportunity to accelerate in our rapidly growing organization.
Agile working environment with flexible working hours and location, career advancement, and competitive compensation package.
We are a family friendly company.
We arrange social activities to help our employees and families become familiar with each other and our culture.
In addition to other benefits, we offer a pension scheme and 100% complimentary and confidential mental health services.


Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

We are committed to equity in all steps of the recruitment and employment experience. We believe in equal access to opportunities in our workplace. We do not tolerate discrimination, including harassment, based on any characteristic protected by applicable law, such as race, color, national origin, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, sex, age, disability, veteran or military status, and genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We strive to be a safe place to ask questions, build professional relationships, and develop careers.

SPAM

Please be wary of recruitment scams. An indication of a scam might be a request for sensitive or bank information at the time of application or emails coming from a non walkerdunlop.com email address. Please call us at 301.215.5500, if you have any concerns about information requested during or after the application process.

Title: Senior BI Data Analyst
Description:
I’m Donatas Šeputis, and I’m looking for a curious, experienced data professional to join us in shaping the future of data and analytics at City Service SE group.

We're building a new, modern data platform — scalable, seamlessly integrated across systems, and designed to turn data into a self-service, 'speak to your data' experience.

We're looking for a Senior BI Data Analyst to turn well-governed data into clear insight and decision-ready reporting across the business. You'll work across a modern data stack — including Microsoft SQL Server, Snowflake, Power BI, Apache Airflow, and GIT — with AI-assisted development support via Claude, partnering closely with our data engineering team to shape what gets modeled, reported, and delivered to the business.

Key Responsibilities


Design, build, and maintain BI dashboards, reports, and self-service analytics solutions on top of our MS SQL and Snowflake environments.
Translate business questions into data models, metrics, and visualizations that are accurate, intuitive, and reusable.
Partner with data engineers to define requirements for the semantic/analytics layer, ensuring datasets are structured for reliable reporting.
Write and optimize complex SQL queries for analysis, validation, and ad hoc business questions.
Define and maintain key business metrics, KPI definitions, and a single source of truth across reporting tools (Power BI).
Ensure data quality, consistency, and traceability in reports through validation checks and reconciliation with source systems.
Maintain version-controlled reporting logic and documentation using Git, following review best practices.
Collaborate with business and IT teams, gathering requirements and presenting findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Support data security, access management, and GDPR-aligned governance practices in reporting and dashboards.
Prepare optimized, reliable datasets and visualizations for analytics, reporting, and AI-driven analytical solutions.
Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate analysis, documentation, and dashboard development.
Participate in technical design reviews and propose improvements to reporting architecture and data visualization standards.
Mentor and support the technical growth of junior/mid-level analysts.


What We Expect from You:


A university degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
4+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analysis, or analytics engineering.
Strong SQL skills, with hands-on experience in (complex queries, performance-aware query writing).
Experience with cloud data warehousing, ideally Snowflake.
Hands-on experience building dashboards and reports in Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable BI tool.
Familiarity with ETL/ELT pipelines and orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, and how they feed downstream reporting.
Proficiency with Git for version control and collaborative development.
Working knowledge of Python or another scripting language for data analysis and automation is a plus.
Understanding of data warehouse and analytics architecture, including layered ("medallion"-style) data processing approaches.
Experience ensuring data quality, accuracy, and reliability across test and production reporting environments.
Comfort working with AI-assisted tools (e.g. Claude) as part of the analytics workflow.
Ability to collaborate across teams, communicating insights clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
Independence, sense of ownership, and initiative in identifying and proposing analytical improvements.
Experience mentoring or supporting less experienced analysts is a plus.


Why Us?


Professional growth and development opportunities within an international group of companies.
Real influence on how the business understands its data — not just building reports, but shaping the metrics and platform behind them.
Help shape a platform where business users can simply ask their data questions — not just build dashboards but build the experience of querying data in plain language.
24/7 accident insurance in Lithuania and abroad.
Hybrid working possibility.


Salary

€3,800–5,400 gross/month

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Company Overview

Holafly is a high-growth scale-up revolutionising how businesses and travellers connect to the internet abroad. Since 2018, we’ve empowered travellers in over 200 destinations worldwide with secure and reliable eSIM solutions. With a team of 500+ professionals across multiple countries, we are scaling globally to support travellers with seamless, unlimited data connectivity. We’re not just connecting people—we’re enabling freedom and peace of mind, ensuring our users stay connected from the second they land, wherever their journey takes them.

The Role

As our App-focused Data Analyst, you will support our mobile growth engine by building robust dashboards, preparing reliable metrics, and conducting deep-dive analyses. By translating raw app data into clear reporting, you will empower our UA, ASO, Product and CRM teams, and Leadership, with the insights they need to confidently execute their strategies and optimize their budgets and releases.

Key Responsibilities


Build and maintain scalable, self-serve dashboards that give App, UA, and ASO teams instant, reliable access to core performance metrics (ROAS, CAC, LTV) and daily tracking.
Fuel marketing investments’ optimizations by creating specialized reports analyzing ad creatives, Custom Product Pages (CPPs), Custom Store Listings (CSLs), and in-app events across channels.
Provide holistic visibility into app growth by unifying organic and paid data, allowing teams to evaluate deduplicated traffic and true channel incrementality.
Support product and marketing decisions by analyzing full-funnel behavior and interpreting A/B tests to identify actionable conversion and retention gaps.
Maintain a trustworthy data foundation by working closely with mobile attribution (MMP-level) data, flagging platform discrepancies, and documenting metrics definitions.
Partner directly with UA and ASO stakeholders to deliver exploratory analyses on channel efficiency and audience quality, making complex data accessible to non-technical teams.


Qualifications


5+ years of Data Analysis experience in a mobile-first, performance marketing, or growth-oriented environment.
Expert-level SQL and proficiency in Python or R for data manipulation and automating reporting processes.
Hands-on expertise with BI tools (Looker Studio, Tableau) and mobile attribution/MMP ecosystems (Adjust, AppsFlyer).
Deep knowledge of App Store analytics platforms (AppTweak, Apple Ads, App Store Connect) and evaluating paid UA data.
Strong statistical foundation, with proven experience translating A/B tests and cohort analyses into clear methodology docs and insights.
Hands-on experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Firebase for mobile apps, including custom event tracking, funnel analysis, and extracting raw data.


Nice to Have


Background in travel, e-commerce, or fast-paced subscription-based apps.
Familiarity with alternative market intelligence tools like SensorTower.
Knowledge of BigQuery, dbt, or similar modern data stack components.


Benefits & Perks


High-Impact Influence: Your metrics and reporting will directly shape UA investments and ASO strategies.
Work-Life Balance: A highly flexible, remote-friendly culture designed for modern professionals.
Global Impact: Join a fast-moving, international team operating across 200+ markets with zero bureaucracy.

Title: Data-analist
HTML:
Data Analyst AI


Ben jij een analytische Data Analyst die graag data vertaalt naar inzichten die daadwerkelijk gebruikt worden? Wil jij werken op het snijvlak van data, business en technologie binnen een internationale organisatie?


Voor een internationale organisatie in Den Bosch zijn wij op zoek naar een Data Analyst.


Over de functie

Als Data Analyst werk je van businessvraag tot bruikbaar inzicht. Je verzamelt, analyseert, transformeert en modelleert data uit verschillende bronnen en vertaalt deze naar dashboards, rapportages en concrete aanbevelingen.


Je werkt nauw samen met business stakeholders en data-specialisten. Hierdoor ben je niet alleen technisch bezig met data, maar denk je ook actief mee over hoe data de organisatie kan helpen betere beslissingen te nemen.


Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

  • Vertalen van businessvragen naar data-analyses;
  • Verzamelen, transformeren en modelleren van data;
  • Ontwikkelen van dashboards en rapportages;
  • Werken met SQL en BI-tools;
  • Analyseren van datasets en vertalen van uitkomsten naar inzichten;
  • Samenwerken met verschillende business stakeholders;
  • Bewaken van datakwaliteit;
  • Bijdragen aan verdere professionalisering van data en analytics;
  • Ondersteunen van teams bij datagedreven besluitvorming.


Jouw kwaliteiten

  • Hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau;
  • Circa 2-4 jaar ervaring binnen data-analyse of BI;
  • Goede kennis van SQL;
  • Ervaring met Power BI;
  • Ervaring met Snowflake en/of dbt is een pré;
  • Python-kennis is mooi meegenomen;
  • Analytisch sterk en communicatief vaardig;
  • Je kunt technische inzichten goed vertalen naar de business;
  • Nieuwsgierig en leergierig.


Over de organisatie

Je komt terecht bij een internationale organisatie binnen de educatieve sector. Vanuit verschillende Europese landen wordt gewerkt aan digitale en fysieke oplossingen die dagelijks worden gebruikt binnen het onderwijs.

Binnen het data- en analyticsdomein wordt volop gewerkt aan het verder datagedreven maken van de organisatie. Je werkt samen met verschillende data-specialisten en stakeholders en krijgt de ruimte om mee te bouwen aan deze ontwikkeling.


Wat bieden ze je

  • Een uitdagende Data Analyst-rol binnen een organisatie met een organisatie met maatschappelijk belang;
  • Een salaris tot circa €70.000 per jaar op basis van 36 uur;
  • Hybride werken is mogelijk, met flexibiliteit om deels vanuit huis te werken;
  • Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ontwikkeling;
  • Een functie waarin je direct impact maakt met data.


Interesse?

Ben jij klaar voor een volgende stap als Data Analyst en wil jij werken op het snijvlak van data en business? Neem dan contact met ons op en stuur je CV mee.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Department

WDTech - R&D

We are Walker & Dunlop. We are one of the largest providers of capital to the commercial real estate industry, enabling real estate owners and operators to bring their visions of communities — where people live, work, shop, and play — to life. We are committed to creating meaningful social, environmental, and economic change in our communities.

Department Overview

WDTech is W&D’s in-house technology team – a group of collaborative and highly skilled technology professionals, all of whom are leading experts in real estate data, data science, and technology.

WDTech Engineering builds solutions that impact not only our products but also the people and processes across our organization. A commitment to innovation and a passion for disrupting the old-fashioned real estate industry are our highest priorities.

The Impact You Will Have

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will play a key role in delivering trusted data insights and analytics that support business and product decision-making across the organization. This role is responsible for analyzing complex datasets, developing reporting solutions and dashboards, and translating data into actionable insights that improve operational effectiveness and support strategic initiatives.

Working closely with Data Analysts, BI Analysts, Data Engineers, Data QA Engineers, Data Scientists, and Product Managers, you will help ensure data products are accurate, scalable, and aligned with evolving business needs as Walker & Dunlop continues to grow as a data-driven organization.

Primary Responsibilities


Analyze and curate data sources to support business and product stakeholders in making informed decisions.
Lead key components of the analytical lifecycle, including data exploration, analysis, reporting, and insight delivery.
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for technical and non-technical audiences.
Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions.
Perform data wrangling, transformation, and analysis using SQL and enterprise analytical databases.
Define and document datasets, business logic, and reporting definitions to support consistent data usage.
Partner with data and product teams to support data governance, data quality, and data management processes.
Analyze user engagement, operational, and product data to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
Mentor junior analysts and promote best practices in analytics, visualization, and stakeholder collaboration.
Perform other duties as assigned


Education And Experience


Bachelor’s degree preferred, preferably in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related field.
6+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or analytics roles with demonstrated ownership of end-to-end analytical projects.
Strong experience working with enterprise analytical databases such as Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, or similar technologies.
Experience developing dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualization tools.
Experience with SQL, data transformation, and analytical reporting workflows.
Experience with Python and geospatial analysis preferred.
Real estate, financial services, or related industry experience preferred.


Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Deep expertise in SQL and data analysis techniques.
Strong proficiency with data visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Understanding of data modeling, ETL processes, and analytical best practices.
Ability to communicate technical concepts and analytical findings clearly to business and technical audiences.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work collaboratively across technical and business teams in a fast-paced environment.
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools that support reporting, documentation, and analysis workflows preferred.
High level of accountability, attention to detail, and commitment to continuous improvement.
Ability to show ownership of your work, take on challenges and acknowledge growth opportunities, and demonstrate patience when learning new processes
Courtesy, respect, and thoughtfulness in teaming with colleagues and other stakeholders


What We Offer 


You will have the opportunity to accelerate in our rapidly growing organization.
Agile working environment with flexible working hours and location, career advancement, and competitive compensation package.
We are a family friendly company.
We arrange social activities to help our employees and families become familiar with each other and our culture.
In addition to other benefits, we offer a pension scheme and 100% complimentary and confidential mental health services.

We are committed to equity in all steps of the recruitment and employment experience. We believe in equal access to opportunities in our workplace. We do not tolerate discrimination, including harassment, based on any characteristic protected by applicable law, such as race, color, national origin, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, sex, age, disability, veteran or military status, and genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We strive to be a safe place to ask questions, build professional relationships, and develop careers.

Gather and clean data from various sources, including databases, spreadsheets, and external APIs; maintain and update databases to ensure data integrity and accessibility.
Analyze large datasets to identify patterns, trends, and correlations, using statistical techniques to interpret data and generate actionable insights.

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.
Proven experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar role.
Proficiency in data analysis tools such as SQL,
Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI).
Familiarity with statistical methods and data modeling techniques is a plus.
Must be french-speaker, at least C1.


Soft Skills


Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex data concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Our workplace reflects the vibrant spirit of our locations, with initiatives such as a Green Transportation Budget, electric bikes and a flexible Hybrid Work Policy. Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Gruppo Digital360 è il gruppo italiano che supporta imprese e Pubblica Amministrazione nella trasformazione digitale, nell’innovazione organizzativa e valorizzazione del brand e posizionamento.

Digital360 unisce rigore accademico e visione imprenditoriale, affiancando le organizzazioni e le imprese, pubbliche e private, con team multidisciplinari che integrano competenze di natura umanistica, economica, tecnologica, legale e organizzativa e riunisce manager, imprenditori e professionisti presenti sul mercato da oltre quarant’anni. All’interno delle sue tre Business Unit – Advisory, GOV e Connect- il Gruppo offre servizi che si sviluppano sui principali pillar della trasformazione digitale, diventando un vero abilitatore dell’evoluzione organizzativa e tecnologica delle aziende e delle organizzazioni.




Nato nel 2012 da un’iniziativa del Politecnico di Milano, il Gruppo Digital360 è oggi una Società Benefit, con headquarter in Italia, a Milano e a Roma, con oltre 1.300 persone e 140M € di ricavi nel 2025.




Attualmente siamo alla ricerca di un Data Analyst appassionato/a, capace di trasformare numeri complessi in storie chiare e strategie vincenti. Il/la candidato/a lavorerà nell’area di Business Information a diretto riporto della direzione IT e si occuperà di raccogliere requisiti e disegnare soluzioni a supporto del business, del board e dell’area finance.




Principali responsabilità:

Analisi e Reporting: estrarre, pulire e analizzare dati provenienti da diverse fonti per supportare il decision-making aziendale.
Data Visualization: progettare e mantenere report interattivi e dashboard d'impatto su Power BI.
Optimization: utilizzare Excel a livelli avanzati per analisi rapide, modelli finanziari o riconciliazioni dati.
Insight strategici: collaborare con i diversi team per identificare trend, anomalie e opportunità di crescita.
Data Quality: monitorare l'integrità dei dati e ottimizzare i processi di raccolta.




Competenze e capacità richieste:

Power BI: conoscenza di Power Query, modellazione dati e linguaggio DAX.
Excel: ottima padronanza (Pivot, Cerca.Vert/XLOOKUP, Formule nidificate, Power Pivot).
Data mindset: capacità di tradurre i requisiti di business in indicatori tecnici (KPI).
Curiosità intellettuale: non ti fermi al "cosa", vuoi capire il "perché".
Precisione: hai un occhio clinico per il dettaglio.
Comunicazione: sai spiegare dati complessi anche a chi non mastica i numeri.




Requisiti:

Esperienza: Almeno 2-3 anni in ruoli analoghi.
Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica, Informatica o percorsi affini, oppure diploma tecnico con competenze equivalenti.




Cosa offriamo:

Inserimento a tempo indeterminato con CCNL Commercio Terziario
RAL compresa tra 30.000€ e 35.000€, definita in funzione del profilo e dell’esperienza complessivamente maturata
Pacchetto welfare aziendale
Buoni pasto per ogni giorno lavorato.




Perché lavorare con noi:

Entrerai in un gruppo che integra consulenza, tecnologia e comunicazione, lavorando su progetti concreti per imprese e Pubblica Amministrazione.
Avrai l’opportunità di confrontarti con competenze diverse e contribuire a iniziative che uniscono strategia, execution e sviluppo del mercato.
Lavorerai in un contesto in evoluzione, dove sperimentazione e collaborazione sono parte integrante del modo di operare.
Utilizziamo l’AI e strumenti avanzati per supportare le attività quotidiane e migliorare l’efficacia del lavoro.
Offriamo modalità di lavoro flessibili e un ambiente che favorisce autonomia e responsabilità.
Investiamo nella crescita delle persone, attraverso formazione continua e opportunità di sviluppo professionale.




La ricerca rispetta il d.lgs. 198/2006 ed è aperta a persone con disabilità, di qualsiasi orientamento o espressione di genere, orientamento sessuale, età, etnia e credo religioso. Il presente annuncio è stato ideato nel rispetto della diversity e dell’inclusività.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Do you want to join a growing team of top professionals who invest time and effort into teaching, career growth, and cultivating employees into the next generation of IT experts? You've come to the right place. Span is an international IT company with over 30 years of experience in developing and delivering advanced technology solutions. Span is recognized in the market as a multi-specialist with a business focus on three key strategic areas: cloud, cybersecurity, and artificial intelligence. We're constantly improving, advancing, and adopting new trends, new skills, and new expertise, giving our employees virtually endless opportunities for professional development.




The Software & AI Solutions business unit gathers over 140 experts and is one of Span's key pillars. We focus on developing advanced software solutions, applying artificial intelligence, and processing and analyzing data to create real business value for our clients. We work across various industries and deliver solutions that make a tangible difference, both for our external clients and our internal needs.




We are seeking a skilled and motivated Data Analyst to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong analytical background, experience with data analysis tools, and the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights. This role requires a proactive individual with excellent problem-solving skills and a keen eye for detail.




What you'll do:

Design and build high-performance, scalable end-to-end analytical solutions – from understanding business needs and modelling data to delivering intuitive reports and dashboards
Develop, maintain, and optimize semantic models, dashboards, and reports that support strategic and operational decision-making
Work closely with business stakeholders to understand complex requirements, challenge assumptions, and translate them into scalable data solutions
Perform ad hoc analyses to identify trends, opportunities, and insights that support business decisions
Ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability by applying analytical best practices throughout the reporting lifecycle
Contribute to improving our BI solutions and reporting processes by proposing new approaches, optimizing existing solutions, and promoting BI best practices
Support business users through workshops, training sessions, and presentations




We could be a perfect fit if you are:

Approaching activities in a planned and organized manner, focused on essentials and working quickly and efficiently
Showing a strong desire for constant career development and gaining experience
Inclined to innovate, always trying out different approaches and looking for new, better and more efficient ways of working
Appreciating and accepting differences, respecting other people and their opinions and ideas and readily giving them yourself




What we expect:

BS in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field
3+ years of experience in Data Analytics or similar data-focused roles
Strong experience with SQL and relational databases
Experience with BI tools, preferably Power BI
Understanding of data modelling principles and experience designing semantic models for analytical reporting
Experience designing and developing reports and dashboards following data visualization best practices
Experience working with large and complex datasets, including query and reporting performance optimization
Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, and analyze significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy
Good spoken and written English skills
Attention to detail and a strong commitment to quality
Ability to work effectively with remote teammates and business users




Skills that will bring you extra points:

Experience with Power Query (M) and DAX
Understanding of ETL/ELT principles and experience with data integration tools (e.g. Azure Data Factory)
Experience working with REST APIs and integrating external data sources
Understanding of modern data architecture concepts (e.g. Data Warehouse, Data Lake, Lakehouse, Medallion Architecture)
Familiarity with Azure data technologies (e.g. Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Lake Storage)
Experience with modern data platforms (e.g. Databricks)
Experience designing and developing paginated reports using SSRS or Power BI Paginated Reports
Interest in or experience using AI-powered tools and agents to enhance analytics and BI development




What's in it for you:

Competitive salary according to your experience
A business phone of your choice
InHouse testing center- we are giving you an option of gaining professional certificates
Mentor - no matter how much experience you've got, we will provide you with an adequate mentor
Regular feedback on your performance and personalized career development plan
Possibility to earn different types of bonuses
Subvention of Multisport card or PassSport - not only brain workout is important
Minimum of 25 vacation days
Complete health checks - adjusted for men and women
Psychological counseling - we care about your well-being
Lunch and transportation compensations
Benefits for children of employees




When you’re ready, click the Apply button below – even if you don’t check every single box. We are looking forward to meeting you! 😊

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Place: Tres Cantos, Community of Madrid, Spain
Description:
Are you looking for an innovative and established organisation where you can develop your career? Are you passionate about turning data into real impact? This is your chance!

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to drive a data-driven culture across our corporate divisions. You will be part of the Data & Advanced Analytics team, helping to transform information into smarter, more strategic decisions.

You will be part of key initiatives in advanced analytics, data governance and artificial intelligence, driving continuous improvement by identifying opportunities and generating actionable insights. This role combines technical challenges with a strong business acumen, involving you in projects that have a real impact on the organisation’s transformation and evolution.

We´ll get to the point; we'll tell you what's not on the web. If you want to know more about us go to GMV website

WHAT CHALLENGE WILL YOU BE TAKING ON?

Within our team, your main responsibilities will be:


Analysing corporate data to identify trends, patterns, risks and opportunities for improvement that drive decision-making.
Creating dashboards, reports and key performance indicators using visualisation tools that facilitate business interpretation.
Design and develop data integration and transformation processes (ETL/ELT) to ensure data availability and reliability.
Define and build data models aligned with the organisation’s analytical needs.
Ensure the quality, consistency and traceability of data throughout its entire lifecycle.
Work with economic, financial and operational information, ensuring data consistency and correct reconciliation.
Collaborate closely with the various business areas to understand their needs and translate them into high-value analytical solutions.
Participate in data governance initiatives, contributing to the efficient and structured management of corporate data.
Identify opportunities to incorporate Artificial Intelligence and language models (LLMs) into corporate processes.
Drive initiatives for automation, innovation and continuous improvement within the data ecosystem.
Promote a cross-functional view of processes and data, encouraging collaboration between departments.


WHAT DO WE NEED IN OUR TEAM?

Previous experience in all the areas described is not essential for this role. We particularly value the ability to learn, intellectual curiosity, a proactive approach and a keen interest in further developing your knowledge of data analytics and artificial intelligence.

We are looking for a professional with analytical skills, critical thinking and a problem-solving mindset. The ability to conceptualise, synthesise and draw conclusions from data, as well as adapt messages to different audiences, and experience in data analysis and exploitation.

Knowledge and experience of the following would be required:


Data visualisation tools (Spotfire, Power BI or similar).
Programming in Python and advanced SQL.
Design and development of ETL processes
Modelling of relational and analytical databases.
Data governance, data quality and metadata management.


The following will be considered an advantage:


Knowledge of applied statistics and quantitative analysis.
Ability to interact with business users and translate functional requirements into technical solutions.
Familiarity with Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI and language models (LLMs), as well as their practical applications in business environments.


WHAT DO WE OFFER?

🕑 Hybrid working model and 8 weeks per year of teleworking outside your usual geographical area.

💻 Flexible start and finish times, and intensive working hours Fridays and in summer.

🚀 Personalized career plan development, training and language learning support.

🌍 National and international mobility. Do you come from another country? We can offer you a relocation package.

💰 Competitive compensation with ongoing reviews, flexible compensation and discount on brands.

Are you looking for an innovative and established organisation where you can develop your career? Are you passionate about turning data into real impact? This is your chance!

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to drive a data-driven culture across our corporate divisions. You will be part of the Data & Advanced Analytics team, helping to transform information into smarter, more strategic decisions.

You will be part of key initiatives in advanced analytics, data governance and artificial intelligence, driving continuous improvement by identifying opportunities and generating actionable insights. This role combines technical challenges with a strong business acumen, involving you in projects that have a real impact on the organisation’s transformation and evolution.

We´ll get to the point; we'll tell you what's not on the web. If you want to know more about us go to GMV website

WHAT CHALLENGE WILL YOU BE TAKING ON?

Within our team, your main responsibilities will be:

  • Analysing corporate data to identify trends, patterns, risks and opportunities for improvement that drive decision-making.
  • Creating dashboards, reports and key performance indicators using visualisation tools that facilitate business interpretation.
  • Design and develop data integration and transformation processes (ETL/ELT) to ensure data availability and reliability.
  • Define and build data models aligned with the organisation’s analytical needs.
  • Ensure the quality, consistency and traceability of data throughout its entire lifecycle.
  • Work with economic, financial and operational information, ensuring data consistency and correct reconciliation.
  • Collaborate closely with the various business areas to understand their needs and translate them into high-value analytical solutions.
  • Participate in data governance initiatives, contributing to the efficient and structured management of corporate data.
  • Identify opportunities to incorporate Artificial Intelligence and language models (LLMs) into corporate processes.
  • Drive initiatives for automation, innovation and continuous improvement within the data ecosystem.
  • Promote a cross-functional view of processes and data, encouraging collaboration between departments.

WHAT DO WE NEED IN OUR TEAM?

Previous experience in all the areas described is not essential for this role. We particularly value the ability to learn, intellectual curiosity, a proactive approach and a keen interest in further developing your knowledge of data analytics and artificial intelligence.

We are looking for a professional with analytical skills, critical thinking and a problem-solving mindset. The ability to conceptualise, synthesise and draw conclusions from data, as well as adapt messages to different audiences, and experience in data analysis and exploitation.

Knowledge and experience of the following would be required:

  • Data visualisation tools (Spotfire, Power BI or similar).
  • Programming in Python and advanced SQL.
  • Design and development of ETL processes
  • Modelling of relational and analytical databases.
  • Data governance, data quality and metadata management.

The following will be considered an advantage:

  • Knowledge of applied statistics and quantitative analysis.
  • Ability to interact with business users and translate functional requirements into technical solutions.
  • Familiarity with Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI and language models (LLMs), as well as their practical applications in business environments.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

🕑 Hybrid working model and 8 weeks per year of teleworking outside your usual geographical area.

💻 Flexible start and finish times, and intensive working hours Fridays and in summer.

🚀 Personalized career plan development, training and language learning support.
