Title: Data Analist / BI Specialist
HTML:
Als Data Analist / BI Specialist zorg jij ervoor dat organisaties hun data omzetten in waardevolle inzichten. Je analyseert complexe datasets, vertaalt deze naar heldere rapportages en dashboards en adviseert stakeholders over datagedreven beslissingen. Met moderne BI-tools zoals Power BI, Tableau of Qlik maak je informatie toegankelijk en begrijpelijk. Daarmee help je onze klanten – zoals de Belastingdienst, Gemeente Den Haag, Centraal Justitieel Incassobureau en VGZ – om hun beleid en processen te verbeteren en toekomstgericht te sturen.


Waarom past deze vacature bij jou?

Je hebt een passie voor data en ziet het als jouw missie om cijfers en informatie te vertalen naar verhalen die impact maken. Je bent analytisch sterk, communicatief vaardig en kunt schakelen tussen business en techniek. Je vindt het leuk om samen te werken met collega’s en stakeholders en voelt je thuis in een omgeving waar data centraal staat.


Wat kan je van ons verwachten?

Bij CIMSOLUTIONS krijg je de kans om te werken aan uitdagende en innovatieve data- en BI-projecten bij toonaangevende organisaties. Wij investeren in jouw ontwikkeling en bieden naast een inspirerende werkomgeving:

  • Een vast dienstverband voor onbepaalde tijd, een max. salaris van € 6.000, bonusregeling, leaseauto, pensioenregeling en maandelijkse onkostenvergoeding;
  • Opdrachtkeuzevrijheid: Jij bepaalt in overleg waar je aan werkt, met de begeleiding van een personal coach;
  • Per jaar € 5.000,- opleidingsbudget en daarnaast ook nog eens 5-10 dagen studietijd;
  • Kennissessies met vakgenoten en inhoudelijke events;
  • Minimaal 25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen op te bouwen of te verkopen;
  • Sociale events zoals sportdagen, weekend weg en gezellige borrels;
  • Een vestiging bij jou in de buurt.


Persoonlijke ontwikkeling

Bij CIMSOLUTIONS geloven we dat leren de sleutel is tot succes. Learn, create and make it work is niet alleen onze slogan, maar zit in ons DNA. Daarom investeren we continu in jouw groei. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen tot bijvoorbeeld Senior Data Analist, BI Architect of Data Platform Specialist. Je wordt begeleid door ervaren collega’s, krijgt toegang tot kennisplatforms en blijft altijd scherp op de nieuwste ontwikkelingen binnen jouw vakgebied.


CIMSOLUTIONS heeft een actief diversiteitsbeleid en streeft naar een evenwichtige verdeling van professionals naar onder andere leeftijd, gender, etnische achtergrond en cultuur, arbeidsvermogen, kennis en competenties. Daarbij benadrukken wij dat gelijke kansen voor iedereen een belangrijk uitgangspunt zijn in onze selectie.

  • Een afgeronde hbo bachelor of wo‑opleiding in Bedrijfskunde, Informatiekunde, Business Analytics of vergelijkbaar;

  • Sterke kennis van en ervaring met SQL en/of Databricks voor analyseren van grote datasets;

Requisitos Para La Posición


Experiencia mínima de 4-5 años en proyectos de BI en funciones similares.
Titulación universitaria superior: Ingeniería Informática, Matemáticas, Estadística o similar.
Dominio leguaje SQL y experiencia trabajando en BBDD tales como Oracle, SQL Server, Sybase, Snowflake ).
Experiencia demostrable con Power BI o herramienta de visualización de datos similar
Persona proactiva, analítica y con buena capacidad de comunicación.
Clara Orientación al Cliente.


Valorables


Conocimiento de metodologías Agile
Experiencia previa en Python
Experiencia previa con AWS
Experiencia previa con otras herramientas de Visualización y Reporting: Power BI, Tableau, Qlik Sense, o de reporting como Business Objects

💻Modelo híbrido de teletrabajo (16 días de teletrabajo al trimestre) para que los adaptes a tus necesidades.

⌚Horario flexible de entrada/salida y jornada intensiva los viernes.

Descripción del Puesto

¿Quieres formar parte del equipo de Serveo?

Si quieres que cada día sea diferente, enfrentándote a nuevos desafíos y formando parte de un equipo que te permita desarrollar todas tus capacidades, ¡sigue leyendo!

En Serveo somos un equipo multidisciplinar, diverso e inclusivo, formado por más de 48.000 profesionales. Somos un referente en servicios deindustria, salud, corporate, government e infraestructuras ofreciendo soluciones integrales, innovadoras y sostenibles.

Sonreímos al cambio y afrontamos juntos cada nuevo reto, impulsando la excelencia de nuestros servicios y fomentando el crecimiento de nuestros equipos en un extraordinario ambiente de trabajo.

¡Estamos orgullosos/as de ser reconocidos como una de las 100 mejores empresas para trabajar en España por Actualidad Económica (El Mundo) y por Forbes y de estar en el Top 5 del Happy Trainees en 2025!

¿En qué consiste el puesto?

Buscamos un Data Analyst en Madrid, cuya misión será transformar los datos en conocimiento accionable para apoyar la toma de decisiones en la organización, analizando, interpretando y visualizando información procedente de múltiples fuentes para identificar tendencias, patrones y oportunidades de mejora.

Funciones a Desarrollar

Analizar y explorar datos, identificando tendencias, patrones y oportunidades que aporten valor al negocio.Diseñar, desarrollar y optimizar cuadros de mando e informes, utilizando herramientas de visualización (principalmente Power BI) para facilitar la toma de decisiones.Traducir necesidades de negocio en requerimientos analíticos, colaborando con las distintas áreas para definir métricas e indicadores clave (KPIs).Garantizar la calidad y coherencia de los análisis, validando la integridad de los datos tanto en origen como en el Data Warehouse y asegurando la correcta interpretación de los resultados.Colaborar con otros perfiles de datos, asegurando la disponibilidad, calidad y adecuación de los datos necesarios para el análisis.Documentar métricas, indicadores y definiciones, manteniendo un catálogo claro y consistente que facilite el autoservicio analítico.Impulsar la cultura del dato y el autoservicio, apoyando a los equipos de negocio en el uso autónomo de las herramientas analíticas.Apoyar la toma de decisiones basada en datos, presentando conclusiones y recomendaciones de forma clara a perfiles técnicos y de negocio.Aplicar estándares de gobierno, calidad y seguridad del dato, asegurando el cumplimiento de las políticas corporativas en el tratamiento de la información.Analizar y comprender la información de negocio de forma integral, identificando oportunidades de mejora y proponiendo nuevos indicadores, análisis y cuadros de mando que aporten valor a la organización.Participar en la definición e implantación de controles y mecanismos de calidad del dato, monitorizando la información y estableciendo procesos de alerta y comunicación con los Data Owners ante la detección de incidencias o anomalías.Colaborar en el diseño y evolución de datasets analíticos y modelos de datos orientados al reporting y al autoservicio, participando en procesos de integración y transformación de datos.

¿Qué buscamos?

Grado en ingeniería informática, matemáticas, estadística, ADE o similarExperiencia sólida en análisis de datos y dominio de SQL para la consulta, explotación y optimización de datos.Dominio de herramientas de visualización (principalmente Power BI).Conocimiento de arquitecturas de datos en plataformas cloud, especialmente Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Knowledge Catalog, etc.).Conocimiento de Python para análisis, tratamiento y automatización de datos.Inglés (Avanzado)Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia en análisis de datos, Business Intelligence o analítica de datos en entornos corporativos con las tecnologías mencionadas.Perfil con capacidad analítica, comunicación, orientación a resultados, mejora continua, atención al detalle, autonomía y proactividad, trabajo en equipo

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

Contrato indefinido: te ofrecemos un proyecto a largo plazo en una empresa líder en servicios de infraestructuras.

Flexibilidad para facilitar la conciliación. Serveo ha sido galardonada con el Certificado EFR de la Fundación Más Familia, por su implicación en la conciliación personal, familiar y laboral. En este puesto tendrás:Flexibilidad horaria de entrada y salidaJornada continua en verano y festividadesPolítica corporativa de teletrabajo

Paquete retributivo competitivo. Retribución total altamente competitiva en el sector, compuesta por una retribución fija más una retribución variableAcceso a una competitiva 'Bolsa Corporativa de Beneficios' anual que podrás destinar con toda flexibilidad a diferentes productos (tarjeta comida, seguro de salud, tarjeta transporte público, cheque guardería, formación o plan de ahorro) según tus intereses, lo que te permitirá optimizar la fiscalidad de tu retribución y disfrutar de importantes descuentos a los que tenemos acceso como gran empresa.

Desarrollo y proyección profesional: a través de la participación en proyectos transversales, formación y movilidad interna.

Excepcional ambiente de trabajo, en el que te sentirás como ‘en familia’ desde el primer día. En Serveo impulsamos una forma de trabajar que deja de lado las jerarquías y empodera a cada persona para ser líder en su día a día.

Title: Enterprise Data Analyst
Description:
Husch Blackwell LLP is a full-service litigation and business law firm with multiple locations across the United States, serving clients with domestic and international operations.

At Husch Blackwell we believe that diverse, equitable and inclusive teams lead to better outcomes. Husch Blackwell is committed to retaining, recruiting, developing, and promoting talented lawyers and business professionals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We foster an engaged, diverse, and inclusive team culture of accountability and purpose that makes our Firm and our communities better.

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight


Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency


Dashboarding & Reporting


Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics


Data Management & Quality


Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities


Continuous Improvement & Growth


Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence


Position Requirements


Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, information design, or a related quantitative communications field; commensurate professional and educational experience shall also qualify
3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role (the role may be filled at more than one level; strong candidates earlier in their careers will also be considered)
Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards
Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets
Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem
Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms
Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders
Experience with statistical modeling, regression analysis, and null hypothesis significance testing
Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects
Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them
Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics
Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations


The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of essential functions, responsibilities, or requirements. The Firm will provide reasonable accommodations as necessary to allow an individual with a disability to apply for and/or perform the essential functions of a position. If you need assistance to accommodate a disability, please contact HR.

Compensation And Benefits

Employees are entitled to compensation commensurate with skill and experience. The exact compensation will vary based on skills, experience, location, and other factors permitted by law. The expected compensation ranges for this position in various states and jurisdictions are as follows:


State of California: $116,000 - $237,000
State of Colorado: $107,000 - $191,000
State of Illinois: $105,000 - $204,000
State of Maine: $79,000 - $182,000
State of Maryland: $113,000 - $171,000
State of Massachusetts: $116,000 - $222,000
State of Minnesota: $116,000 - $192,000
Jersey City, NJ: $126,000 - $229,000
State of New York: $108,000 - $234,000
State of Vermont: $115,000 - $220,000
State of Virginia: $76,000 - $220,000
State of Washington: $113,000 - $214,000
Washington, D.C.: $150,000 - $220,000


The above salaries do not include a discretionary bonus, however bonus opportunities are non-guaranteed, and are dependent upon individual and firm performance. Full-time employees receive benefits including: medical and dental coverage; life insurance; short-term and long-term disability insurance; pre-tax flexible spending account for certain medical and dependent care expenses; an employee assistance program; Paid Time Off; paid holidays; participation in a retirement plan program after meeting eligibility requirements; and more.

Please include a cover letter and resume when applying.

EOE/Minority/Female/Disabled/Vet. Principal Applicants Only.

Title: Federal Data Analyst
Description:
Position: Federal Data Analyst

Location: Boston

About Pryzm

Pryzm is transforming how companies engage with the federal government. Today, federal procurement and BD is fragmented across disconnected workflows, siloed intelligence, and institutional knowledge locked in spreadsheets and inboxes. Pryzm brings together market intelligence, budget data, program visibility, and human insights into a single platform that helps teams navigate and win in the federal ecosystem. Pryzm is backed by Tier 1 investors including a16z, and is trusted by organizations across the national security and federal technology ecosystem. Our mission is simple: deliver the best capabilities to the missions that matter most.

The Role

Pryzm's platform depends on data that most companies don't even attempt to track well. We're looking for a Federal Data Analyst to help own that data, keeping it accurate, useful, and ahead of what our customers need. The role blends technical data work with market-facing analysis, and touches everything from day-to-day data quality to the insights we put in front of customers.

What You'll Do


Own and continuously improve pieces Pryzm's federal data, noting meaningful shifts and building structural improvements within the platform
Field customer-requested data pulls end to end, from scoping the ask to delivering a clean, accurate output
Design and build new data feeds and trackers tailored to specific customer use cases and workflows
Mine Pryzm's data for patterns and signal, turning it into thought leadership for existing customers and outbound marketing
Run structured QA passes across personnel, organizational, and program data to catch errors, gaps, and staleness before customers do
Partner with the rest of the data team, shaping long-term priorities for data coverage, structure, and quality
Partner with product and engineering to translate data gaps and customer feedback into architecture and UI improvements


What We're Looking For


0-3 years of experience in a role that combined hands-on data work with analysis or research, or relevant college degree + intern experience.
Technical with Data: you can write basic SQL, work with large or messy datasets, and spot a structural problem before it becomes a customer complaint
Familiarity with government contracting or federal personnel data (USASpending awards, J-Books/budget documents, DoD organizational structure) is a strong plus, but not a requirement.
Strong analytical writing, where you can turn a dataset into a clear, credible narrative for an executive audience
High attention to detail and self-driven mindset.
Comfort operating in ambiguity and moving quickly across data QA, customer requests, and longer-term projects in the same week


Qualifications


Located in Boston. This is a fully on-site position.
US Person required.
Veterans and those with military or intelligence community backgrounds strongly encouraged to apply


Benefits

Pryzm offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:


Competitive salary and meaningful equity
Platinum healthcare: comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage fully covered for employees and dependents
Basic Life/AD&D and long-term disability insurance fully covered, with the option to purchase additional life insurance for you and your dependents


Compensation Range: $75K - $90K

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About The Opportunity

Job Summary

Under the supervision of the Data Quality & Research Administration Analytics Manager and with support of senior level team members, the Senior Data Analyst will work closely with key stakeholders to identify and conduct data analysis projects that support the mission and goals of the University and Northeastern University Research Enterprise Services (NU-RES). The Senior Data Analyst will provide support to key projects through data collection, computational support, and data interpretation and reporting, and will ensure data accuracy and consistent reporting by designing and creating optimal processes and procedures to systematize the data reporting process. The incumbent will use advanced data modeling, predictive modeling, and analytical techniques to develop reports used in key data submissions to internal and external stakeholders. Possess a good sense of humor, ability to be calm under pressure, and effectively communicate with report requestors to ascertain requirements for reports that tell an accurate story.

This position can also reside in Toronto. If you are a Canadian applicant, please submit your application here

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant subject area (e.g., computer science, data science, mathematics, statistics, information technology, or related field); 3+ years of experience with querying databases, SQL, and Microsoft Excel; experience developing robust dashboards using Tableau and/or Power BI; creating visuals using data visualization best practices.
Proficiency with business intelligence and reporting tools such as Cognos or Snowflake preferred.
Understanding of, and experience in, using analytical concepts and tools, including data modeling and predictive analytics.
Project management, time management, and communication skills necessary to execute responsibilities in a collaborative, academic setting.
Teamwork and collaboration in a professional setting.
Demonstrated curiosity, problem-solving skills, and ability to meet deadlines.
Excellent written and oral communication skills with ability to advise and clearly communicate ideas and results to non-technical audiences.
Strong ability to manage multiple assignments while working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
Ability to maintain a positive attitude and work well independently, within a team environment, and with external users as well as a variety of internal audiences.
Experience working with university research administration data and systems preferred.
Experience documenting business procedures and processes preferred.
Understanding of, and experience in, using AI-enabled tools to provide appropriate levels of support to daily work.
Familiarity with electronic research administration (eRA) systems (e.g., Coeus, ePAWS, or similar eRA platforms) preferred.



Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

45% — Data Collection, Assessment, Interpretation, and Reporting

Collect relevant data (both internal and external) to be used by college constituents to support decision making and strategic direction, resource allocation, internal and external reporting, and other operational decisions. Success factors include the accuracy and relevance of the data, analysis, and the clarity and usefulness of final reports. Develop and iterate on self-service reports and dashboards with an eye towards automation and re-use. Manage data sourced from both legacy systems (e.g., Coeus) and current eRA platforms (e.g., ePAWS 2.0), ensuring continuity and accuracy across reporting environments.

25% — Data Visualization

Oversee the development and maintenance of key performance dashboards that show progress toward strategic and operational goals related to research. Work closely with Research Enterprise Services stakeholders to identify opportunities for additional dashboard requirements as needs evolve. Develop and iterate on self-service reports and dashboards with an eye towards automation and re-use. Tools include Tableau (including Tableau Prep and Tableau Server), Cognos, and other visualization platforms as applicable.

10% — System Support

Evaluate and test back-end changes to electronic research administration systems as they impact data quality and access, including connectivity with Tableau and the Cognos Data Warehouse environment. Company: Executive Office of Technology Services and Security
Description:
General Statement Of Duties And Responsibilities:

In collaboration with the Director of Research and other Research Unit staff, the incumbent of this position is responsible for conducting and coordinating all data related projects for the Agency while also acting as the local administrator of SPIRIT II, the Agency’s case management system. The primary focus of this position is extraction of raw data from SPIRIT II by building and modifying SQL queries using Toad Datapoint software and validation of such data, along with tracking, auditing, and analysis of the data. As such, experience with SQL queries and TOAD Data Point is a must. Additionally, the incumbent is expected to have knowledge of Microsoft Power BI to be able to analyze and display as well as routinely refresh and update SPIRIT II data in the Power BI Dashboard. The incumbent should be well versed with Parole policies and procedures pertaining to different business processes across units to ensure data is entered and tracked by staff as per existing policies and procedures in a reliable manner. The incumbent should be able to identify and communicate data quality issues to management and where required, to staff across units.

The incumbent further needs to develop a very good understanding of SPIRIT II and how it is being utilized by different units and user roles. Over time, they should be able to troubleshoot any issues with recording data in SPIRIT II and contribute significantly towards preparing reliable criteria for new SPIRIT enhancements to improve data tracking. The incumbent may need to assist the Director with conducting LS/CMI certification training as well as annual booster training for the Agency staff and any other SPIRIT related trainings on a need basis. This position assists the Director with data preparation for the Agency’s Annual Statistical Report, annual surveys, and any internal and external data requests. Other related duties as assigned.

DETAILED STATEMENT OF DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


Helps with extraction and validation of raw data from SPIRIT by building and modifying SQL queries using Toad Datapoint software.
Uses Microsoft Power BI to analyze, display and routinely refresh and update SPIRIT data in the Power BI Dashboard.
Creates weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports for units within the Agency for performance measurement, and communicates data issues where applicable.
Familiarizes themselves with Parole policies and business procedures across units to ensure data is entered and tracked by staff consistent with existing policies and procedures.
Regularly audits and tracks data captured by active reports and extracts from SPIRIT and communicates data quality issues to management and where advised, relevant staff across units.
On request from the Director, analyzes data to measure performance across different business processes to help towards improving policies and procedures.
Assists with coordination for conducting LS/CMI certification training and annual booster training.
Collects and prepares data annually for the MPB Statistical Report, BJS Parole Survey, and NCRP data submission.
As the SPIRIT backup administrator whenever needed, works on developing a very good understanding of SPIRIT II and how it is being utilized by different staff across units.
Over time, should be able to troubleshoot any issues with recording data in SPIRIT II, and contribute significantly towards preparing reliable criteria for new SPIRIT enhancements to improve data tracking.
Uploads the RODs and monthly lifer hearing calendars on the Agency website and serves as one of the website managers.
Assists the Director with both internal and external data requests, including public records request, media requests, requests from legislators, and external and internal research requests when needed.
Other related duties as required.


Preferred Qualifications

Expertise with use of Microsoft Power BI, Toad Datapoint for building queries, excel

First consideration will be given to those applicants that apply within the first 14 days.

Applicants must have (A) at least two years of full-time or equivalent part-time professional or technical experience performing related duties that include business data recovery, analysis, query design, reporting and statistical analysis; or (B) any equivalent combination of the required experience and the substitutions below

Substitutions:

I. A Bachelor’s degree or higher with a major in Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Information Management, Statistics or a related field may be substituted for the required experience

Description:
Position Summary

IT Data Analyst I plays a vital role in transforming data into valuable insights that support improved business and operational decision-making. Working under close supervision, this role supports the preparation of management reports and statistical summaries, helping identify and gather appropriate data, and ensuring data accuracy and integrity. IT Data Analyst I works with a variety of data sources, reporting tools, and analytical methods to create reports and dashboards, analyze trends, maintain data quality, and communicate findings effectively to stakeholders. This is an opportunity to build strong technical and analytical expertise while collaborating on projects that contribute to reliable, data-driven decisions.

Duties And Responsibilities


Design and develop metrics, analyses, reports, and dashboards to support decision-making and operations across state government.
Employ a variety of statistical and other software applications, graphics tools, and business intelligence (BI) applications to analyze results, evaluate performance, and project future trends and needs.
Support the design, development, and implementation of data-sharing efforts across Commonwealth offices and agencies.
Work with team members and outside department to access data for ongoing projects and other business intelligence needs.
Support the development of public-facing data analytics and reporting.
Research and report on data-management best practices, including in the areas of governance, storage, privacy, and reporting.


Preferred Qualifications


Practical experience in data analysis, reporting, and visualization, using languages and software such as Python, R, SQL, VBA, and Tableau or other BI tools.
Demonstrated interest in public policy or administration, experience in a government setting.
Analytical and critical thinking skills.
Experience clearly describing, summarizing, and documenting how work was performed.
Experience with basic applied statistical techniques.
Ability to produce consistently high-quality output under strict deadlines.
Ability to work independently and in a team environment with varying levels, team members, peers, management, and business stakeholders.
Ability to prioritize, execute, and manage work in a matrixed, high-pressure environment.
Strong intellectual curiosity demonstrated drive to master new skills, systems, and subject matter.

The 4,000+ employees of Massachusetts Department of Transportation (MassDOT) take great pride in connecting the Commonwealth’s residents and communities. MassDOT’s divisions include Highway, Registry of Motor Vehicles, Aeronautics, and Rail & Transit. Headquarters (Planning & Enterprise Services) provides business and administrative support and policy leadership for each of the four (4) divisions.

This role is 100% remote, with travel to Massachusetts once per quarter, and will play a critical part in transforming complex data into actionable insights that support leadership decision-making and cross-functional reporting.


The ideal candidate brings deep experience analyzing large, complex datasets, building business intelligence solutions, and partnering with stakeholders to drive scalable analytics strategy.


Position Overview

The Data Analyst will convert complex data into actionable business insights by building strong contextual and domain knowledge within their assigned functional area. This individual will collaborate closely with subject matter experts, Data Stewards, Data Engineers, and Data Scientists to deliver scalable analytics and business intelligence solutions.


This role will have direct impact on the redesign of Data Marts and Data Models, enabling leadership, cross-functional stakeholders, and end users to leverage enhanced reporting and self-service analytics capabilities.


Principal Duties & Responsibilities

  • Partner cross-functionally with business teams and leadership to develop and implement Business Intelligence strategies
  • Lead BI-specific project workstreams from concept through implementation
  • Generate actionable insights through analysis of key metrics across functions
  • Perform deep data analysis to identify root causes and design data-driven solutions
  • Develop mechanisms for performance monitoring, controls, and reporting
  • Support cost/benefit analyses and document business requirements for data solutions
  • Conduct end-to-end solution testing and lead user validation testing of datasets and reports
  • Contribute to the redesign and optimization of Data Marts and enterprise Data Models
  • Build and maintain documentation to support data interpretation and self-service reporting
  • Perform additional duties as assigned


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • 7+ years of experience analyzing and modeling large, complex datasets (preferably within higher education administrative environments)
  • Strong experience writing complex SQL queries across multiple joined datasets
  • Proven experience developing dashboards and reports
  • Demonstrated ability to define requirements and use data/metrics to drive business insights
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Cognos, or QuickSight
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and root cause analysis skills
  • Ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams and leadership levels
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-paced environments
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships with diverse stakeholders


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with data warehousing concepts
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python
  • Knowledge of data security concepts
  • Experience supporting higher education administrative functions

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description

Data Analyst, Customer Data Solutions

The Opportunity

Join the Business Analytics team at Workhuman, where we sit at the core of the organization, driving strategy and decision-making through data. As a Data Analyst, you will help shape the next generation of analytics at Workhuman—moving beyond manual data requests and traditional reporting toward intelligent, self-service, and conversational experiences for our internal stakeholders and customers.

You will start by becoming an expert in how we deliver customer data today, using that knowledge to automate manual workflows and turn recurring needs into scalable capabilities. From there, you will help build data models, data products, and AI-assisted experiences that fundamentally change how people discover, explore, and act on data.

The ideal candidate is intellectually curious, data-driven, technical, and business oriented. They will dive deep into our customer data, build production-grade analytical solutions, and actively experiment with emerging technologies. We are looking for someone excited not just to make analytics faster, but to rethink how analytics is experienced.


This is a hybrid position, with three days per week onsite in our Framingham office.
Applicants must have valid permanent work authorization in the U.S. (e.g., U.S. citizen, permanent resident). We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.


What We Can Offer You


The opportunity to help shape the future of how Workhuman delivers analytics to internal stakeholders and customers
Hands-on experience building AI-assisted, conversational, and self-service analytics experiences
Ownership over transforming highly manual workflows into scalable analytical capabilities
The freedom to experiment with modern data and AI technologies and help define how we use them


The Skills You Will Bring


Proficiency in querying, analyzing, and visualizing large datasets using SQL and data visualization tools
Experience building production-grade data models; experience with dbt is a plus
Strong analytical problem-solving skills and business intuition
Demonstrated curiosity and hands-on use of generative AI, professionally or independently, to analyze data, write code, automate workflows, or build new capabilities
Exposure to AI coding tools, AI-assisted analytics, conversational analytics, or similar emerging technologies is a plus
Strong communication and project management skills and a highly collaborative approach to problem-solving


Achievements


Built dashboards, data products, or self-service capabilities that changed how people access and use data
Automated or materially reinvented recurring analytical workflows
Built or experimented with an AI-enabled tool, workflow, or project, professionally or independently
Translated ambiguous stakeholder or customer needs into scalable analytical solutions


The base salary range for this position is $92,000 to $130,000. Offered base compensation within this range will be determined based on the candidate’s qualifications, experience, geographic location, and other factors relevant to the scope and responsibilities of this role.

This role is also eligible for bonus or other variable compensation based on job performance and our standard benefits package, which supports employee well-being and work-life balance.

Thank you for considering joining our team. We strive to create an inclusive and accessible application process for all candidates. If you encounter any difficulties or have specific accessibility requirements while applying for this position, please don't hesitate to reach out to us at  globalrecruitment@workhuman.com for assistance. We are committed to ensuring equal access to opportunities for all individuals.

We recognise and embrace individuals’ differences and believe that workforce diversity and inclusion are essential to our long-term growth and success. Even if you don’t think you “check every single box” above, please still consider applying. We’re looking for a human who is collaborative, and innovative with a growth mindset. Title: Data Analyst - Hopedale, MA
Description:
About Us

As a company, we promote a culture of honesty and integrity, and value the trust it allows us to build with customers and employees alike. Our focus on our people is what sets us apart and keeps our customers coming back to work with us!

If you are seeking to be a part of a family, this is the place for you!

Maersk Logistics & Services USA, Inc. handles end-to-end warehousing and distribution logistics needs utilizing our strategic network of storage facilities. Our facilities are capable of receiving, storing, processing and dispatching cargo, so we can build flexibility and resilience into the supply chain process. Our integrated solutions allow us to be prepared for supply chain risks, so we can plan distribution to better achieve lead time and goals despite unexpected conditions. Our extensive experience, connections, and deep expertise across different sectors, industries, and transportation modes, means we can be counted on for process excellence that will save time and money.

Summary

The Data Analyst supports warehouse operations by transforming operational data into actionable insights that improve productivity, quality, labor utilization, and customer service. This role partners closely with operations leadership to identify trends, develop reporting, and drive data-informed decision-making across a fast-paced distribution environment.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills with the ability to communicate findings to business leaders and develop scalable reporting solutions.

Key Responsibilities


Analyze operational performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and root causes.
Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and recurring reports using business intelligence tools.
Monitor key operational metrics, including productivity, quality, throughput, inventory accuracy, labor utilization, and service performance
Partner with operations managers to support labor planning, staffing analysis, and capacity forecasting.
Conduct ad hoc analyses to support business initiatives and operational improvements.
Translate complex datasets into clear recommendations for frontline leadership and senior management.
Validate data accuracy and investigate discrepancies across multiple systems.
Automate recurring reporting processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
Support continuous improvement initiatives through statistical analysis and performance measurement.
Present findings and recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders.


Qualifications


1-3 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, supply chain, manufacturing, or distribution operations.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills including Pivot Tables, Power Query, Power Pivot, and complex formulas.
Experience writing SQL queries to extract and analyze data.
Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence platforms.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced operational environment.


Benefits

Company Benefits:


Medical
Dental
Vision
401k + Company Match
Employee Assistance Program
Paid Time Off
Flexible Work Schedules (when possible)
And more!


Pay Range

$60,000-$69,000*


The above-stated pay range is the anticipated starting salary range for the position. The Company may adjust this range in light of prevailing market conditions and other factors such as location. The Company will work directly with the selected candidate(s) on the final starting salary in accordance with all applicable laws.

Title: Senior Health Data Analyst - Compass
Description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

As the Senior Health Data Analyst on the Compass Patient Team for Veeva Compass, you’ll focus on the health data in our Compass Patient data product.

Veeva Compass is our suite of data products, with Compass Patient including prescription and medical claims record-level data to support more broad de-identified patient analytics for commercial use cases, like patient journey, market landscape, provider engagement, and more.

You’ll own health data investigations and improvements as part of our Product team. You’ll focus on three key areas:


Data Support - investigate internal and external questions and requests to understand data trends and behavior within customer-defined cohorts and across the network.
Data Quality - Define and track quality metrics in your target domain in dashboards, identify improvement opportunities, and work cross-functionally to document and share learnings.
Data Network Improvements - Collaboratively launch new features to continue to enhance our data in your target expertise area. You’ll focus on investigating, defining and testing productizable improvements that work at scale across billions of records.


This is a great opportunity for someone who is passionate about data and excited about working alongside Product Managers, Customer Success Managers, Engineers, and QA to implement improvements to continue to enrich our data and drive product excellence.

What You’ll Do


Own the investigation and resolution of data observations and data questions driven by internal and external stakeholders
Understand our product pipeline and impact to data to identify improvements
Build standard templates and practices to streamline data quality in your target domains
Own key analytics projects in the data and feature roadmaps
Design new data analytics and data quality features & capabilities, including features such as match, merge, dedupe logic, value enrichment and reference mappings
Establish quality metrics and build dashboards to drive continuous improvement of our data products for key areas such as merging, payer data, lab, prescribers, etc.


Requirements


4+ years of experience analyzing prescription data and medical claims data
Advanced SQL skills; able to query and manipulate relational databases
Knowledge of Industry Standard billing codes such as ICD, CPT/HCPCS, NDC
Experience documenting and presenting analytics results with stakeholders
Experience defining KPIs and building dashboards to measure success


Nice to Have


Experience in Python
Experience with the BI tool Sigma
Experience in commercial life science use cases
Experience in enterprise products


Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.


Follow the application process and submit your resume.
Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
A conversation with the hiring manager
A practical case exercise
A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.
Perks & Benefits


Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
Retirement programs
1% charitable giving program


Compensation


Base pay: $80,000 - $125,000
The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.


Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us at talent_accommodations@veeva.com.

Title: Lead Data Analyst (Management Data Analysis), Data Analysis and Reporting
Description:
About Us

National Grid is hiring a Lead Data Analyst, Data Analysis and Reporting for our Capital Project Delivery organization in Waltham, MA.

Every day we deliver safe and secure energy to homes, communities, and businesses. We are there when people need us the most. We connect people to the energy they need for the lives they live.

The pace of change in society and our industry is accelerating and our expertise and track record puts us in an unparalleled position to shape the sustainable future of our industry. To be successful we must anticipate the needs of our customers, reducing the cost of energy delivery today and pioneering the flexible energy systems of tomorrow. This requires us to deliver on our promises and always look for new opportunities to grow, both ourselves and our business

Job Purpose

The Lead Data Analyst, Data Analysis and Reporting role is responsible for enabling data-driven decision-making across Capital Project Delivery through advanced analytics, dashboard development, artificial intelligence, and data visualization solutions.

This position will partner with business stakeholders to transform complex operational, portfolio, resource, and financial data into actionable insights that improve planning, forecasting, and execution of National Grid’s capital investment portfolio.

Key Accountabilities


Develop and maintain executive-level dashboards and visualizations using Power BI.
Partner with business leaders to translate challenges into data science solutions.
Create automated reporting and self-service analytics capabilities.
Analyze large datasets to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
Support data governance and reporting standards.


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree or continued education certificated in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Analytics, Information Systems, or related field preferred.
2+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or business intelligence required
Experience developing dashboards using Power BI.
Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, and analytics tools required
Experience with AI, machine learning, and generative AI applications.


More Information

Salary

$127,000 - $149,000 a year

National Grid will not be providing visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future. You must have the ability to work without a need for current or future visa sponsorship.

National Grid utilizes an assessment that evaluates the job qualifications/characteristics using AI or statistically based scoring. For more information, please view NYC Local Law 144.

This position has a career path which provides for advancement opportunities within and across bands as you develop and evolve in the position; gaining experience, expertise and acquiring and applying technical skills. Title: Senior Data Analyst, Customer Operations
Description:
Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd®, Slideshare®, Everand™, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise.

Culture at Scribd, Inc.

We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer.

We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location.

So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude.

This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization.

About The Team And Role

Scribd, Inc. is evolving from one of the world’s largest document libraries into a platform where active knowledge building happens. With a library of 300 million documents and over 250 million monthly visitors, our next chapter focuses on helping users move from simply finding information to building deep, actionable understanding.

As the first Senior Data Analyst embedded in Customer Operations you will have the unique opportunity to build the CS Analytics function and own analytics and operational insights for the department. You will partner closely with Customer Operations leadership & team, Product, Finance (RevOps), and Data Engineering to build trusted reporting, improve operational rhythms, and drive measurable outcomes across retention, expansion, customer health, and support efficiency.

In this role, you will translate ambiguous questions into clear measurement frameworks, forecasting models, and actionable reporting. You will also help the organization adopt AI-enabled analytics and automation to reduce manual work, improve decision quality, and establish strong measurement and governance.

About You

You are a deeply analytical thinker who is curious and loves to solve problems. You are comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities. You combine strong technical skills with an operator’s mindset and can communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical partners.

You Care Deeply About


Building trusted datasets, definitions, and reporting that teams can rely on.
Turning ambiguous questions into structured analyses and measurable hypotheses.
Creating operational metrics and dashboards that are easy to use and drive action.
Applying AI thoughtfully, with clear success metrics and appropriate governance.


You will


Own Customer Success and Customer Operations measurement
Define and maintain core metrics and business definitions across the customer lifecycle, including onboarding milestones, time-to-value, engagement, customer health, renewals, expansions, and churn.
Create clear documentation and enable consistent interpretation across Customer Success Operations, RevOps, Finance,Establish instrumentation and data quality requirements with Data Engineering to ensure reliable sources of truth.
Build decision-ready reporting and self-serve analytics
Build and iterate on dashboards, KPI scorecards, and operational reporting that support day-to-day execution and executive visibility.
Enable self-serve analytics with clear definitions, drill paths, and actionable views for CS leaders, managers, and operators.
Create automated reporting and proactive alerting for KPI movement and risk signals, such as drops in engagement, support spikes, onboarding delays, and renewal risk.
Customer retention, churn, and expansion analytics
Define and maintain retention metrics, including logo and revenue churn, GRR and NRR, renewal rates, and cohort retention.
Build and operationalize churn and renewal risk analyses and models that surface leading indicators.
Develop and iterate on customer health scoring frameworks that combine usage, lifecycle events, support signals, billing signals, and qualitative inputs.
Forecasting and capacity planning
Build forecasting models for key planning needs such as renewal volume, renewal risk, churn, expansion pipeline, ticket volume, and staffing capacity for our \BPO partner
Define evaluation approaches such as backtesting, holdouts, calibration, and monitoring, and ensure forecasts remain reliable over time.
Partner with Customer Operations to translate forecasts into staffing plans, coverage models, and operating cadences.
AI-enabled automation and productivity
Identify and prototype AI-driven workflows that reduce manual analysis and speed up decision-making, such as automated insights, narrative summaries, anomaly detection triage, and stakeholder Q&A.
Define success metrics and guardrails for AI-supported analytics, including accuracy, coverage, bias considerations, data privacy, and appropriate human review.
Drive adoption through enablement, feedback loops, and iteration with cross-functional partners.
Cross-functional partnership and storytelling
Translate Customer Success Operations questions into structured analyses and measurable hypotheses.
Communicate insights with clear narratives that influence decisions across technical and non-technical audiences.
Build strong relationships with CS, Customer Ops, RevOps, Finance, Support, and Data teams to align priorities and execute effectively.

You have


4+ years of experience in analytics, business operations, or business intelligence roles, ideally supporting Customer Success, Customer Operations, RevOps, Support, Sales, Growth, or similar customer-facing functions.
Experience working in a B2C subscription or membership-based business (e.g., SaaS, media, streaming, or consumer subscription), with hands-on familiarity with subscription metrics like LTV, churn, refund rate, and renewal rates.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with analytical datasets and BI tools (Looker, Tableau, etc.), with an emphasis on performance, usability, and metric governance.
Comfortable working within an existing Databricks environment, reading gold-layer schemas, running queries, and working with Data Engineering to understand what data is available and how to use it.
Experience with Python (or similar) for analysis, forecasting, and modeling.
A track record of building retention, churn, renewal risk, forecasting, or related analyses and translating outputs into business action.
A strong foundation in statistics and experimental thinking, including hypothesis testing and measurement design.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders across technical and non-technical teams.
Comfort working independently in an environment with evolving priorities.


Nice to have


Experience with customer health scoring, churn modeling, retention and expansion analytics, or lifecycle analytics.
Experience with analytics engineering practices (for example dbt-style testing, documentation, and semantic layers).
Experience evaluating or implementing AI or LLM-enabled analytics workflows, including quality measurement and human-in-the-loop processes.
Familiarity with SaaS subscription metrics, cohort analysis, and billing systems.
Proficiency with Zendesk or similar customer support platforms, and comfort working directly in support tooling to extract and analyze operational data.

Title: Analyst, Digital & Loyalty Analytics
Description:
Job Purpose:

The Analyst, Digital & Loyalty Analytics is the hands-on quantitative engine for Panera’s loyalty and customer intelligence team. Sitting within the Business Analytics organization, you will write complex queries, analyze guest transactional data, measure CRM campaign performance, and build automated dashboards that drive decision-making across the MyPanera Loyalty program and digital channels.




This role requires strong technical execution in SQL and visualization tools, combined with a natural curiosity for consumer behavior and digital product performance.




Location: Newton, MA (Hybrid – 3 days per week in-office)




Key Responsibilities:

Data Extraction & SQL Execution: Write clean, efficient SQL queries to extract, transform, and aggregate guest, transaction, and campaign data across large-scale enterprise data environments.
CRM & Loyalty Campaign Measurement: Analyze the performance of loyalty offers, email/app messaging, and personalized promotions to measure redemption rates, incremental sales, transaction lift, and margin impact.
Dashboard & Visualization Development: Design, deploy, and maintain high-impact Power BI dashboards tracking key loyalty KPIs, including active member growth, subscription retention (Unlimited Sip Club), and customer lifecycle trends.
A/B Testing & Experimentation Support: Execute readout evaluations for marketing tests and digital feature rollouts, applying statistical methods to measure baseline vs. test performance and incremental lift.
Customer Segmentation & Behavioral Analysis: Perform ad-hoc exploratory analysis to understand guest frequency patterns, lapsed behavior, category affinity, and trade-down risks.

REPORTS TO: Director of Organizational Insight

Position Overview

The Data Analyst for Strategic Initiatives resides in the Office of Data and Accountability (ODA) in the Division of Data, Information and Systems Improvement in Boston Public Schools. The Data Analyst leads complex analytical projects that inform district policy, strategic decision-making, and operational implementation. This role is responsible for designing and executing sophisticated analyses, managing data for high-impact district initiatives, and ensuring the integrity and accessibility of district data.

The Data Analyst serves as a technical expert in educational data, statistical analysis, and data visualization, translating complex information into actionable insights for district leadership, schools, and the community. The position requires advanced analytical expertise, exceptional project management skills, and the ability to collaborate across departments to deliver accurate, timely, and meaningful data products.

As a member of a highly collaborative team, the Data Analyst contributes to enterprise-wide data initiatives, supports the development of district data analyses and dashboards, and provides mentorship and technical leadership on complex analytical projects.

Responsibilities

Strategic Data Analysis and Policy Support


Lead complex district analyses that support strategic initiatives, policy implementation, and executive decision-making.
Design and conduct statistical analyses using student-, school-, and district-level data to identify trends, evaluate outcomes, and inform continuous improvement.
Develop recurring and ad hoc analyses and/or dashboards for district leadership, School Committee presentations, and public reporting.
Translate technical findings into clear reports, visualizations, and recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Provide technical consultation to district departments, schools, and external stakeholders regarding data collection, interpretation, and analysis.


Exam School Admissions Analytics


Lead the annual analytical processes supporting the district's exam school admissions policy.
Develop and validate socioeconomic tier calculations using census and geographic data in accordance with School Committee policy.
Manage the collection, standardization, validation, and calculation of student GPAs across BPS and non-BPS schools.
Conduct multiple rounds of quality assurance and validation to ensure accuracy and integrity of admissions calculations.
Produce annual reporting and supporting analyses for School Committee presentations and public communications.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure accurate and timely implementation of the admissions process and governance of data elements related to selective admissions.


Project Management and Cross-Functional Collaboration


Manage multiple complex analytical projects simultaneously while meeting competing deadlines.
Coordinate work across departments to ensure successful implementation of district initiatives.
Facilitate meetings with stakeholders to gather requirements, review findings, prioritize work, and resolve issues.
Represent the Office of Data and Accountability on district committees, project teams, and cross-functional initiatives.
Collaborate with district departments and technical teams within ODA to define business requirements, establish shared reporting standards, and maintain consistent data definitions.
Support data governance initiatives by promoting best practices for reporting, data quality, and documentation.
Fulfill data requests from internal and external members of the BPS community by extracting data from internal databases, including ad-hoc and recurring requests
Support student privacy regulations as mandated by FERPA, HIPAA, IDEA, MA DESE, City of Boston, and BPS; facilitate the execution of data sharing agreements where applicable
Provide technical assistance to school and central staff regarding data needs, assessments, and analyses.
Perform other relevant duties in the Office of Data and Accountability as needed


Qualifications – Required


Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Data Analytics, Education Research, Computer Science, Public Policy, or a related field.
Minimum of three years of experience analyzing complex K–12 education data.
Demonstrated experience managing high-profile analytical projects involving multiple stakeholders.
Advanced proficiency in SQL and at least one statistical programming language (R, Python, or Stata).
Experience developing interactive dashboards using Power BI or comparable business intelligence platforms.
Experience working with relational databases and large-scale datasets.
Strong understanding of statistical methods, data validation, quality assurance, and analytic best practices.
Excellent project management, organizational, and prioritization skills.
Demonstrated ability to explain complex analytical concepts to diverse audiences.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
Commitment to educational equity and using data to improve outcomes for students.
Authorization to work in the United States.


Qualifications – Preferred


Master's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Education Research, Public Policy, Computer Science, or related field.
Experience supporting district-wide policy implementation or accountability systems.
Knowledge of census, geographic, or demographic data analysis.
Experience with data governance, enterprise reporting, or business intelligence strategy.
Familiarity with Boston Public Schools or another large urban school district.
Fluency in one or more of Boston Public Schools' preferred languages.

Title: Analyst, Advanced Analytics
Description:
Description

The Strategy and Insights team within the Enterprise Transformation Office is actively searching for a highly motivated analyst to join the Procurement Analytics team. This position will provide analytical support and insights to Enterprise Procurement to help generate value from their supplier relationships. This person will be required to frame and answer operational and strategic questions from senior management and executive leadership. The ideal candidate possesses advanced analytical abilities and will be able to work collaboratively & independently.

This is a hybrid position. Candidates within 50 miles of select offices are expected in-office Twice a Month.

Responsibilities


Perform analysis and recommendations to influence Enterprise Procurement strategies and goals.
May be asked to present analysis in an understandable and concise manner to effectively influence others.
With guidance, develop and produce dashboards and reports to support assessment and monitoring of operational and expense/spend metrics.
Assist in maintaining and improving the current reporting infrastructure.
Identify issues within existing tools, processes, data sources and voice suggestions to the team to improve accuracy, decrease latency, and reduce inefficiencies.
Stay informed about procurement category market trends, identifying drivers for expense saving opportunities.
Maintains close working relationships with data providers and partners.
Query and validate large and complex datasets to deliver analytically sound insights.
Support an inclusive, equitable, and high-performing culture.


Qualifications


Bachelor's Degree plus 2-4 years of experience, or master’s degree with no professional experience, or equivalent.
Proficient in Excel, PowerPoint, and statistical software packages (SAS, Emblem).
Knowledgeable in data query languages and tools (SQL and Snowflake)
Must have good planning, analytical, decision-making and communication skills.
Knowledge of data sources, tools, statistical principles, methodologies, and techniques.


About Us

The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Title: Senior Fraud Analyst (Hybrid)
Description:
Description

The Sr. Fraud Data Analyst will work with Fraud & BSA management as well as Information Systems Data Analysis team to help unlock the power of our data and convert it into actionable insights. Must be able to source and package complex data from multiple disparate systems, translating it into key insights with minimal assistance between analyzing the data and interpreting/communicating the results.

Here’s what you can expect from the job and what you need to be successful:

What You’ll Do


Utilizing system insights, be able to anticipate or quickly react to changing fraud schemes by adjusting rules or other parameters
Ability to write, test, and publish fraud detection rules on a cross platform basis leveraging identified fraud trends to help minimize member’s exposure
Serve as a liaison to user communities and SME groups for key financial crime vendor platforms
Gather and analyze data in support of business cases and proposed projects
Provide scheduled and ad hoc statistical analysis and summary reporting to management
Serve as team SME assigned to projects where Fraud & BSA are determined to be key stakeholders
Create and maintain business intelligence reports and delivery systems and create, maintain, and enhance regular reporting deliverables
Proatively analyze data from a variety of sources to inform decision making
Scrub data to ensure accuracy of reporting
Quickly and accurately deliver analysis, constantly exceeding customer expectations.
Develop insight to data, review findings with business partners, and provide superb customer service through clear and concise communications as well as complete documentation
Present key findings and recommendations to Risk Management leadership and to DCU senior management when appropriate
Mentor and develop technical skills and accumen of other Fraud & BSA team members as directed by management


Essential Skills


Bachelor's Degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field
Minimum of 3 years of professional data analysis experience
Some exposure to fraud detection or financial crime platforms preferred
Familiarity with Machine Learning and Articial Intelligence (ML/AI) concepts is a plus
Knowledge of advanced SQL, query optimization and stored procedures
Strong data analysis & business skills
Knowledge of data visualization and predictive analytics tools (PowerBI, Tableau)
Knowledge of Microsoft tools (SSIA, SSAS, SSRS)
Knowledge of analytic approaches and methods (reporting, modeling, optimization)


Location: Marlborough, MA | Chelmsford, MA

Target Compensation: $93,000 - $111,000

Schedule: Monday through Friday 8a-5p

Title: Pediatrics Data Analyst
Description:
Position Summary

Analyze large amounts of data, supplying statistical information, interpreting data, managing data and providing technical support to help the department allocate resources, measure performance, and help design new programs, facilities and systems. Typically involves Quality Assurance/Improvement, Database Management, and streamlining data collection processes. May oversee and coordinate research projects as well as statistical tests and programs.

Position: Pediatrics Data Analyst

Department: Pediatrics

Schedule: Full Time

Essential Responsibilities / Duties


Performs a variety of duties related to data management, and analysis including: SAS programming, dataset cleaning, descriptive analyses, regression modeling, power calculations, creation of SPC comparative reports in QI on a regular basis
Assists with data presentations needed in abstracts, manuscript preparation and presentations.
Works jointly with the NeoQIC director and senior project manager to develop and administer surveys in REDCAP.
Provides data and information to network partners in a readily accessible, understandable and actionable manner using tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, and other tools as needed.
Conducts literature searches using web-based search engines and other reference tools and synthesizes information in requested formats.
Assists in the dissemination of project and specific study-related information through conferences and presentations and contributes to the methods and results sections of manuscripts for peer review.
Collaborates across the department to support financial initiatives, including outpatient, inpatient, and Emergency Department (ED) data analytics.
Performs other duties as assigned and/or necessary.


Education

JOB REQUIREMENTS


Bachelor's Degree required, plus three years of experience with data collection, analysis, and/or program evaluation; or
Master's Degree in a healthcare field plus one year of relevant experience.
Advanced statistical courses (2) can be substituted for one year of relevant experience


Knowledge And Skills


Proficiency with MS Suite (Excel /Minitab /Visio /Access/Word /Outlook/PowerPoint).
Support BACO metrics
Must have experience in statistical analysis and interpreting data from analytic studies.
Comfortable presenting in group settings
Experience interacting with database environments (e.g. SQL, MS Access, Oracle) is a plus.
Strong conceptual and analytical skills; able to interpret and apply statistical techniques, and effective communication skills to explain methods and findings to non-statistician team members and audiences.
Ability to work independently and to set priorities while managing several projects simultaneously; strong attention to detail is essential.


Compensation Range

$62,500.00- $91,000.00

This range offers an estimate based on the minimum job qualifications. However, our approach to determining base pay is comprehensive, and a broad range of factors is considered when making an offer. This includes education, experience, skills, and certifications/licensures as they directly relate to position requirements; as well as business/organizational needs, internal equity, and market-competitiveness. In addition, BMCHS offers generous total compensation that includes, but is not limited to, benefits (medical, dental, vision, pharmacy), discretionary annual bonuses and merit increases, Flexible Spending Accounts, 403(b) savings matches, paid time off, career advancement opportunities, and resources to support employee and family well-being.

NOTE: This range is based on Boston-area data, and is subject to modification based on geographic location.
