Title: Business Intelligence Specialist
Description:
Power your future with Qualus in our Program Management department as a Data Analyst Level 1 (2-5 years of experience). The Data Analyst will be responsible for developing & maintaining project reporting to track and monitor the performance of the relevant organizations. Individual is responsible for analytical/reporting related tasks to aid in efficient monitoring of project costs, trends, and schedules to track the overall health of the project. Analytical thinking, transformation of data, and performance of compliance reviews & data validation for the functional area is required. 2-5 years experience.

Responsibilities


Discussing with management and relevant stakeholders to define goals/requirements
Gathers data/business intelligence from a variety of sources
Researching, developing and implementing data-gathering methods
Gathering, cleansing, modeling, and transformation of data
Develop reports and dashboards utilizing Power BI and other related interactive data visualization software
Ability to create customized calculations and measures
Summarizes data for review by executives, managers, clients, and stakeholders
Collaborating with coworkers and management to implement process improvements to support data integrity
Evaluate the effectiveness of generated output
Performs other related duties as assigned


Minimum Qualifications


Candiate must have 2-5 years of PowerBi experience and be able to build reports and maintain a PowerBI Dashboard.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including advanced data analysis, financial modeling, and reporting capabilities.
Experience with utility capital investment business models is preferred but not required.
Demonstrated financial management experience, including:
Cash flow forecasting and management for capital projects, including both internal labor and contractor-supported work.
Purchase Order (PO) financial tracking and oversight.
Financial risk assessment and mitigation to support achievement of investment objectives.
Capital portfolio financial planning, monitoring, and performance management.
Identification, evaluation, and communication of financial risks and opportunities.
Strong data management, analysis, and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex information into actionable insights.
Proven ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams, particularly between Project Management and Financial Management organizations.
Experience preparing and delivering executive and leadership-level reporting, including financial performance, portfolio status, risks, and investment outcomes.


Benefits & Compensation

Qualus benefits offered include Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short and Long-Term Disability, 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, EAP, Parental Leave, Paid time off, and Holidays, for those who qualify.

The final salary awarded for this role may vary from the above range based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs. The salary range provided in this job posting may be subject to change for business purposes.

Company Overview

Qualus is a leading pure-play power solutions firm and innovator at the forefront of power infrastructure transformation, with differentiated capabilities across grid modernization, resiliency, security, and sustainability. The firm partners with utilities, commercial, industrial, data center, and government clients, and renewable and energy storage developers, offering comprehensive solutions through boutique and integrated advisory, planning, engineering, digital solutions, program management, energy efficiency and specialized field services. Qualus also provides software and technology enabled services and develops breakthrough solutions for critical power industry challenges such as distributed and variable resource integration, emergency management, and secure data exchange. The firm has over 2,000 professionals, with offices throughout the U.S. and Canada.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We are committed to providing an inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on any grounds protected by applicable human rights legislation across Canada and the US.

We are committed to a secure and transparent hiring process. We do not request payment or sensitive personal information, such as Social Security numbers or banking details, during the application process. Please use caution and verify opportunities through our official channels.

AI Integration: Demonstrated proficiency using AI tools to accelerate analytical workflows, documentation, automation, and insight generation, with a strong ability to critically evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs against governed data.
Analytical & Commercial Mindset: Experience building and governing enterprise KPI frameworks, pipeline/forecasting models, and executive/Board reporting with the ability to translate complex technical findings into actionable commercial insights.
Collaborative Leadership: A track record of working across departments (Operations, Finance, Sales, CX, Product) to align on metric definitions, establish single-source-of-truth frameworks, and drive consensus.
Adaptability & Rigor: High standard of intellectual independence and curiosity, with the ability to bring clear recommendations—not just data—in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Title: Senior Product Data Analyst, Dealer
Description:
Who We Are

At CarGurus (NASDAQ: CARG), our mission is to give people the power to reach their destination. We started as a small team of developers determined to bring trust and transparency to car shopping. Since then, our history of innovation and go-to-market acceleration has driven industry-leading growth. In fact, we’re the largest and fastest-growing automotive marketplace, and we’ve been profitable for over 15 years.

What We Do

The market is evolving, and we are too, moving the entire automotive journey online and guiding our customers through every step. That includes everything from the sale of an old car to the financing, purchase, and delivery of a new one. Today, tens of millions of consumers visit CarGurus.com each month, and ~30,000 dealerships use our products. But they're not the only ones who love CarGurus—our employees do, too. We have a people-first culture that fosters kindness, collaboration, and innovation, and empowers our Gurus with tools to fuel their career growth. Disrupting a trillion-dollar industry requires fresh and diverse perspectives. Come join us for the ride!

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Product Data Analyst to join our Dealer team which tackles a complex data environment, building out core assets, running experiments, and many more unstructured analytics tasks to support the growth of the dealer product suite.

Our Product Data Analytics org as a whole supports our Product and Engineering teams, providing the final word on all analytics for CarGurus’ user and dealer experiences. We are looking for thoughtful, curious, internally driven candidates who can dive into complex data and draw novel, insightful conclusions.

What You’ll Do


Conduct exploratory empirical analyses using SQL and Python that bridge disparate data sources (e.g. website usage, subscription records, inventory volumes, etc.). to quantify product performance, user behavior, and/or market trends. Distill unstructured “big data” around product performance, user behavior and/or market insights into actionable outcomes.
Creatively compress sweeping, high-level exploratory requests into specific calculations that address your stakeholders’ underlying needs. Relentlessly dig into the data, taking initiative to consult with other individuals and teams as you judge necessary. Go beyond the letter of the initial assignment, to hammer out any anomalies or self-direct your inquiry into other relevant issues.
Advocate and participate in brainstorming/planning sessions for specific, data-driven product innovations that help further high-level company strategy, primarily in partnership with the Product/Engineering teams.
Avoid passivity in the face of flawed proposals; tactfully and persuasively push back against potential missteps.
Craft, audit and improve metrics that define business success, condensing abstract or loosely-defined concepts down to concrete calculations.
Experiment with new kinds of visualizations, build intuitive dashboards and other visual monitoring tools to guide daily decision-making by senior stakeholders and the company at large. Re-work underlying code to appropriately structure visualization inputs.
Communicate and present complex quantitative findings in easily digestible terms to company leadership, homing in on key takeaways. Concretely and informatively respond to any probing, on-the-spot follow-up questions from senior decision-makers.
Conceive of new data assets and build automated transformations (via DBT, LookML, etc.) to bring them to fruition.
Partner with Data Engineering teams to advance core data modeling/architecture (e.g. user clickstream logging), by optimizing, integrating, and distilling large raw datasets and metadata.
Draw upon prior experience with expansive, unrefined datasets to fix modeling bottlenecks in quick, scalable, outside-of-the-box ways.
Use Claude Code and agentic workflows to automate, accelerate, and escalate the sophistication of your analyses.
Be comfortable escalating and automating your analyses using R/Python scripting.


What You’ll Bring


4+ years of experience in analytics, ideally involving complex modeling, quantitative analysis and applied statistics 2+ years of experience communicating the high-impact results of analyses to leadership teams to influence strategy
Hands-on experience leveraging GenAI to optimize workflows and agentic coding platforms like Claude Code (preferred) or Cursor
Expert fluency in SQL. A strong background with either R or Python is highly desirable.
Second-nature understanding of core statistical concepts (regression, significance testing, omitted variable bias, independence/dependence, etc.)
Willingness to step outside your role and independently come up with novel ideas for the business.
Willingness to challenge others’ ideas and advocate for your own.
Strong project planning skills, with experience building roadmaps, estimating required resources, and flagging inter-dependencies with other teams/projects.
Preferred tools/programs: Snowflake, Snowplow, dbt, Claude Code or Cursor, Looker/Omni, Jira, Salesforce, Google/MS suite


The displayed range represents the expected annual base salary / On-Target Earnings (OTE) for this position. On-Target Earnings (OTE) is inclusive of base salary and on-target commission earnings, which applies exclusively to sales roles.

Individual pay within this range is determined by work location and other factors such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

This annual base salary forms part of a comprehensive Total Rewards Package. In addition to benefits, this role may qualify for discretionary bonuses/incentives and Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).

Position Pay Range

$120,000—$151,000 USD

Working at CarGurus

We reward our Gurus’ curiosity and passion with best-in-class benefits and compensation, including equity for all employees, both when they start and as they continue to grow with us. Our career development and corporate giving programs, as well as our employee resource groups (ERGs) and communities, help people build connections while making an impact in personally meaningful ways. A flexible hybrid model and robust time off policies encourage work-life balance and individual well-being. Thoughtful perks like daily free lunch, a new car discount, meditation and fitness apps, commuting cost coverage, and more help our people create space for what matters most in their personal and professional lives.

CarGurus may require in-person interviews as part of our hiring process, particularly for positions based in our Boston and Dublin offices. Candidates selected for an in-person interview will be notified in advance. Please be aware that travel expenses are the responsibility of the candidate.

We welcome all

CarGurus strives to be a place to which people can bring the ultimate expression of themselves and their potential—starting with our hiring process. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. We foster an inclusive environment that values people for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. That’s why we hope you’ll apply even if you don’t check every box listed in the job description. We also encourage you to tell your recruiter if you require accommodations to participate in our hiring process due to a disability so we can provide the appropriate support. We want to know what only you can bring to CarGurus.

Title: Senior Customer Operations Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Customer Operations Data Analyst - hybrid role based in Lexington, MA

About Mimecast

The work people build is worth protecting, and it's harder to protect than it used to be. AI agents now move at machine speed with human-level access, and a small slip-up can become a very public one. We disrupt cybercriminal activity before that happens. We think fast, go big, and always demand more of ourselves. We work hard, deliver, and repeat. We grow with real determination and put success well within reach. We push each other to be better and expect to be pushed back, in a community built on respect, where everyone is counted. Work Protected.

Overview

As the analytical backbone of our Customer Experience & Delivery (CxD) organization, you’ll provide the insight that helps leaders across Support, Professional Services, Customer Success, and Renewals make better decisions. You’ll own metrics and reporting for each function, identify risk across the customer base, and deliver timely analysis of operational performance, customer cohorts, process bottlenecks, and emerging issues.

You’ll partner closely with CxD leaders to turn ambiguous business questions into clear, actionable insights. You’ll also work alongside Mimecast’s corporate AI team and CxD’s AI initiatives to define success measures and evaluate the customer and operational impact of AI-driven tools. This highly visible senior individual contributor role is suited to someone equally comfortable building recurring dashboards and pressure-testing a hypothesis with ad hoc SQL.

This role reports to a Manager or Director within CxD Operations & Analytics and is remote or hybrid in line with Mimecast’s location policy.

What You'll Do


Design, build, and maintain recurring dashboards and reporting for Support, Professional Services, Customer Success, and Renewals, covering metrics such as SLA and CSAT performance, ticket volume and resolution time, utilization, engagement, and renewal and retention rates
Analyze usage, support, engagement, and financial data to identify at-risk accounts and segments, refine risk-scoring approaches, and proactively surface emerging trends to CxD leadership
Deliver timely deep-dive analyses of operational performance, customer cohorts, process bottlenecks, and emerging issues, with clear findings and actionable recommendations
Partner directly with CxD function leaders to understand evolving data needs, define and refine KPIs, and translate ambiguous business questions into structured analyses
Mine operational data to identify cross-functional trends and connect insights that individual teams may not see on their own
Partner with Mimecast’s corporate AI team and CxD AI workstreams to define success metrics, track project performance, and measure the impact of AI-driven tools on customer and operational outcomes
Validate the accuracy and integrity of data from systems such as Salesforce, Gainsight, Zendesk or ServiceNow, and Snowflake, resolving or escalating quality issues at the source
Automate recurring reporting and develop self-service analytics that enable CxD teams to answer routine questions independently


What You'll Bring


A bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Analytics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Substantial experience independently delivering data analysis, business intelligence, or operations analytics in a complex environment, ideally within customer support, customer success, or professional services
Advanced SQL skills and experience querying and modeling large datasets in a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, Redshift, or BigQuery
Proficiency with a BI and visualization platform such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker
Hands-on experience with CRM or customer success platforms such as Salesforce, Gainsight, Zendesk, or ServiceNow
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including pivot tables and complex formulas
Strong business acumen and the ability to translate data into clear, actionable recommendations for non-technical stakeholders
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence presenting findings directly to functional leaders
The judgment and autonomy to manage multiple concurrent requests and prioritize effectively in a fast-moving environment
Experience using Python or R for statistical analysis, forecasting, or risk and propensity modeling is advantageous
Familiarity with AI and machine learning concepts, including partnering with data science or AI teams to define and track success metrics, is advantageous
Experience in SaaS, cybersecurity, or enterprise technology, particularly building customer health scores or churn and renewal risk models, is advantageous
Familiarity with workflow automation and self-service BI adoption practices is advantageous


The base salary range for this position is $124,000−$186,000 plus benefits. This range represents the minimum and maximum new hire compensation for this role. The position may also be eligible for incentive plans and additional benefits, in accordance with company policy and local regulations. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location with individual compensation also dependent on factors such as qualifications, experience, and skills. Final offers will reflect these considerations and may vary accordingly.

Belonging at Mimecast

Cybersecurity is a community effort. That’s why we’re committed to building an inclusive, diverse community that celebrates and welcomes everyone – unless they’re a cybercriminal, of course.

We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, and we’d encourage you to join us whatever your background. We particularly welcome applicants from traditionally underrepresented groups.

We consider everyone equally: your race, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, ability, marital status, nationality, or any other protected characteristic won’t affect your application.

If you require any adjustments or accommodations due to a disability, or any other reason that may help you in your interview process, please let us know by emailing careers@mimecast.com.

Due to certain obligations to our customers, an offer of employment will be subject to your successful completion of applicable background checks, conducted in accordance with local law.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment.

Description:
As a leading financial services and healthcare technology company based on revenue, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has 27,000+ employees in 35 countries. Some 20,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology.

Job Description

Job Title Enterprise Marketing Data Analyst – Cross-Functional Insights & Visualization

Locations: Boston, MA, New York, NY | Hybrid

About The Role

Join SS&C’s Corporate Marketing team and help shape a globally recognized brand powered by data-driven insight. This role plays a critical part in defining how marketing performance is measured, understood, and communicated across integrated campaigns, digital channels, and corporate initiatives worldwide. You will transform complex datasets into clear, compelling insights that guide strategy, optimize investment, and elevate executive decision-making. If you’re passionate about blending analytics, storytelling, and brand impact to drive growth in a global financial technology leader, this role offers the opportunity to make a visible, lasting impact.

Why Join SS&C

SS&C combines proprietary technology with deep industry expertise to support complex financial and health care operations. Our teams design, implement, and operate solutions that help clients manage data, automate processes, and scale their businesses with confidence.

You will work with industry experts, modern platforms, and evolving technologies, gaining exposure to real-world operational challenges and large-scale enterprise environments.

How You Will Make An Impact

Cross-Functional Data Partnership


Engage with business units to understand their data needs, processes, and KPIs.
Map and document the data landscape across systems (CRM, MAP, web analytics, advertising platforms, product data, etc.).
Serve as the primary analytics liaison, ensuring marketing has accurate, accessible, and trusted data to support decision-making.
Translate business challenges into clear analytical requirements and data solutions.


Analytics, Insights & Storytelling


Analyze marketing performance across channels, segments, and lifecycle stages to identify trends, gaps, and growth opportunities.
Transform complex datasets into concise insights that marketing leaders can act on.
Develop insights frameworks that support campaign optimization, ROI analysis, attribution, funnel performance, and forecasting.
Present findings with clarity, business context, and recommendations.


Data Visualization & Dashboard Development


Design and build intuitive, executive-ready dashboards using platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar.
Automate reporting to eliminate manual processes and improve data accuracy and speed.
Ensure dashboards emphasize clarity, trust, and storytelling—not just data display.
Maintain and evolve a library of standardized metrics, definitions, and reporting models.


Data Quality, Governance & Process Improvement


Identify and resolve data quality issues across systems; partner with RevOps, IT, and Data Engineering on remediation.
Contribute to governance frameworks, ensuring consistent KPI definitions across the organization.
Recommend improvements to data pipelines, integrations, and enrichment processes.


Required Experience


3–7+ years of experience in Marketing Analytics, Marketing Operations, Business Intelligence, or Data Analysis.
Strong data visualization skills with hands-on experience in BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Qlik, Domo, etc.).
Proficiency in SQL and structured data manipulation.
Experience with CRM (Salesforce), marketing automation tools (Marketo, HubSpot, Eloqua), and digital analytics platforms (GA4, Adobe Analytics).
Ability to translate data into clear insights and recommendations for non-technical audiences.
Strong communication, storytelling, and stakeholder-management skills.


What Sets You Apart (preferred Qualifications)


Experience in B2B SaaS, financial services, technology, or other data-driven environments.
Familiarity with attribution models, pipeline analysis, and forecasting.
Experience with AWS, Snowflake, BigQuery, dbt, or similar tools.
Background in statistics, predictive modeling, or experimentation.

Title: Claims Analyst
Description:
The Claims Analyst will be responsible for supporting the effective management of claims portfolios through data analysis, forecasting, and reporting, providing insights into claim trends and financial performance to inform decision-making in line with Group Claims processes.




Responsibilities

Analyze claims data across managed portfolios to identify trends, patterns, and key drivers of loss performance
Support claims forecasting activities, including projections of loss development, reserves, and financial outcomes
Prepare and maintain regular management reporting on claims performance, key metrics, and emerging trends
Partner with Claims, Finance, Actuary, IT, and Operations teams to validate data accuracy and ensure consistency across reporting outputs
Monitor and analyze variances between actuals and forecasts, providing insights and recommendations to support decision-making
Develop and enhance reporting tools, dashboards, and data models to improve visibility into claims performance
Support the identification and remediation of unreconciled data, reporting, and systems-related gaps impacting claims analytics and forecasting capabilities
Contribute to initiatives aimed at improving consistency and standardization across claims processes, including controls, KPIs, and governance practices
Provide analytical support for portfolio reviews, including evaluation of resource needs, alignment with forecasted claims outcomes, and overview of portfolio performance
Assist in tracking and prioritizing operational and reporting improvements to enhance readiness, scalability, and overall claims performance
Ensure data integrity and compliance with internal controls, reporting standards, and Group Claims policies
Work with external stakeholders to fulfill any claims related requests, including loss runs, data calls and other time-sensitive matters
Support ad hoc analysis requests related to claims performance, portfolio trends, and emerging risks




Requirements

2–6+ years of relevant experience in insurance, claims analytics, or financial/data analysis
Experience working with large data sets, including reporting, trend analysis, and performance monitoring
Strong analytical capability and problem-solving skills, including experience with data modeling, forecasting, and variance analysis
Advanced Excel Skills (e.g., Pivot Tables and Lookup Formulas) proficiency with BI tools (e.g., Power BI, SQL ,SAP, or similar analytics platforms) and PowerPoint skills strongly desired
Solid understanding of insurance and/or reinsurance business models, with exposure to claims operations preferred
Strong business writing and reporting skills, with the ability to present insights clearly and concisely
Demonstrated attention to detail and a high level of data accuracy
Ability to translate data into actionable insights to support business decision-making
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across all levels of the Claims, Finance, IT, and Operations teams
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment
High level of motivation and creativity to identify and develop new strategies and approaches to problems, creating efficiencies in existing and new processes
Must be legally authorized to work in USA.
Limited travel may be required.

American Technology Consulting (ATC) is a service-first tech company dedicated to helping businesses unlock their full potential through innovative technology solutions. We empower organizations to leverage data for smarter decisions and meaningful impact. At ATC, we foster a culture of growth and invite passionate individuals to join our team, contribute to impactful projects, and excel as data-driven problem solvers. We embrace diversity and welcome candidates from all educational and professional backgrounds, including recent Master’s graduates without prior technical experience.


Job Overview:

As an Entry-Level Data Analyst at ATC, you will be at the forefront of turning raw data into actionable insights. This role offers a fantastic opportunity to work on real-world challenges, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and apply your problem-solving skills in a supportive and innovative environment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Collect, clean, and organize data to prepare it for analysis.
  • Identify trends, patterns, and correlations using statistical and analytical tools.
  • Develop insightful dashboards, visualizations, and reports using tools like Tableau, Power BI, or Excel.
  • Assist teams in making data-driven decisions by presenting clear and concise insights.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver solutions.
  • Ensure data accuracy and consistency through validation and quality checks.
  • Stay updated on industry trends, best practices, and new data tools or technologies.


Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and a willingness to learn data visualization tools like Tableau or Power BI.
  • Excellent communication skills to present findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • Candidates must have U.S. work authorization.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Internship or project experience in data analysis or visualization.
  • Familiarity with SQL for querying and managing databases.
  • Knowledge of statistical concepts and tools like Python or R (a plus but not required).


What We Offer:

  • Career Growth: Opportunity to advance in a dynamic and supportive work environment.
  • Mentorship: Guidance and training from experienced professionals in the field.
  • Diversity in Projects: Work across various industries and innovative technologies.

  • H1B sponsorship or related visa support for eligible candidates.

Title: Senior Quality Data Analyst
Description:
When you join the growing BILH team, you're not just taking a job, you’re making a difference in people’s lives.

Under the direction of the System Director, Quality and/or System Director, Quality Analytics, the Senior Quality Data Analyst supports quality, safety, patient experience, regulatory, equity and strategic performance analytics across the health system. This role leverages software applications to design advanced reporting and analytic solutions, develops predictive and analytic solutions, performs detailed data mapping and analysis, and translates complex data into actionable insights for operational, financial and strategic decision-making.

The Senior Quality Data Analyst serves as a primary analytic point of contact and analytics consultant for assigned quality and operational areas and works as a strategic business partner with leaders and teams to produce data that assists in key decision-making, quality improvement, regulatory readiness, and enhanced patient outcomes. The role leads enterprise-level analytic initiatives, coordinates complex cross-functional projects, and provides subject matter expertise in quality measurement, regulatory reporting, and performance analytics. This position requires intellectual curiosity, strong technical and analytic skills, and the ability to manage multiple complex data projects simultaneously.

The Senior Quality Data Analyst utilizes hospital systems, databases, reporting tools, and business intelligence applications to update, analyze, visualize, and disseminate data. This role maintains the integrity and quality of data by understanding workflows, validating source data and metric logic, and translating business needs into technical specifications for reports, dashboards, and analytic products. The position also serves as an enterprise resource for data governance, reporting standards, and performance measurement, while identifying opportunities to enhance analytics through automation, emerging technologies, and artificial intelligence.

Job Description

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Complex Data Projects & Stakeholder Partnership


Manages multiple complex data projects related to quality, safety, patient experience, regulatory performance, health equity, and internal system goals.
Leads enterprise-level analytic initiatives spanning multiple hospitals, departments, and business functions, coordinating complex workstreams and balancing competing organizational priorities.
Serves as a primary analytics consultant for assigned business units, departments, committees, or enterprise-wide quality initiatives by defining analytic requirements, interpreting findings, and recommending data-driven actions.
Works collaboratively with operational, clinical, administrative and executive leaders to translate business needs and strategic objectives into analytic solutions, performance measures, and actionable insights that support operational and financial decision-making, quality improvement, regulatory readiness, and enhanced patient outcomes.
Provides subject matter expertise for quality measurement methodologies, regulatory reporting programs, public reporting, value-based purchasing, and performance improvement initiatives.
Provides consultative expertise to senior leaders on performance improvement opportunities, regulatory strategy, public reporting implications, and organizational benchmarking.


Data Reporting, Visualization & Dashboard Development


Designs, develops, maintains, and enhances reporting and analysis tools, including dashboards, scorecards, data visualizations, recurring reports, and ad hoc analyses.
Creates reports and dashboards that track multidimensional performance against system, regional, hospital, department, service line, regulatory, and quality improvement goals.
Draws upon advanced technical skills, including programming and/or query skills, business intelligence and data visualization tools to display key results, including trends, variation, control charts, failure rates, stratified analyses, and other displays that support clear communication through data.
Prepares comprehensive reports, dashboards, summaries, and presentations for technical and non-technical audiences.
Develops predictive models, scenario analyses, and forecasting tools to estimate organizational performance under value-based purchasing, regulatory, contractual, reimbursement, and public reporting programs.
Transforms complex analytic findings into executive-level insights that identify emerging risks, incentive opportunities, and reputational indicators to support strategic planning.


Data Analysis, Mapping & Insight Generation


Leverages software applications to design solutions, perform complex data mapping and analysis, and generate business, clinical, regulatory, and quality intelligence.
Extracts, integrates, and analyzes data from multiple internal and external sources. Audits data, investigates discrepancies, resolves issues, and collaborates with appropriate teams to address data quality concerns.
Interprets complex data, validates analytic findings, and ensures analyses are accurate, complete, and actionable to support organizational decision-making.
Performs advanced statistical, comparative, and trend analyses to identify performance drivers, evaluate interventions, quantify organizational risk, and support evidence-based decision-making.
Synthesizes complex analytic findings into strategic recommendations that influence organizational priorities, regulatory compliance, financial incentives, and quality improvement efforts.


Data Integrity, Metric Stewardship & Documentation


Ensures the integrity, quality and standardization of data meets operational requirements, reporting standards, regulatory specifications and organizational goals.
Translates business needs and reporting requirements into technical specifications, metric definitions, analytic methods, and report production processes.
Develops and maintains documentation of analytic methods, metric development, dashboard logic, data dictionaries, and report production processes.
Acts as a system resource and integral member of data integrity and governance, analytics, and reporting efforts.
Serves as an enterprise resource for data governance, analytic methodologies, reporting standards, and performance measurement to ensure consistency across the health system.
Identifies opportunities and leads initiatives to automate reporting processes, improve analytic efficiency, and enhance data governance practices through emerging technologies and advanced analytics.


Collaboration, Dissemination & User Support


Collaborates with Information Systems, Data Governance, Quality, Patient Safety, Regulatory, Patient Experience, Performance Improvement, clinical leaders, and operational teams to develop, maintain, and optimize reporting applications, analytics solutions and data sources.
Oversees routine and ad hoc dissemination of key information to stakeholders, including weekly, monthly, quarterly, executive, governance, regulatory, and operational reporting as assigned.
Evaluates the utility of reporting methods and visual representations to improve communication, usability, and decision-making through data.
Provides analytic expertise and guidance to stakeholders and may serve as a team leader for projects or work groups, fostering collaboration, improving workflows, and supporting successful project execution.
Mentors analysts and serves as a technical resource for advanced analytic methodologies, reporting standards, data visualization best practices, and quality measurement.
Supports organizational education related to quality initiatives, regulatory programs, performance metrics, and analytic reporting by developing training materials, metric definitions, documentation, user guides, and educational resources for stakeholders.
Partners with clinical, operational, and technical teams to evaluate, implement, and optimize artificial intelligence (AI), large language model (LLM), and automation solutions that improve data abstraction, registry reporting, regulatory workflows, and analytic efficiency.
Serves as a quality and safety subject matter expert to support development, validation, and governance of AI-enabled analytic tools and prompt frameworks to ensure accurate, reliable, and responsible use in analytics for actionable improvement efforts.


Strategic Performance Analytics


Leads analytic support for enterprise regulatory reporting and value-based performance programs, including CMS, Joint Commission, Leapfrog, NHSN, HEDIS, AHRQ, patient experience, and other federal, state, commercial, and accreditation reporting requirements.
Coordinates enterprise reporting calendars, regulatory submission timelines, validation/audit activities, and reporting dependencies to ensure timely and accurate submission of required deliverables.
Develops predictive analytics, scenario modeling, and performance forecasting that incorporate anticipated changes to regulatory and performance measurement programs to estimate organizational performance, reimbursement, incentive payments, penalties, and publicly reported ratings.
Monitors regulatory updates and evolving measurement specifications, assesses organizational impact, and recommends reporting, analytic, and operational strategies to support organizational readiness.
Synthesizes organizational performance trends, external benchmarks, and quality intelligence into strategic recommendations that support executive decision-making, organizational priorities, and long-term planning.


Minimum Qualifications

Education


Bachelor's degree required in Computer Science, Mathematics, Allied Health, Public Health, Health Informatics, Healthcare Administration, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
Master's degree in Public Health, Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Health Informatics, Healthcare Administration, Data Analytics, or equivalent preferred.


Licensure, Certification & Registration


CPHQ, Lean Six Sigma, Epic, Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, SQL, data analytics, healthcare quality, or related certification preferred.


Experience


Five to eight years of related work experience required.
Strong experience in data management, report writing, analytics, visualization, dashboard creation, and interpretation of large data sets required.
Experience using multiple data sources, hospital systems, relational databases, business intelligence tools, or reporting applications required.
Experience with quality, safety, regulatory, patient experience, population health, or performance improvement data preferred.
Experience with predictive modeling, machine learning technologies, or advanced analytic methods preferred.


Skills, Knowledge & Abilities


Advanced proficiency with data analysis, reporting, and visualization tools such as SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Excel, Epic SlicerDicer, SAS, R, Python, or similar tools.
Advanced technical computer skills as required for technical support specific to functional area and related systems.
Ability to translate business needs and stakeholder questions into technical specifications, analytic plans, dashboards, reports, and actionable insights.
Strong understanding of healthcare quality, safety, patient experience, regulatory, and performance measurement programs.
Ability to validate data, troubleshoot discrepancies, and ensure accuracy and consistency of reporting.
Ability to analyze complex data, identify meaningful trends, and communicate findings clearly to technical, clinical, operational, and executive audiences.
Strong data storytelling skills, including the ability to display key results through effective visualizations and concise interpretation.
Ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously and complete analytic work in a timely and efficient manner.
Strong collaboration skills and ability to build effective working relationships across departments and disciplines.
Commitment to health equity, transparency, continuous improvement, and using data to support organizational learning and better outcomes.


Preferred Qualifications & Skills


Working knowledge of programming or query languages such as SQL, Python, R, or similar tools preferred.
Experience with business intelligence tools for data visualization, dashboard development, and report automation, such as Power BI, Tableau, Epic reporting tools, or similar platforms preferred.
Understanding of data management, data manipulation, and interpretation of large databases in a healthcare or medical center environment preferred.


Pay Range

$75,000.00 USD - $125,000.00 USD

The pay range listed for this position is the annual base salary range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at this time. Actual compensation is determined based on several factors, that may include seniority, education, training, relevant experience, relevant certifications, geography of work location, job responsibilities, or other applicable factors permissible by law.

Title: Senior Data Analyst (Hybrid)
Description:
When you join the growing BILH team, you're not just taking a job, you’re making a difference in people’s lives.

Seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager & Data Analyst to support grants management operations and reporting across Beth Israel Lahey Health (BILH). The Senior Project Manager & Data Analyst will serve as a liaison between grants management stakeholders, technical teams, and system business analysts ensuring the accuracy and integrity of data within the grants management system and related applications. This role will manage data elements, system interactions, and reporting requirements while developing dashboards, management reports, and analytics for leadership and other stakeholders. The position will define and oversee the reporting pipeline for the various grants operations groups, including the selection, validation, and integration of data elements from the grants management system into the enterprise data warehouse to support consistent reporting and analytics. The role will collaborate closely with Grants Administration, Finance, Compliance, Information Systems, and other ancillary groups to support informed decision-making, process improvement, and the effective use of grants management and compliance data. Successful candidates will have demonstrated experience with enterprise data lake queries (like SnowFlake), familiarily with ELT processes, report and dashboard design, and ad hoc reporting using SQL tools and PowerBI.

Leverages software applications to design solutions, performs detailed data mapping and analysis and reviews all data for accuracy and reasonableness prior to distribution. Produces business, research or clinical intelligence.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities:


Manages one or more complex data projects. Utilizes hospital systems and database applications to update and analyze data. Prepares and distributes various reports to key stakeholders. Meets with departmental leadership to review reports or requests for data.
Maintains integrity and quality of data and assures data conformity meets operational requirements and goals. Acts as a central resource and integral member of data collection team. Assists in planning, establishing and monitoring criteria for data collection. Trains department staff on data acquisition methods. Extracts data from multiple sources. Audits and resolves all issues.
Ensures application access is in compliance with all regulatory and medical center practices. Acts as gatekeeper for application. Sets and defines user access and determines level of access. Reports all security risks to the application.
Collaborates with IS to obtain and maintain applications used for data collection and reporting. Recommends tools, upgrades and alternatives. Assists in the development of application security and back-up plans. Coordinates interface solution with multiple applications.
Designs and develops reporting and analysis tools. Interprets data and refines analysis. Prepares and presents comprehensive reports. Develops forms, tables and other data tools in the applications that capture, report and consolidate data. Provides application data collection, analytics and reporting expertise. Completes analytics in a timely and efficient manner.
Prepares weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports/dashboards and/or data submissions department.


Required Qualifications


Bachelor's degree required in Computer Science, Allied Health, or related field.
3-5 years related work experience required.
1-3 years of multiple application maintenance with relational databases.
Advanced technical computer skills as required for technical support specific to functional area and related systems.


Preferred Qualifications


Application Certification for one of the applications used in the department.


Competencies

Written Communications:

Ability to summarize and communicate in English moderately complex information in varied written formats to internal and external customers.

Oral Communications

Ability to comprehend and communicate complex verbal information in English to medical center staff, patients, families and external customers.

Knowledge

Ability to demonstrate in-depth knowledge of concepts, practices and policies with the ability to use them in complex varied situations.

Teamwork

Ability to act as a team leader for small projects or work groups, creating a collaborative and respectful team environment and improving workflows. Results may impact the operations of one or more departments.

Customer Service

Ability to provide a high level of customer service to patients, visitors, staff and external customers in a professional, service-oriented, respectful manner using skills in active listening and problem solving. Ability to remain calm in stressful situations.

Physical Nature Of The Job

Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally in carrying, lifting, pushing, pulling objects. Sitting most of the time, with walking and standing required only occasionally.

Pay Range

$74,880.00 USD - $124,800.00 USD

Title: CEMA Business Intel Analyst
Description:
Job Description


Do you love to improve business processes and drive improvement through data analytics? Are you looking for a role that supports a diverse and growing portfolio developing and producing the most advanced electronic systems that protect our warfighters? Are you inspired to join an organization with a strong culture that’s focused on ensuring we hear all voices, being brilliant on the basics, and developing our teams and leaders? BAE systems put our customers first – exemplified by our mission “We Protect Those Who Protect Us®. Come join our team!

We are seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst who will partner with a diverse team of directors, managers, engineers, technicians, and operators to develop solutions for gathering and analyzing data to help overcome challenges and improve business execution. The role requires use of your process knowledge to rapidly translate complex data into actionable insights, improving data accuracy and automation to accelerate ramp to rate, and serve as the factory‑floor liaison to ensure that quantitative findings lead to tangible quality and throughput gains. Candidates must have strong analytical, statistical, and communication skills, a solid foundation in manufacturing processes, and thrive in fast‑paced, dynamic environments.



Key Responsibilities



Partner with cross‑functional teams to turn production data into insights that boost product yield, flow, and cost efficiency.
Be a spokesperson for the factories and get involved in the design, testing, and implementation of dashboards and other data tools with the Analytics Team.
Use data analysis to determine areas for improved process yields, flows, on-time delivery and cost savings measures.
Work directly with the process and product teams to implement improvements.
Champion the implementation of AI solutions and assistants to the factory end users.


If you want an exciting opportunity in a fast-paced environment, where you can partner with a diverse team and contribute to our mission, then this position will provide tremendous professional and personal satisfaction.



Required Education, Experience, & Skills



Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of related work experience
Experience with manufacturing standards, processes and techniques
Strong technical skills in data analysis
Strong communication skills
Experience working in cross functional teams
Experience using dashboards and reporting for business intelligence
Experience using GenAI models for analysis




Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills



Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or a technical field
Background in data analytics or data science
Experience with Mat lab, Python, SQL, or other programming language
Experience in project management
Process or Product Engineering experience
New product introduction experience
Proven success with change management in a fast-paced, manufacturing environment



Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $118095 - $200762

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.



About BAE Systems Electronic Systems


BAE Systems, Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary of BAE Systems plc, an international defense, aerospace and security company which delivers a full range of products and services for air, land and naval forces, as well as advanced electronics, security, information technology solutions and customer support services. Improving the future and protecting lives is an ambitious mission, but it’s what we do at BAE Systems. Working here means using your passion and ingenuity where it counts – defending national security with breakthrough technology, superior products, and intelligence solutions. As you develop the latest technology and defend national security, you will continually hone your skills on a team—making a big impact on a global scale. At BAE Systems, you’ll find a rewarding career that truly makes a difference. Electronic Systems (ES) is the global innovator behind BAE Systems’ game-changing defense and commercial electronics. Exploiting every electron, we push the limits of what is possible, giving our customers the edge and our employees opportunities to change the world. Our products and capabilities can be found everywhere – from the depths of the ocean to the far reaches of space. At our core are more than 14,000 highly talented Electronic Systems employees with the brightest minds in the industry, we make an impact – for our customers and the communities we serve.

Strong written and oral communication

Title: Analyst II, GTM Analytics & BI
Description:
Meet Our Team


PLEASE NOTE: We are currently considering candidates who are within a commutable distance of our Waltham office and those who wouldn't require sponsorship now or in the future.***


Our team stands at the forefront of data analytics, leveraging cutting-edge technology including generative AI to create sophisticated data products. We are passionate about driving data driven decisions and scaling our business that leads to positive business outcomes. We’ve built relationships as trusted business partners to our stakeholders and are constantly looking for ways to improve how we work and look at our business. The team is highly collaborative within Pega and a team first approach. We work with a high sense of excellence and urgency to deliver the best possible work product to drive results. The team values collaboration, learning, and mentorship, and provides a strong environment for analysts to grow their skills and impact.

Picture Yourself At Pega

You will be part of a highly innovative company, changing how companies work and optimizing their outcomes. In this role you will be part of a collaborative team that is well versed and skilled in their space. You will be an adaptive/flexible change agent driving data driven decisioning while seeing the benefits of your hard work turn into business outcomes. You'll work alongside high-performing team members who are passionate about pushing the boundaries of what's possible with data analytics and AI.

What You'll Do At Pega

The Go-to-Market Analytics and Insights Analyst II will partner with other internal team members, as well as partners across the Go-to-Market function. This role will be a key business partner to these teams by building and maintaining data products to support actionable insights that help drive optimal business outcomes. You will contribute to ongoing analytics initiatives, help ensure data quality and consistency, and look for opportunities to improve how data is delivered and used across the business.

In This Role You Will


Build, maintain, and enhance dashboards, reports, and analytical data products used by GTM teams
Ensure data products deliver accurate, consistent, and actionable insights aligned to standardized KPI definitions and data models
Apply best practices in data visualization, performance optimization, and reporting design to improve usability and adoption
Contribute to the development and enhancement of data products that improve efficiency and support decision-making
Partner with stakeholders and team members to translate business needs into reporting and analytical outputs
Perform ad hoc analyses to uncover insights and support business performance
Contribute to the design and evolution of scalable analytical solutions and reporting approaches
Define requirements, logic, and structure for dashboards and analyses with guidance and feedback from team members
Help standardize reporting structures, KPI frameworks, and data product design
Identify opportunities to improve analytical approaches, reporting processes, and data quality
Collaborate on team initiatives exploring new tools, technologies, and analytical approaches (e.g., GenAI-enabled analytics, automation)
Support continuous improvement through documentation, process enhancements, and adoption of best practices


Who You Are

The ideal candidate has a solid foundation in reporting and analytics and contributes accurate, consistent outputs. You’re intellectually curious about data and how it drives business decisions, motivated to solve problems, and excited to continue developing your technical, analytical, and communication skills in a fast paced, collaborative environment. You take ownership of your work, actively seek learning opportunities through hands on experience, feedback, and mentorship, and contribute thoughtfully to team initiatives. You enjoy working with modern analytics tools and are energized by the opportunity to support meaningful business outcomes while steadily expanding your impact over time.


Solid foundation in reporting, data analysis, and visualization, with experience building and maintaining dashboards and reports
Detail-oriented with a focus on data accuracy, consistency, and alignment to defined metrics and business logic
Analytical thinker who connects data outputs to business context and supports actionable insights
Independently manages reporting and data-related tasks with guidance as needed
Organized and able to manage multiple priorities effectively
Identifies issues, asks clarifying questions, and progresses work to completion
Collaborates effectively with team members and stakeholders to deliver consistent outputs
Experience working with data tools across reporting, data management, and visualization
Continues to build skills in data modeling and scalable reporting approaches
Works in evolving problem spaces using structured, data-driven approaches


What You've Accomplished


Brought new innovative ideas and approaches to looking at data and reports that led to groundbreaking new insights.
Taken complex data/information and make it simple, scalable, and actionable that led to measurable business impact.
Established strong stakeholder relationships and provided support to ensure success.
Have turned data into trusted information used to drive decisions and actions.
Identified process gaps or areas for optimization while also helping drive it from design to completion.


Pega Offers You


Gartner Analyst acclaimed technology leadership across our categories of products
Continuous learning and development opportunities
An innovative, inclusive, agile, flexible, and fun work environment
Competitive global benefits program inclusive of pay + bonus incentive, employee equity in the company
Experience rapid professional growth through exposure to cutting-edge technology and complex business challenges
Opportunities to take ownership of significant projects that directly impact business outcomes
Contribute to shaping the future of our analytics capabilities
Remote work options
Flexible PTO policy
Culture that celebrates innovation and continuous learning


Additional Information

Base salary range for this role is 71,300 - 106,600 USD annually. This role may also be eligible for annual bonus OR commission, as well as benefits and other incentives.

The final compensation will be determined during the offer process based on the candidate's education, experience, skills, and qualifications, as well as market conditions and may vary from the posted range. We will share an information on benefits, bonus/commission, and other pay components for this role at the relevant recruitment stage.

Title: Customer Insights Analyst
Description:
Reporting to: SVP, Strategic Analytics

Department: Strategic Analytics

Location: Boston, MA (Hybrid)

Position Summary

Grand Circle Corporation is the leader in international travel, adventure and discovery for Americans aged 50+. Headquartered in Boston MA, and with more than 35 offices globally, more than two million Americans have traveled with our award-winning travel brands: Grand Circle Cruise Line, Overseas Adventure Travel and Grand Circle Travel.

We’re looking for a Customer Insights Analyst to transform how we understand and predict customer behavior. Embedded within the Strategic Analytics department, you will use data to shape brand development and bring value to customers and business teams. This role sits at the intersection of advanced analytics, customer intelligence, and business strategy.

Key Responsibilities


Analyze customer behavior patterns to identify actionable insights and opportunities for targeted marketing interventions
Collaborate with data engineering and BI to ensure data quality and reporting accessibility
Define and monitor KPIs that align with business objectives
Build conceptual dashboards that track customer journeys and identify optimization opportunities
Partner with brand, marketing, and other business teams to translate analytical findings into measurable business impact
Tell data-driven stories that convince and influence leaders using clear insights and recommendations
Develop predictive models for key business metrics including churn, lifetime value, and propensity scoring
Design and run experiments to test hypotheses about customer engagement and measure impact of strategic initiatives


Qualifications


2+ years in data analysis, preferably in a subscription or loyalty focused B2C environment
Advanced SQL proficiency (complex queries, window functions, and optimization)
Strong statistical foundation with hands-on experience in regression, classification, clustering, and time series analysis
Proficiency in Python or R for analysis and modeling
Experience with BI tools (Tableau, PowerBI, Looker, or similar)
Proven ability to communicate the results and recommendations of your analysis to senior leadership
Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or quantitative field


Technical Skills


Experience working with cloud data warehouses and large-scale datasets
Proficiency with version control and collaborative development practices
Understanding of data pipeline concepts and ETL processes
Familiarity with cloud computing platforms and services
Knowledge of data governance and security best practices


Nice to Have


Experience with customer data platforms or marketing automation
Knowledge of machine learning frameworks (scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow)
A/B testing and experimental design expertise
Familiarity with causal inference methodologies and experimentation techniques
Prior experience in travel or hospitality industry


Total Rewards

The base salary range for this role is $110,000 – $130,000 annually for employees based in Boston, MA. Final compensation may vary and will be determined based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, internal equity, and geographic location. In addition to base pay, this role is eligible for an annual incentive bonus and first-class benefits, which include:


Health & wellness: Comprehensive and heavily subsidized medical, dental, and vision plans, plus on-site gym access, holistic wellness sessions, and group fitness classes
Time for you: Substantial Paid Time Off (PTO), and 11 paid holidays- including Juneteenth, Memorial Day, and Labor Day – and Summer Fridays. Plus- extensive parental leave, with up to 12-16 weeks paid leave at 100% base salary.
Travel more, spend less: 50% off our trips for you and a companion, 25% for additional immediate family members, and exclusive quarterly associate travel deals
Your future, secured: 401(k) with company match, life insurance, and disability coverage
Continuous growth: Tuition assistance for both professional and personal development, opportunities for professional development through oversees travel, and direct access to Pinnacle Leadership & Team Development.
Extra perks: Commuter benefits, FSA options, pet insurance, home & auto discounts, and paid volunteer time off to give back to the community


To learn more, please visit our websites at www.gct.com, www.oattravel.com and www.grandcirclefoundation.org.

Ensuring that data is a competitive differentiator for our enterprise, the USRM Data Office sets strategic data product visions, governs data for quality and compliance, develops best in class data and reporting solutions, and continuously seeks to optimize the value that data creates for our customers and company. Our team includes data analysts, data stewards, data strategists, and data product owners — performance-driven individuals who make sure that data is appropriately leveraged across every layer of our business.

The Operational Data & Reporting team within USRM Data Office is seeking a Senior Data Solutions Analyst focusing on scalable data & reporting solutions and insights for a range of stakeholders within our Direct Distribution and Partnerships reporting team.

This position may have in-office requirements dependent upon candidate location

Candidates who live within 50 miles of Boston, MA; Portsmouth, NH; Seattle, WA; Columbus, OH; or Plano, TX will follow a hybrid schedule, coming into the office two days per week. Otherwise, this role is remote.

Responsibilities


Design and develop scalable data solutions with a focus on reusability that enable effective self-service data consumption and can describe their value to the customer.
Independently works on prototyping/developing data solutions that meet the needs of the organization and business customers. Coding scalable proof-of-concepts and solutions.
Stay up to date with advancements in data engineering, evaluate new tools and recommend adoption where appropriate.
Identify opportunities to apply Gen AI for data discovery, lineage summarization, automated documentation, query generation and developer productivity (prompt engineering and code generation)
Designs proof-of-concept solutions utilizing and advanced understanding of multiple coding languages to meet technical and business requirements with an ability to perform iterative solution testing to ensure specifications are met.
Strive to become a technical leader and mentor for the team, providing assistance & guidance to junior team members
Optimize and tune data infrastructure for performance, scalability, reliability and cost-efficiency
Prioritizes efforts based on customer value and can set expectations for deliverables of high complexity.
Ensure data solutions include activities and deliverables required to achieve high data quality and displays a strong understanding of complex, multi-tier, multi-platform systems, applying principles of metadata, lineage, business definitions, compliance and data security to project work.


The Ideal Candidate Will


Have strong technical aptitude with data manipulation, data wrangling and Reporting tools (SQL, Power Bi, SAS, Python cloud computing: AWS and Snowflake).
Demonstrate 3+ years of experience building production data pipelines, data solutions and Power Bi Dashboards.
Possess hands-on experience with data quality testing frameworks and practices,and experience implementing automated data tests and validation.
Have excellent communication skills and the ability to work with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
3-5+ years’ experience in coding for data management, data warehousing, or other data environments, including, but not limited to, ETL & scripting languages (Python)
3-5+ years’ experience with top quadrant Business Intelligence tools. Demonstrated technical knowledge and skills in coding languages and business intelligence tools (e.g., SQL, Power BI SAS, Python) and interest in expanding knowledge in this space.
Must possess strong analytical, strategic, project management, decision-making and problem-solving skills.
Direct Distribution domain knowledge preferred but not required.
Demonstrates a comprehensive understanding of new technologies as needed to progress initiative and ability to adapt
Able to describe value and support the prioritization of data solutions.
Able to organize and address customer pain points.


Qualifications


Strong written and oral communication skills required
Bachelor`s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related discipline preferred
Master`s in same or related disciplines strongly preferred
3-5 years experience in coding for data management, data warehousing, or other data environments, including, but not limited to, working in NoSQL implementation, ETL, Java, scripting languages (Python, Perl, Shell), and the Hadoop stack

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Title: Labor Relations Data and Reporting Analyst
Description:
Company Description

By working at Harvard University, you join a vibrant community that advances Harvard's world-changing mission in meaningful ways, inspires innovation and collaboration, and builds skills and expertise. We are dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming environment where everyone can thrive.

Why join Harvard University Central Administration?

Harvard University's Central Administration (CADM) is a 5,000+ employee organization that supports the university's overall excellence by understanding and serving the needs of its schools, students, faculty, staff, alumni, and surrounding communities. Through dynamic and collaborative partnerships, CADM provides high-quality and efficient services to the schools to help them achieve their goals.

Job Description

Job Summary:

Labor Relations Data and Reporting Analyst at Harvard leveraging strong analytical, communication, and people skills. This role plays a key role in delivering analytics to leaders responsible for strategy and decision-making. A critical aspect of this role is the focus on union data, where you will analyze union membership trends, contract metrics, and other union-related information to inform strategic decisions.

Job Specific Duties:

Collect, analyze, and disseminate union data across various business subject areas within Harvard. Provide support on diverse analyses and reporting services, including conducting complex statistical and quantitative analyses and presenting data through written reports, oral presentations, and graphical displays. Conducts specialized analysis of union staff data to identify trends and insights, providing actionable recommendations to HR leadership and union representatives.

This position will support a variety of operations including, but not limited to, gathering business requirements, serving as the primary contact for the community on using data to answer labor and union contract questions, troubleshooting problems, performing quality assurance of data and applications, providing project support, managing data access, maintaining data dictionaries, and other duties as required within Labor Relations (e.g., QlikView HR Analytics, Operational applications, and SQL).

Typical Core Duties:



Analyze data in a complex union environment, project management and consultative services during union negotiations.
Design and evaluate data sets; generate reports and tables of statistical results using a variety of tools (query and database).
Research, develop, and analyze metrics, particularly focusing on union data, to assist with union metrics and contract negotiations.
Conduct analyses of salary data, including collective bargaining impacts
Ensure compliance with University Human Resources policies, procedures, and applicable legal regulations, including ownership of and a specific focus on union agreements and labor laws.
Using formats that are meaningful to clients, develops dashboards, reports, written management summaries elucidating conclusions, and makes oral presentations when appropriate.
Participate in Union/Management joint committees
Manage policies owned by Labor and Employee Relations.


Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:



Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience required
Minimum of 5 years’ relevant work experience


Additional Qualifications and Skills:



Advanced knowledge of human resources and union specific data.
Experience working in a union environment.
Proficient in MS Office products, advanced Excel skills, experience with Power BI preferred.
Experience with creating and using financial models.
Experience working in higher education administration, business analytics, business intelligence, business administration, and/or information technology.
Strong oral and written communication skills.


Additional Information



Standard Hours/Schedule: 35 hours per week
Visa Sponsorship Information: Harvard University is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position
Pre-Employment Screening: Identity, Education
Other Information:

This position has a 90-day orientation and review period.

Work Format Details

This position has been determined by school or unit leaders that some of the duties and responsibilities can be effectively performed at a non-Harvard location. The work schedule and location will be set by the department at its discretion and based upon operational needs. When not working at a Harvard or Harvard-designated location, employees in hybrid positions must work in a Harvard registered state in compliance with the University’s Policy on Employment Outside of Massachusetts. Additional details will be discussed during the interview process. Certain visa types and funding sources may limit work location. Individuals must meet work location sponsorship requirements prior to employment.

Salary Grade and Ranges

This position is salary grade level 057. Please visit  Harvard's Salary Ranges  to view the corresponding salary range and related information.

Benefits

Harvard offers a comprehensive benefits package that is designed to support a healthy work-life balance and your physical, mental and financial wellbeing. Because here, you are what matters. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:



Generous paid time off including parental leave
Medical, dental, and vision health insurance coverage starting on day one
Retirement plans with university contributions
Wellbeing and mental health resources
Support for families and caregivers
Professional development opportunities including tuition assistance and reimbursement
Commuter benefits, discounts and campus perks


Learn more about these and additional benefits on our Benefits & Wellbeing Page.

EEO/Non-Discrimination Commitment Statement

Harvard University is committed to equal opportunity and non-discrimination. We seek talent from all parts of society and the world, and we strive to ensure everyone at Harvard thrives. Our differences help our community advance Harvard's academic purposes.

Harvard has an equal employment opportunity policy that outlines our commitment to prohibiting discrimination on the basis of race, ethnicity, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, religion, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law or identified in the university's non-discrimination policy. Harvard's equal employment opportunity policy and non-discrimination policy help all community members participate fully in work and campus life free from harassment and discrimination.
